25.17.4     Transport needs an explicit population bridge

Let S = 1 denote the source pilot and S = 0 the target branch, and define ps (x) = P (X = x |
S = s) and τ (x) = E[Y (1) − Y (0) | X = x, S = 1]. One sufficient route assumes consistency,
source treatment exchangeability, positive source treatment and response probabilities, valid
response adjustment within source covariates, and equality of conditional potential-outcome
means across S. It also requires source support wherever p0 (x) > 0. Under these restrictions,
iterated expectation gives

                                                p0 (X)
                              X                                      
                         τ0 =   p0 (x)τ (x) = E        τ (X) S = 1 .                       (25.40)
                              x                 p1 (X)

This is a project derivation for a declared finite-covariate regime. Equality of conditional
means is extra scientific information; it is not established by the existence of a weight column
or by the imputation procedure. Causal banking proposal project (2026bf)
   For clarity, write ea (x) = P (A = a | X = x, S = 1) and ra (x) = P (R = 1 | A = a, X =
x, S = 1). Under the same response restriction and positivity, each source conditional mean
can be written
                                        ⊮{A = a}RY
                                                                 
                           µa (x) = E                 X = x, S = 1 .                 (25.41)
                                         ea (x)ra (x)
Condition first on A = a and R = 1, cancel the treatment and response probabilities, then
apply the mean restriction and source causal assumptions. Substitution into equation (25.40)
gives a combined population, treatment and response-weight expression. It is not a variance
estimator: estimated nuisance models, sampling the target covariates, clustering and any use
of MI require a jointly justified inference procedure. Weights for these different purposes must
remain separately named.
   Suppose the source proportions of two customer strata are (4/5, 1/5) and the target propor-
tions are (1/5, 4/5). Conditional intervention effects are USD 10 and USD −10. The pilot’s
average effect is 6, the target’s is −6, and the population weights are 1/4 and 4. At an assumed
cost of USD 2, the pilot margin is USD 4 and the target margin is USD −8. The exact
reference also enumerates randomized treatment and four positive response rates, verifying
that the combined weighting expression recovers the stipulated target. No software error is
needed for the naive deployment decision to reverse: the wrong population suffices.Causal
banking proposal project (2026bf)
   If the source instead contains only the first stratum, the second effect is unobserved and
no finite reweighting creates its information. With the explicit restriction that the second
effect lies in [−10, 10], the target effect is 2 + (4/5)τ (1) ∈ [−6, 10], giving margin [−8, 8] at
cost 2. Without such a justified bound, even that interval cannot be asserted. An adapter
should report the support defect and any defensible identified set. Silently trimming the
second stratum changes the target population; silently predicting into it adds extrapolation
assumptions.Causal banking proposal project (2026bf)


25.17.5     Competitive position and a public qualification route

The documented commercial systems already provide substantive imputation, analysis and
diagnostic workflows. The proposal has not demonstrated a native replacement or superior
estimation performance. Its proposed contribution is to preserve the causal question and
its restrictions across those workflows: source and target populations, observation clocks,
missingness reasons, imputation identity, covariance semantics and explicit refusal. Licensed
isolated execution is a candidate integration route; public manuals do not grant redistribution
25.18. Dynamax reuse requires a declared conditional law and information clock                393


rights for the engines. EViews, Mplus and graphical-tool profiles cannot be ranked without
the missing originals, and prices remain unknown.StataCorp (2026z); SAS Institute (2026f);
IBM (2026c)
   A useful first prototype would compare a selected licensed procedure and an already re-
viewed open implementation on the same generated population, missingness law and estimand.
Complete-record analysis, complete-case analysis, single imputation, proper multiple impu-
tation and an explicitly specified response-weight procedure supply substantive alternatives.
Fix the causal target, sample law, interaction structure, number of imputations, diagnostic
and refusal rules before evaluation. Include MAR and MNAR cases, complete and missing
source support, compatible and incompatible imputation models, cluster sampling, changing
coefficient sets and unsuccessful fits. Report bias, coverage under the claimed regime, interval
width, unavailable requests, simulation error and full workflow cost. A sensitivity grid evaluates
robustness; it is not a device for choosing whichever assumption makes a preferred intervention
profitable.
   The library, CLI and MCP interfaces should carry the same request and result meaning.
Original and imputed data need stable unit and imputation identifiers, measurement types,
category references, passive transformations and sampling design. Results need per-imputation
estimates and covariance, pooled scale and degrees of freedom, convergence diagnostics,
population support and retained failures. An assistant can help locate technical passages,
propose models and explain sensitivity; it cannot infer the unobserved outcomes or authorize
a scientific assumption from fluent text. These public comparisons can establish whether the
proposed integration merits a more expensive bank experiment.


25.18      Dynamax reuse requires a declared conditional law and
           information clock
A servicing team may infer a borrower’s unobserved repayment propensity from payments,
contacts and changing account conditions. A state-space engine is a natural computational
component, but its likelihood must describe the experiment that generated those observations.
Treating an adaptive contact as an ordinary input can omit information carried by the contact
decision itself. Replacing an online filter by a full-history smoother can introduce information
unavailable when the bank acted. These are distinct scientific errors even when both calls
return finite arrays.
  The selected Dynamax revision is commit 5098927f2c377c0dd548cda750e6f1436220aac6,
dated 29 September 2026. Twelve original files at that revision supply the present comparison:
the project description, root notice, dependency metadata, HMM abstraction, filtering and
smoothing implementation, standard transition component, state-space fitting wrapper, version
helper, selected tests and parameter/shape helpers. This is a historical source inspection. The
inherited PyPI version 1.0.2 is a separate release observation; the selected dynamic version
helper has not been executed to establish release equivalence.(Dynamax contributors, 2026)


25.18.1     An input-conditioned model is not a logger-aware causal model

The inspected HMM wrapper supplies initial-state probabilities, transition matrices and
emission log likelihoods to its filter. Its marginal-probability method returns the filter’s
marginal log likelihood. No separate observed-action likelihood is automatically inserted.
For externally fixed inputs this is a reasonable computational representation of a declared
conditional experiment. For an action selected using a private state, the joint law generally
394                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


also needs the action mechanism. Merely passing the realized action as an input does not
establish that the omitted factor is ignorable.(Dynamax contributors, 2026)
  Consider an authored one-period construction. Let latent repayment propensity Z be
Bernoulli with probability 1/2. Conditional on Z, let action A match Z with probability 9/10,
and outcome Y match Z with probability 4/5. The action and outcome noises are conditionally
independent. The outcome has no structural dependence on the action. The observed law
therefore factors as
                               p(z, a, y) = p(z) p(a | z) p(y | z).                   (25.42)
Exact enumeration gives
                                         37                         13
                     P (Y = 1 | A = 1) =    ,    P (Y = 1 | A = 0) = ,
                                         50                         50                      (25.43)
                           E[Y | do(A = 1)] − E[Y | do(A = 0)] = 0.

The observational contrast is 12/25, although acting has no effect in the stipulated structural
model. Given A = 1, Y = 1, the posterior probability of Z = 1 is 36/37. Omitting the logger
and conditioning only through the outcome factor gives 4/5 instead. Both calculations are
coherent for their respective information sets; only the former uses the observed informative
action under this law. They are exact project calculations, not Dynamax execution results.
(Causal banking proposal project, 2026ac)
   Suppose a unit improvement in repayment probability is assigned USD 200 of value and an
action costs USD 20. These are assumptions. Substituting the observational contrast gives USD
76, whereas the stipulated causal effect gives minus USD 20. No model-fitting improvement
can make those two targets equal without additional assumptions or information. A proposed
adapter must either justify the conditional-input experiment, provide the logger-aware law,
or return a clearly described unsupported causal request.(Causal banking proposal project,
2026ac)


25.18.2     Preserve the observation and transition clocks

The source distinguishes predicted, filtered and smoothed probabilities. Filtering at time t
conditions on the observation prefix; smoothing can use all observations through the end of the
sequence. The distinction belongs in the product’s result type and availability timestamp. An
online decision cannot silently consume the smoother because it is more concentrated or easier
to compute. Retrospective state reconstruction is a legitimate but different task. (Dynamax
contributors, 2026)
   For a separate exact example, let Z persist across two dates, with prior probability 1/2,
and let two conditionally independent signals each match Z with probability 4/5. Observing
Y1 = 0 gives
                                       1                                  1
                 P (Z = 1 | Y1 = 0) = ,       P (Z = 1 | Y1 = 0, Y2 = 1) = .          (25.44)
                                       5                                  2
Suppose a decision between the two signals earns USD 100 when Z = 1 and costs USD 30.
Under that explicitly assumed response rule, the legitimate first-date expected net is minus
USD 10. Using the later signal would report USD 20 for the same first-date decision. This is
an information-clock violation, not an observed advantage of smoothing or evidence about real
servicing returns. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026ac)
   Input indexing is equally consequential. The generic HMM transition helper constructs
its time-varying transition matrices from inputs[1:], consistent with the inspected model
abstraction’s destination-time input. The low-level filter description instead writes its transition
using the source-time input. A wrapper must declare the mapping rather than infer it from an
25.18. Dynamax reuse requires a declared conditional law and information clock                395


argument name. The standard transition class accepts an input argument but returns its fixed
transition matrix without using that argument. Passing a contact sequence therefore does
not ensure that the selected transition model actually responds to contacts. A deterministic
indexed-sequence reference should compare sampling, model wrappers and low-level calls before
admission. (Dynamax contributors, 2026)


25.18.3     Numerical completion and parameter learning need separate checks

The inspected normalizer preserves exact zeros, floors very small positive entries and substitutes
one for a zero denominator. An all-zero input consequently remains all zero rather than
becoming a valid probability distribution. The emission update subtracts the maximum
log likelihood without a dedicated all-minus-infinity branch. The smoother masks near-zero
predicted probabilities using a closeness test before another normalization. These are local
source observations motivating native conformance cases; they are not measured defect rates
or a claim about every reachable backend execution. Invalid support, nonfinite arithmetic,
unsupported laws and valid negative scientific findings must not collapse into the same output
status.(Dynamax contributors, 2026)
   The fitting wrapper exposes a specified iteration count and an objective trace. For nonpositive
iteration counts it returns the supplied parameters with an empty trace. The reviewed path
does not make a general convergence or identification guarantee. Selected parameter helpers
also distinguish fully frozen groups from partially frozen groups that certain joint EM updates
reject; the inspected tests compare that boundary with SGD support. A caller must retain
initialization, trainable flags, shapes, optimization settings and failures. A state posterior
conditional on fitted parameters is not automatically a confidence statement about parameter
estimates or a selected policy. (Dynamax contributors, 2026)
   Selected upstream tests compare filtering and smoothing with explicit finite latent-path
sums, exercise nonstationary transitions and inspect fitting behavior. They provide useful
candidate conformance specifications, but none was executed here. A future native suite should
include impossible emissions, zero support, one-step and empty sequences, input shifts, frozen
parameters, multiple starts and device synchronization. Resource and timing claims must
include compilation, conversion and failed requests.(Dynamax contributors, 2026)


25.18.4     Prefer a narrow original-engine comparison; defer executable ad-
            mission

The selected root notice is MIT. The project metadata requires Python at least 3.10 and
eight direct runtime dependencies: JAX, JAXlib, TFP-nightly, fastprogress, Optax, jaxtyping,
typing-extensions and NumPy. Those declarations are unversioned; build and optional groups
are separate. A complete distribution, transitive notices and resolved backend/precision
environment remain necessary before executable admission. Root license text alone does not
qualify the whole installed stack.(Dynamax contributors, 2026)
   The proposal should retain the original engine as a conditional-state-space comparator behind
a narrow adapter. A small exact enumerator remains the transparent baseline for finite cases;
it does not offer a scaling solution. A complete port would duplicate numerical, differentiation
and maintenance obligations without a demonstrated platform need. A causal policy optimizer
built solely from a conditional likelihood is outside the initial profile. Scientific ownership
must cover the target, logger and clocks; engineering ownership must cover the environment,
conversions and failure contract; release ownership must cover the actual distribution and
notices.
396                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


  This is a bounded reuse recommendation with executable admission deferred. Public sources
and generated examples suffice to specify the first comparison. Native conformance, parameter
uncertainty and measured full-workflow cost remain prototype work; authentic bank assignment
and value remain later institutional questions. Neither the package name nor an API returning
a posterior closes those distinct obligations.


25.19      A commercial host does not settle synthetic-control se-
           mantics or rights
A bank comparing a treated regional portfolio with other regions needs a credible untreated
path, not merely an optimizer that returns donor weights. A commercial statistical host
may run a community estimator, a vendor-native command or a general optimization routine.
These are different implementation, support and rights arrangements. The proposed common
service should compare those arrangements explicitly while preserving donor eligibility, timing,
missingness, pre-fit and the uncertainty protocol.
   The selected Synth-for-Stata repository is an author-maintained community implementation
inside the commercial Stata host. Its inspected command identifies version 0.0.8 and declares
Stata version 13.0. The selected commit, ae99fd1ed100e8f5ea38386f18f02e61a90956e6, is
dated 30 April 2026. Twelve authenticated texts cover its command, help, loss helper, package
manifest, optimizer interface, component notices and selected test artifacts. No Stata exe-
cutable, plugin binary or compiled Mata library was run here. A host compatibility declaration
is not a verified installed edition, entitlement or vendor-supported causal capability.(Abadie,
Alberto and Diamond, Alexis and Hainmueller, Jens and contributors, 2026)

25.19.1    Freeze the donor universe and information used to select weights

The selected help describes a convex weighted donor combination. Donors default to all panel
units other than the treated unit; an explicit donor list must contain at least two units. That
syntactic rule cannot establish that another region is unaffected by the intervention, has
comparable measurement or supplies a credible untreated trajectory. Predictor averages ignore
missing entries, while a wholly missing predictor is rejected. Consequently, two units can
contribute averages over different observed dates. Predictor-specific windows can also override
the common predictor period.(Abadie, Alberto and Diamond, Alexis and Hainmueller, Jens
and contributors, 2026)
  Consider an authored regional-portfolio example, with outcomes measured in thousands of
USD. Two donors and the treated region have trajectories
              D1 = (90, 110, 120),   D2 = (110, 130, 140),   T = (100, 120, 150).        (25.45)
The first two dates precede intervention. Equal donor weights reproduce both preperiod
treated values exactly and predict 130 at the third date. Stipulate that this donor average is
the treated region’s true untreated path. The corresponding treatment effect is then 20, or
USD 20,000. This truth is an assumption of the example, not something established by pre-fit
alone. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026ak)
   Now suppose the second donor also receives a spillover of 20 at the final date. Its observed
final value becomes 160. The same weights predict 140 and the apparent treated gap falls to
10. Alternatively, selecting weights using the treated postintervention outcome can choose 1/4
for the first donor and 3/4 for the contaminated second donor. The selected synthetic path is
then
                              Te = (105, 125, 150),    T3 − Te3 = 0.                     (25.46)
25.19. A commercial host does not settle synthetic-control semantics or rights               397


The intervention has not disappeared from the stipulated world; contamination and postout-
come selection have changed the comparison. A lower postperiod gap cannot certify a better
causal counterfactual.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026ak)
  The source makes this timing check operationally relevant. Default predictor and MSPE
periods precede treatment. For an explicitly supplied MSPE period, however, the inspected
command checks that the requested dates occur in the panel, without imposing a separate
before-treatment inequality in that branch. The help allows later predictor dates only under
a substantive unaffectedness condition. The proposed adapter must therefore declare and
check the scientific window; passing a command’s membership validation is a narrower result.
(Abadie, Alberto and Diamond, Alexis and Hainmueller, Jens and contributors, 2026)


25.19.2     Keep optimizer settings and failure states attached to the result

The selected help and code disagree on two defaults. The help gives constraint margin 0.05
and precision parameter 7, whereas the command syntax uses 0.005 and 12. A reproducible
comparison must record explicit supplied values and the actual source or binary rather than
rely on an unqualified default. The source also computes RMSPE before calling a compiled
Mata rounding routine on the weight vector. The routine’s body has not been inspected, so
its precise rounding rule and the resulting relation between displayed weights and the reported
pre-fit score remain open.(Abadie, Alberto and Diamond, Alexis and Hainmueller, Jens and
contributors, 2026)
   More directly, the inspected C wrapper assigns the return status from pr_loqo, stores the
primal vector and returns zero without branching on that optimizer status. The associated
header distinguishes optimal, suboptimal, iteration-limit and infeasible outcomes. A successful
wrapper return therefore cannot, on this source evidence alone, be interpreted as an optimal
feasible synthetic control. Future native conformance should inspect the actual binary, status
propagation, constraint residuals and support of the returned weights before reporting scientific
results. These are static observations, not measured failure frequencies or proof that every
invocation fails. (Abadie, Alberto and Diamond, Alexis and Hainmueller, Jens and contributors,
2026)
   Source criticism also requires avoiding false defects. The nested loss helper returns negative
squared error to a maximizer. Selecting the larger log objective among alternative starts is
consistent with minimizing the underlying squared error. A nearby comment about the lowest
loss does not justify reversing the comparison signs. The relevant object is the implemented
objective and its sign, not the variable name alone.(Abadie, Alberto and Diamond, Alexis and
Hainmueller, Jens and contributors, 2026)


25.19.3     A placebo count needs its own sampling and selection argument

The selected help says the estimator can support placebo and permutation analyses, but that
does not supply a universally calibrated test for a bank’s regional intervention. The protocol
must identify which units could have been treated under the null, how pre-fit filters and donor
eligibility were chosen, whether the treated region enters the reference set, the tail direction
and which tuning steps are repeated for every placebo. Donor and time dependence also
remain substantive assumptions.
   A purely arithmetic illustration makes the denominator visible. One equally or more extreme
statistic among five eligible statistics, including the treated unit, yields 1/5. Retaining only
two statistics yields 1/2. Neither fraction is automatically a valid p-value: the assignment or
exchangeability argument and the rule selecting retained cases still need justification. The
398                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


finite count is an authored reference, not a theorem attributed to an uninspected original or
an inference result from the vendor engine.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026ak)
   The proposed common output should keep donor weights, balance, outcome paths, pre-fit
diagnostics, optimizer status and any separately justified inference object distinct. A trajectory
difference must not become a confidence interval or policy value merely because downstream
software expects a scalar.


25.19.4     Preserve unresolved component notices and comparison breadth

The pinned README states GPL version 2 or later, while the bundled optimizer source and
header retain proprietary notices, including a restriction on unauthorized commercial use.
This discrepancy is an unresolved rights record. It is not a finding of lawful distribution, an
accusation of infringement or permission to embed the component. Authoritative clarification
for the exact distribution is required before an adoption decision. The commercial host,
community code, compiled plugin, Mata library and any hosted service must each retain their
own scope.(Abadie, Alberto and Diamond, Alexis and Hainmueller, Jens and contributors,
2026)
   The broader comparison remains inconclusive. Stata, EViews, SAS, IBM, MathWorks
and commercial hosted open-source frontends remain separate candidate families; only the
selected community implementation has matching technical originals in this tranche. Generic
regression, optimization, synthetic-data or control-arm descriptions cannot establish a donor-
weighted comparative panel estimator. Uninspected sources and failed acquisition routes
likewise cannot establish product absence. Prices, entitlements, full native alternatives and
applicable automation or redistribution rights remain unresolved.
   For the prototype proposal, retain the community estimator as a documentary comparator
and defer executable admission until the rights conflict, binary correspondence and numerical
contract are resolved. Compare transparent exact examples and separately reviewed open-
source estimators under the same donor, clock and inference specification. Public evidence
can establish that design before a paid vendor trial; it cannot substitute for institutional
assignment truth or realized banking value.


25.20      Generalized synthetic control: preserve the panel target
           across a wrapper
A branch manager evaluates a staggered rollout of a servicing policy. Some branches adopt
early, some late, and some remain untreated. A useful analysis must say whether its answer
concerns a typical branch, a typical treated branch-month, or a portfolio weighted by an
explicitly chosen exposure. These targets differ before any model is fitted. A package wrapper
can change the answer by losing a weight or substituting an estimator even when the underlying
numerical engine is otherwise appropriate.
   The selected pre-cutoff gsynth 1.4.0 source is a compatibility wrapper around fect. Its
maintainers describe the wrapper as retained solely for backward compatibility. The reviewed
dependency candidate is fect 2.4.5, declared on 29 May 2026 and published through the
selected CRAN revision on 30 May. Matching pinned upstream and CRAN wrapper, manual,
license and change-log files agree byte for byte. This establishes a concrete source comparison;
it does not establish an installed combination. The wrapper’s declared lower bound, fect >=
2.0.0, permits multiple engine versions with potentially different behavior.Yiqing Xu and
package contributors (2026b,a)
25.20. Generalized synthetic control: preserve the panel target across a wrapper               399

Identification of the missing Yit (0) is a separate question from these definitions. A sample’s
retained cells need not represent the original portfolio when observation or unit-removal rules
depend on risk or outcome.
   The selected gsynth manual promises that weight specifies the weighting variable for the
weighted average effect. The complete 95-line wrapper declares that argument but never
reads it again and never passes it to fect. Its documented weighted interface therefore has a
concrete source-level defect. A successful call or the stored call string would not demonstrate

not executed the native wrapper.Yiqing Xu and package contributors (2026b)
   For an exact illustration, two equally represented treated cells have effects −6 and 10 dollars.
Their unweighted mean is 2, whereas weights 9 and 1 give (−54 + 10)/10 = −22/5 = −4.4. If

calculated margins are USD 1 and USD −5.4. A weighting omission can reverse the indicated

outputs of either package.Causal banking proposal project (2026bc)
   Exposure duration creates another distinction. Suppose one unit experiences effect 10
in each of three treated periods, while another experiences effect −6 in one treated period.
Equation (25.47) gives τcell = 6 and equation (25.48) gives τunit = 2. At an assumed per-period
cost of 4, averaging the net effects using the same respective measures gives margins 2 and

as influential in an analysis intended to describe a typical branch.Causal banking proposal

   The selected engine exposes both treated-cell and unit-average calculations. It also dis-
tinguishes weights for outcome-model fitting from weights for aggregation. Supplying W fills
both roles; supplying only W.agg is intended to change aggregation, while W.est alone leaves
canonical aggregation unweighted. The inspected source rejects distinct columns for the two
roles, despite an error message referring to earlier versions and a future release. Its executed
conditional, rather than that stale version message, determines the limitation. Zero-weight rows
are dropped, and weighted aggregates are routed into the ordinary output slots. A proposed
adapter must therefore record both the requested role and the actual retained population;
blindly multiplying supplied weights is not a general substitute for missing role support.Yiqing
Xu and package contributors (2026a)

25.20.2     A factor model needs information in the relevant directions

A useful working model for an untreated outcome is

                               Yit (0) = αi + ξt + xT       T
                                                    it β + λi ft + εit ,                        (25.49)

where xit contains covariates with a justified intervention-time meaning, ft represents common
latent factors and λi is the unit’s loading. Even if donor observations reveal ft exactly, a treated
unit’s pre-period outcomes must determine the component of λi that matters after treatment.
Covariates caused by the intervention, anticipation, spillovers to donors, or changing loadings
require additional arguments. A low prediction error on past observations cannot establish
those substantive conditions.
   For a precise obstruction, suppress the intercepts, observed covariates and errors. Let the
factors in two pre-periods and one post-period be

                           f1 = (1, 0)T ,   f2 = (2, 0)T ,   f3 = (1, 1)T .                     (25.50)

Donor loadings (0, 1) and (1, 1) generate observed paths (0, 0, 1) and (1, 2, 2). A treated
loading of either (2, 0) or (2, 4) gives the same pre-treatment path (2, 4). Hold its observed
post-treatment outcome at 8. The two compatible untreated post outcomes are 2 and 6, giving
effects 6 and 2. With an assumed intervention cost of 4, the net values are 2 and −2. The
complete observed panels agree between these two worlds. Causal banking proposal project
(2026bc)
  Writing Fpre for the pre-period factor matrix, the direction v = (0, 1)T satisfies

                                     Fpre v = 0,       f3T v = 1.                               (25.51)

The pre-period factor rank is one while the full factor rank is two. Repeating the two pre-factor
rows over six distinct calendar periods does not change that rank. A third donor with loading
(2, 1) can raise the donor count without resolving this missing treated-unit information. Thus
minimum period and donor counts are useful guards, but are not proofs of the relevant rank
condition. This example lies outside full pre-factor-rank qualification; it is not evidence that
an estimator valid under that qualification fails. Causal banking proposal project (2026bc)
   The inspected engine includes count/rank restrictions and, in one unbounded treated-loading
                                     T F
branch, solves using the inverse of Fpre pre . A failed solve returns unavailable effect fields. Near
singularity can remain problematic even when the solve returns. Its inspected rank-selection
paths aggregate cross-validation scores and can apply a minimum-error, one-standard-error or
legacy one-percent selection rule. The final rule may override an intermediate rank update.
These are predictive selection procedures, not tests proving counterfactual identification. A
restricted loading model, an informative additional pre-period, an external loading restriction
or a prospective experiment could address a particular ambiguity, but each changes the
information or assumptions of the problem.Yiqing Xu and package contributors (2026a)


25.20.3     Defaults, missingness and uncertainty must travel together

In the selected wrapper, the default estimator is gsynth. Legacy EM=TRUE selects ife only if
the estimator argument was omitted. The default requested inference is parametric for the
gsynth route and bootstrap for the IFE or matrix-completion routes. A parametric request
for the latter routes is changed to bootstrap with a warning; the legacy name nonparametric
maps to bootstrap. The wrapper also sets unit fixed effects, five CV folds and tolerance
10−3 , whereas the direct engine’s inspected defaults include two-way effects, twenty folds and
25.20. Generalized synthetic control: preserve the panel target across a wrapper              401


tolerance 10−5 . Direct-engine adoption therefore requires explicit configuration rather than
assuming identical defaults. Yiqing Xu and package contributors (2026b,a)
   The engine’s gsynth route forces a never-treated donor pool and rejects treatment reversals.
Too few pre-treatment observations or excessive missingness can remove units; the returned
result must disclose this change in population. A package family’s support for switching
treatments does not override the restrictions of this selected method. Missing-cell masks also
enter fitting and effect aggregation, so reporting only the number of input rows conceals the
denominator actually used.Yiqing Xu and package contributors (2026a)
   For parametric uncertainty, the selected engine requires the isolated never-treated pool. Its
automatic error mode uses an autoregressive strategy when cells are missing and an empirical
strategy otherwise; explicitly requested empirical or wild modes require a complete panel.
In inspected case-bootstrap code, units or cluster identifiers are resampled, with support-
conditioned retries in unit-resampling branches. Ordinary jackknife with a cluster argument
emits a warning that clustering is ignored. These are different sampling mechanisms; a
generic confidence-interval label cannot make them interchangeable.Yiqing Xu and package
contributors (2026a)
   The inspected average-effect uncertainty uses the standard deviation of bootstrap draws
with missing values removed and, by default, a normal interval. The basic-pivot option
has a different construction. Any future qualification must preserve attempted, valid and
failed draws, resampling units, selection/refitting behavior and reasons for unavailable output.
Dropping failed draws from a standard-deviation calculation is not evidence that inference
remains valid. Dependence across branches, common calendar shocks, model misspecification
and post-selection uncertainty each require a declared law and a specific argument. This
source comparison has executed neither native package and makes no empirical coverage claim.
Yiqing Xu and package contributors (2026a)


25.20.4     Reuse through an explicit panel contract

The proposal retains the pinned wrapper as a compatibility reference and favors evaluating
a direct fect worker if a prototype is funded. The ignored weight and implicit remapping
make an unrestricted wrapper pass-through unsuitable for a new interface. Porting the
engine immediately would duplicate panel conversion, rank selection, native numerical routines
and inference before a behavioral comparison exists. Classic synthetic control, difference-in-
differences, matrix-completion and state-space approaches remain substantive comparators
whose targets and identifying assumptions must be matched to the banking question.
  Both packages declare MIT + file LICENSE; the saved license files contain the holder and
year. That declaration supports identifying the stated license, but this review has not inspected
the complete standard template or every dependency’s terms. The wrapper says it needs no
compilation, while the selected engine requires compiled components, R 4.1 or later, Rcpp
and RcppArmadillo. A deployment estimate must include that environment. Process isolation
does not itself establish rights, reproducibility or numerical validity.Yiqing Xu and package
contributors (2026b,a)
  A common library, CLI and MCP request should carry unique unit/time keys, the complete
calendar, action timing, outcome units, the donor population, observation masks, target
weights and their fitting/aggregation roles. It should also freeze the method, fixed effects, rank
candidates, selection rule, tolerance, resampling law and dependency identities. The response
should return the actual configuration, retained sample and denominators, conditioning and
convergence diagnostics, original warnings, named effect aggregates and a separately typed
uncertainty result. An agent translating the business question may propose these fields; it
402                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


cannot infer a missing weighting basis or certify donor validity from a fluent explanation.
   Before admission, a public reference comparison should reproduce the wrapper’s weight
omission and compare an explicitly configured engine on known target calculations. It should
then exercise unequal exposure durations, missingness, reversals, donor shortages, weak factor
support, rank resets, failed solves, cluster warnings and bounded runtime failures. Known-law
factor panels can test selected calibration claims before any costly bank experiment, provided
selection and failure-denominator rules are frozen in advance. Total cost includes validation,
conversion, rank search, repeated fits, uncertainty, serialization, review and maintenance.
These public comparisons can establish whether a panel prototype merits investment while
preserving the assumptions a later banking study must test. Causal banking proposal project
(2026bc)


25.21      Reusable trend sensitivity requires the full statistical
           contract
A funding manager evaluating a branch offer needs to distinguish a plausible departure from
parallel trends from uncertainty about the preperiod trend itself. HonestDiD is a useful
reference for this distinction. The selected R revision declares version 0.2.8 and implements
sensitivity inference associated with Rambachan and Roth. The paper supplies identification
and inferential arguments; the source supplies a particular numerical interface. Neither makes
an invalid event-study design valid simply because a confidence interval was returned. The
proposed library should retain the method family, while requiring a separate qualification of the
R worker, its solvers and its conversion of bank targets before operational adoption (Rambachan
and Roth, 2023; Ashesh Rambachan, Jonathan Roth and contributors, 2026b).


25.21.1     Two restrictions with different zero points

Consider an offer that starts at time 1, with one earlier comparison at −1 and an untreated
reference period 0. Let δt be the difference between treated and comparison groups’ untreated
mean outcomes, expressed relative to its value at time 0, so δ0 = 0. Assume no anticipation
through time 0, a fixed population and a coherent, equally spaced calendar. Write x = δ−1
and y = τ + δ1 , where τ is the postperiod treatment effect in the same outcome units. These
are population contrasts, not estimated coefficients. An outcome can be quarterly contribution
in dollars per eligible exposure, provided the same denominator and accounting convention
apply in all periods.
   A relative-magnitude restriction with multiplier m ≥ 0 bounds the next untreated first
difference by m times the absolute preperiod first difference. An absolute smoothness restriction
with M ≥ 0 bounds the change in that first difference. In this three-period case they give

               |δ1 | ≤ m|x|,          IRM (x, y; m) = [y − m|x|, y + m|x|],                (25.52)
          |δ1 + x| ≤ M,               ISD (x, y; M ) = [y + x − M, y + x + M ].            (25.53)

The first interval follows by substituting every admissible δ1 into τ = y − δ1 ; the second follows
from δ1 ∈ [−x − M, −x + M ]. Every endpoint is attainable under the stated restrictions. With
x = −2 and y = 4, zero relative magnitude gives effect 4, whereas zero smoothness gives effect
2. The latter continues a linear untreated differential trend. It does not impose a flat trend.
With m = M = 1 the intervals are [2, 6] and [1, 3], but the numerical equality of the tuning
values has no substantive meaning: m is dimensionless, while M is an absolute change in the
outcome difference on the chosen discrete calendar. Changing dollars to cents multiplies M
25.21. Reusable trend sensitivity requires the full statistical contract                          403


and the target by 100 and leaves m unchanged. Changing the spacing or aggregation of periods
requires a new restriction argument; it cannot be handled by relabelling an axis (Rambachan
and Roth, 2023; Causal banking proposal project, 2026bh).
   The earlier curvature analysis develops the multiperiod smoothness kernel. The present
comparison adds a separate concern: setting an estimated pretrend equal to its population value
can remove precisely the uncertainty that a sensitivity procedure is supposed to propagate. An
estimated xb = 0 does not establish x = 0. Failing to reject a pretrend test does not establish
that equality either. A proposed workflow must pass the preperiod estimates and their joint
covariance into its sensitivity calculation, alongside a substantive justification of the restriction.
