additional information, or correct an unsupported request.


27.9      Effect candidates, hulls and confidence sets
Tetrad’s inspected IDA constructor requires a legal partially directed acyclic graph and
continuous data. Its total-effect routine produces regression-based candidates across eligible
parent configurations. Candidate-specific exceptions are caught and logged without a typed
failed-candidate object in the returned list. Consequently, the downstream interface needs
enough information to distinguish a genuinely small candidate set from a larger intended
calculation whose members partly failed.tetrad contributors (2026)
   Three numerical objects must remain distinct. A candidate multiset records effects attached
to graph alternatives. Its convex hull fills all values between the smallest and largest candidate.
A confidence set is a random set with a stated coverage interpretation under a sampling law.
Neither the candidate list nor its hull becomes a confidence set merely because it has endpoints.
  The inspected IDA distance helper illustrates the distinction. For project values S = {0, 0.8}
and hypothetical truth θ = 0.4,

                        d(θ, S) = min |θ − s| = 0.4,     d(θ, hull(S)) = 0.
                                   s∈S

The selected helper uses the minimum–maximum interval, so it computes the second quantity.
Its empty-list branch returns the supplied true effect, which could even be negative. These are
static observations about that helper, accompanied by project arithmetic; no Tetrad execution
is claimed. They imply that evaluation and transport must define their set object before
442                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


choosing a distance metric. An empty set of available estimates requires an explicit unavailable
or failed state, not an arbitrary scalar score.tetrad contributors (2026)
   The initial adoption preference is therefore to evaluate the existing Java engine through a
narrow process boundary, with endpoint roundtrips and typed failure handling. Porting an
isolated helper would omit the graph semantics that make its output meaningful. For aGrUM,
the existing C++ core and Python wrapper deserve comparison before any reimplementation.
Its saved build files declare version 3.2.0 and C++20; these are environment requirements to
test, not evidence that the proposed binary or wrapper already works.
Chapter 28

Design-based estimation, weak
information and diagnostics

28.1     An instrument is a scientific claim
Suppose a bank uses a rule-based funding incentive Z as an instrument for an offered rate
A, with retained balances Y as the outcome and baseline controls W . Software can encode a
regression system, but it cannot establish that the incentive has no direct effect on balances
or that its assignment is independent of omitted balance determinants. Those are properties
of the economic setting and information process. The package comparison begins after the
instrument, target population, timing and exclusion claim have been stated.
   The selected ivreg documentation describes ordinary two-stage least squares and robust
M/MM regression choices. Exogenous regressors in the outcome equation must also appear
among the instruments. An adapter should therefore retain explicit endogenous, exogenous and
instrument column roles rather than constructing the formula from a single list of predictors.
The robust regression option is an estimator choice; it does not supply a weak-instrument
confidence guarantee. The inspected package is ivreg 0.6-8. The broader AER family is a
separate source-review obligation.ivreg contributors (2026)
  Weak information changes the result contract. The inspected ivmodel documentation
exposes Anderson–Rubin and conditional-likelihood-ratio routines whose confidence-set outputs
are matrices of interval components. A client that extracts one lower and one upper endpoint
can lose disconnectedness or unboundedness. The appropriate object is
                                               J
                                               [
                                         C=         Ij ,
                                              j=1

where each component Ij retains its endpoints, possible infinite bounds and method-specific in-
terpretation. The number of components is part of the result, not formatting metadata.ivmodel
contributors (2023)
   For illustration, a hypothetical reported set C = (−∞, −2] ∪ [3, ∞) excludes zero while
remaining unbounded in both directions. Its interval hull is the whole real line. Replacing the
set with that hull changes the question “is zero in the set?” and replacing it with a midpoint
invents a finite estimate. Conversely, an empty inversion result is not equivalent to a missing
calculation. The proposed result schema must preserve these distinctions before any banking
decision rule uses the output. This hypothetical set is not a computed result from ivmodel.
  The two R packages are therefore complementary candidates. ivreg supplies a regression

                                             443
444                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


interface with specific estimation and diagnostic choices; ivmodel supplies selected weak-
information test/inversion interfaces. A matched trial must align instruments, controls, scaling,
sampling assumptions and covariance choices. It must retain weak and zero first stages, singular
designs and unbounded sets. A regression returning quickly on a well-conditioned example
would not qualify the weak-information case, and the presence of an inversion API would not
establish coverage for dependent bank panels.


28.2     Regression discontinuity is a family of designs
A credit policy can change at a score cutoff, but several causal questions can be attached to
that threshold. A sharp design studies a deterministic assignment change. A fuzzy design
uses a discontinuity in treatment probability. A kink design studies a change in slope. These
require different estimands and denominators. Treating them as one generic local regression
would make an apparently comparable benchmark compare different scientific problems.
  The inspected rdrobust 4.0.0 documentation exposes sharp, fuzzy and kink settings, local-
polynomial choices, bias correction, bandwidth choices and variance options. The adapter
should bind the cutoff and running-variable units to the result and export the actual bandwidth
and inference settings. The bandwidth for a point-estimation objective and the choices
underlying a bias-corrected interval cannot be silently conflated. The saved 4.0.0 snapshot
predates the literature cutoff; it is not a claim that this was the latest release on that
date.rdrobust contributors (2026)
   For a fuzzy design, the treatment jump matters as much as the outcome jump. If a local
effect is expressed schematically as τY /τA , a small τA produces an unstable ratio even when
each fitted regression has a clean numerical convergence report. The bank’s first question
should be whether the score rule changes the specified treatment in the relevant population.
The software trial should vary that first-stage jump and preserve weak cases rather than
selecting only a strong demonstration.
   rddensity supplies a different operation: local-polynomial density or manipulation diagnostics
near the cutoff. Such diagnostics can challenge a design, but failure to reject a discontinuity
does not verify the assignment mechanism or continuity of potential outcomes. An interface
that displays “RD valid” after a density test would convert one diagnostic into a much
stronger scientific statement. A useful report instead gives the test, bandwidth, support and
interpretation limit alongside other design evidence. Discrete scores and mass points require
explicit attention.rddensity contributors (2026)
   rdlocrand represents another approach, based on a declared local-randomization window.
Its selected documentation states that a positive polynomial order uses asymptotic inference
and that confidence-set inversion is performed over a supplied grid. Thus a finite grid endpoint
is not automatically a finite confidence bound. If all evaluated values near the boundary
remain accepted, the result should say that the search is truncated. Extending the grid is a
computational remedy; it is not evidence for the local-randomization assumption. Window
selection, assignment probabilities and the intervention must still be recorded.rdlocrand
contributors (2026)
   These packages should be evaluated as a collection of design-specific operations. The
proposed integration uses a common report for the score, cutoff, assignment rule and target,
then separate method records. The product should not expose a single switch called “robust
RD” that hides whether the calculation is continuity-based local-polynomial inference or
local-randomization inference. The alternatives may both be useful, but they answer their
questions under different assumptions.
28.3. Sensitivity parameters are not missing truth                                           445


28.3      Sensitivity parameters are not missing truth
Two other R interfaces provide useful sensitivity summaries. sensemakr parameterizes omitted-
variable sensitivity through partial R2 quantities and observed-covariate benchmarks. A large
benchmark asks how conclusions would change if an omitted variable had specified residual
associations; it does not measure the actual association of an unobserved variable. The bank
must identify what makes a proposed benchmark plausible, and the report should retain both
the chosen benchmark and the effect scale.sensemakr contributors (2024)
   The selected EValue evalues.RR interface takes a risk ratio and optional confidence limits
and reports E-values for the point and the near-null confidence limit. This is a particular
scale-specific sensitivity operation. A default probability difference, a standardized regression
coefficient and a net present value should not be passed to it as if they were risk ratios.
Any conversion needs an explicit target and assumptions. An E-value does not estimate a
confounding correction or certify an absence of confounding.EValue contributors (2025)
   These tools can make a funding or credit recommendation more intelligible: they expose
how much an assumption would need to change before a conclusion changes. They cannot
supply verified instrument exclusion, known ownership, correct record inclusion or a gold audit
label. Their adoption is therefore conditional on a result contract that separates observed data
summaries, user-supplied sensitivity assumptions and causal conclusions.
Chapter 29

Longitudinal treatment, monitoring
and mediation

29.1      The history is part of the intervention
The servicing problem is naturally sequential. An initial action A0 , such as an early contact,
can change a later financial condition L1 . A second action A1 is then chosen using that
condition, and a later account cost Y is observed. The variable L1 can be both a consequence
of the first action and a determinant of the second. Treating it as an ordinary baseline control
erases that temporal structure. Treating both actions as one binary indicator can erase the
policy being evaluated.
  Consider a finite project mechanism in which A0 , L1 , A1 are binary and
              Pr(L1 = 1 | do(A0 = 0)) = 0.8,               Pr(L1 = 1 | do(A0 = 1)) = 0.4.
Conditional mean cost, in CNY per account over a fixed horizon, is specified as
                           m(a0 , l, a1 ) = 100l − 50a1 l + 20a0 + 10a1 .
The initial action costs 20 and reduces the chance of the adverse condition. The later action
costs 10 and reduces adverse-condition cost by 50 when that condition is present. These
numbers define the example; they are not estimates of actual bank effects.
  For a second-stage rule d, replacing the two action equations gives
                                    1
                                    X
                     V (a0 , d) =         m(a0 , l, d(l)) Pr(L1 = l | do(A0 = a0 )).                  (29.1)
                                    l=0

Equation (29.1) follows by enumerating the two possible conditions under the specified inter-
vention. It yields
                     V (0, 0) = 80,          V (1, l 7→ l) = 44,      V (1, 1) = 50.
The adaptive policy is better than always giving the later action because it avoids paying for
that action in accounts without the adverse condition. No policy-learning or global-optimality
theorem is needed for this comparison of three explicitly specified rules. A proposed general
optimizer would have additional obligations.
   Now hold A0 = 0 and consider an observed logger that gives A1 = 1 with probability 0.9
when L1 = 1, and 0.1 otherwise. The observed treated group contains a disproportionate share
of accounts with the adverse condition. Direct enumeration gives
       E[Y | A1 = 1, A0 = 0] = 58.64865 . . . ,            E[Y | A1 = 0, A0 = 0] = 30.76923 . . . .

                                                     446
29.2. Point treatment and sequential software have different contracts                         447


The observational difference is approximately +27.88. Yet the intervention contrast that treats
everyone at the second stage, at A0 = 0, is V (0, 1) − V (0, 0) = 50 − 80 = −30. The sign
reversal is selection by an observed time-varying condition in this mechanism. It shows why
an interface must retain the treatment history and the distribution over which the policy is
valued.
   In an application, evaluating an expression like (29.1) from observations requires substantive
assumptions connecting observed conditional distributions to the intervention model. It
also requires that relevant histories and actions have support. The example supplies its
structural law directly; it does not demonstrate that a bank’s logger, monitoring or missingness
mechanisms satisfy those assumptions.


29.2      Point treatment and sequential software have different
          contracts
The selected tmle interface concerns binary point-treatment effects with missingness and
subject-ID options. It is a candidate for a suitable static effect question; that does not make
it an arbitrary longitudinal policy engine. The versioned documentation also contains a
treatment-missingness wording difference between DESCRIPTION and the selected Delta
argument. That feature needs implementation review before it is enabled in an adapter. A
convenient argument name cannot settle what missingness pattern the procedure supports.
tmle contributors (2025)
   stremr’s selected sequential g-computation and TMLE documentation is closer to the
servicing problem. It accepts time points, sequential outcome-model formulas, treatment
intervention probabilities, monitoring intervention probabilities and related weighting choices.
Treatment and monitoring are separate intervention components. A bank that increases
contact may also increase the chance that financial stress is recorded; holding monitoring fixed
and changing it are different policy questions. The interface should name which of these is
being evaluated.stremr contributors (2017)
   The same documentation makes several operational qualifications explicit. The Qstratify
option is labeled nonfunctional and an error source. Weight truncation and stabilization are
choices. Iterative targeting has stopping and iteration controls. A wrapper should reject
the documented nonfunctional option before execution and report the actual truncation and
stopping behavior after execution. A truncated weight or stopped numerical iteration is
not evidence that positivity or statistical accuracy has been established. It is part of the
approximation and diagnostic record.
   survtmle addresses another closely related but distinct problem: right censoring, competing
failures and cumulative incidence. Its selected interface supports two treatment values. A
competing failure must not be recoded as ordinary censoring simply to fit a common input
schema. In a banking setting, default, repayment, restructuring and account closure can
correspond to different outcome or observation events, depending on the question. The
adapter must preserve the cause, horizon and target, and the analyst must justify their
interpretation.survtmle contributors (2019)
   The initial software decision is to evaluate separate R operations for static TMLE, sequential
g-computation/TMLE, and competing-risk cumulative incidence. One common transport
envelope can contain their inputs and outputs, but it should not imply scientific substitutability.
The proposed tests include treatment-confounder feedback, monitoring-dependent recording,
administrative censoring, absent action support, and the distinction between a failure event
and a missing observation. These trials must assess the specific estimand and sampling law; a
448                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


successful fit on complete independent records does not qualify a dynamic bank panel.
   The age of a saved distribution is recorded as evidence about that distribution, not as a
verdict on project maintenance. In particular, older stremr and survtmle snapshots do not
prove abandonment. Conversely, a recent version string does not demonstrate correctness
of every documented feature. Build compatibility and method validity require their own
observations.


29.3     Mediation changes the target again
A servicing team may want to decompose an action’s effect into a part operating through
customer engagement and a part operating through other channels. This is a different question
from the total effect of an adaptive policy. The mediator’s definition and observation time
matter, and a missing engagement record may itself be affected by contact intensity.
   medflex supplies a natural-effect-model interface based on expanded data. Its selected
documentation explains that the original mediator is excluded from the final natural-effect
formula and that a full bootstrap refits working models. Both details affect integration.
Expanded records must retain their link to the original account, and a bootstrap operating
on those records independently would not generally reproduce a bootstrap of the original
subjects and fitting procedure. Reusing a fixed first-stage fit would also change the documented
full-bootstrap operation.medflex contributors (2025)
   The proposed adapter should therefore export an expansion identity, the original sampling
unit, the effect scale, the mediator definition and the models refitted in each resample. It
should not market data expansion as a solution to unmeasured mediator–outcome confounding.
Sensitivity summaries can accompany the decomposition, but they remain conditional analyses
of assumptions. A total-effect engine and a mediation engine can both be useful without their
outputs being interchangeable.


29.4     What an R boundary must preserve
An R process boundary is a plausible first integration route because it permits evaluation
of the existing estimator with its native dependencies. It is not yet a selected or qualified
deployment. The input should contain a stable account identifier, the information and action
clock, event/availability times, the observation convention, the intervention specification and
the target’s units. Serialization must distinguish absent values from absent records and preserve
factor levels, censoring codes and repeated-subject structure.
   The output needs more than an estimate. It must identify the exact target, weights and
truncations, nuisance-model choices, fitted sample, uncertainty procedure and unavailable
quantities. A bridge may fail before the estimator runs, during fitting, or while translating
a result. These failures require different remedies. The first remedy is an environment or
transport repair; the second may require numerical diagnostics or revised assumptions; the
third requires correction of the adapter. None is a causal conclusion about the underlying
servicing policy.
   Porting is an alternative only after the complete method boundary is clear. Reimplementing
a final regression while omitting its expansion, sequential weighting, model-refitting bootstrap
or stopping conditions would create a different procedure. The advantage of a native port
must be demonstrated on the full workflow, including data transfer, model fitting, uncertainty
and failure handling. A faster final matrix multiplication is not enough.

Panel effects, event studies and
synthetic controls

30.1     Population averages and treated-group averages
A bank-wide policy evaluation can target all eligible accounts, the accounts actually treated,
or a particular rollout cohort at a particular horizon. Even perfectly computed effects can
support opposite decisions when the target population is silently changed.
  In a project example, half the eligible accounts belong to a high-response baseline stratum
H. Treatment is given with probability 0.8 in H and 0.2 outside it. Suppose the incremental
gross contribution of treatment over the declared horizon is CNY 400 in H and CNY 100
outside it. These are stipulated stratum effects, with no estimation noise. The population
average treatment effect is

                              ATE = 0.5(400) + 0.5(100) = 250.

Bayes’ rule gives
                                                 0.5(0.8)
                          Pr(H | A = 1) =                       = 0.8,
                                            0.5(0.8) + 0.5(0.2)
so the average effect in the treated group is

                              ATT = 0.8(400) + 0.2(100) = 340.

At a hypothetical CNY 300 treatment cost, average net benefit is −50 for the eligible population
and +40 for a group with the treated-group composition. The example does not authorize
future targeting using an observed treatment label; it shows why a result’s population is a
necessary part of its meaning.
   DRDID’s selected documentation explicitly targets ATT and distinguishes panel data from
stationary repeated cross sections. A shared API must retain both facts. A repeated cross
section does not supply the same account-level changes as a panel, even if its columns have
the same names. A result labeled only “average effect” would hide the target distinction
illustrated above. Double robustness also operates within the procedure’s identification and
nuisance-model framework; it does not establish parallel trends or assignment truth.DRDID
contributors (2026)




                                                449
450                                                              Causal analysis for a universal bank


30.2     Staggered timing and generated outcomes
A rollout across branches or customer groups creates treatment cohorts and relative event times.
A useful request must state the first treatment time, whether treatment is absorbing, which
units serve as controls, which relative times are supported, and how effects are aggregated.
Otherwise two event-study plots can represent different populations at the same displayed lag.
   did2s documents a first stage fitted on untreated observations and a second stage using the
full sample. The standard-error calculation is adjusted for that procedure and its clustering
contract. Passing the residualized outcome to an ordinary second regression and reporting that
regression’s default standard error would not preserve the documented method. The proposed
adapter must retain the first-stage sample, generated outcome, omitted periods, treatment
timing and inference settings.did2s contributors (2026)
   eventstudyinteract is community Stata code. Its selected help file describes an interaction-
weighted estimator: estimate cohort-by-relative-time effects, estimate cohort shares, then
aggregate with those shares. It permits never-treated or last-treated control cohorts; when the
last-treated cohort is used, periods in which that cohort receives treatment must be excluded.
The help file warns that the cited validity result covers balanced panels without covariates,
while the implementation also accepts unbalanced data. Software acceptance of that input is
therefore not the same as an inspected validity argument for it.EventStudyInteract contributors
(2023)
   The package stores the interaction-weighted estimates and covariance in e(b_iw) and
e(V_iw). The ordinary e(b) and e(V) entries belong to the underlying interacted regression.
An adapter exporting the familiar default slots would risk returning the wrong object. This
is a concrete reason to qualify the statistical handoff rather than merely test that Stata can
launch.
   The same documentation describes pointwise intervals. Simultaneous coverage of an entire
event path is a different property. As a project probability calculation, ten independent
intervals each with exactly 0.95 coverage cover all ten targets with probability

                                    0.9510 = 0.5987369 . . . .

Actual event-study estimates need not be independent, and this number is not a measurement
of eventstudyinteract. It demonstrates that a collection of pointwise labels cannot itself
establish a simultaneous guarantee. A report must identify the family of targets and the
inference method supporting any joint statement.
   The Stata runtime introduces a commercial dependency, but it does not make eventstudyin-
teract a built-in vendor capability. The inspected community files also do not establish their
complete redistribution license. A prospective Stata bridge consequently needs both a licensed
runtime and a package/ dependency license review. Comparing that bridge with a vendor’s
own estimator requires the vendor’s dated technical documentation, not inference from this
community package.


30.3     Synthetic controls and the source of uncertainty
When a policy changes for one region, branch group or business line, a donor combination can
form a counterfactual trajectory. The donor definition, pre-treatment period, scaling, fitting
criterion and post-treatment horizon are part of the scientific design. The weight optimizer is
one component of that design. A small fitting loss does not by itself explain why post-treatment
prediction error should have a particular distribution.
30.4. Bayesian intervention analysis for branch campaigns                                    451


   The inspected Synth interface takes preprocessed predictor and outcome matrices and
reports donor/predictor weights and optimization losses. This makes it a candidate for a
controlled weight-construction operation. The selected passages do not supply a universal
placebo or confidence-coverage guarantee. The product should report fitting loss and donor
dependence as diagnostics and attach only an uncertainty procedure whose assumptions and
target have been separately stated.Synth contributors (2026)
   augsynth’s selected dispatcher distinguishes single-outcome, multiple-outcome and staggered
settings, with distinct balance and regularization controls. Selecting the family name is
therefore insufficient to select a method. The downstream path and its inference procedure
must be inspected for the particular request. The author-repository snapshot was available
after a CRAN mirror lookup failed; that establishes source access for the inspected revision,
not a CRAN release history.augsynth contributors (2026)
   scpi’s selected documentation explicitly distinguishes in-sample and out-of-sample uncer-
tainty and exposes donor constraint sets, solvers and simulation choices. A generic scalar
“standard error” field would compress these components into a misleadingly uniform object.
The proposed integration retains the constraint set, solver outcome, simulation identity and
the assumptions used for prediction error. It also records failures: an infeasible or numerically
failed solve does not become a zero effect, and changing the constraint set to obtain a solution
changes the reported procedure. scpi contributors (2026)
   For banking examples, donor contamination is a substantive concern to assess: a nominally
untreated branch may be affected by shared pricing, national communications or customer
movement. This is a proposed design diagnostic, not an observed defect in a package or dataset.
The software should make donor membership and exclusions reviewable. It cannot verify lack
of spillovers solely from a donor weight vector.


30.4      Bayesian intervention analysis for branch campaigns
A bank that launches a campaign in one branch group may want the daily path of additional
applications, rather than a single coefficient pooled over all branches. Google CausalImpact is
a substantive candidate for this question. Its Bayesian structural time-series approach models
how the treated series would have evolved without the intervention, using its earlier history
and, when available, contemporaneous control series. The proposed reuse decision is to retain
the R implementation as a reference and prospective baseline, with an isolated R adapter
conditional on a compatible environment and reviewed behavior. No such adapter or fitted
package comparison has been executed here. This disposition preserves a useful alternative
without turning a forecasting model into a general identification engine. Causal banking
research proposal project (2026a); Google CausalImpact maintainers (2026a)
   Here the package name denotes google/CausalImpact. It does not denote the aGrUM
symbolic object discussed in the identification survey. The selected R source is version 1.4.1
at the commit beginning 0f5bf8d97cfb, committed on 31 March 2026. Its DESCRIPTION
retains a 24 September 2025 package date, but the later commit raises the required R version to
4.5.0. An unchanged package version is consequently insufficient to reproduce the environment.
The repository contains a three-platform release-R check workflow and substantive input,
model and inference tests; inspection of those files establishes intended checks, not that the
checks passed on the proposed platform.Google CausalImpact maintainers (2026a,b)
452                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


30.4.1    The target and the identifying restriction

Let the intervention begin after date T0 , let H be the declared post-intervention horizon, and
write Yt (0) for the outcome that the treated branch group would have produced without the
campaign. The realized path contrast is ∆t = Yt − Yt (0). A posterior for this missing path uses
the observed pre-intervention response and the control history X1:T0 +H . In the state-space
formulation of Brodersen and colleagues,

                                     Yt (0) = ZtT αt + εt ,                                 (30.1)
                                      αt+1 = Tt αt + Rt ηt .                                (30.2)

Here αt is a latent state, Zt maps it to the scalar response, Tt evolves that state, and Rt
maps state innovations into it. The observation and state innovations have the specified
Gaussian laws; trend, seasonality and regression components determine the matrices and their
parameters. Posterior simulation integrates over the stated parameter, state and variable-
selection uncertainty. The inherited method supplies a joint predictive law for the entire
missing response path, not merely separate forecasts at each date.Brodersen et al. (2015)
    For causal attribution, the control series must remain unaffected by the intervention, and
the pre-period relationship must continue to describe the untreated post-period response.
Neither an accurate pre-period fit nor a posterior excluding zero proves these restrictions.
National advertising, shared customer acquisition channels, a branch closure or a simultaneous
pricing change can make the proposed donor history inappropriate. A post-period control
may be available for retrospective analysis while being unavailable when a campaign is first
planned. The proposal must distinguish these two information sets before using retrospective
fit to justify a prospective decision.Google CausalImpact maintainers (2026a); Brodersen et al.
(2015)
  An exact construction shows the consequence. Let At = 0 for eight pre-period days and
At = 1 for four campaign days. Set x0t = 10 + t and suppose the observed daily application
count and control index satisfy

                         Xt = x0t + 15At ,     Yt = 100 + 2x0t + 20At .

In this first law, the campaign increases applications by 20 per day and also changes the
control index by 15. The pre-period relationship is exactly Yt = 100 + 2Xt . Continuing that
relationship into the post-period gives

                            Yt − (100 + 2Xt ) = 20 − 2(15) = −10.

The same twelve observed rows arise under a second law in which the exogenous control
path is the observed Xt , the campaign leaves it unchanged, and the response equation is
Yt = 100 + 2Xt − 10At . Under that law the effect is genuinely negative. The exogenous control
path is allowed to shift on the campaign date; no random timing assumption excludes that
possibility in this construction. Thus the identical observations, including perfect pre-period
fit, support opposite effects under different control-invariance assumptions. This is a project
counterexample to automatic attribution, not a fitted CausalImpact result or a claim that its
algorithm returns the exact linear forecast. Causal banking research proposal project (2026b)
   More generally, with pre-period slope β, donor contamination γAt and response effect τ At ,
the continued linear contrast is τ − βγ. This decomposition makes a sensitivity analysis
interpretable: an owner can state a plausible range for donor spillover and inspect when the
sign changes. It does not estimate that range from the same ambiguous history. Similarly,
an unmodeled untreated post-period shift δ would enter the contrast as τ + δ − βγ. A richer
30.4. Bayesian intervention analysis for branch campaigns                                     453


state model can represent some changes, but cannot learn from missing untreated outcomes
which part of a coincident break was caused by the campaign.
   For an investment illustration, stipulate a net value of USD 1 per additional application and a
four-day campaign cost of USD 20. The two laws imply 4(20) − 20 = 60 and 4(−10) − 20 = −60
dollars. These are deliberately specified values, not measured bank economics. Their role is to
show why obtaining a defensible unaffected control or a randomized comparison can matter
more than reducing Monte Carlo error around the wrong counterfactual. Causal banking
research proposal project (2026b)


30.4.2    What the selected implementation actually summarizes

The R data path takes the response in its first column and controls in later columns. It
checks numeric input, requires more than three total rows and a pre-period spanning at least
three row positions, and rejects missing covariates. Some out-of-range period endpoints are
clipped with warnings. The automatic path standardizes using pre-period moments and masks
the response after the pre-period before fitting. The supplied-model path instead requires a
separately fitted bsts model with the post-treatment response missing. These details are part
of the computation’s information boundary; an adapter must not silently train on the response
it is supposed to predict counterfactually.Google CausalImpact maintainers (2026b)
   The automatic model includes a local level and optionally seasonality and regression. The
inspected defaults include 1,000 iterations, standardization, local-level prior scale 0.01, no
seasonal component and static regression. The static regression construction also supplies an
expected model size of three, expected R2 = 0.8, and prior degrees of freedom 50. These are
modeling choices to expose and examine, rather than bank-independent constants that need
no justification. The source passes seed=1 to its bsts calls, while predictive observation-noise
simulation uses R random generation. Reproducibility therefore needs the full runtime and
random-state contract; preserving only a displayed seed is insufficient. The number of iterations
is not a convergence certificate. Google CausalImpact maintainers (2026b)
   The distinction between latent-state means and predictive draws matters. The implementa-
tion averages state contributions for point predictions, but uses trajectories including simulated
observation noise for predictive quantiles. For draw b, the reported effect transformation is
                                                             TX
                                                              0 +h
                             (b)          (b)        (b)               (b)
                           ∆t = Yt − Yet ,         Ch =               ∆t .
                                                            t=T0 +1

                (b)
Quantiles of Ch retain dependence between dates. They are not obtained by adding the
marginal lower and upper bounds. The source also forces cumulative impact to zero before the
post-period begins; that convention must not be misreported as an empirical pre-treatment
causal test.Google CausalImpact maintainers (2026b); Brodersen et al. (2015)
  For example, consider four artificial two-day predictive draws:

                         (80, 120),   (120, 80),   (80, 120),    (120, 80).

Each marginal central 95 percent empirical interval is [80, 120], whereas every path sums to
200. The interval of sums is [200, 200]; adding marginal endpoints gives [160, 240]. If the
observed two-day total is 220, the corresponding draw-wise cumulative effect is always 20.
This finite arithmetic checks the aggregation rule only. It is neither an MCMC experiment nor
a coverage result. Causal banking research proposal project (2026b)
  Relative effects require another distinction. The inspected summary computes draw-wise
454                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


relative totals                                 P
                                                  Yt
                                       R(b) = P t (b) − 1
                                               t Yt
                                                 e

and then summarizes those ratios. A ratio of posterior means can differ sharply. With
actual total 10 and three artificial counterfactual totals −1, 1, 2, the ratios are −11, 9, 4, whose
mean is 2/3; dividing 10 by the mean counterfactual total and subtracting one gives 14. Zero
denominators are undefined, and small or negative denominators can make a percentage difficult
to interpret. The proposed report retains absolute effects and explicit denominator diagnostics
rather than clipping such values into a plausible-looking percentage.Google CausalImpact
maintainers (2026b); Causal banking research proposal project (2026b)
   The field called p is a one-sided simulation tail-area calculation. The inspected implementa-
tion appends the observed total to the predictive totals and takes the smaller inclusive tail
proportion. For B predictive draws its smallest positive value is 1/(B + 1); the four-draw
construction above gives 1/5, not zero. Its meaning depends on the specified predictive model
and simulation. It is not a design-based randomization probability, a proof that the causal
assumptions hold, or a posterior probability that a point-null model is true. An interface should
preserve the source field and explain this definition instead of converting every uncertainty
measure into the same generic significance label.Google CausalImpact maintainers (2026b);
Causal banking research proposal project (2026b)
   Finally, units determine useful aggregation. Brodersen and colleagues distinguish a cumu-
lative flow effect from an average stock effect. Daily additional applications can be summed
over the campaign. An extra USD 10,000 of deposit balance observed on each of three dates is
USD 10,000 at the last date; summing those snapshots produces USD 30,000-days under a
daily exposure convention, not USD 30,000 of new deposits or revenue. Funding value would
need a specified balance-time and margin calculation. The adapter request therefore includes
whether the response is a flow, a stock, a rate or an index, its units and its aggregation rule.
Brodersen et al. (2015); Causal banking research proposal project (2026b)


30.4.3    Calendars, failures and a proposed adapter boundary

The source saves the original time labels and then replaces the internal time index with
sequential row numbers. Its own comment notes that this precludes automatic filling of
missing time points. The missing-date tests check that omitted labels remain omitted from
the output. A Friday and the following Monday may therefore be neighboring model steps
in a sparse input. For a bank, business-day dynamics and calendar-day accrual are different
choices. Before fitting, the proposed adapter validates a declared calendar, row uniqueness,
time-zone treatment and period boundaries. Filling omitted rows, carrying forward balances
or aggregating transactions would require an explicit transformation; each can change the
estimand or state evolution. Google CausalImpact maintainers (2026b)
   Constant, entirely missing or insufficiently observed response series cause the selected model
builder to warn and return no fitted model. The wrapper can still return an object with
the CausalImpact class and unavailable inferences. Checking only the object’s class would
misclassify that failure as success. The proposed output boundary instead requires a fitted
model, usable draws and the requested summaries, while retaining warnings and missing-value
reasons. Missing controls, inadmissible periods, failed inference, unavailable relative summaries
and an unsupported scientific request need distinguishable responses. A treatment-affected
donor is a scientific restriction to assess; it is not equivalent to a numerical error. Google
CausalImpact maintainers (2026b); Causal banking research proposal project (2026a)
  For a future R worker, the request should bind the response definition, units, calendar,
30.4. Bayesian intervention analysis for branch campaigns                                    455


pre/post periods, donor identities, supplied causal restrictions, data provenance, missingness
policy, model specification, priors, iteration and random-state settings, and a resource limit.
The response should retain source/runtime identities, effective periods, warnings, posterior draw
identity or a verifiable draw artifact, point and cumulative summaries with their uncertainty
type, denominator diagnostics and execution status. Neither the generated prose report nor
a generic “success” field substitutes for these quantities. Inputs and outputs would cross a
versioned file or process boundary; the existing CLI and MCP service does not acquire this
behavior merely because the contract is specified. Causal banking research proposal project
(2026a)
   The first behavioral comparison should run the same frozen fixture directly in R and through
the adapter in the same environment. It should compare effective periods, row labels, warnings,
draw dimensions and numerical summaries, not only a plotted effect. Separate fixtures should
cover a missing date, missing controls, a constant response, a one-day post-period, a gap
between periods, out-of-range endpoints and a supplied model with incorrectly retained post-
treatment outcomes. The exact constructions above provide independent checks of aggregation
and reporting; they do not replace a matched native run. A subsequent prospectively designed
simulation can assess recovery under an explicit observation law and retain contaminated
donors and structural breaks as failures. None of these future fitted comparisons is claimed as
completed.Causal banking research proposal project (2026a)


30.4.4    Language paths, licenses and the reuse decision

The R package declares Apache 2.0. Its license requires preserving the applicable license

is LGPL-2.1 | MIT + file LICENSE; its companion file supplies the copyright holder and
year. The inspected Boom description also identifies incorporated third-party code. Any
distributed build consequently needs its own dependency and notice inventory, including the
applicable LGPL source or relinking route. These declarations are source evidence, not a
solved dependency lock or blanket redistribution clearance. Google CausalImpact maintainers
(2026a); Steven L. Scott and package contributors (2026)

30.5     Fitting weights and target weights
fect’s selected documentation distinguishes weights used in counterfactual fitting from weights
used to aggregate treatment effects. The latter do not automatically implement inverse-
probability or doubly robust confounding correction. A fitting weight changes the optimization
or fitting population; an aggregation weight changes the reported average. The two can be
numerically similar vectors and still represent different operations.fect contributors (2026)
  This distinction is especially important when a bank moves between account-weighted,
exposure-weighted and monetary-loss-weighted effects. If effects τi are reported as
                                              P
                                                 wi τi
                                         τw = Pi       ,
                                                  i wi
then the definition and availability time of wi are part of the target. A realized post-treatment
balance weight can change the population being averaged and may itself be affected by
treatment. The formula alone does not justify its causal interpretation. The interface should
retain the weight’s meaning and clock, including whether it was fixed before action.
   fect also documents restrictions on its parametric bootstrap. Its 2.4.5 manual retains some
language about earlier version roadmaps. Those passages require implementation review before
30.5. Fitting weights and target weights                                               457


being presented as verified current behavior. The proposed trial therefore selects an exact
fitting method, aggregation rule and resampling law and checks them together. A successful
counterfactual fit cannot substitute for that complete procedure.
   The resulting panel strategy is plural: evaluate ATT procedures, staged regression,
interaction-weighted event studies, donor weighting and counterfactual factor approaches
for the questions they support. The product may offer a coherent report across them
while preserving incompatible targets and assumptions. Matched comparisons should align
populations, horizons and information, and they should retain a losing method or an
unsupported case instead of forcing every candidate into one ranking.
Chapter 31

Agents, language boundaries and
qualification

31.1     A directional suggestion is a proposal
Language assistance can help an analyst translate a business question into variables, explain
candidate diagrams, retrieve documentation and construct a tool request. Those operations
are useful even when a language model cannot identify an effect from the available information.
The software boundary should make that distinction explicit: a model-generated proposition
enters an evidence and review process before it changes the graph used for causal inference.
   The inspected pgmpy LLMPairwise implementation is an instructive concrete example. It
requires exactly two variables and builds its prompt from their names and optional descriptions.
Observed values are not used to orient the edge. The prompt asks the model to choose
one of two directions and the result constructs a graph with one directed edge. There is
no output choice for no edge, a common cause, insufficient information or a retained graph
alternative.pgmpy contributors (2026b)
   This design may be suitable for collecting a narrowly defined directional suggestion. It
cannot by itself answer a broader question about whether two bank variables are causally
connected. “Contact” and “distress” may refer to variables at different times, and a bank
can contact distressed customers while earlier contact also changes later distress. Names
without clocks do not determine the causal question. The project graph-equivalence example
in Chapter 27 also shows that observational ambiguity can remain even with data; a forced
linguistic choice does not resolve that mathematical ambiguity.
   Two implementation details strengthen the case for treating the output as a proposal. The
selected internal cache uses the unordered pair of names as its key. Description, prompt,
provider/model and sampling parameters are not part of that key. If an instance retains this
cache across calls, changed semantics can therefore reuse an old orientation. This is a static
conditional finding about the cache path; the full estimator lifecycle has not been executed.
An integration test must establish when state is retained and verify invalidation against the
actual call contract.pgmpy contributors (2026b)
   The response parser searches first for a digit 1 or 2, then for an A/B token. A sentence
containing such a digit can be interpreted as an orientation even when its meaning is a refusal.
For example, the text “neither option 1 nor option 2 is justified” contains a first matching
digit. The proposed integration should use a strict structured response with explicit abstention
and preserve the raw response. Parser acceptance is a syntactic property; it cannot establish
the truth of the extracted direction.

                                              458
31.2. Evidence and authority must travel separately                                          459


   The decision for this inspected path is therefore to reject direct use of its raw edge as a
qualified discovery result. An exploratory assistant could still use it after adding a complete
request identity, structured abstention, independent source checks and graph alternatives.
Those changes would need their own review and evaluation. They are proposed remedies, not
already verified upstream or project behavior.


31.2     Evidence and authority must travel separately
An assistant might accurately quote a package manual yet request an operation that the
organization has not approved. It might also request an approved operation for a causally
invalid target. Evidence, scientific applicability and operational authority are separate inputs.
A citation is evidence for a claim in its scope; it is not authority to execute an action. A
successful schema check is evidence that a declaration has the expected shape; it is not evidence
that a business owner certified the declaration.
   The proposed workflow binds a reviewed target and graph declaration to an exact input
identity. The selected operation consumes that declaration, returns typed results and retains
the chain from the question to the assumptions, method and output. Changes to the treatment
clock, target population or diagram create a different scientific request. A cached numeric
result or prior approval should not silently follow those changes.
   Retrieved documentation must be treated as source material. Text inside a manual, repos-
itory or model response cannot grant itself permission to select another tool, change the
target or publish a decision. For the product user, the meaningful consequence is a reviewable
record of which evidence supported which proposition and which person or authorized process
accepted the scientific declaration. Internal file names and routing details are not substitutes
for that explanation.


31.3     One operation across library, CLI and MCP
A reusable causal product can expose a library call, a command-line request and an MCP
tool for the same operation. Their success criterion is semantic equivalence. Given the same
complete request and execution policy, each should preserve the target, graph endpoints,
expression or set topology, numerical units, missingness and refusal state. The transport
should not narrow a PAG to a DAG, replace a disconnected set with a pair of endpoints, or
turn an unsupported request into a zero effect.
   This motivates a narrow integration boundary. A discovery operation returns a graph object
together with the test and search settings needed to interpret it. An identification operation
returns an expression or a typed failure in the supplied model class. An estimation operation
returns its target, uncertainty and numerical diagnostics. A policy-value operation returns
the specified regime and horizon. A consumer can combine these operations only when their
contracts match; the mere availability of a tool name does not establish that match.
   For Tetrad, the initial bridge candidate is a Java process with explicit graph serialization.
This isolates runtime management but adds startup, transfer and error-mapping costs. Its
inspected root POM declares compiler release 21, while the inspected README describes
Java JDK 25+ for bridge use. These are distinct source observations requiring an actual
environment qualification; choosing one by assumption would conceal a deployment uncertainty.
tetrad contributors (2026)
  For the selected R estimators, a process boundary can preserve the native method and
460                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


dependencies. A direct Python interface can reduce translation for causal-learn and selected
pgmpy operations. For aGrUM, comparing the existing wrapper with native C++ calls can
clarify whether serialization or binding overhead matters for the intended workload. These are
candidate routes. No downloaded package was executed for the inspections reported in this
reader.
  Porting should be justified by a concrete advantage: unavailable deployment environments,
a measured bottleneck, a required result representation or a maintenance constraint. It carries
an obligation to reproduce the complete procedure, including error behavior and uncertainty.
Rewriting only a point estimate while retaining a familiar method name would create a
misleading compatibility claim. Direct adoption also requires a dependency and license review;
a permissive root license does not settle every bundled component.


31.4     A matched trial needs scientific and operational failures
Qualification begins with an exact supported request and a suitable reference. For a graph
operation, independent endpoint fixtures and known graph classes test representation and
algorithm scope. For an estimator, analytically tractable mechanisms or an independently
reviewed implementation test the target and numerical behavior. For a confidence set,
evaluation must retain empty, disconnected and unbounded outputs. For a longitudinal
procedure, a mechanism with action-dependent histories tests whether the intervention was
preserved. Ordinary and difficult cases belong in the same declared trial.
   The measured workflow includes serialization, process startup, dependency loading, fitting,
uncertainty and result publication. A bridge that improves fit time but dominates total
latency with transfer costs may be a poor choice for small requests. Conversely, an expensive
startup may be acceptable for a large repeated analysis if the process lifecycle is controlled. A
comparison should retain both outcomes rather than report only the most favorable component
timer.
   Failure injection tests a different property from statistical calibration. Interrupted input
transfer, worker failure and interrupted publication should not create a partly valid result.
Replay needs immutable inputs and exact predecessor artifacts. If a method uses randomness,
its seed and configuration belong in the request record, while nondeterministic numerical
behavior needs a stated tolerance. A recoverable execution record makes the calculation
auditable; it does not prove its causal assumptions.
   No general preference for a process bridge, a native binding or a port can be established
without these measurements. The current source evidence does support a narrower decision:
evaluate existing implementations first where their contracts fit, preserve distinct outputs and
failures, and reject interfaces that force unsupported scientific meaning without a reviewed
adaptation.


31.5     Commercial comparison and the remaining evidence
         boundary
The commercial comparison must operate at the same level of specificity. For each vendor
edition, the evidence should identify the estimator or graph operation, its supported data and
assumptions, uncertainty and diagnostic outputs, automation interface, license boundary and
dated cost information. A product brochure can establish that a capability is advertised; it
cannot substitute for technical documentation of the method or an actual trial.
31.6. Selecting Tetrad without adopting an unrestricted discovery service                    461


  The selected community Stata package demonstrates why runtime and vendor capability
must be separated. It may extend an organization’s Stata workflow, but that observation does
not establish what the vendor ships, licenses or supports. Similarly, a graphical application
component does not establish a commercial causal-identification engine. Where essential
vendor originals remain unavailable, the capability comparison is unverified; it is not a finding
that the vendor lacks the feature.
   The immediate engineering requirements are nevertheless concrete. Preserve scientific
targets and uncertainty objects, expose method-specific unsupported states, qualify language
boundaries, and evaluate whole workflows under declared assumptions. These requirements
address defects that would otherwise be hidden by a superficially uniform API. Completing
the wider software survey, commercial comparison and bank qualification requires additional
primary sources and trials; this selected review supplies evidence and testable integration
choices for that work.

          ery service

31.6.1    What the dependency and maintenance evidence establishes

Parsing the active library-POM dependency elements yields twenty direct declarations. This

and text utilities, an explicit JUnit entry, GUI-related libraries and the DJL API and PyTorch
engine. Several have no explicit scope in that POM; the data-reader version is expressed
through the project version. This is the declared module configuration, not a measured
minimal dependency set for PC. The presence of a PyTorch-related dependency does not show
that a PC request uses a GPU, and a commented dependency is not an active requirement.
(cmu-phil/tetrad, 2026b)
  An executable comparison should therefore resolve and hash the selected artifacts, distinguish
build and runtime needs, and inspect the effective dependency tree. Removing apparently
unused dependencies without checking imports, service loading, packaged resources and tests
would create a new distribution whose behavior needs review. Conversely, inheriting the
462                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


complete application environment may impose avoidable setup and maintenance costs. These
two alternatives can be measured on the same PC request; neither is declared faster or cheaper
in this proposal.
   The source tree and README provide a maintenance route: a named project, build/test
commands and an issue tracker. The inspected PC tests include graph-oracle assertions and a

for detecting a changed implementation, but it is not an independent proof of a statistical
property. No upstream CI success, current support service level or future response time has
been measured. Upgrades must repeat semantic, numerical and failure checks instead of relying
on an unchanged method name. (cmu-phil/tetrad, 2026a,b)


31.6.2    Rights and the actual reuse choice

The saved root license is GPL version 3; the inspected PC source header grants version 3 or
later. The license’s basic permissions explicitly address running an unmodified program and
making/running works that are not conveyed. Its conveyance sections require preservation of
notices and, in the applicable object-code arrangements, corresponding source. Modified source
has additional notice and license conditions. These primary terms support consideration of
a local research comparison while leaving the actual packaged distribution and third-party
components to be reviewed. A process boundary is an engineering choice, not a blanket
exemption from these terms. (cmu-phil/tetrad, 2026b)
   The proposal therefore selects the restricted Java PC route for further work but does
not yet mark an engine as available. Direct unrestricted adoption is rejected for this route
because it would expose unreviewed algorithms, defaults and input regimes under one apparent
guarantee. Porting PC into a new local implementation is deferred: it would add responsibility
for orientation rules, tests and maintenance without a measured deployment constraint that
justifies the duplication. The existing shared semantic layer and exact examples remain useful
regardless of the selected engine. The choice can change if resolved dependencies, distribution
obligations or measured workflow costs make another candidate more suitable. (Causal banking
proposal project, 2026r)


31.6.3    The first comparison has a graph target and a failure contract

The retained prototype profile concerns complete IID continuous data under explicit linear-
Gaussian, acyclic, causally sufficient, faithful and no-selection assumptions. It uses the fixed
settings specified by the Java adapter contract and retains the banking target, population,
units, sampling unit and information clock. The immediate output is a validated CPDAG. It is
not an intervention estimate, an effect confidence region or a declaration that the assumptions
are true. Latent-variable FCI, FGES, time-series search, background-knowledge constraints
and missing-data procedures require separate profiles. (Causal banking research project, 2026v)
   The independent exact reference gives three Gaussian causal models with the same observed
covariance and the same noncollider chain class. Their intervention responses from the first to
the third variable are zero, zero and 2/5. Thus a unique selected orientation can change a
banking recommendation while leaving the observed law unchanged. An adapter must retain
the unresolved chain rather than silently report one member’s effect. The reference also checks
endpoint direction, isolated variables, unit conversion and changes in scientific context. These
are project calculations, not outputs from a Java executable. (Causal banking research project,
2026w)
  Failure handling is a material selection condition. In the pinned Fisher-Z implementation,
31.6. Selecting Tetrad without adopting an unrestricted discovery service                    463


checkIndependence catches a singular-matrix exception and returns a dependence result with
p = 0. The exception-preserving getResult path permits a different wrapper design. That
wrapper must validate each result, record a failed numerical query and withhold the job’s
graph when its computation did not complete. The inspection establishes source behavior
at one revision; it is not a measured failure rate or a claim that every data set triggers it.
(cmu-phil/tetrad, 2026a)
   The stable skeleton search also uses parallel work. Its pair routine catches an interruption,
restores that worker’s interrupt flag and returns from the pair. The parent wrapper therefore
needs a job-level failure state and complete terminal query records before publication. An
independent whole-process time and memory limit complements the engine’s cooperative
behavior. Neither a returned graph object nor an elapsed timeout setting alone proves that
every required query completed. The complete interface, concurrency behavior and failure
propagation remain implementation tests, not benefits already delivered by the contract.
(Tetrad contributors, 2026a; Causal banking research project, 2026v; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026r)


31.6.4    Alternatives, costs and a revisable admission decision

The first executable comparison should include the separately reviewed R or Python PC
candidate using the same scientific assumptions, test settings, data and graph target. Such
a comparator is selected only after its own source and environment review. Weka’s predic-
tive Bayesian-network workflow, supplied commercial latent-model fits and symbolic effect-
identification engines answer different questions; they can be useful components without serving
as substitutes for this CPDAG comparison. (cmu-phil/tetrad, 2026a; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026r)
   Measure environment setup, retained disk footprint, full-request runtime, peak memory,
conversion overhead, analyst corrections and maintenance effort. Failed queries, numerical
failures, cancellations and unsupported requests remain in the account. A computation of
the wrong scientific object cannot win by being fast. No vendor price, bank workload or
analyst-time saving is assigned from the current source inspection.
   Three responsibilities make admission concrete. The adapter maintainer resolves and records
the build/runtime and dependency rights. The scientific reviewer checks the selected profile,
graph-class recognition and matched references. The workflow owner evaluates full-request
failure handling and the actual cost against a usable baseline. These are proposed roles, not
fabricated acceptance by named institutions. Revisit executable admission when the pinned
build, conversion, graph-class, numerical and interruption cases have actual results; reopen the
choice when revision, license, API, dependency or target assumptions change. Other proposal
and prototype work remains independent of this local admission question. (Causal banking
proposal project, 2026r)


31.6.5    Choosing an R discovery and effect-set boundary

The preferred R route is a restricted integration of pcalg for Gaussian observational discovery
and singleton linear effects. Its attraction is the connection between a partially directed graph
and a multiset of effects: the product can preserve uncertainty about direction instead of
forcing a unique business answer. The proposal selects this pinned path for local prototype
implementation under the strict contract developed below. Runtime qualification remains
open until the environment and conversion boundary have been exercised; selection does not
claim that the proposed R adapter already works.
464                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


   The selected source is pcalg version 2.7-12, dated 12 September 2024, at CRAN mirror
revision 930fe476875ddc00528dbaacb6f48f2791ab12e3. The bounded history query selects
the most recent mirror commit before the 7 October 2026 cutoff. The reference manual was
generated in May 2026; this later document date does not change the release into a 2026
implementation. Ten inspected source files have byte identities matching the selected Git
tree. The mirror is explicitly a read-only copy of the CRAN package, and its commit history
establishes package identity and release activity, rather than upstream support quality (pcalg
contributors, 2026; pcalg contributors; CRAN source mirror, 2024b).
   PC, its stable and conservative variants, FCI, GIES and IDA are operations or families within
this package, not independent implementations whose agreement would multiply evidence.
The initial integration selects only the PC/IDA path. The presence of latent-variable and
interventional algorithms in the same package does not make their model classes interchangeable.
A later FCI route would require a separate partial ancestral graph contract, and a later GIES
route would require intervention metadata and score assumptions. A successful installation
cannot settle either scientific extension.

What an effect multiset would mean for a bank

Let the observed vector contain an offered rate change X, an intermediate customer response
M , and a monetary outcome Y . The initial model is a linear Gaussian structural system with
independently sampled units, no hidden common causes and a distribution faithful to its causal
DAG. The sampling unit could be a customer in a stipulated independent-unit experiment;
repeated customer months cannot be relabeled as independent rows. The graph search
estimates conditional independence structure. Its significance level is a level for individual
tests, not a confidence level for the entire graph or for the effect of a future bank action (pcalg
contributors, 2026).
  For a compatible DAG G, the singleton total effect is the derivative
                                          ∂
                                   θG =     EG [Y | do(X = x)].
                                         ∂x
In the stated linear model it is constant in x. When Y is not a parent of X, it can be calculated
by regressing Y on X and the parents of X in G. If Y is a parent, its total effect from
X is zero. The global IDA construction considers compatible DAGs; the local construction
uses admissible local parent configurations. They need not attach the same multiplicity to
a numerical value. Neither construction turns a frequency in this multiset into a posterior
probability of a graph (pcalg contributors, 2026; pcalg contributors; CRAN source mirror,
2024b).
  The distinction is visible without fitting a package. Consider the exact covariance matrix,
ordered as (X, M, Y ),                                    
                                         1     0.6    0.48
                                Σ =  0.6 1.36 1.088  .
                                                          
                                        0.48 1.088 1.8704
The partial covariance of X and Y given M is 0.48 − 0.6(1.088)/1.36 = 0. The three DAGs
X → M → Y , X ← M → Y , and X ← M ← Y can each generate this same Gaussian law
with positive independent error variances. Exact rational reconstruction of all three systems
gives total effects 0.48, 0, 0. Global enumeration therefore has multiset [0, 0, 0.48]; the two local
parent configurations of X give [0, 0.48]. Averaging the first would produce 0.16, and averaging
the second would produce 0.24. Neither average is identified as the bank’s intervention effect.
These are exact project constructions and independent references, not results from executing
pcalg (Causal proposal project, 2026b).
31.6. Selecting Tetrad without adopting an unrestricted discovery service                      465


   Suppose X is measured in percentage points and Y in thousands of currency units. The
nonzero derivative becomes 4.8 currency units per basis point, so a 25-basis-point action gives
120 currency units per modeled unit in the forward-chain system. The other systems permit
zero. In general, for X ′ = cX X and Y ′ = cY Y ,

                               Σ′ = DΣDT ,         ′
                                                  θG = (cY /cX )θG .

Both the covariance transformation and the output units must survive an R process boundary.
A correlation matrix alone is insufficient to restore monetary units. Further, naming X an
offered rate is not evidence for its causal position. Justified timing or an intervention can
exclude competing graphs; vocabulary alone cannot. Sampling uncertainty remains a separate
obligation even when a graph class has been correctly represented.


Matrix conventions change causal meaning

An adjacency matrix is not a complete interface specification. In this package, the documented
amat.cpdag convention refers to the row endpoint, whereas amat.pag refers to the column
endpoint. The selected pcAlgo coercion calls wgtMatrix, whose default transposes the under-
lying graph matrix. Thus a consumer that changes the accessor while keeping its old decoder
can reverse every directed edge (pcalg contributors, 2026; pcalg contributors; CRAN source
mirror, 2024b).
  For distinct named nodes i and j, write the ordered pair (Aij , Aji ). The following conventions
must remain separate.

                                                  Pair for an               Interpretation
   Representation          Pair for i → j         undirected edge           requirement
   amat.cpdag from        (0, 1)                  (1, 1)                    Row-endpoint
   the pcAlgo matrix                                                        convention; retain
   coercion                                                                 the exact accessor.
   Matrix of the          (1, 0)                  (1, 1)                    Row denotes source;
   underlying                                                               verify the installed
   graphNEL object                                                          graph conversion.
   amat.pag               (2, 3)                  (3, 3)                    Column-endpoint
                                                                            marks; outside the
                                                                            initial effect path.


   A symmetric example cannot detect a transpose. The proposed acceptance fixtures therefore
include a named directed chain and a named collider, each under every permutation of its three
columns. An independently written decoder was checked on 54 representation/fixture/permu-
tation combinations, and 36 deliberate transposes of directed fixtures changed the expected
answer. These checks establish the small reference examples. They do not establish that an
installed R serializer preserves them; that is the later adapter test (Causal proposal project,
2026b).
  The response should retain the original representation, node order, exact accessor and
package revisions alongside named edges. A display may render the graph more conveniently,
but an unresolved edge must stay unresolved. The importer must also retain the origin of
exceptional marks. A pair of twos can encode an orientation conflict in PC and a bidirected
edge in a PAG; equal integers do not establish equal scientific meaning.

Failures must be caught before they are hidden

The selected source makes three failure boundaries especially consequential. First, with
solve.confl=false, relaxed PC can overwrite an earlier edge direction when another collider
or orientation rule conflicts with it. With solve.confl=true, it can preserve conflicting
directions using reciprocal entries of two. The proposed profile therefore uses conservative
PC, stable skeleton search, relaxed orientation and conflict preservation. Such a result may
still fail to be a valid CPDAG. The discovery result can retain this diagnostic, while the
effect calculation must refuse it. The conflict is not evidence of a latent common cause (pcalg
contributors; CRAN source mirror, 2024b).
   Second, a finite conditional-independence p value need not show that every preceding
numerical operation was valid. The inspected pcorOrder uses a pseudoinverse for conditioning
sets of size at least two, replaces a missing partial correlation by zero, and clips its result.
zStat likewise replaces a missing statistic by zero; gaussCItest then evaluates a two-sided
Gaussian tail probability. Disabling NAdelete acts later in the skeleton routine and cannot
recover a failure already replaced inside these functions (pcalg contributors; CRAN source
mirror, 2024b).
  For example, in the invalid correlation matrix with every entry equal to one, the one-variable
conditioning formula gives
                                                1−1·1          0
                                 r12|3 = p         2       2
                                                              = .
                                             (1 − 1 )(1 − 1 )  0

Replacing this undefined value by zero yields a finite p value of one. An independently written
base-R scalar trace reproduces this arithmetic; it also verifies that positive-definite factorization
rejects the input. A separate invalid-degrees-of-freedom example reaches the same finite p
value through the statistic fallback. These are intentionally invalid inputs, already excluded
by a correctly enforced preflight. They demonstrate why checking only the final p value is
insufficient, without establishing a failure for valid, well-conditioned package inputs (Causal
proposal project, 2026b).
   The proposed initial path instead supplies a strict Gaussian test callback through PC’s exist-
ing independence-test interface. It uses checked positive definite submatrices and factorization
solves, preserves degrees of freedom, and refuses rank loss, nonpositive residual variances, non-
finite arithmetic or unacceptable conditioning. It does not silently substitute a pseudoinverse,
clip a failed calculation or choose a new regularization parameter. Numerical tolerances must
be fixed before adapter qualification. This callback is a proposed project component with
its own comparison obligation, rather than a description of unmodified gaussCItest. The
compiled fast skeleton path is outside the initial profile so that it cannot bypass this callback.
   Third, the inspected IDA code replaces all nonzero graph weights by one before checking
graph validity. If validity fails, it emits a message without an immediate stop. A conflict
pair (2, 2) can therefore lose its distinction from an undirected pair (1, 1) before that check.
The proposed adapter must inspect the untouched graph, reject conflict codes, and enforce
a strict CPDAG/extension gate before calling IDA. It must not treat a warning stream as a
structured failure response, or silently orient an edge to make an invalid request calculable
(pcalg contributors; CRAN source mirror, 2024b).


Reuse choice, operating cost and the next experiment

An isolated local R process is the preferred implementation boundary. The request would
contain an operation name, named data or a checked summary, units, sampling assump-

the first experiment interpretable.
   The package declares GPL version 2 or later, R at least 3.5.0, seventeen imports and
three LinkingTo dependencies. It requires compilation; the selected build file links LAPACK,
BLAS and Fortran libraries. These are dependency declarations, not a resolved runtime

inspected key graph/build packages; no package benchmark is claimed here.
