31.7      R discovery when borrower risk and selection are hidden
The preceding PC/IDA boundary assumes a causally sufficient system. That assumption is
consequential in a servicing application: private borrower distress can affect both the bank’s
contact decision and subsequent recovery, while inclusion in an observed account panel can
depend on both. A larger regression or a more elaborate graph display does not by itself
remove either problem. The R comparison must therefore ask what information survives
latent common causes and selection, which object an algorithm returns, and which additional
argument would turn that object into a decision.
   The selected implementation is again pcalg 2.7-12 at the preserved September 2024 CRAN
mirror revision. FCI, RFCI, FCI+, conservative and majority variants, and the Joint Causal
Inference options are related operations in this package. They are not six independent software
implementations. The bounded R search also returns methodological papers, a Python software
paper and other-language leads; their presence in a search result does not establish an R
implementation. The following claims concern inspected pinned manuals, implementation
paths and authentic method papers. They do not constitute a complete census of every
R extension or an executed package comparison (pcalg contributors; CRAN source mirror,
2024a).


What a latent-variable graph says. Let X denote the recorded variables, L unrecorded
variables, and S the variables on which inclusion is conditioned. For an underlying acyclic
causal graph, a maximal ancestral graph can represent the conditional-independence structure
left after marginalizing L and conditioning on S. A partial ancestral graph, or PAG, records
features shared by compatible ancestral graphs. The marks carry information: an arrowhead
at a vertex rules out its ancestry of the opposite vertex and the selection variables under the
stated model; a tail carries an ancestral restriction; a circle leaves an endpoint unresolved. In
particular, selection can make the interpretation of a tail refer to ancestry of selection, rather
than a uniquely established direct causal effect on the other recorded variable. An estimated
PAG is neither a single fully specified structural model nor a numerical intervention estimate
(pcalg contributors; CRAN source mirror, 2024a; Colombo et al., 2012).
  The distinction is stronger for RFCI. In the definition of an FCI-PAG, an adjacency asserts
dependence for all eligible conditioning subsets of the recorded variables, conditional on
31.7. R discovery when borrower risk and selection are hidden                               469


selection. In an RFCI-PAG the corresponding requirement concerns subsets of the adjacent
sets. This weaker statement can leave additional edges and can represent more than one Markov
equivalence class. The causal endpoint information is sound in the oracle theorem under
faithfulness, but it is incorrect to relabel the RFCI output as the complete FCI equivalence
class. A common serialization class named fciAlgo does not erase this difference. The
proposed artifact must retain the algorithm, version and object semantics as well as the matrix
(Colombo et al., 2012; pcalg contributors; CRAN source mirror, 2024a).

A bank decision that the observed table cannot settle. Consider a binary contact
action A and binary recovery Y . Three authored mechanisms produce exactly the same strictly
positive observed table:
                                           Y =0 Y =1
                                   A=0      2/5    1/10
                                   A = 1 1/10       2/5
In the first mechanism A is randomized with probability 1/2, and P (Y = 1 | do(A = a)) =
1/5 + 3a/5. Its effect is 3/5. In the second, hidden U is a fair binary variable. Conditional on
U , action and recovery are independent, with

           P (A = 1 | U = u) = 1/10 + 4u/5,         P (Y = 1 | U = u) = 1/8 + 3u/4.

All eight (U, A, Y ) cells have positive probability. Marginalization gives the same displayed
table, but setting A does not alter U or Y : both intervention means are 1/2 and the effect
is zero. Thus an observed conditional contrast of 3/5 is compatible with no contact effect
(Causal banking proposal project, 2026l).
   For the third mechanism, A and Y are independent in the population, with P (A = 1) =
2/5 and P (Y = 1) = 1/3. Inclusion probabilities for (A, Y ) = (0, 0), (0, 1), (1, 0), (1, 1)
are respectively 1/5, 1/10, 3/40, 3/5. Multiplying by the population cell probabilities and
normalizing by P (S = 1) = 1/5 again gives the displayed table. The population effect is
zero; the selected association does not identify the unselected population effect. The selection
graph has A → S ← Y . It has a different interpretation from the hidden common-cause graph
A ← U → Y , even though this observed table cannot distinguish them from the direct-effect
mechanism (Causal banking proposal project, 2026l).
   If a recovery is assigned a value of USD 100 and a contact costs USD 20, the three stipulated
population net values are USD 40, USD −20 and USD −20. These are illustrative prices
and mechanisms, not bank measurements. The three values demonstrate unresolved decision
consequences; they are not a sharp identified set over all possible causal models. A useful
product keeps the conflicting explanations and asks which restriction, assignment evidence or
intervention could distinguish them. Selecting the graph whose implied profit is most attractive
cannot supply that missing information (Causal banking proposal project, 2026l).

How the algorithms spend information and computation. FCI begins with an
adjacency search and then considers separating sets that can lie outside a node’s immediate
neighborhood. Its Possible-D-SEP stage can remove edges the initial search retained, after
which orientation rules refine endpoint marks. RFCI omits that global stage and instead
performs additional local tests for unshielded triples and discriminating paths. This is a trade
between computational work and informativeness, not a claim that RFCI finds exactly the
same graph more cheaply on every input. The oracle soundness result requires a faithful
underlying DAG and correct conditional-independence information. Neither a software return
code nor a large nominal sample size establishes these premises (Colombo et al., 2012; pcalg
contributors; CRAN source mirror, 2024a).
470                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


   The high-dimensional consistency result is also specific. It assumes IID copies of the selected
observed law, multivariate Gaussianity, faithfulness, restrictions on graph-neighborhood growth,
and nonzero partial correlations bounded away from a shrinking detection boundary while
remaining bounded away from one. The FCI result uses a stronger restriction on the growth
of Possible-D-SEP sets. Its conclusion uses a sequence of tuning levels; it is not a finite-sample
graph-confidence guarantee at the user’s chosen alpha. Repeated monthly observations on the
same borrowers do not become IID merely because they are supplied to the same function
(Colombo et al., 2012).
   The per-test level should consequently travel as a test parameter, not a confidence attached
to the entire graph. For an explicitly hypothetical family of 100 independent true-null tests at
level .05, the probability of at least one rejection is 1 − .95100 . That elementary calculation
does not describe FCI’s adaptive testing error, but it exposes the unsupported step from a
per-test parameter to a simultaneous claim. Graph uncertainty, orientation ambiguity, model
restrictions and sampling uncertainty need separate treatment before an effect set can receive
a coverage label (Causal banking proposal project, 2026l; Colombo et al., 2012).
   FCI+ supplies a different search strategy. Its method paper bounds the number of oracle
independence tests by order N 2(k+2) for N observed variables and a fixed bound k on node
degree. The result presumes the faithful acyclic model and the stated oracle conditions while
allowing latent variables and selection. Polynomial order at fixed k is not a practical runtime
promise, and the paper notes that sample versions can use larger conditioning sets and lose
power. The proposal should compare FCI+ as an alternative under the same generated regimes,
without translating the complexity result into a bank-scale performance claim (Claassen et al.,
2013).


Options are scientific choices, not cosmetic settings. The pinned implementation
exposes normal, anytime and adaptive-anytime FCI. A finite m.max restricts conditioning-set
size. A distinct parameter, pdsep.max, is checked against the size of a candidate Possible-D-
SEP set: when that size exceeds the limit, the selected code skips the corresponding search. It
does not simply enumerate all subsets up to that order. A job that reaches the limit therefore
needs an explicit restricted-search disposition. A faster answer is not automatically equivalent
to an unrestricted run (pcalg contributors; CRAN source mirror, 2024a).
   Missing conditional-independence results require equal care. In the inspected Possible-D-
SEP path, NAdelete=TRUE maps a missing test result to one and can remove an edge; false
maps it to zero and retains the edge in that path. This is a software rule, not evidence that
the missing result establishes independence or dependence. The proposed adapter should
retain the missing-test count and reason and apply an explicit admission policy. It should
not silently use either behavior to manufacture certainty. Hard-coded gaps and edges likewise
encode supplied restrictions; their provenance and sensitivity belong in the scientific result
(pcalg contributors; CRAN source mirror, 2024a).
   Conservative or majority-rule orientation reduces particular ambiguities but does not imply
full order invariance. The order-independent methods paper distinguishes stable skeletons,
decisions about unshielded triples and the subsequent orientation rules. RFCI can remove
further edges using order-dependent separating sets, so even a stable initial skeleton does not
make its final skeleton fully invariant. The package manual retains this warning. Permuting
the input columns and translating back to the original labels is therefore a useful proposed
diagnostic, not a theorem that the selected route must already pass (Colombo and Maathuis,
2014; pcalg contributors; CRAN source mirror, 2024a).
   Selection and context options must be admitted together. FCI and FCI+ default to allowing
selection bias. Setting selectionBias=FALSE imposes its absence and disables the selected
31.7. R discovery when borrower risk and selection are hidden                                471


selection-related orientation rules. In this pinned implementation nondefault JCI assumptions
require the no-selection setting. A branch or policy-regime label is not automatically an
exogenous, unconfounded randomized context. The proposed workflow must ask why that
context restriction is justified and whether account inclusion is compatible with it. The wider
cyclic and JCI theoretical claims require their own source and method review; this comparison
does not inherit them from an exposed argument name (pcalg contributors; CRAN source
mirror, 2024a).

Two concrete boundary defects change the reuse decision. For amat.pag, the matrix
entry refers to the endpoint at the column variable: one is a circle, two an arrowhead and three
a tail. This differs from the package’s DAG/CPDAG convention. The pinned pcalg2dagitty
implementation has explicit branches for seven nonzero endpoint pairs but omits the two
tail–circle cases. In particular, the documented input
                                                    !
                                              0 1
                                              3 0

represents a tail at the first vertex and a circle at the second. A static trace through this
two-node conversion adds neither an edge nor an isolated node and constructs pag{} before
the parser call. This is a source-level counterexample to unconditional lossless conversion, not
a recorded native parser response. The proposed route must explicitly support both cases
or refuse them before conversion, then verify labels, all endpoints and round-trip identity in
an isolated runtime qualification (pcalg contributors; CRAN source mirror, 2024a; Causal
banking proposal project, 2026l).
   FCI+ has a different provenance problem. Its manual describes the general result object as
containing separating sets, but the inspected return constructor places empty lists or vectors
in several diagnostic fields, including separating sets and test counts, with a placeholder
pMax. Empty fields must not be reported as a measured zero-test search or as a complete
explanation of why an edge disappeared. RFCI’s reported initial-skeleton test counts also do not
enumerate all of its later local tests. A scientifically auditable route needs instrumentation of
the conditional-independence interface or an explicit diagnostic-coverage limitation. This work
has inspected those code paths; it has not installed that instrumentation (pcalg contributors;
CRAN source mirror, 2024a).
   A representative-graph conversion cannot repair either scientific uncertainty or missing
provenance. The inspected pag2magAM documentation constructs one compatible MAG, subject
to a restriction on new edges into the requested node and the absence of selection variables.
Its output is a representative used within a specified graphical criterion, not evidence that
the selected graph is the true bank mechanism. In particular, the existence of one convenient
adjustment or effect calculation does not settle all models represented by the original discovery
result (pcalg contributors; CRAN source mirror, 2024a).

A restricted integration path and its alternatives. The preferred addition to the
proposal is an isolated R FCI/RFCI comparison route that preserves PAG versus RFCI-
PAG semantics and all endpoint marks. FCI is the richer reference; RFCI is the explicitly
less informative alternative when the proposed workload makes the full search unattractive.
FCI+ remains a candidate subject to complete diagnostic accounting and matched resource
evaluation. The initial PC/IDA path remains appropriate only when its separate causal-
sufficiency assumptions are defended. The existing Python and Java comparisons offer
independent implementation candidates, but equal algorithm names do not establish equal
defaults, conversion conventions or statistical outputs.
472                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


   Direct adoption of an arbitrary returned graph as a bank decision is rejected. A wholesale
port is also not yet justified: it would inherit a large scientific verification burden, and moving
the same logic into another language would not resolve latent information or selection. The
immediate reuse choice is a narrow adapter with explicit test, search and diagnostic contracts.
The package’s previously inspected GPL declaration and dependency inventory remain relevant
to any distribution decision; this scientific selection grants neither a new licensing conclusion
nor deployment approval.
   The proposed qualification should begin with independently specified independence oracles
and small known graphs, then use generated samples with hidden causes, selection, weak
associations and missing tests. It must retain all requests, budget exits and graph ambiguities;
compare FCI, RFCI and FCI+ on the same declared laws; and separate native numerical
behavior from serialization correctness. Endpoint pairs, isolated nodes, invalid graph types,
column permutations, diagnostic completeness and search truncation need individual fixtures.
Only after those results should a decision study evaluate whether a justified effect or refusal
changes contact policy value. No package execution, finite-sample calibration or accepted R
adapter is claimed by the present source review.


31.8      A restricted pgmpy integration: verify the candidate,
          preserve the question
The proposal selects a narrow pgmpy integration for generating an adjustment candidate
from a supplied, fully observed causal DAG. The project must then verify that candidate
independently before reporting it. This choice reuses a permissively licensed graph library while
preserving a scientific boundary: a successful method call does not prove that the supplied
graph describes the bank, that the requested adjustment identifies the intended effect, or that
a numerical estimator has valid uncertainty. The selection authorizes development of this
limited prototype path; it is not evidence that an adapter has been implemented or executed
pgmpy contributors (2026a); Causal banking research project (2026ac).
   The source is pinned to the repository revision beginning 1f6296fc2606, committed on 5
October 2026 and selected by the cutoff-bounded history query. Its project metadata declares
version 1.1.2. Fifteen inspected source, guide, test and licensing files match the selected Git
tree, in addition to their local SHA-256 identities. Source acquisition occurred after the 7
October cutoff. The pin establishes which implementation is discussed; neither a late repository
snapshot nor a recent commit measures maintainer responsiveness or long-term support pgmpy
contributors (2026a).


31.8.1    A guide, a graph type and an implemented method are separate
          evidence

The identification guide presents minimal, variance-optimal and all-set adjustment routes.
The pinned implementation gives a more qualified picture. Its minimal-variance branch raises
NotImplementedError. The minimal branch explicitly requires a single exposure and outcome,
constructs a proper backdoor graph, then obtains a minimal separator. The all-set branch
enumerates subsets of an ancestor candidate set after removing specified causal-path and latent
variables. These operations cannot be combined into a claim that every documented graph
class and every advertised adjustment variant is implemented with the same semantics pgmpy
contributors (2026a).
  The distinction between minimal and minimum matters even without statistical estimation.
31.8. A restricted pgmpy integration: verify the candidate, preserve the question               473


A set is inclusion-minimal when no proper subset remains valid. It is minimum-cardinality
when no valid set has fewer elements. The inspected separator routine greedily removes
dispensable members of an initial set; that does not establish a global cardinality minimum.
Nor does cardinality alone determine estimator variance, data acquisition cost or missingness.
A front end should not translate the option name into the promise “the cheapest or most
precise set of controls” pgmpy contributors (2026a).
   An exact graph illustrates the difference. Let C cause A, B and Y ; let A and B cause X; and
include X → Y . The two inclusion-minimal backdoor sets are {C} and {A, B}. Conditioning
on C blocks both forks; without C, both A and B are needed. A project reference that deletes
dispensable variables from {A, B, C} obtains either answer depending on deletion order. That
computation describes the semantics of greedy minimality; it is not a measured pgmpy output.
For a lending example, one verified common driver may be cheaper to collect than two separate
proxies, but its actual measurement quality and availability still determine whether the smaller
set is useful Causal banking research project (2026ac).
   The package’s all-set path is also a bounded algorithmic choice. Enumerating subsets can
require work exponential in the candidate count. Restricting the candidates to ancestors is
meaningful, but a consumer must retain that domain rather than describe the output as all
imaginable observed-variable sets. Variables irrelevant to the target, descendant restrictions and
generalized adjustment criteria introduce different enumeration questions. The first proposed
wrapper therefore excludes both all-set enumeration and the unimplemented minimum-variance
option. It asks for one candidate and checks its stated sufficient criterion pgmpy contributors
(2026a).


31.8.2    A total-effect validator must reject the wrong question

The inspected public validation call first checks the supported graph type and invokes a
graph-role check. The latter checks the presence of exposure and outcome roles. The adjust-
ment validator then tests whether parents of the exposure remain connected to the outcome
conditional on the exposure and proposed adjustment variables. This particular call path does
not independently exclude descendants of the exposure pgmpy contributors (2026a).
   Consider the supplied DAG X → M → Y with X a root. Its exposure has no parents, so
the inspected parent’s-connection predicate is an empty conjunction and evaluates to true,
even if the proposed adjustment variable is the mediator M . The role-presence check does not
reject that assignment. This is a static trace through authentic source, not an installed-engine
experiment. It suffices to show why the project cannot adopt that validation call alone as
its total-effect admission rule. The finding concerns this specific validator and pin; it does
not assert that every identification method returns an invalid set pgmpy contributors (2026a);
Causal banking research project (2026ac).
   The financial significance can be derived exactly. Let independent, zero-mean, unit-variance
errors generate
                        X = UX ,     M = 2X + UM ,         Y = 3M + UY .
Under an intervention on X, the derivative of expected Y is 6. The covariance entries are

    Var(X) = 1,      Var(M ) = 5,    Cov(X, M ) = 2,      Cov(X, Y ) = 6,    Cov(M, Y ) = 15.

The coefficient of X in the population regression on (X, M ) is
                                         6 · 5 − 2 · 15
                                                        = 0.
                                           1 · 5 − 22
474                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


Conditioning on the mediator has removed the mediated path. Reporting that coefficient as
the total effect would change the causal question. If X is a one-unit service intensity, Y is
dollars over the agreed horizon and the common linear law is stipulated for 1,000 accounts, the
authored gross response scenario is 6,000 dollars, compared with zero under the misreported
coefficient. This is generated arithmetic, not bank ROI, a binary-treatment guarantee or a
measured customer response Causal banking research project (2026ac).
   The proposed first path consequently requires a conservative pre-action backdoor contract.
A candidate set must contain observed variables distinct from exposure and outcome, include
no descendants of the exposure, and d-separate exposure and outcome in the graph with
outgoing exposure edges removed. This is a sufficient contract for the selected DAG setting.
It is intentionally narrower than generalized adjustment over all supported graph classes. An
otherwise useful generalized set outside the contract receives an unsupported-scope disposition;
it is not declared scientifically impossible. The separation between a restricted sufficient
criterion and complete identification is part of the result’s meaning.
   Two project-owned graph calculations support the proposed verification boundary. One
tests separation after ancestral moralization. The other enumerates simple skeleton paths,
checks noncollider conditioning and checks whether colliders have conditioned descendants.
They agree on 26,064 queries across all 543 labeled DAGs on four nodes, including every
ordered exposure–outcome pair and every subset of the remaining nodes. The check helps
detect mistakes in the small reference implementation; it is not a proof for arbitrary graph size,
an upstream pgmpy test run or a statement about statistical discovery from finite samples
Causal banking research project (2026ac).


31.8.3    A selected DAG can conceal unresolved direction or a failed extension

Static discovery remains a separate reuse decision. The pinned PC class supports original,
stable and parallel variants; its defaults include parallel execution, test level .01, a maximum
conditioning-set size of five and a partially directed return. In the fitted method, the names
pdag and cpdag follow the same return branch. The dag option calls a conversion selecting
one orientation. The option spelling alone cannot establish a complete equivalence class,
whole-graph confidence or causal identification under hidden confounding. The source declares
causal sufficiency, acyclicity and faithfulness; particular conditional-independence tests add
their own assumptions pgmpy contributors (2026a).
   The default conditioning cap can stop search before all possible separating sets have been
considered. Test selection, data types and expert constraints must therefore be retained
alongside the graph. A per-test threshold of .01 is not a .99 confidence level for every edge or
the downstream effect. Required and forbidden edges introduce external information; their
provenance must survive any business-language or agent-assisted formulation step. A graph’s
attractive rendering cannot supply that provenance pgmpy contributors (2026a).
   The PDAG implementation contains a particularly clear conversion boundary. Its to_dag
routine warns when it cannot find a consistent extension preserving directed edges and v-
structures, then orients remaining edges arbitrarily while avoiding cycles. The result can
therefore be an acyclic graph with different v-structures. The to_cpdag route first obtains an
extension when undirected edges exist, so it cannot be used as an independent certificate that
the input represented a valid equivalence class pgmpy contributors (2026a).
   A four-node chordless undirected cycle supplies an exact refusal fixture. There are sixteen
orientations of its four edges; two form directed cycles and fourteen are acyclic. Every acyclic
orientation has a sink with two nonadjacent parents and therefore introduces an unshielded
collider. Consequently none preserves the undirected graph’s absence of specified colliders.
31.8. A restricted pgmpy integration: verify the candidate, preserve the question              475


The project enumerates all fourteen acyclic cases to check this small argument. An arbitrary
DAG returned after a warning would answer a different graphical question; simply confirming
acyclicity would miss the change Causal banking research project (2026ac).
   The initial integration therefore consumes an already supplied DAG rather than an automat-
ically completed discovered graph. Future discovery integration must preserve typed directed
and undirected edges, isolates, separating sets, constraints, warnings and the exact selection
procedure. Named-edge conversion is preferable to guessing direction from an unlabeled
binary matrix. An incomplete or nonextendible graph must remain an explicit scientific or
computational limitation, with no fallback to a conveniently oriented causal story.


31.8.4    The permitted prototype path and its failure contract

The proposed operation accepts one exposure and one outcome in a fully observed acyclic
graph, with unique string node identifiers and an explicit node list. It initially caps the graph
at twelve nodes as a conservative wrapper design choice; that number is not measured engine
capacity. Latent, bidirected, selection, undirected and ambiguous-edge inputs are outside
this path. It constructs a fresh pinned DAG with explicit roles and requests the minimal
adjustment candidate. The original graph remains available for comparison Causal banking
research project (2026ac).
   After a successful return, the wrapper must verify unchanged nodes, edges, exposure and
outcome roles; validate candidate membership and timing; exclude exposure descendants; and
run the independent graphical check. Success then means a candidate satisfying the specified
criterion relative to the supplied graph. It carries no numerical effect, confidence interval or
certification of the graph’s real-world truth. An empty valid set is a meaningful result, whereas
a null or failed return is a different disposition. A failure to find a set by this method must not
become a claim of global causal nonidentifiability Causal banking research project (2026ac).
   Exceptions, warnings, unsupported variants, altered graph structure and resource limits
are retained with their causes. They do not become an empty adjustment set or zero effect.
The same graph, target identity and disposition must cross library, CLI and MCP boundaries.
Implementation acceptance will require actual pinned-engine calls on named confounder,
mediator, collider, isolate and permutation fixtures, together with invalid graph and failure
cases. The exact references developed here provide oracles for that work; no pgmpy runtime
or adapter call was performed Causal banking research project (2026ac).
   The minimal path’s attraction is limited but practical: pgmpy can propose a graph-based
candidate while the project’s independent sufficient check guards its meaning. It is not
necessary to copy the whole library or port its graph stack to another language to obtain
this benefit. A reference-only role remains appropriate for presently unverified discovery and
estimation branches. Minimum-variance adjustment is rejected at this pin because the branch
is unimplemented. Generalized adjustment, latent graphs and data-driven direction selection
are deferred to separate source and semantic reviews pgmpy contributors (2026a).

31.9     A scoped causal-learn reuse decision
For the first Python discovery comparison, direct scoped integration of PC from causal-learn

marks and isolated nodes. A conflict mark produced by PC cannot be interpreted as an FCI
latent common cause. Singular Fisher-Z inverses, invalid effective degrees of freedom and
nonfinite p-values must produce an unavailable numerical query rather than an independence

   A complete implementation needs a locked executable environment, dependency rights
inventory, method-specific conversion, failure handling and a matched engine comparison.

initial adapter because their assumptions and output meanings differ. R pcalg and Java
