31.10       A restricted CausalML route for heterogeneous offer
            effects
Flexible response prediction becomes useful to a bank only when its contrast matches the offer,
population and information available at the decision date. The inspected Uber CausalML
revision declares version 0.17.0, Python at least 3.11, eighteen required dependencies and an
Apache-2.0 root notice. Its T-learner and R-learner provide plausible reusable components for
a static offer comparison. This is a source-based selection, without an installed environment
or measured interval performance (uber/causalml, 2026).
  The T-learner fits separate response models for each treatment and the shared control.
For a binary offer A, write ma (x) = E(Y | A = a, X = x). Under consistency, conditional
exchangeability, overlap and a suitable sampling law, the conditional mean contrast is τ (x) =
m1 (x) − m0 (x). It is a contrast of conditional means, not an identified individual customer’s
two potential outcomes. The target population then determines how these contrasts should be
averaged.
  An exact stipulated account population makes the difference visible. Two pre-offer strata
have equal population mass and offer probabilities 1/5 and 4/5. Their mean recoveries
without an offer are USD 100 and USD 120; with an offer, USD 105 and USD 135. Suppose
exchangeability holds within each stratum. The conditional effects are 5 and 15, hence

  ATE = 12 (5) + 12 (15) = 10,      ATT = 15 (5) + 45 (15) = 13,     ATC = 45 (5) + 51 (15) = 7.

The observed treated mean is 129 and the untreated mean is 104, giving an unadjusted
difference of 25. All four numbers are correct for their stated calculations, but only one is
the population ATE. The adapter must retain the population measure instead of treating the
presence of a number named “effect” as sufficient (Causal banking proposal, 2026a).
   If the offer costs USD 8 and the imposed means are known, offering only to the second
stratum gives expected gain 12 (15 − 8) = 3.5 dollars per eligible account, compared with 2
dollars for offering to everyone. This is a planning calculation with known means. Selecting
a rule from fitted effects introduces uncertainty and selection; these dollar amounts do not
establish a learned policy’s value or observed bank ROI.
   The inspected implementation returns contrast columns in its treatment-label order. The
wrapper should use that returned mapping, preserve account and feature IDs, and state
treatment-minus-control units. The initial route should remain binary: in the inspected
multi-treatment path, the ATE point average uses prediction rows while the variance terms use
each treatment/control subset. The populations therefore require a separate analysis before a
multi-arm uncertainty contract is promised (uber/causalml, 2026).
  Uncertainty also has several meanings. The selected CATE interval path uses prediction
percentiles from refitted samples; the default ATE expression combines arm residual variances
and fitted-effect variation. The base bootstrap resamples rows. None of these operations
automatically accounts for household clusters, repeated account histories or common calendar
shocks. With a treated fraction of 1/100 and a resample of size 100, the probability of selecting
no treated row is (99/100)100 , about 0.366. A failed arm cannot be silently discarded to
improve reported interval availability. Changing to stratified or block resampling changes
478                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


the procedure and needs its own declared target and analysis (uber/causalml, 2026; Causal
banking proposal, 2026a).
   The R-learner offers a related computational alternative. Its inspected caller forms outcome
residuals and a weighted regression with pseudo-outcome (Y − m(X))/(A
                                                                 b          − eb(X)) and weight
            2
(A − eb(X)) . In the deterministic conditional-mean example above, substituting the true
m and e makes that pseudo-outcome equal to the stratum effect for both treatment values.
The identity explains the intended orthogonalization; it does not validate learned nuisance
functions, delegated propensity folds or dependence-aware cross-fitting. Those delegated paths
must be reviewed before a broader route is enabled.
   Observed uplift curves are another distinct object. The inspected metric uses true effects
if supplied and otherwise uses treated/control observed means with interpolation. A curve
can be computable under confounding and still fail to identify policy value. An ordinary
exact stratified estimator therefore remains a useful comparator, alongside separately reviewed
EconML and grf paths.
   The preferred proposal is an optional pinned T-learner service with explicit base regressor,
binary arms and independent whole accounts. Preserve every seed, environment identity, pop-
ulation weight, pre-offer feature clock and outcome horizon. Reject missing arms, unsupported
sampling, stale row mappings, nonfinite output and unsupported targets with a reason. Keep
time-varying treatment, latent-state inference and multi-arm uncertainty outside this first
contract. Full adoption would import several scientific contracts at once; porting would assume
their maintenance without a demonstrated need. Executable admission remains deferred until
input/import paths, dependency notices and target, column, interval and failure fixtures have
been reviewed and run.


31.11      CausalNex: maintenance, graph semantics and reuse
A graph-learning package enters a bank’s proposal through two different questions: whether
its mathematical output answers the intended question, and whether someone can own its
continuing operation. CausalNex illustrates why both questions matter. Its canonical source
at revision b87ab2059987, dated 31 August 2026, declares version 0.12.2. The README
explicitly states that the project reached end of life on 24 June 2026 and will receive no
further updates, bug fixes, security patches or issue and pull-request review. The later source
commit does not rescind that notice. This is affirmative maintenance evidence from the
recovered repository; the earlier failure to retrieve its historical namespace was only an access
failure.(mckinsey/causalnex, 2026b)
   The proposal therefore rejects CausalNex as a default new dependency while retaining
its design as a historical reference. A narrow archival comparison could still be justified
by a specific reproducibility need. It would require an accountable maintainer, an isolated
environment and a declared endpoint; the old package’s existence supplies none of these
obligations automatically. The root notice declares Apache 2.0 and separately excludes rights
to the QuantumBlack trademarks. That notice supports a licensing route, but it is not a
complete inventory of transitive and bundled rights. The packaging requires Python at least
3.8 and below 3.11, NumPy below 1.24, pandas below 2.0 and pgmpy below 0.1.20, together
with other dependencies and Python-specific scikit-learn requirements. These declarations
motivate environment isolation; they do not establish that a resolved environment is impossible,
vulnerable or inexpensive to maintain.(mckinsey/causalnex, 2026b)
31.11. CausalNex: maintenance, graph semantics and reuse                                        479


31.11.1     A learned structure and an intervention target

Consider a servicing analyst who records account covariates, an offer and a subsequent recovery
amount. The inspected continuous-data NOTEARS entrypoints take an n × d matrix X, with
accounts in rows and variables in columns. With Wij representing a coefficient from variable i
to variable j, the unpenalized data term and acyclicity function are
                             1
               L(W ; X) =      ∥X(I − W )∥2F ,      h(W ) = tr{exp(W ◦ W )} − d.
                            2n
Here ◦ denotes elementwise multiplication, exp is the matrix exponential and ∥·∥F is the square
root of the sum of squared matrix entries. The augmented objective adds ρh(W )2 /2 + αh(W ),
with penalty ρ and multiplier α. The lasso path represents a coefficient as the difference of
nonnegative parts and penalizes their sum. Tabu edges and tabu parent or child variables
become optimizer bounds. These are concrete source-level computations.(mckinsey/causalnex,
2026b)
   Even an acyclic solution supplies a candidate structure under that loss and those restrictions.
An intervention contrast such as expected recovery under an offer versus no offer additionally
needs a causal interpretation, an eligible population, an outcome horizon and assumptions
about confounding and the observation clock. A post-offer delinquency measurement cannot
become a baseline variable because the optimizer accepts its column. The selected entrypoints
return no causal graph confidence region or treatment-effect interval. The package also
advertises Bayesian-network fitting and intervention facilities; this selected source review does
not qualify those separate implementations or establish their appropriateness for longitudinal
servicing.(mckinsey/causalnex, 2026b)
   The graph class makes another boundary explicit. A StructureModel can contain directed
cycles. Edge origins take the values unknown, learned or expert; the pandas wrapper preserves
column names and marks learned edges, whereas the selected array-created graph uses the
class default. Origin records who or what supplied an edge. It does not certify its truth.
An assistant can preserve that provenance and ask which temporal or business restriction
supports an expert edge, but should not convert the label “expert” into verified causal
evidence.(mckinsey/causalnex, 2026b)


31.11.2     Preprocessing and graph repair change the reported object

The selected objective does not center X automatically. To see the consequence without
fitting the upstream package, impose two observations (−1, −2) and (1, 2) for variables (A, B)
and restrict the direction to A → B. With no intercept the least-squares coefficient is
P             P 2
   i Ai B i /  i Ai = 2, and the full two-variable loss above is 1/2. Change the origin of the
first variable to A′ = A + 1. The observations become (0, −2) and (2, 2), and their centered
second-moment matrix remains                       !
                                              1 2
                                                     .
                                              2 4
Yet the no-intercept coefficient is now 1. Holding the old coefficient at 2 yields loss 3; refitting
within the fixed direction yields loss 2. These are exact calculations for an imposed example,
not measurements of which graph the upstream optimizer would select. They show why a
caller must declare centering, the population used to fit preprocessing and the treatment of
intercepts.(Causal banking proposal, 2026b)
  Scaling also affects a subsequent graph operation. The method threshold_till_dag
repeatedly deletes the edge with smallest absolute weight until a DAG remains; its own
docstring warns about weights with different units.(mckinsey/causalnex, 2026b) For a stipulated
480                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


two-cycle, let the coefficients be A → B = 0.2 and B → A = 0.5. This rule deletes A → B.
Express the same coefficient relations using B ′ = 10B: the weights become 2 and 0.05, so
the rule deletes B → A. Algebraically, a change of units with diagonal scale matrix D gives
W ′ = D−1 W D. In this example the cycle product remains 0.1 and both acyclicity values equal
2 cosh(0.1) − 2 > 0. The cycle has not disappeared through a change of units; the pruning
choice has changed. (Causal banking proposal, 2026b)
   In a banking model, two opposite surviving arrows can lead to different adjustment sets and
intervention stories. Deleting a weak edge is thus a scientific modeling choice, even when it
also solves a software input requirement. A wrapper would need to retain the original graph,
the units, the declared pruning procedure and the full deletion trace. Standardizing variables
may define a more explicit comparison, but cannot prove the resulting arrows causal or remove
observational ambiguity.
  Threshold boundaries also deserve an explicit contract. At the inspected revision the
unpenalized path zeros weights satisfying |w| ≤ t, while the lasso path zeros weights satisfying
|w| < t. For nonzero weights w = ±0.2 and threshold t = 0.2, the first path removes both edges
and the second retains them. A common adapter that applies a single threshold convention
would silently change one method’s output. Independent rational arithmetic reproduces
these boundaries; testing the actual wrapper would remain a separate implementation task.
(mckinsey/causalnex, 2026b; Causal banking proposal, 2026b)


31.11.3     A conditional archival route and its alternatives

The inspected optimizer consumes the returned solution vector and can issue a nonconvergence
warning before returning a graph. It does not promote optimizer success into a structured
scientific guarantee. A prospective archival wrapper would capture termination and warnings,
test finite output and acyclicity, and retain an unqualified candidate when these checks fail.
It would preserve column identities, transforms and tabu directions, and report timeouts or
environment failures as unavailable results. An edge weight would never be repurposed as a
confidence level. These requirements follow from the selected source and from the meaning of
the proposed output; no CausalNex runtime qualification is claimed here.(mckinsey/causalnex,
2026b)
   Direct adoption would transfer unsupported lifecycle obligations to the product. Porting
the optimizer would additionally transfer numerical behavior, dependency adaptation and
testing to the local team; there is no demonstrated embedding requirement that warrants this
ownership. An isolated historical benchmark is the narrower route when a concrete comparison
requires it. Other discovery engines discussed in this survey need their own pinned decisions,
because constraint tests, score searches and latent-variable representations answer different
questions. Their names are not aliases for CausalNex, and a separately reviewed pgmpy version
does not qualify the older dependency used here.
   For a small banking prototype, an explicit expert DAG and an exactly enumerated reference
model provide useful comparators: they expose assumptions and intervention arithmetic while
leaving discovery accuracy open. The cost comparison should include retained environments,
license and dependency review, preprocessing, failed requests, analyst correction, future fixes
and retirement. No observed price or maintenance-cost estimate is available from the present
static review. Reconsideration of CausalNex would require a unique archival need, a named
owner, a permissible resolved environment and executed conversion and failure checks. Public
or generated examples can support those initial checks without purchasing access to bank data.
31.12. Reusing DAGMA without changing the scientific question                               481


31.12      Reusing DAGMA without changing the scientific ques-
           tion
A bank considering a new servicing action may first want to learn which observed variables
could mediate its response. Continuous structure learning offers a computational route to
candidate graphs, but its output must survive several distinct interpretations: numerical
optimization, graph topology, structural assumptions and the intervention being contemplated.
DAGMA is a useful case because the original Python implementation exposes a compact linear
optimizer and a nonlinear alternative, while its acyclicity argument has a precise domain. The
proposed reuse decision is to retain this original implementation as a reference and a candidate
for a later isolated adapter. The current evidence does not justify wholesale adoption or a
port into the core library. The selected source revision dates from January 2024; it is distinct
from translations of the method in other software. (Causal banking research project, 2026aq)


31.12.1    A domain theorem is not a numerical acceptance test

Write Wij for the weight from parent i to child j, and let S = W ◦ W denote its entrywise
square. The inherited characterization uses

                     hs (W ) = − log det(sI − S) + d log s,      s > ρ(S),               (31.1)

where d is the number of variables and ρ is the spectral radius. Within this nonsingular
M-matrix domain, hs (W ) is nonnegative and vanishes exactly for a DAG. The primary paper
separately assumes that the chosen statistical model identifies the graph. Its central-path
result concerns the limiting optimization scheme, not every finite sequence of approximate
gradient steps. Neither statement supplies an effect confidence region for a graph selected
from a finite banking sample. (Bello, Kevin and Aragam, Bryon and Ravikumar, Pradeep,
2022, Section 2, Theorem 1 and Lemma 6)
 An independent two-variable calculation provides a useful behavioral oracle. For W12 = a,
W21 = b and zero diagonal,

                          hs (W ) = − log{1 − (ab/s)2 },      |ab| < s.                  (31.2)

Differentiating this scalar expression, or using ∇hs (W ) = 2W ◦ (sI − S)−T , gives an inde-
pendent check of the original module’s derivative. At a = 0.2, b = 0.3 and s = 1.3, its
value is approximately 0.00213244957. The inspected original module agrees with the scalar
expression; central finite differences at step 10−6 agree with its derivative to a maximum
absolute discrepancy below 4 × 10−11 in this example. This is a numerical identity check at a
declared point, not an estimate of graph recovery or a uniform numerical guarantee. (Causal
banking research project, 2026ap)
                                                                       √ √
   The domain cannot be omitted from that oracle. For W = diag( 2, 2) and s = 1, the
determinant is one, although the graph contains two self-loops and ρ(S) = 2. The original
helper returns a value near zero outside its theorem domain. For a two-cycle with a = 2,
b = 1 and s = 1, the determinant is −3; the helper’s log-absolute-determinant expression gives
− log 3. These are direct calls to the numerical helper. They do not show that the optimizer
admitted those matrices during fitting: the optimization loop contains separate inverse-matrix
domain checks. They show why a consumer cannot certify a DAG by accepting an isolated
small residual. A future adapter must inspect domain validity and the returned graph’s actual
support, including self-loops and directed cycles. (Causal banking research project, 2026aq,ap)
482                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


31.12.2     What the executed source module requires of an adapter

The bounded execution used the unchanged saved linear module with Python 3.11.15, NumPy
2.1.3, SciPy 1.17.1 and tqdm 4.70.0. It did not install the complete DAGMA distribution.
Seven deterministic input cases exercised the least-squares path with four inner iterations and
one outer stage. These small budgets deliberately expose interface boundaries; the resulting
observations are not a performance or accuracy study. (Causal banking research project,
2026ar)
   The first boundary is ownership of observations. In the least-squares path, the module
centers the caller’s array in place. Integer input raises a NumPy casting exception. A service
that retains the original observations for another estimator therefore needs its own floating-
point copy, a record of the removed means and a stable mapping between columns and variable
identities. Copying data is also a real memory and transfer cost. It should appear in a matched
workflow comparison rather than disappear outside the timed optimizer. (Causal banking
research project, 2026aq,ar)
   The second boundary concerns scientific constraints. The signature describes edge collections
as optional lists, while the inspected implementation recognizes tuples of tuples. For the
same four-row input, excluding edge (0, 1) as ((0,1),) produced a zero in that matrix entry.
Supplying [(0,1)] instead left an entry approximately 0.039991. The invalid branch constructs
a ValueError without raising it. An empty tuple raises an indexing exception. A requested
included edge also remained absent on a zero-signal input, consistent with the upstream
warning that inclusion is not guaranteed. These findings call for an explicit distinction between
hard exclusions, soft inclusion preferences and hard required edges. A scientific constraint
cannot silently become a preference because a serialization library changed a tuple to a list.
(Causal banking research project, 2026aq,ar)
   The third boundary is the identity of the diagnosed result. With no weight threshold, the
deliberately short run returned a cyclic matrix, including self-loops. With a threshold of 0.3,
the same optimization returned the empty graph. The saved prethreshold residual remained
approximately 0.003200116, although the returned graph’s residual was zero. The stored
least-squares score was approximately 2.693174, while evaluation on the returned graph gave
3.125. Neither value is intrinsically misleading if its matrix is named. A wrapper becomes
misleading when it attaches one matrix’s diagnostics to another matrix without saying so.
(Causal banking research project, 2026ar)
   A proposed adapter should retain the raw and thresholded matrices, the original and effective
optimization settings, the observation transform and diagnostics recomputed on each reported
object. Its runtime bound must cover the upstream retry loop as well as the nominal iteration
counts. Malformed inputs, singular solves, nonfinite values, exhausted budgets and cyclic
outputs need distinct error or incomplete dispositions. Silently deleting an edge to obtain
a DAG changes the reported procedure; any such repair would require its own explicit rule
and qualification. These are concrete requirements for a future wrapper, not capabilities
established by the reference module’s execution. (Causal banking research project, 2026aq,ar)


31.12.3     Units and nonlinear weights can reverse a banking interpretation

For a stipulated linear structural model written with row observations, X = XW + E, a
change of measurement units Z = XD−1 gives WZ = DW D−1 , where D is a positive diagonal
scale matrix. In a DAG, the total directed-path coefficient matrix is

             K = (I − W )−1 − I = W + W 2 + · · · + W d−1 ,       KZ = DKD−1 .             (31.3)
31.12. Reusing DAGMA without changing the scientific question                                 483


This algebra describes a change of units in an already stipulated structural model. It does not
prove that a fitted graph has a causal interpretation or that a penalized optimizer is invariant
to rescaling its data. (Causal banking research project, 2026ap)
   For example, suppose an authored three-variable model has W12 = 2, W23 = 3 and W13 = 1.
Its total first-to-third coefficient is 1 + 2 × 3 = 7. With D = diag(10, 1, 100), the transformed
edge weights are 20, 0.03 and 0.1, and the transformed total coefficient is 0.7. Both describe the
same stipulated mechanism in different units. A raw threshold of 0.5 retains all three original
edges but only one transformed edge. Thus a threshold needs an explicitly declared scale;
“the same threshold” is not a scientifically matched comparison across arbitrarily standardized
borrower measures. Fitting, thresholding, refitting and any subsequent uncertainty calculation
must be treated as a whole procedure. (Causal banking research project, 2026ap)
   The nonlinear alternative has a different problem. The inspected fc1_to_adj routine
takes a norm of first-layer weights and returns nonnegative entries. It does not return signed
intervention derivatives. Consider two authored one-parent response functions,
                                                                               1
             f+ (x) = 4σ(2x) − 2,      f− (x) = −4σ(2x) + 2,       σ(u) =           .      (31.4)
                                                                            1 + e−u
Their first-layer norm is the same, namely two, and both have baseline zero. Since σ ′ (0) = 1/4,
their derivatives at zero are +2 and −2. In a stipulated servicing illustration with USD 100
per outcome unit and USD 20 marginal cost per unit of action intensity, the local net-value
derivatives are USD 180 and USD −220. The same nonnegative adjacency weight is consistent
with opposite local recommendations. These are exact derivatives of declared functions; they
are neither finite-action effects nor results of executing the nonlinear PyTorch implementation.
(Causal banking research project, 2026aq,ap)
   An intervention calculation therefore needs the fitted structural functions, the intervention
definition, units and assumptions that justify using those functions causally. A graph-only
export loses that information. For equivalence-class, latent-variable or temporal questions, the
reviewed constraint-based and temporal routes remain substantive alternatives. A convenient
DAG representation cannot substitute for their different information and uncertainty contracts.


31.12.4     The reuse choice and the evidence that would change it

The inspected repository carries Apache 2.0 terms. Redistribution requires the license, relevant
retained notices and marked modifications, together with applicable NOTICE obligations.
That root license does not settle the terms of every dependency or of a different implementation.
The package metadata declares NumPy, SciPy, torch, tqdm and igraph without version bounds,
although the narrow linear source path imports only the first, second and fourth. Its version
configuration refers to src/VERSION, absent from the inspected pinned tree. This is a concrete
build-identity issue to resolve against a selected release, not grounds to invent a release number
or declare that every published package is broken. Saved examples and the inline demonstration
function also do not establish a supported build or passing continuous integration. (Causal
banking research project, 2026aq)
   Reference use is consequently justified now. Conditional integration of a selected linear
path is a plausible next prototype: establish a complete permissible build, implement the
stated conversion and failure contract, and replay the boundary cases with independent graph
and numerical oracles. Direct adoption leaves those obligations with the caller. Porting adds
floating-point, solver, threshold and maintenance differences before any measured need for
a port has been demonstrated, so it is not selected here. NOTEARS supplies a meaningful
numerical comparator under matched model and output assumptions, while PC, FCI or
484                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


temporal alternatives answer different questions where sufficiency, hidden causes or time order
matter.
   The initial evaluation should use generated mechanisms with known truth and public inputs
with declared limits. It should predeclare identifiable and observationally equivalent cases, unit
transformations, graph-error and downstream decision criteria, and retain failed or incomplete
requests in the denominator. The prototype maintainer owns build reproducibility and failure
semantics; the scientific reviewer owns assumptions and any later effect-identification argument.
Full costs include copying, serialization, optimization, diagnostic review and dependency
maintenance. Their actual prices and a banking return remain unknown. A validated wrapper
and useful matched public or generated results would justify reconsidering integration and the
expense of independent and bank-specific trials. (Causal banking research project, 2026aq,ar,ap)



31.13      Causica: a generative reference with explicit admission
           boundaries
An analyst wants to simulate a larger servicing effort for a borrower, compare it with the
observed treatment, and then aggregate the result into a contact policy. A learned structural
model makes these operations convenient: one model can represent a graph, conditional
mechanisms, noise and interventions. Convenience does not settle whether the graph is
identified, whether a counterfactual refers to the same borrower, or whether the reported
uncertainty includes the relevant source of error. Causica is useful precisely because its explicit
abstractions let the proposal examine these questions together.
   The selected source is Microsoft’s Causica revision c3b7dd2b09fe, dated 24 August 2026,
declaring package version 0.4.5. Its DECI path combines an approximate distribution over
graphs with learned functional relationships and noise modules. This is a proposed reference for
a structural-model component. It is not an enabled estimator in the local six-operation service.
The distinction matters when comparing the proposal with an existing library: describing
a model in a monograph does not implement its training, inference, diagnostics or failure
handling. (Microsoft Causica contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal, 2026e)


31.13.1     What the original result does and does not justify

Geffner et al. formulate DECI using a nonlinear additive-noise model with no latent confounders.
Its graph distribution and function/noise parameters are learned by maximizing an evidence
lower bound. Their Theorem 1 is an infinite-data result for a maximizing solution. Appendix
A assumes minimality, structural identifiability, correct specification, causal sufficiency and
integrability of the log likelihood. Structural identifiability means that another graph in the
admitted model family cannot generate the same observed distribution. It is an assumption
with substantive content, not a property created by calling the optimizer. (Geffner et al., 2022)
  These conditions expose four separate obligations for a banking use. The variable set must
represent the relevant common causes; the structural family must distinguish the intervention
query from observational alternatives; the fitted mechanisms must approximate the admitted
law; and the numerical procedure must achieve an adequate solution. Universal function
approximation does not verify the first two obligations or make a finite training run a global
maximum. The paper explicitly says that the theorem does not cover its mixed-type and
missing-value extensions. A practical implementation may support those inputs without
inheriting that theorem for them. (Geffner et al., 2022)
31.13. Causica: a generative reference with explicit admission boundaries                       485


   After fitting, graph-averaged intervention simulation answers a model-based question. In the
selected source, graph draws share the learned functional and noise modules. Those draws are
therefore not samples from an independently specified posterior over all function parameters.
Their variation is also not a frequentist confidence region for the true graph. The product
should report the fitted model, graph distribution and numerical simulation error separately,
keeping any unresolved structural ambiguity visible. (Microsoft Causica contributors, 2026)


31.13.2     Conditioning, intervention and the same borrower’s counterfactual

The pinned SEM interface distinguishes do, condition, noise generation and noise reconstruction.
Its selected conditioning method supports a set only when that set has no parents outside
it; otherwise it raises an unsupported-operation error. This restriction is meaningful. The
paper’s more general CATE discussion uses regression on simulated interventional samples and
assumes that treatment does not cause the conditioning variables. That description should
not be silently mapped to an unrestricted call to the selected conditioning helper. (Microsoft
Causica contributors, 2026; Geffner et al., 2022)
   For an exact illustration, let X = UX be a standardized pre-action risk factor, T = X + UT
a continuous servicing intensity, and

                                      Y = 20T + 10X + UY

the net recovery before the separately considered cost of changing intensity. Suppose the three
noises are independent centered Gaussians, with variances 1, 1, 100, and measure Y in dollars.
This is an authored structural model, not a fitted bank law or an example satisfying general
graph identifiability. Since E[X | T = t] = t/2,

                        E[Y | T = t] = 25t,       E[Y | do(T = t)] = 20t.

Replacing an unsupported conditioning request by an intervention changes the answer. Re-
versing that substitution changes it as well. The first request selects borrowers through
their observed intensity and risk; the second changes intensity while retaining the population
distribution of risk. (Causal banking proposal, 2026f)
   For a factual borrower with (X, T, Y ) = (1, 2, 55), the reconstructed noises are
(UX , UT , UY ) = (1, 1, 5). Holding these noises fixed gives counterfactual recoveries of USD 15
at intensity zero and USD 35 at intensity one. The individual contrast is USD 20. Replacing
factual noise by fresh population noise gives marginal means zero and twenty instead. The
contrast happens to agree in this constant-effect construction, while the borrower’s two
counterfactual levels do not. Agreement of an effect difference is therefore an insufficient test of
factual-unit preservation. The pinned ite helper reconstructs noise once and reuses it for the
two interventions; the counterfactual helper follows the same abduction/action/prediction
logic. (Microsoft Causica contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal, 2026f)
   The ATE helper takes a different route: it samples each intervention arm and subtracts
component means. With independent samples of size n from each arm in the stipulated
model, the Monte Carlo variance of that contrast is 400/n, because each arm has residual
variance 200. At n = 100 the variance is four square dollars. Coupling the two arms through
the same noise gives an exactly constant twenty-dollar contrast here. Such coupling can
reduce simulation variance, but its appropriateness must be checked for the intended estimator.
Neither calculation establishes sampling uncertainty for learned functions, uncertainty about
the graph, or causal truth. (Causal banking proposal, 2026f)
486                                                                  Causal analysis for a universal bank


31.13.3     A training penalty is not an output DAG check

The selected DECI module applies a matrix-exponential acyclicity penalty during training.
Its ENCO adjacency distribution nevertheless samples independent Bernoulli entries off the
diagonal; the selected SEM-distribution path wraps these matrices without a separate DAG
filter. At the initialized zero logits, each directed edge has probability 12 12 = 14 . For two nodes,
both opposite edges are present with probability 1/16. This is an exact statement about
the initialized distribution, not an observed failure frequency after training. A penalty may
greatly reduce cyclic mass; its existence alone does not certify every returned graph. (Microsoft
Causica contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal, 2026f)
   The numerical consequence is visible without running a neural model. The selected structural
simulator starts at zero and performs one simultaneous update per node. For a DAG, induction
over parent depth explains why a finite number of such updates can propagate a fixed noise
vector to every node. That argument depends on acyclicity. Consider instead the authored
equations
                                  x1 = 1 + 21 x2 ,  x2 = 12 x1 .
Two updates from zero produce (1, 0) and then (1, 1/2). The latter has equation residual
(−1/4, 0); the algebraic fixed point is (4/3, 2/3). Thus a finite update result can look numerically
ordinary while failing even the supplied cyclic equations. The fixed point is a numerical
comparison, not an independently justified equilibrium causal interpretation. The proposal
should refuse an unqualified cyclic draw rather than promote its finite update into a valid
intervention result. (Microsoft Causica contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal, 2026f)
   Hard knowledge constraints need the same admission check. The pinned source uses zero
for prohibited edges, one for required edges and NaN for unspecified edges. Shape checks and
diagonal masking do not by themselves prevent a required directed cycle. A public contract
should use explicit typed states, validate their values and causal consistency, and translate
them into this internal representation. Adjacency entries also need a declared parent-to-child
convention; they must not be confused with signed structural coefficients. If an adapter discards
cyclic samples, it changes the effective graph distribution by conditioning on acceptance. It
must retain the rejected mass and describe any reweighting, so a failure cannot disappear from
the denominator. (Microsoft Causica contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal, 2026e)


31.13.4     A vector score needs a vector reference

The evaluation boundary has another concrete issue. The pinned ATE helper averages over
observations and retains the outcome’s component dimension. The selected eval_ate_rmse
reference instead applies .mean() without specifying an axis to each intervention dataset. For a
multidimensional node this collapses observations and components together before subtracting
the two arms. The resulting scalar is then compared with a component vector. The source can
therefore assign a nonzero error to an exact vector estimate. (Microsoft Causica contributors,
2026)
   Take two equal-size reference arms whose component means are (2, 8) and (0, 0), with both
components measured in dollars. The correct vector effect is (2, 8). An exact prediction has
zero componentwise error, but the all-axis reference is 5, producing
                                   q                           √
                                       (2 − 5)2 + (8 − 5)2 =       18.

This is an independent exact trace of the inspected reduction, not the output of an executed
Causica test. The selected integration test checks result shape; that assertion alone does not
detect this counterexample. The pinned pytest configuration also excludes the integration
31.13. Causica: a generative reference with explicit admission boundaries                     487


directory from default recursive collection, so the existence of a CI workflow running the
general test tree is not evidence that this integration test ran. (Microsoft Causica contributors,
2026; Causal banking proposal, 2026f)
  The repair route is specific. First preserve the observation axis and calculate each compo-
nent’s treatment contrast. Then declare whether the requested score is a vector, a weighted
monetary sum or a norm. Different currencies, horizons, one-hot categories or scales must not
be pooled implicitly. An executable prototype should supply a deterministic SEM or fixed
prediction reference, check zero error for an exact multicomponent effect, and test deliberate
perturbations component by component. Only after these checks should noisy simulation be
added. This separates a scorer error from simulation variation and model error, reducing
the chance of rejecting a correct estimator or rewarding an incorrect one. (Causal banking
proposal, 2026e)


31.13.5     Graph averaging must preserve the decision risk

A useful numerical average may still conceal a structurally fragile decision. Suppose two
admitted models imply effects of USD 20 and minus USD 20 and have stipulated weights
3/4 and 1/4. The weighted effect is USD 10 and the between-model variance is 300 square
dollars. Averaging R independent model draws estimates that weighted mean with Monte
Carlo variance 300/R. As R grows, numerical error vanishes around the chosen weighted
mean; the two component effects remain different. The weights themselves are not validated
by increasing the simulation count. (Causal banking proposal, 2026f)
   With an assumed incremental cost of USD 8, the component net values are USD 12 and
minus USD 28, while their weighted average is USD 2. A manager who requires robustness
across the admitted models cannot infer it from that positive weighted average. The output
should show the component consequences and the basis for the weights, alongside a model-
averaged recommendation when one is requested. If observationally compatible models remain
relevant, the next information-gathering decision concerns which restriction or experiment
could distinguish their action consequences. A narrow numerical error bar around an average
does not answer that question. (Causal banking proposal, 2026f,e)


31.13.6     Reuse choice and a bounded prototype

The pinned root license is MIT. The package declares Python 3.10 and Torch 2.0.0; its saved
lock contains 277 packages, including Lightning, TensorDict, NumPy and MLflow. These
records provide a reproducible dependency starting point, not proof that an installation or
every dependency right has been qualified. The saved repository metadata does not mark
it archived, but neither an activity timestamp nor a CI badge is a support commitment.
The README directs users of older Rhino and DDECI paths to a previous release. The
current tree contains adjacent temporal classes, yet the selected intervention helper explicitly
refuses temporal functional relationships. These are distinct paths requiring distinct reviews.
(Microsoft Causica contributors, 2026)
   Direct adoption is deferred because it would inherit unresolved graph, conditioning, scoring
and environment boundaries. A wholesale port is not selected: it would transfer neural,
noise-distribution, optimization and dependency maintenance without demonstrated benefit.
The selected near-term use is a pinned reference, followed by a possible narrow adapter that
preserves upstream mechanics and validates the contract at its boundary. A supplied graph
simulator and a graph-class effect analysis remain substantive comparators; they expose
different tradeoffs between structural commitments, flexibility and uncertainty. (Causal
488                                                                    Causal analysis for a universal bank


banking proposal, 2026e)
   The first prototype can use public or generated mechanisms. It should check known DAG
propagation, reversed node order, intervention versus conditioning, factual-noise preservation,
scalar and vector effects, required cycles, failed optimization, repeated interventions, temporal
refusals and batch dimensions. It should retain unsuccessful requests and separate fitted-model
error, simulation error and structural ambiguity. Training and simulation time, dependency
work, expert review, conversion failures and update maintenance belong in the cost comparison.
Bank experiments become justified only after this bounded work demonstrates that the
proposed integration preserves a useful causal question and improves a declared workflow. No
trained-model performance, bank return or enabled integration is inferred from the source
review or exact examples. (Causal banking proposal, 2026e)


31.14      d3rlpy: learning a policy without losing its evaluation
           target
A collections team wants to choose the next contact, restructuring offer or referral from a
borrower’s history. A library that learns actions from logged episodes is an attractive challenger
to a manually specified rule. The proposal must nevertheless say which policy is evaluated,
whose starting states define value, when money is received, and which unobserved alternatives
the historical data can support. These choices belong to the scientific interface. They cannot
be delegated to an algorithm name.
   The selected d3rlpy source is revision 38c34b6f99fd, dated 10 September 2025 and declaring
version 2.8.1. It supplies offline and online reinforcement-learning interfaces, episode and
transition objects, and fitted Q evaluation (FQE). The separately observed PyPI release also
has the label 2.8.1; a matching label alone does not establish equality between a released
distribution and a later repository snapshot. The proposal selects these pinned interfaces
as a reference and prospective challenger. An enabled bank adapter remains conditional on
the concrete acceptance cases developed here. (d3rlpy contributors, 2025b,c; Causal banking
proposal, 2026at)


31.14.1     From a loan history to a value target

Let Ht contain information available before action At , and let St = f (Ht ) be the state supplied
to a learner. Let Rt+1 be net cash flow from that decision interval, including contact cost
and any specified credit loss. For a policy π, a starting distribution µ, and a declared period
discount γ, the proposed target is
                                                         "T −1         #
                                                          X
                                     π
                                 V       (µ) = ESπ0 ∼µ            t
                                                                 γ Rt+1 .
                                                          t=0

This is a definition of the desired policy value. Recovering it from logs requires that the
state/history and observation process support the relevant conditional transitions and rewards,
that action assignment is adequately accounted for, and that the policy does not require
unsupported histories and actions. A convenient compressed state need not preserve these
conditions. A feature constructed from a later recovery cannot be included in a state available
to an earlier collections decision. The adapter therefore needs timestamps, lineage and a
declared information set as well as arrays. (Causal banking proposal, 2026at)
  FQE fits a separate action-value approximation for a supplied policy. In the selected
implementation, the update obtains the next action through predict_best_action, passes
31.14. d3rlpy: learning a policy without losing its evaluation target                          489


the observed terminal indicator to the Q-loss calculation, and discounts a transition spanning
k intervals by γ k . The public learner distinguishes a greedy prediction from a sampled action.
That distinction matters: the inspected FQE update does not average its continuation over the
actions of an arbitrary randomized policy. No claim about all possible custom implementations
follows from this selected path. (d3rlpy contributors, 2025c)
   Consider a one-decision model with stipulated rewards USD 2 and USD 10 for actions zero
and one. A policy choosing these actions with probabilities 1/4 and 3/4 has value USD 8.
A deterministic policy always choosing action one has value USD 10. Evaluating the latter
cannot certify the former, even if both are stored in the same learner object and agree on
which action has the largest score. The proposed contract must freeze whether deployment
uses a greedy rule, a sampled rule, an exploration mixture or a constrained postprocessor. For
a stochastic target, it must either supply a verified policy-integrated Bellman update or refuse
this FQE route. These are exact target distinctions, not empirical claims about learner quality.
(Causal banking proposal, 2026au,at)


31.14.2     Ending an episode changes which observations are learned from

The pinned episode generator separates terminal flags from timeout flags. If both are set, it
gives priority to termination by setting the overlapping timeout entries to zero. The source
assignment modifies the supplied timeout array. It then emits episodes at marked boundaries.
If no termination or timeout is present it raises an assertion; if a final segment after an earlier
boundary is unclosed, that segment is not emitted. The selected episode representation counts
all rows as transitions when terminated and one fewer when truncated. A basic terminal
transition receives a zero successor, whereas a nonterminal transition needs the next stored
observation. (d3rlpy contributors, 2025a)
   These conventions are reasonable only after mapping the bank’s observation scheme. A
default may be terminal for a loan-lifetime objective; an extract ending on a reporting date
is not evidence that no later recovery will occur. A refinancing event may end one contract
while preserving a customer-level relationship. Each target needs an explicit event dictionary.
Treating all extract boundaries as terminal substitutes zero future value for an unresolved
continuation. Treating an actual end as truncation can omit the final reward. (Causal banking
proposal, 2026at)
   For an exact row-accounting example, three stored rows provide three transitions when the
episode is terminal but only two when it is truncated: the latter’s final observation can be a
successor, while its final action and reward have no successor transition in the basic picker.
In a six-row input with a timeout only at row index two, the generator emits indices zero
through two and leaves indices three through five outside emitted episodes. The adapter should
retain the original six-row count, identify this final segment and require a declared disposition.
Silently relabelling the tail as a completed episode would conceal missing information. A
separate boundary fixture with both flags true must verify the declared precedence and preserve
the caller’s original arrays. (Causal banking proposal, 2026au,at)
   The inspected upstream test has an additional qualification limit. Its parameter named
“overlap” sets timeout flags, but the assignment to terminal flags occurs only in the separately
named terminal branch. Consequently that parameter does not exercise simultaneous true
flags. This is a direct source-control-flow observation, not an upstream test execution or a
claim that the precedence code fails. A prototype must construct an actual overlap, check input
immutability at the wrapper boundary and verify row disposition across terminal, truncated
and unclosed episodes. The presence of a suitably named test is insufficient evidence that the
intended case is covered. (d3rlpy contributors, 2025a; Causal banking proposal, 2026at)
490                                                              Causal analysis for a universal bank


31.14.3     An initial-state score must actually use the initial population

The selected InitialStateValueEstimationEvaluator is documented as averaging value at
initial states. Its implementation iterates through batches of each episode and takes the first
observation of every batch. The batch window is 1,024 rows. For sufficiently long episodes,
later batch starts therefore enter the reported mean. Episode duration also changes the number
of contributions. This cannot be treated as one starting observation per borrower merely
because of the evaluator’s name. (d3rlpy contributors, 2025c)
  Take two terminated episodes with 2,048 and one rows. Stipulate predicted values USD 10
and USD 30 at the long episode’s first and second batch starts, and USD 20 at the short
episode’s initial state. Equal weighting of the two initial borrowers gives

                                  Vbstarts = (10 + 20)/2 = 15.

The literal selected batching calculation gives

                                Vbbatch = (10 + 30 + 20)/3 = 20.

The five-dollar difference arises even when every supplied prediction is exact. It is population
substitution, not approximation error. This exact control-flow reference has not executed the
native package. (Causal banking proposal, 2026au)
   A repaired wrapper should extract exactly the declared start state for every eligible target
unit and average with prespecified population weights. It should separately report exclusions
and zero-transition episodes, including batch-boundary tests at 1,023, 1,024, 1,025 and 2,048
rows. A continuing portfolio might instead require a calendar-date state distribution; that is
a valid different target and needs an explicitly different scorer. The package’s average-value
metric over logged transitions is useful as a scale diagnostic, while its SoftOPC score contrasts
values in episodes selected by a return threshold with values across all episodes. Neither is
automatically the requested incremental collections value. (d3rlpy contributors, 2025c; Causal
banking proposal, 2026at)


31.14.4     Calendar time and monetary units survive preprocessing

The basic transition picker assigns interval one. The multistep picker uses row offsets to
discount intervening rewards and to construct the continuation interval. A physical calendar
is not supplied by those row offsets. If a state is recorded monthly until delinquency and daily
thereafter, identical row discounts express different economic preferences in the two regions.
The contract must choose a fixed grid or a verified clock-aware conversion; the learner and
evaluator must then use the same convention. (d3rlpy contributors, 2025a; Causal banking
proposal, 2026at)
   Suppose cash flows USD 10 and USD 20 occur at months zero and two, with a stipulated
monthly discount of 0.9. The calendar value is 10+0.92 (20) = 26.2, whereas treating the second
stored record as the next month gives 10 + 0.9(20) = 28. This discrepancy is deterministic.
More training cannot resolve a clock the input has failed to represent. (Causal banking
proposal, 2026au)
   Reward preprocessing raises a related issue. The selected source includes clipping, affine
standardization and scaling by a range of episode returns. The public predict_value applies
observation and action transformations but does not apply an inverse reward transformation. A
transformed Q-value must therefore retain its transformed-objective label. Moreover, applying
a one-step inverse to a cumulative value is generally incorrect when preprocessing shifts rewards.
31.14. d3rlpy: learning a policy without losing its evaluation target                         491


If r′ = ar + b, then                                         "T −1           #
                                        ′π
                                                              X
                                                 π       π               t
                                    V        = aV + bE               γ           .
                                                              t=0
The additional term depends on the discounted horizon and potentially the policy. A shift can
change preferences when policies alter episode length. This equation is an authored algebraic
identity for the declared transform, not a theorem about a fitted neural approximation. (d3rlpy
contributors, 2025c; Causal banking proposal, 2026au)
   For two adjacent periods with rewards ten and twenty, γ = 0.9, and r′ = (r − 5)/5, the
original value is USD 28 and the transformed value is 3.7. Applying the one-step inverse gives
5(3.7) + 5 = 23.5. The correct horizon-aware inversion gives 5(3.7) + 5(1 + 0.9) = 28. Clipping
is more severe: rewards one hundred and one thousand both become one at an upper clip
of one. No inverse call can recover their original magnitudes from that output alone. The
original cash-flow records must remain available for evaluation. If a return-range scaler has
an equal minimum and maximum, the selected division also needs an explicit invalid-scale
outcome rather than a nonfinite monetary score. (d3rlpy contributors, 2025c; Causal banking
proposal, 2026au)


31.14.5     Conservative learning cannot create missing intervention evidence

The discrete CQL path combines its temporal-difference loss with a penalty formed from
log-sum-exp action values minus the logged-action value. This is a specified learning objective.
Its name and penalty do not establish the bank’s action-assignment mechanism, recover omitted
confounders or turn a never-observed action into an identified policy comparison. (d3rlpy
contributors, 2025c)
   In a one-state example, suppose logging always chooses action zero and observes reward
zero. Two admissible models agree on every logged record. Under action one, their rewards
are respectively USD 100 and minus USD 100. The value of always taking action one is
different in these models, although no observed-data fitting criterion can distinguish them
using the specified logs alone. A conservative learner may prefer the supported action; that
is a defensible decision rule under additional preferences or ambiguity restrictions. It is not
recovery of the missing reward. The proposed output should retain unsupported action mass
and any imposed structural assumptions, and refuse an unconditional causal-value certificate.
(Causal banking proposal, 2026au,at)
   Evaluation requires a further separation among sources of uncertainty. A return distribution
describes variation in what happens under a fixed policy and model. Variation among fitted
critics or random seeds describes another object. Neither automatically supplies sampling
coverage for an estimated mean, uncertainty from unsupported actions or the effect of searching
over many policies. The selected FQE configuration exposes a critic count, but the inspected
update is not by itself an inference procedure for all those targets. (d3rlpy contributors, 2025c;
Causal banking proposal, 2026at)
   For example, a return equally likely to be zero or one hundred has mean fifty and variance
2,500 square dollars. Under an explicitly independent sample of one hundred such returns, the
sample mean has variance twenty-five and standard error five dollars. The return standard
deviation is fifty dollars. Reporting one as the other confuses individual risk with precision
of a mean. If two equal-value policies instead receive independent, unbiased score errors of
plus or minus ten, selecting the larger score gives errors −10, 10, 10, 10 across the four equally
likely possibilities: expected optimism is five dollars. These stipulated calculations motivate
customer-level evaluation splits and selection-aware protocols; they are not measured FQE
coverage or a prediction of a particular bank’s bias. (Causal banking proposal, 2026au)
492                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


31.14.6     A bounded reuse decision and its next experiment

The root source has an MIT license with notice-retention and warranty terms. Its package
declaration requires Python at least 3.9 and eleven direct dependencies, including PyTorch
at least 2.5, Gym at least 0.26 and Gymnasium exactly 1.0.0. Several other requirements
are unpinned. The inspected CI configuration uses Python 3.10 on Ubuntu and macOS and
temporarily omits Windows from its active matrix. These are declared inputs and configuration,
not a resolved installation, a successful CI observation or a commitment to future support. A
deployment decision also needs dependency notices, checkpoint compatibility and a reviewed
update policy. (d3rlpy contributors, 2025b)
  Direct adoption is deferred. Narrow integration is a plausible later route because it can retain
upstream learners while making population, episode, policy, clock, scale and failure semantics
explicit. Porting the neural learners is not selected: it would create a second implementation
and its numerical-equivalence burden without a demonstrated benefit. Rejecting all reference
use is also unwarranted; the identified issues admit specific constraints, fixes and generated
acceptance cases. SCOPE-RL and Open Bandit Pipeline remain separate candidates, and an
approval for this reference cannot be inherited by those engines or their different sequential
and contextual-bandit targets. (Causal banking proposal, 2026at)
   The next justified experiment is a small generated environment with an exact tabular value
and direct independent rollouts. It should first verify the native observations and repaired
conversions above, then compare learned policies against the tabular reference while removing
an action from logging support. Training, tuning and final evaluation should have explicit
episode identities; repeated configurations, failed fits, unsupported requests and nonfinite scores
stay in the denominator. Runtime, review time, data reconstruction and maintenance cost
belong beside performance. Bank-specific losses, authentic customer validation and measured
return on investment are later inputs. This sequence permits a concrete product proposal now
while making the evidence required for a future adapter precise. (Causal banking proposal,
2026at)


31.15      Native discovery software and the meaning of a C++
           boundary
A bank may choose a native library because it must fit a larger numerical system, reduce data
movement or control deployment dependencies. Those are reasonable engineering motives, but
they do not select a causal model. A fast graph search can still answer the wrong question,
discard the direction ambiguity that matters to a rate decision, or reinterpret a repeated
customer history as independent observations. The useful comparison therefore starts with
the statistical object and only then asks which implementation can preserve it.
   Four roles need separate treatment. A native discovery engine takes data and method
assumptions to a graph or graph class. An R or Python package with a C++ backend supplies
that engine through a host-language contract, including coercion, missingness and graph
conversion. A graphical-model inference library evaluates a model already supplied to it. A
research demonstrator may expose a valuable search idea without distributing a complete
reusable implementation. Counting all four as interchangeable “C++ causal libraries” would
obscure the investment choice.
   The bounded comparison uses two repository-search routes, for causal discovery and Bayesian-
network structure learning, together with known engines and direct upstream references. All
eleven returned candidates are represented below, with four known leads and two direct
31.15. Native discovery software and the meaning of a C++ boundary                         493


upstream leads. This is a seventeen-candidate comparison of inspected releases, not an
exhaustive catalogue of every native implementation. The searches used a current index with
a creation-date filter; selected commit snapshots separately enforce the 7 October 2026 cutoff.
Repository language metadata identifies a lead. The implementation files, release terms and
mathematical contract determine its role. For example, the selected SVI-DAG model imports
JAX and Flax and is implemented in Python, although its repository was returned by the
C++ query (SVI-DAG contributors, 2026).

494                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


   For aGrUM, the attractive property is the explicit distinction between structure-learning
outputs. In the selected source, learnPDAG and learnDAG call different completion operations;
learnPAG is restricted to the FCI branch. The wrapper must retain that distinction. If the
caller asks for a graph class, obtaining a DAG extension is not an acceptable silent substitute.
The selected PC implementation also separates skeleton learning, structural restrictions and
collider orientation. Its stable branch delays edge deletion until the end of a conditioning level,
whereas the ordinary branch can delete immediately. This is a method choice that belongs in
the returned provenance (aGrUM contributors, 2026a).
   The data contract is equally consequential. The inspected aGrUM PC setup constructs a
Chi-square or G-square test over the database. The inspected structure-learning entrypoints
explicitly reject missing values. The presence of parameter-learning EM elsewhere in the
library does not remove that structural restriction. A first adapter should therefore expose a
declared discrete-data route and preserve the rejection. Discretizing continuous bank covariates
or imputing missing histories requires a separate scientific argument, not merely a conversion
function.
  OpenBNSL supplies a second explicit native boundary. Its selected build uses C++20,
Python, pybind11, OpenMP and Boost, with optional CUDA detection. The documentation
specifies categorical variables. The inspected PC routine freezes neighbor information for a
conditioning level, distributes tests and then applies the collected edge removals. The CI
implementation dispatches Chi-square, G-square or an oracle graph, calculates contingency-
table statistics within observed strata, and returns an independence decision. It also applies
a Yates adjustment in one-degree-of-freedom strata, including before the G-square branch.
A comparison against another implementation must reproduce that convention or explicitly
compare different tests (OpenBNSL contributors, 2026).
   The build’s CUDA option is not evidence that GPU-PC is implemented. The selected
feature list separately leaves that item unchecked. Similarly, its published timing examples
remain the authors’ reported benchmarks, not measurements of the proposed bank workflow.
The proposal would measure the complete path from categorical encoding through CI tests,
graph conversion and a meaningful result, with timeouts and unsupported requests retained.
Neither a worker count nor a short kernel time measures that path by itself.

31.15.2     Scores, conditional independence and functional assumptions

The native implementations also show why a common parameter name is not a common
statistical interface. In PC-style search, α commonly controls the rejection threshold of an
individual conditional-independence test. In the inspected XGES command line, alpha defaults
to two and multiplies the BIC complexity penalty. In ccdr.run, alpha limits the number
of edges relative to the number of variables. Mapping all three to a generic “confidence”
setting would change the method (aGrUM contributors, 2026a; Achille Nazaret and XGES
contributors, 2026; Bryon Aragam and Dacheng Zhang, 2026).
   For a target variable j and candidate parents P , the inspected XGES scorer computes
centered empirical covariance, solves the parent regression using an LLT factorization, and
forms residual variance
                                         b jj − Σ
                                 vbj|P = Σ           b −1 Σ
                                                       PP Pj.
                                                b jP Σ    b

Its local score, when these operations are well defined, is
                                    n                  α log n
                       s(j, P ) = − {1 + log vbj|P } −         (|P | + 1).              (31.5)
                                    2                     2
This equation describes the selected implementation; it is not a new consistency theorem. The
centered covariance uses divisor n, and the residual variance, factorization status and finite
31.15. Native discovery software and the meaning of a C++ boundary                          495


logarithm need explicit checks in a prospective numerical comparison. The inspected overload
that accepts intervention indices computes the same covariance without using those indices.
Its signature alone therefore does not establish an interventional score (Achille Nazaret and
XGES contributors, 2026).
  By contrast, ccdrAlgorithm follows a regularization path rather than returning one universal
best graph. Its documented gamma chooses MCP or L1 regularization; its sigmas argument
can fix conditional variances; and its input must be numeric without missing values. These
decisions affect the family of fitted models. The path should be retained with its tuning
and stopping information, while a later selection rule is evaluated separately. BNSL likewise
exposes a criterion choice and a parent-set bound. A fast search over a restricted family should
be described as such, rather than as an unrestricted optimum or a calibrated causal answer
(Bryon Aragam and Dacheng Zhang, 2026; Joe Suzuki and Jun Kawahara, 2026).
   Constraint, score and functional methods should consequently remain separate comparison
families. Constraint methods require a suitable CI test and the graphical assumptions that
make its independence information meaningful. Score methods require a score model, search
space and declared regularization or prior. Functional approaches add restrictions on structural
functions and noise that may orient edges left ambiguous by a Gaussian independence model.
The earlier Python comparison supplies selected functional and continuous optimization
alternatives. The C++ search does not establish their absence from every native ecosystem. It
does reveal that neither a nonlinear experiment’s title nor a repository language label supplies
a reviewed native contract.
   The selected rCausalMGM route illustrates the host-language issue. Its pcStable docu-
mentation distinguishes numeric and categorical variables, drops missing rows, accepts an
optional initial skeleton and returns a CPDAG under causal sufficiency. The native path calls
its stable skeleton search, regression-based CI machinery and orientation routines. A sparse
initial skeleton can prevent consideration of an omitted adjacency; missing-row deletion can
change the population. Both need to appear in the scientific contract. Its adjMat2Graph
documentation defaults directed to false and does not fully specify endpoint orientation.
The selected evidence supports an integration candidate, while the exact converter still needs
delegated-source inspection and a runtime fixture (Tyler C Lovelace, Max Dudek, Jack Fiore
and Panayiotis V Benos, 2026).


31.15.3     A funding calculation that detects a reversed matrix

Consider a synthetic structural model for a bank offer. Let A denote an administered-rate
offer measured in ten-basis-point increments, M retained deposits measured in USD 10 million
units, and Y annual contribution measured in USD 1 million units. Take independent centered
structural errors and stipulate

            A = εA ,              M = 12 A + εM ,                 1
                                                           Y = − 10 A + 25 M + εY .       (31.6)

The negative direct coefficient represents the modeled cost of the higher offered rate. The
mediated route represents the modeled contribution of retained balances. These amounts are
a transparent synthetic accounting example, not bank estimates (Causal banking proposal
project, 2026h).
  Define Wij as the coefficient from source i to target j, in node order (A, M, Y ). Then
                                               
                             0 1/2 −1/10
                        W = 0 0    2/5  ,            X = W T X + ε.
                                       
                             0 0     0
496                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


For this acyclic system, W 3 = 0, and the total effect of a unit offer on contribution is

                         θA→Y = [(I − W T )−1 ]Y,A = − 10
                                                       1
                                                          + 21 25 = 10
                                                                    1
                                                                       .                    (31.7)

It corresponds to USD 100,000 annually. Direct substitution after do(A = 1) gives the same
result. An adapter that instead interprets the same bytes as X = W X + ε reverses the
direction convention and returns zero for this query. Dropping the negative direct coefficient
while preserving the positive route returns USD 200,000. Both errors can survive a check that
only counts nonzero entries or compares absolute weights.
   This example requires a coefficient matrix, not an unweighted adjacency matrix. A graph
alone cannot supply the monetary calculation. In addition, units must transform with the
coefficients. For X ′ = DX, with diagonal positive unit-conversion matrix D, the row-source
coefficient convention requires W ′ = D−1 W D. The effect in the new units is (DY Y /DAA )θA→Y .
Converting only the displayed output label would leave the arithmetic wrong. Exact rational
calculations verify this transformation, all six permutations of the three named nodes and an
independent topological substitution (Causal banking proposal project, 2026h).
   The selected OpenBNSL header provides a concrete reason to test storage and meaning
separately. Its directed-edge query accepts (u, v) in source-to-target order, while its packed
storage looks up the bit for u inside the parent array indexed by v. Copying rows of that
parent array into a public source-row matrix would transpose the relationship. The proposed
adapter must decode the public graph semantics rather than infer them from a memory
layout (OpenBNSL contributors, 2026). The exact bitmap exercise in the project checks this
distinction; it does not execute OpenBNSL.
   Undirected edges need a different check. In the inspected header, two potential arcs represent
one undirected edge, while one arc represents a directed edge. A generic directed graph with
both arcs would instead contain a two-cycle. A correct boundary therefore carries an explicit
graph type, endpoint marks and node identity. It cannot infer causal cycles from the number
of bits, or erase the marks to satisfy a DAG-only downstream API.


31.15.4    A correct orientation can still leave an effect unidentified

Byte-faithful conversion is necessary, but scientific ambiguity remains even after it succeeds.
Consider a different, standardized Gaussian example with covariance
                                                         
                                          1 1/2 1/5
                                    Σ = 1/2 1 2/5 .
                                                   
                                         1/5 2/5 1

The partial covariance of A and Y given M is zero. A forward chain with coefficients 1/2, 2/5
and error variances 1, 3/4, 21/25 generates this law. So does a fork A ← M → Y , with
coefficients 1/2, 2/5 and variances (3/4, 1, 21/25) in (A, M, Y ) order. A reverse chain also
generates it, with variances (3/4, 21/25, 1). Each variance is positive. Exact covariance
reconstruction checks equality for all three systems (Causal banking proposal project, 2026h).
   Their offer effects are 1/5, 0, 0, respectively. If one outcome unit is USD 1 million, the
structural alternatives allow USD 200,000 or zero for a unit action. Choosing an arbitrary
DAG extension from a PDAG would choose one answer without evidence for that choice.
Averaging extensions would add a distribution over graphs that the observed covariance does
not provide. The useful output is a graph class and its justified effect alternatives, with any
sampling uncertainty handled separately. This is the same reason the pcalg integration retains
an effect multiset rather than presenting its mean as an identified monetary answer (pcalg
contributors; CRAN source mirror, 2024b).
31.15. Native discovery software and the meaning of a C++ boundary                            497


  Native score search may be the appropriate computational component for that workflow. It
does not, by itself, supply the identification layer, a confidence region over graphs, a decision-
useful effect set or banking validation. The proposal should budget separately for each missing
component instead of treating an executable graph search as the complete causal product.


31.15.5     Why categorical encoding and predictive rules need their own
            review

Categorical support does not imply that an arbitrary discretization preserves the required
adjustment information. Let a binary risk state R have probability one half, and suppose A
and Y are independent given R, each having success probability 1/5 when R = 0 and 4/5 when
R = 1. There is no structural arrow from A to Y ; changing A does not change Y . Treatment
probabilities are positive in both strata. Nevertheless, exact enumeration gives

    E[Y | A = 1] = 17/25,     E[Y | A = 0] = 8/25,     E[Y | A = 1] − E[Y | A = 0] = 9/25.

Collapsing the two risk categories into one bin destroys the conditioning information and
retains that spurious association. The population contrast within each original stratum is
zero (Causal banking proposal project, 2026h). A finer encoding also has a cost: conditioning
on five binary variables creates up to thirty-two strata before the two tested variables are
cross-classified. Cell sparsity, omitted combinations and test approximations consequently
belong in the proposed evaluation. More bins do not automatically improve inference at a
fixed sample size.
  A second example addresses the conditional-entropy lead in the finite search. Its README
describes low conditional entropy as a causal rule. Let U ∼ Bernoulli(1/2). In one structural
model take A = U, Y = A; in another take A = U, Y = U . Both models have identical
observed atoms (0, 0), (1, 1), each with probability one half, and both have H(Y | A) = 0.
Their intervention contrasts are one and zero. Thus even perfect prediction does not establish
an offer’s causal effect. This exact counterexample concerns the claimed inferential rule; it is
not a benchmark of the downloaded program (Causal banking proposal project, 2026h; Named
repository contributors, 2026).
   The inspected COJEC implementation creates an additional, narrower concern: its
selected rule uses the expression p(x, y) log p(x, y)/ log p(x), a threshold of 0.08 and a
count condition above nine. That expression is different from the full conditional entropy
− x,y p(x, y) log{p(x, y)/p(x)}. The source observation and the identification counterexample
  P

justify declining this rule as a causal-effect contract. They do not establish that association
screening has no useful exploratory role (Named repository contributors, 2026).

cannot silently replace the terms of an omitted scorer, a nested dependency or another project’s
