   For the first row, searching only [−1/2, 1/2] finds no accepted value even though the true
inverted set contains two infinite rays. An interface must distinguish “empty on the searched
grid” from a globally empty set. It must also distinguish an infinite endpoint from missing
information and from an unfinished numerical search. Replacing the two components by their
convex hull would insert all the rejected values between −1 and 1; replacing them by a finite
interval would remove supported tail values. A monetary decision can change under either
alteration.
   Static inspection adds a specific implementation concern. In the pinned ivmodel CLR
routine, a numerical error during conditional p-value evaluation is caught and replaced with
zero; a root-search error similarly substitutes zero for an intermediate quantity. The AR routine
uses a projection F statistic, while CLR constructs a residual cross-product covariance. The
parent object’s generic heteroskedastic or cluster standard-error options do not establish that
these paths implement the corresponding robust tests.(ivmodel package contributors, 2026) A
proposed worker must expose or independently detect the numerical failure before accepting
the result. An explicit zero p-value is otherwise indistinguishable from the substituted failure
value at that field alone. The source establishes the branch; its frequency and native triggering
cases remain to be measured in a controlled prototype. This is a reason to retain the package
as a reference while withholding runtime admission for that path.


32.15.3     A local polynomial cannot fill a gap in the score support

rdrobust’s continuity-based profile distinguishes sharp, fuzzy and kink designs, the degree
used for estimation and bias correction, left/right estimation bandwidths h, bias bandwidths
b, kernel, variance procedure and clustering. Its outputs distinguish conventional estimates,
bias-corrected estimates and the associated uncertainty rows. The adapter must preserve
these associations; a corrected estimate with the wrong standard error is a different procedure.
Effective sample sizes, unique score counts and warnings are part of the result. (rdrobust
package contributors, 2026)
32.15. R instruments and credit thresholds: preserving the design and its limits               597


  Rounded credit scores make the support issue concrete. Suppose the only score values are
R = −1 and R = 1, eligibility is D = 1{R ≥ 0}, and observed mean losses are USD 100 and
USD 80 respectively. Two continuous potential-mean models agree at every observed score:

                                A: m0 (r) = 100,       m1 (r) = 80,
                                B: m0 (r) = m1 (r) = 90 − 10r.                              (32.7)

Model A has treatment effect USD −20 at zero, while model B has effect zero. There are no
observations approaching the cutoff from either side, so continuity alone cannot select between
the models. More customers at the same two scores reduce uncertainty about the observed
means but do not identify the unobserved limits. A mass-point option can alter estimation
behavior; it cannot create missing score support.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026bk;
rdrobust package contributors, 2026)
   If additional substantive information bounds each potential-mean slope in absolute value by
L, and the nearest observations are distance δ from the cutoff, each extrapolation contributes
at most Lδ. In this two-point law the cutoff effect belongs to

                                 θ(0) ∈ [−20 − 2Lδ, −20 + 2Lδ].                             (32.8)

The endpoints are attainable by choosing the two potential-mean slopes within the declared
bound. With L = 10 and δ = 1, the effect set is [−40, 0] dollars. At an assumed treatment
cost USD 10, the net-margin set is [−10, 30] dollars, and it does not justify a uniformly
positive-margin claim. These are identification bounds with known observed means; sampling
uncertainty would need to be added rather than silently absorbed into the slope restriction.
   rddensity supplies a different diagnostic: local-polynomial density estimates and tests for
a discontinuity in the running-variable distribution, with explicit bandwidth, variance and
mass-point options. Its documentation distinguishes a conventional statistic from robust bias
correction and warns about conventional inference with an MSE-selected bandwidth.(rddensity
package contributors, 2026) Even exact equality of the score density on both sides would not
prove continuity of potential losses. For example, a continuously uniform score can coexist
with another policy that changes at zero and affects loss, even when the treatment being
studied has no effect. A density test examines the score law, not that competing intervention.
Conversely, rounded scores need their own support and measurement discussion before a
continuous-density interpretation is applied.


32.15.4     Local randomization is an alternative design with its own obligations

rdlocrand assumes local randomization within a supplied or selected window. The window-
selection routine considers nested windows and covariate balance tests. That procedure is
useful evidence for design assessment, but a favorable balance p-value cannot prove assignment
independence. Outcome-driven window search also changes the inference problem. The
proposed request must retain whether the window was fixed before outcome inspection,
selected with pre-treatment covariates, or chosen through a procedure requiring additional
selection analysis. (rdlocrand package contributors, 2026)
   The distinction is visible in a finite reference. Fix six customers’ losses under the sharp null
at (0, 0, 0, 100, 100, 100) dollars. Assume exactly three are assigned treatment, uniformly over
the 63 = 20 allocations, in a window fixed in advance. If the first three receive treatment, the
difference in mean loss is −100. Exactly two allocations have an absolute difference at least
this large, so the two-sided randomization p-value is 2/20 = 0.1. This is complete enumeration
under a Fisher sharp null of no effect for any customer. It does not supply a general test of
598                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


zero population average effect under arbitrary heterogeneous effects.(Causal banking proposal
project, 2026bk)
   The pinned rdlocrand documentation also distinguishes requested from effective polynomial
degree. For the documented mean contrasts and fuzzy procedures, positive degree invokes
large-sample normal inference; a randomization p-value is not computed. Some statistic/degree
combinations revert to degree zero with a warning. Fuzzy test inversion can require an explicit
effect grid. Consequently, the adapter must export the effective method, degree, variance choice,
assignment law, seed, repetitions, window and grid, not just the originally requested options.
HC3 standard errors do not confer finite-sample randomization validity, and a TSLS/Wald
label does not remove weak-first-stage concerns. (rdlocrand package contributors, 2026)


32.15.5    Reuse choices, rights and a prototype that can change the decision

The immediate recommendation is reference reuse with conditional plans for original R workers.
The dedicated ivreg interface is the natural initial ordinary-2SLS candidate; AER remains a
distinct baseline and dependency. ivmodel is valuable for documenting sets and sensitivity, with
CLR admission conditional on a qualified failure path. rdrobust serves an explicit continuity
profile, rddensity a supplementary diagnostic, and rdlocrand a separate local-randomization
profile. A direct port adds numerical and maintenance duties and should follow an identified
operational need. Existing grf effect-estimation and fixest panel-worker proposals do not
automatically qualify an IV target or this threshold design merely because they share an R
execution path.
   The pinned metadata declares GPL version alternatives for AER, GPL version 2 or later for
ivreg, and GPL 3 for the three RD packages. ivmodel declares GPL 2 or its local license file,
whose inspected text supplies an MIT alternative with copyright/permission-notice conditions
and a warranty disclaimer. These facts improve the package-level comparison but do not clear
the full dependency tree. rdlocrand imports AER and sandwich; other profiles also depend on
statistical, formula, matrix or plotting packages. Exact installed versions and their notices
must be included in the selected distribution.(AER package contributors, 2026; ivreg package
contributors, 2026; ivmodel package contributors, 2026; rdrobust package contributors, 2026;
rddensity package contributors, 2026; rdlocrand package contributors, 2026)
   The GPL texts distinguish running a program from copying, modifying and conveying
it, and impose applicable notice and corresponding-source conditions. Moving an engine
behind a process boundary does not itself decide all obligations of a particular distributed
product. Original-worker integration and porting therefore need a review of the actual
distribution, including third-party material. No current package recommendation grants that
implementation clearance. (Free Software Foundation, 1991, 2007)
   A useful public prototype would first compare typed requests with independent projection
and set-inversion references, then test the complete native workflow. The ordinary-IV cases
should vary rank, weights, missingness and covariance conventions while preserving the target.
Weak-IV cases should stress a vanishing first stage, disconnected sets, numerical integration
and root-search failures. Threshold cases should distinguish smooth support approaching zero,
a small take-up discontinuity, rounded scores and competing policies. The local-randomization
path should reproduce the twenty-allocation example before larger simulations, and analyze
selected-window behavior separately.
  Before final simulation, freeze the data laws, target, package/dependency versions, seeds,
replication budget, tolerances and stopping rule. Keep failed fits in the denominator and
report Monte Carlo uncertainty. Native execution, serialization fidelity, statistical calibration
and decision value answer different questions; passing one must not silently mark the others
32.16. Commercial survival software and repeated banking interventions                          599


complete. An LLM can help translate the business question, propose alternative eligibility
graphs and assemble these typed requests. It must preserve unresolved exclusion, compliance
and score-support questions, and must not convert a failed search or a diagnostic p-value into
a causal certificate. This design makes a bounded prototype informative before an expensive
experiment with bank data.


32.16       Commercial survival software and repeated banking in-
            terventions
A servicing team observes default, prepayment, hardship contact and changing arrears over
a loan’s life. It asks whether repeated assistance will improve customer outcomes and the
value of the portfolio. Several familiar software operations sound relevant: a survival curve,
a Cox regression with changing covariates, an average treatment effect on survival time, a
competing-event model and a latent growth model. They do not answer the same question.
An adequate comparison begins with the decision, eligible population, common time origin,
event definitions and intervention history. Only then can the proposed library decide which
commercial operation is a valid comparator.
   This bounded review develops eight families from official technical text: Stata, SAS/STAT,
IBM SPSS, JMP, Minitab, NCSS, Statistica and Mplus. MATLAB remains a ninth candidate
because both attempted official method pages were unavailable. Several sources identify an
edition; the exact NCSS and Mplus editions and the Minitab update remain unresolved. A
mutable manual acquired after 7 October 2026 does not establish its exact content at that
literature cutoff. Consequently the comparison supports its inspected method claims, not an
exhaustive historical market census or installed-product qualification. No commercial engine
was executed, and no price, deployment entitlement or performance advantage is inferred from
documentation (Causal banking proposal, 2026aq).


32.16.1     Time, events and causal targets belong in the interface

Let T g be the first terminal-event time under a declared feasible policy g, and J g the event
type, such as default or prepayment. A first-event survival probability P (T g > t) differs from
the default cumulative incidence FDg (t) = P (T g ≤ t, J g = D). The restricted mean time
without either event is E[min(T g , τ )], for a specified horizon τ . It is neither the unrestricted
mean default time nor a ratio of conditional hazards. A policy may change prepayment as
well as default, so changing the target can change the apparent benefit. These objects are
proposed contract fields, not automatically identified quantities.
   For a discrete two-period construction, write dgk and pgk for the conditional probabilities
of default and prepayment during period k among loans still active at its start. They are
mutually exclusive, with dgk + pgk ≤ 1. Set S0g = 1. Direct conditioning gives
                                                                  K
                      Skg = Sk−1
                             g
                                 (1 − dgk − pgk ),    FDg (K) =     g
                                                                        Sk−1 dgk .
                                                                  X

                                                                  k=1

The analogous sum with pgk gives prepayment incidence. The recursion is an accounting
identity within the stipulated policy law. Identification of that law from bank observations
requires additional causal and observation assumptions. In particular, replacing the recursion
by 1 − k (1 − dgk ) removes prepayment while retaining the same default hazards. That is
        Q

a different construction; the unchanged-hazard premise does not follow from observing the
original competing-event process (Causal banking proposal, 2026ap).
600                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


  Suppose both periods have default probability 1/10 under two generated policies. Policy
A has prepayment probability 2/5, while B has probability 1/10. After two periods A has
default incidence .15, prepayment incidence .60 and active probability .25. B has corresponding
probabilities .18, .18 and .64. Removing prepayment and retaining the default hazard gives .19
under either policy. All three default numbers answer different questions. A lower observed
default incidence under A can arise because more loans leave through prepayment, even though
the conditional default hazard is identical. Full enumeration of both period outcomes agrees
with the recursion (Causal banking proposal, 2026ap).
   Value need not rank the policies by default incidence. Stipulate USD 10 per active loan at
the start of each period, USD 100 lost at default and USD 20 lost at prepayment, with no
discounting. Expected active periods are 1.5 and 1.8, so values are

  VA = 10(1.5) − 100(.15) − 20(.60) = −12,        VB = 10(1.8) − 100(.18) − 20(.18) = −3.6.

The policy with fewer defaults has lower value under these exposed prices. These are authored
scenarios, not estimated bank effects or claims that prepayment always causes a loss. The
interface should return the joint event accounting and the declared value map, allowing different
accepted prices without changing the scientific target (Causal banking proposal, 2026ap).


32.16.2     Stata offers causal survival comparators with explicit limits

The inspected stteffects manuals document ATEs, effects on the treated and potential-
outcome mean survival times through regression adjustment, inverse-probability weighting and
combined methods. These are substantial existing causal-estimation capabilities. Comparing
the proposed library only with an unadjusted survival plot would understate the commercial
alternative. The manuals also expressly exclude delayed entry, time-varying covariates and
multiple-record data from this command family. A documented baseline-treatment survival
estimator therefore cannot be silently relabeled as an estimator of a repeated collections policy
(StataCorp, 2026i).
   Three scientific conditions remain distinct: conditional independence of treatment and
potential outcomes given the supplied covariates, treatment overlap and correct adjustment
for censoring. The documentation distinguishes likelihood-adjusted censoring in LAC-IPWRA
from weighted-adjusted censoring in WAC-IPWRA. In the inspected implementation, weighted
censoring requires random, correctly modeled censoring and a censoring process that does not
vary by treatment level. The choice is consequential for a servicing example where treatment
changes the chance that records disappear. Calling an estimator doubly robust does not remove
an identification premise or extend the documented censoring regime (StataCorp, 2026i).
   The proposed adapter should retain the chosen estimand, treatment/control labels, outcome
distribution, treatment model and censoring adjustment as separate fields. It should export
propensity scores, censor-survival probabilities, conditional means, covariance type and the
actual estimation sample. The manual documents an overlap tolerance that can stop estimation
and an option identifying offending observations. It also distinguishes robust, clustered,
bootstrap and jackknife uncertainty. A refusal at an overlap boundary belongs in the result,
not in an omitted request. Balance and overlap diagnostics examine supplied observed
covariates; they do not authenticate an unmeasured-confounding assumption (StataCorp,
2026i).
   Stata’s separate stcrreg command models the subhazard of a selected event with specified
competing events. It permits single or multiple records but not multiple failures per subject.
Its event codes, time interactions, cluster settings and cumulative-incidence interpretation
require a different conversion contract from stteffects. Recurrent missed payments and
32.16. Commercial survival software and repeated banking interventions                       601


terminal default are different event structures even when the raw table has the same number
of rows. The first proposed commercial trial should use a supported fixed-treatment case
and a separately specified competing-event case; it should not claim that either demonstrates
arbitrary dynamic-policy evaluation (StataCorp, 2026j).


32.16.3     SAS and JMP illustrate why competing-event outputs differ

SAS/STAT 14.1 PHREG documents counting-process input in intervals (T1 , T2 ], with covariates
held fixed within each record and event status at the end. Its examples cover repeated events
and delayed entry. This is useful for representing servicing records faithfully, provided subject
identity, actual entry time and covariate availability are preserved. The input representation
does not itself identify the effect of intervening on a history. It specifies who belongs in a
model’s risk set (SAS Institute, 2015b).
   The same edition documents a distinct subdistribution-hazard pathway through EVENTCODE.
Subjects with competing events remain in modified risk sets with weights; they should not
be exported as ordinary event-free subjects. The manual specifies a sandwich covariance, an
explicit cluster-ID route, cumulative-incidence predictions and pointwise interval settings. It
also states that several options and statements are ignored in this mode, including ASSESS,
BAYES and RANDOM. A generic wrapper that accepts every option and labels it effective would
misdescribe the analysis. The adapter must preserve the effective procedure configuration and
distinguish a pointwise band from a simultaneous or policy-value guarantee (SAS Institute,
2015b).
   JMP 18.1’s inspected Competing Causes page describes cause-specific survival estimation by
censoring events from other causes and states independence for its cause-wise interpretation.
Its Omit Causes control recalculates the display to illustrate removal of selected causes.
In the banking construction, removing prepayment and holding default hazards unchanged
yields .19, while actual default incidences are .15 and .18. Thus a cause-removal display is
not interchangeable with the observed cumulative default probability. Nor does the control
establish that a bank can remove prepayment without changing default mechanisms. This is
a scoped comparison of the documented platform, not an assertion that every JMP survival
capability shares that interpretation (JMP Statistical Discovery, 2024; Causal banking proposal,
2026ap).
   The proposal should therefore avoid importing a column merely named “survival” or
“risk.” Its descriptor needs the event set, horizon, conditional population, risk-set convention,
cause-removal premise where used, and uncertainty definition. SAS’s subdistribution output
and the inspected JMP cause-wise display are useful alternatives for different questions. A
matched experiment first harmonizes the question and only then compares numerical estimates,
diagnostics and workflow cost.


32.16.4     Time-dependent regression must preserve the decision clock

IBM SPSS Statistics 30 documents the system time variable T_, both for explicit time
interactions and for segmented measured covariates. Its weekly example combines logical
interval indicators with measurements. Statistica 14.2 separately offers survival-time inputs,
explicit time-function covariates and counting-process start/stop inputs. These are useful
ways to represent changing records, but a change of input form is not evidence of a causal
dynamic-regime estimator. Measurement time, availability time and the action time must still
be checked independently (IBM, 2025; Cloud Software Group, 2024).
  Consider 100 stipulated loans at a common initial eligibility date. Twenty default before
602                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


day two. Among the 80 survivors, 40 receive assistance at day two and 40 do not; ten in each
group subsequently default. Labeling exposure from the initial date by whether assistance ever
occurs gives risks 10/40 and 30/60, an apparent difference of minus 25 percentage points. The
future-treated category necessarily excludes the twenty early defaults. A day-two landmark
comparison gives 10/40 in each arm, but now concerns the survivor population. Neither
rewriting the label nor dropping early events recovers a baseline assignment-policy effect. The
construction diagnoses a clock and denominator error; it is not an estimate of Cox-regression
bias (Causal banking proposal, 2026ap).
   A converter should split records at declared changes while preserving which covariate value
was known immediately before the decision. In a (s, t] record, the end event and any new
information at t must follow an explicit ordering convention. A measurement collected after
an event cannot be carried back into its risk interval. A policy scheduled for day two needs
a definition for loans that default earlier. These are scientific design choices, not formatting
repairs; the software should reject ambiguity rather than choose an ordering from the row sort.
   Minitab’s inspected counting-process method table makes several conversion checks concrete.
It distinguishes fixed predictors from time-dependent repeated measures, records categorical
coding and tie adjustment, distinguishes robust from model covariance, and describes stratifi-
cation and proportional hazards diagnostics. It also documents excluded rows with missing
or nonpositive response times and an error when entry exceeds exit. Consequently the input
row count is insufficient: a proposed adapter should reconcile subjects, intervals, events and
exclusions, and preserve the effective covariance and tie method. This is documentation-based
design; exact edition and runtime parity still need qualification (Minitab, 2026).


32.16.5    Sequential confounding is not removed by a time column

An exact two-decision construction shows the additional causal work. Let A0 be an early
assistance action randomized with probability 1/2. Let L be later arrears, with probabilities
.8 under A0 = 0 and .2 under A0 = 1. The later action A1 has probability .8 when L = 1 and
.2 when L = 0. Define final default probability by

                         P (Y = 1 | L = l, A1 = a) = .1 + .4l − .05a.

Independent randomizers generate the stated conditional probabilities. This fully specified
law supplies consistency, sequential exchangeability and positive treatment support for this
example. None is inferred from a fitted hazard model or a software diagnostic (Causal banking
proposal, 2026ap).
   Marginally P (L = 1) = 1/2. Later assistance selects higher-risk histories: P (L = 1 | A1 =
1) = .8 and P (L = 1 | A1 = 0) = .2. Hence observed default risks are .37 with A1 = 1 and
.18 with A1 = 0, despite the negative conditional action effect. Under fixed policies, direct
summation instead gives
                            P (Y 0,0 = 1) = .2(.1) + .8(.5) = .42,
                            P (Y 1,1 = 1) = .8(.05) + .2(.45) = .13.
Their difference is −.29, while the observed late-action difference is +.19. The two policy
values are also reproduced by averaging the default indicator Y over the complete sixteen-state
law with weights
                                    1{A0 = a0 , A1 = a1 }
                                                             .
                                 P (A0 = a0 )P (A1 = a1 | L)
This is a population identity for the authored law, not a fitted weighting study or an asserted
finite-sample coverage result (Causal banking proposal, 2026ap).
32.16. Commercial survival software and repeated banking interventions                        603


   Conditioning on L can remove confounding of the later action while also holding fixed
a variable changed by the earlier action. In this construction, the controlled A0 difference
at fixed (L, A1 ) is zero, although the two-regime contrast is not. A single coefficient from
a regression containing A0 , L, A1 cannot be interpreted as the total effect of the repeated
policy without further calculation and assumptions. The proposed library needs an explicit
longitudinal target, history-indexed assignment/observation laws and a valid standardization
or other justified procedure. A counting-process adapter can supply faithful data to such work;
it is not a substitute for it.
   Mplus’s inspected Chapter 6 offers distinct discrete-time survival, Cox, parametric baseline-
hazard and latent-factor survival examples. In the discrete example, post-event periods
and dropout can share a missing-value code. A bank adapter should retain their different
reasons before conversion. The latent-factor example makes numerical integration and its
computational burden explicit. Its measurement model is a substantive alternative when
supported, but fitting a latent factor does not authenticate causal confounding control. These
examples justify a narrow model-and-output comparator, while the chapter’s exact edition,
intended runtime and rights remain unresolved (Muthen and Muthen, 2026c).


32.16.6     Censoring and failed uncertainty calculations remain outcomes

A small horizon-observation example separates an outcome model from its observed cases.
Half the population is low risk with default probability .1; half is high risk with probability
.6. All low-risk outcomes and one quarter of high-risk outcomes are observed. Observation
is stipulated independent of default conditional on this recorded stratum. Full-cohort risk is
.5(.1) + .5(.6) = .35, while complete-case risk is

                                   .5(.1) + .5(.25)(.6)
                                                        = .20.
                                       .5 + .5(.25)

Inverse observation weighting restores .35 under the known probabilities. It cannot do so
by arithmetic alone if the stratum is unavailable, the probabilities are wrong or observation
depends on unrecorded future outcomes. This finite missingness construction motivates the
analogous checks for a time-indexed censoring model; it does not establish a continuous-time
estimator (Causal banking proposal, 2026ap).
   NCSS’s Cox manual supplies a useful reporting comparator even without a qualified in-
tegration. Its run summary contains processed and estimation rows, likelihood iterations,
achieved convergence and completion status. The described stopping statistic is the maximum
relative coefficient change on the last iteration. A finite number in a coefficient table is
therefore not enough to classify a run as converged. The proposal should preserve these
diagnostics and distinguish numerical nonconvergence, a scientifically unidentified target and
an unsupported method. The source is an undated official chapter; it supports the inspected
reporting semantics, not a claim about a particular installed NCSS release (NCSS LLC, 2026).
   Uncertainty calculations need their own failure denominator. Suppose eight subjects include
only one with a required rare treatment history. An ordinary eight-draw subject bootstrap
omits that subject with probability (7/8)8 ≃ .3436. An unregularized mean for that history is
undefined in those resamples. Discarding them and silently drawing replacements conditions
the replication distribution on containing the history. It is not the unconditional bootstrap
originally declared. This exact occupancy calculation does not claim a 34.36% failure rate for
any vendor command: it specifies a stress case for the proposed wrapper. A cluster bootstrap,
stratified design, regularization or a restricted target is a substantive alternative with its own
assumptions, not a license to hide failures (Causal banking proposal, 2026ap).
604                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


32.16.7     Build a target-preserving comparator before a product claim

The current six-operation reference service handles declared graph syntax, a supplied-DAG
backdoor case, supplied-moment inversion, deterministic sensitivity sets and declared observa-
tion clocks. It does not expose fitted survival, competing-risk or dynamic-regime estimation.
Research derivations elsewhere in this proposal do not enlarge that service contract. The
inspected commercial procedures already supply serious estimation, diagnostics and reporting
alternatives; the proposed differentiator must be demonstrated in target preservation, sup-
ported causal scope and transparent uncertainty, rather than assumed from having an agent
interface (Causal banking proposal, 2026aq).
   The immediate route is a public/generated comparator contract. Begin with a fixed-
treatment survival target supported by the chosen procedure; add a competing-event case with
separately declared incidence and cause-removal targets. Verify subject identity, time units,
entry/exit boundaries, event codes, treatment levels, selected rows and output units. Then
inspect complete failure trajectories, censoring diagnostics and uncertainty settings. Repeated
policies enter a separate experiment with an explicit sequential identification argument and
exact reference law. No unsupported request should be routed to the nearest command by
name.
   Stata and SAS warrant consideration as licensed numerical comparators; IBM, Statistica
and Minitab supply useful clock, representation and diagnostic comparisons; JMP clari-
fies cause-removal semantics; NCSS exposes convergence reporting; and Mplus supplies
survival/measurement-model alternatives. These are proposed uses of documented paths.
Proprietary code should not be ported under an assumed license. A future adapter or direct-
use decision requires the selected edition, authorized execution mode, permitted exports
and applicable redistribution and benchmark-publication terms. MATLAB and uninspected
extensions stay unresolved. Missing evidence is not a negative feature finding (Causal banking
proposal, 2026aq).
   Only after the public/generated prototype preserves these targets and makes the intended
comparison useful should a paid runtime study or authentic bank experiment be commissioned.
Its cost includes the license, conversion, fitting, uncertainty replication, failed attempts, review
and maintenance. No current quotation or bank ROI is available from this review. That is a
specific later input, while the present proposal can already specify the scientific comparisons,
acceptance cases and unsupported uses.


32.17      Commercial survival options against the proposed service
The preceding survival analysis compares several procedures on their own terms. A procurement
decision needs a second comparison: what each inspected edition documents, what the present
local service actually does, and what the proposal still asks an implementation to supply. These
are three different columns. In particular, an operation’s appearance in a product proposal
is not evidence that its reference service computes it. The existing local service implements
a bounded supplied-moment residual inversion, a supplied DAG back-door construction for
independent units, graph syntax, deterministic sensitivity and observation-clock checks. Its
method dispatcher returns unsupported for the three authored fixed-treatment survival,
competing-incidence and sequential-policy identifiers. This observation is a test of the local
dispatcher, not a vendor execution or an attempted encoding of every survival target. The
present request enum also has no separately named survival operation. These facts establish a
current implementation gap for the proposed cases, while the precise future service boundary
remains a design decision. (Causal banking research project, 2026ao)
32.17. Commercial survival options against the proposed service                             605


   For a fixed treatment at a common origin, Stata’s inspected stteffects documentation
already describes average effects, effects on the treated and potential mean survival outcomes
with regression, weighting and combined estimators. It documents overlap and censoring
diagnostics. This is a substantive commercial comparator. The same command family expressly
excludes delayed entry, time-varying covariates and multiple-record data; its separate stcrreg
subhazard path has another target and conversion contract. The proposal should first compare a
documented fixed-treatment profile and a separate competing-event profile, retaining treatment
labels, analysis sample, censoring adjustment and uncertainty. A dynamic servicing-policy
claim would require additional identification and implementation evidence. The inspected
mutable manuals do not verify a particular installed Stata update at the literature cutoff.
(StataCorp, 2026i,j)
   SAS/STAT 14.1 PHREG documents interval records, time-dependent covariates, delayed
entry and recurrent-event examples, as well as an EVENTCODE subdistribution path with modified
competing-event risk sets. It is a useful licensed comparator for faithful record preparation
and cumulative-incidence output. Some statements and options are ignored in the documented
subdistribution mode; a bridge must report effective settings, not only submitted text. The
inspected SAS route does not by itself identify an intervention on a repeated assistance policy.
The much larger later PHREG manual was not acquired within the fixed transfer bound, so
later-edition equivalence remains unreviewed rather than assumed. (SAS Institute, 2015b)
   Other inspected products can answer narrower conversion questions. IBM SPSS Statistics 30
documents T_ time expressions and measured-covariate segments. Statistica 14.2 distinguishes
survival-time, time-function and start–stop forms. Minitab’s counting-process help records
tie adjustment, covariance choice, excluded rows and entry/exit errors. These are useful for
testing the proposed clock and row-reconciliation layer, but a time-varying column is not a
sequential policy estimator. JMP 18.1’s inspected Competing Causes display treats other
events as censored in cause-wise analysis under its stated independence premise; Omit Causes
recalculates a removal illustration. It is not the same object as an observed default cumulative
incidence or an established intervention on prepayment. A comparison that reads either output
as a policy value has changed the scientific question before considering software quality. (IBM,
2025; Cloud Software Group, 2024; Minitab, 2026; JMP Statistical Discovery, 2024)
   NCSS’s inspected Cox chapter contributes a reporting comparator: processed and used
rows, iterations, achieved convergence and completion status. A finite coefficient without
convergence is not a completed scientific result. Mplus’s inspected chapter gives discrete-time,
Cox, parametric and latent-factor survival examples. It illustrates both a richer modeling
alternative and the need to separate dropout from post-event missingness; a latent measurement
model does not verify the absence of hidden confounding. Exact NCSS and Mplus editions are
unresolved. MATLAB remains a candidate, but the two attempted official method originals
returned HTTP 403. No feature-absence or quality ranking follows from that acquisition
outcome. (NCSS LLC, 2026; Muthen and Muthen, 2026c; Causal banking research project,
2026an)
   The comparison therefore does not count a vendor’s documented Cox feature against a
proposed causal-policy feature as though both were exchangeable. For each profile, the
proposed library must bind treatment and event definitions, time origin, eligible subjects,
history and availability clock, observation/censoring law, estimand, uncertainty and value
units. The initial public/generated trial can compare fixed-treatment survival where a chosen
licensed method actually applies, then a competing-event example with separate incidence and
cause-removal outputs. A generated start–stop fixture tests identity, excluded rows, ties and
event ordering. A sequential-policy example requires its own assignment and observation law
and must remain unsupported by the current service until a selected estimator is implemented
606                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


and qualified. The earlier two-period competing-event and sixteen-state sequential examples
provide exact references, not vendor performance data. (Causal banking proposal, 2026ap;
Causal banking research project, 2026an)
   This route also determines what evidence a paid evaluation would buy. The prototype should
first show that the selected target and conversions matter on public or generated inputs. Then
an owner could select an exact commercial edition, obtain the intended entitlement and confirm
automation, export, embedding and benchmark-publication rights. A frozen matched run
would compare the same profile, input population, failure denominator, diagnostics, uncertainty
and full workflow cost. Prices and those rights are unavailable in the inspected record, so the
present comparison cannot choose a purchase or claim a cheaper product. Missing historical

32.18      Commercial policy evaluation: what an offline score
           permits
A servicing manager comparing a contact policy with the existing workflow needs a value for a
specified action rule, population and horizon. Several commercial tools expose quantities called
policy value, reward, uplift or expected utility. These quantities support different decisions.
A static treatment-assignment rule, a learning procedure that changes after each event, a
sequence of servicing actions, and an optimum within a supplied decision model are distinct
objects. The proposal should compare them at those boundaries before deciding whether to
buy a license, integrate an engine or build a missing component.
   The documented landscape already contains useful capabilities. Stata’s cate postestimation
evaluates prespecified treatment-assignment policies. The historical Azure Personalizer service
documents offline comparisons of learning policies. GeNIe and its SMILE engine provide
decision analysis and expected utilities in supplied influence diagrams. Amazon Personalize
documents held-out recommendation metrics. JMP’s uplift platform provides a separate
targeting alternative. These are substantive comparators, but they do not jointly establish
a generally valid sequential causal-policy service. The following comparison uses inspected
official technical text; none of these vendor engines was executed for this review. (StataCorp,
2025; Microsoft, 2026a; BayesFusion, LLC, 2024n; Amazon Web Services, 2026a; JMP, 2025)


32.18.1    Four policy questions and one declared information clock

For one binary treatment, let X denote information available before treatment, Y (a) the
potential outcome, and π(x) ∈ [0, 1] a prespecified probability of assigning treatment. The
static value is
                        V (π) = E{π(X)Y (1) + [1 − π(X)]Y (0)}.
This is the target displayed in Stata’s policy-evaluation methods. The command also compares
two policies and accepts probability-valued policy variables. Its synonym estat tassigneval
should not be counted as a separate method. The premises of the underlying treatment-effect
analysis still apply. A rule chosen by maximizing this same evaluation sample is a different
inferential target from a prespecified rule; a changing sequence of actions is not represented
merely by placing its last action in the treatment column. (StataCorp, 2025)
  For sequential servicing, let Ht be the observed history immediately before action At , Rt
the subsequent net cash flow, bt (a | h) the logging probability, and πt (a | h) the proposed
32.18. Commercial policy evaluation: what an offline score permits                            607


policy. A finite-horizon target is
                                      "T −1            #          t

The change-of-law argument needs consistent actions and outcomes, sufficient histories for
sequential assignment, positive logging probability wherever the target policy acts, and an
appropriate initial population and observation law. Under a correctly specified observed-
state experiment, the likelihood ratios change the action distribution while leaving the shared
environmental mechanisms unchanged. Jiang and Li develop trajectory and stepwise importance
sampling and a sequential doubly robust construction; their discussion also requires separating
a data-derived target policy from the sample used for evaluation. That result does not grant
causal validity to arbitrary hidden servicing states or misrecorded logging probabilities. (Jiang
and Li, 2016)
   A supplied-model decision engine answers a third question: what action has the highest
expected utility if its probability tables, information sets and utilities are correct? A recom-
mendation metric answers a fourth: how well does a learned ranking reproduce or predict
held-out interactions? Either can be valuable without identifying the effect of deploying a new
servicing policy. The commercial feature matrix should retain the target, source of mechanisms,
sampling unit and uncertainty claim for each quantity.

32.18.2     A final-action adjustment can reverse a servicing decision

Consider a generated two-stage law with γ = 1. The first action A0 is a fair binary draw; the
next observed state is L1 = A0 . The logger chooses A1 = 1 with probability 9/10 after A0 = 0
and 1/10 after A0 = 1. Define a terminal net reward, in stipulated dollars, by
                         R = 20A0 + 100A1 − 120A0 A1 − 5(A0 + A1 ).
This law deliberately models an adverse interaction between repeated actions; it is not an
estimated banking mechanism. Its four paths are
                              (A0 , A1 ) (0, 0) (0, 1) (1, 0) (1, 1)
                                Pb        1/20 9/20 9/20 1/20
                                 R            0    95     15 −10
For the policy setting both actions to one, direct substitution gives V = −10. The full trajectory
weight is twenty on path (1, 1) and zero otherwise, hence Eb [W R] = (1/20)(20)(−10) = −10.
(Causal banking proposal, 2026az)
  Using only the history-conditional last-action ratio answers another question:
                                  1{A1 = 1}
                                                  
                         Eb                    R = 12 (95) + 21 (−10) = 42.5.
                                  b1 (1 | A0 )
It retains the logger’s first-action distribution. Using the marginal last-action probability
Pb (A1 = 1) = 1/2 instead gives 2{(9/20)95 + (1/20)(−10)} = 84.5. Neither positive number
evaluates the two-action target whose value is negative. The example specifies exactly what a
static-policy comparator can and cannot replace. More observations of the same law would
estimate the wrong target more precisely. (Causal banking proposal, 2026az)
   There is also a precision cost even when the weighting is correct. Here Eb W = 1 and
Eb W 2 = 20, so the population ratio (Eb W )2 /Eb W 2 is 1/20. Only one twentieth of trajectories
follow the target path in expectation. This ratio explains a loss of information; it is not a
finite-sample coverage guarantee or a universal effective sample size. The number of logged
events alone cannot settle whether a policy comparison is precise enough for an investment
decision. (Causal banking proposal, 2026az)

32.18.3     Azure Personalizer is a historical workflow reference

The acquired Microsoft pages describe Rank requests containing available actions, action
features, context and an event identifier, followed by a Reward call. The inspected overview
uses a reward between zero and one and permits delayed feedback. It describes learning
across users and expressly says that the service does not maintain individual user histories.
These are useful workflow features, but a sequence of event-level calls is not itself a specified
customer-trajectory causal model. A monetary servicing objective also needs an explicit reward
transformation, treatment costs and horizon; a click score cannot be silently substituted for
discounted net recovery. (Microsoft, 2026a)
   The offline-evaluation pages compare the current online learning policy, the application’s
default action, a random-action policy, uploaded alternatives and policies found by optimization
discovery. They display estimated average rewards and confidence intervals, allow a policy to
be downloaded or applied, and recommend representative traffic and at least 50,000 events
as a practical starting point. The conceptual description replays chronological events with a
blank model for each learning policy and retains observed rewards when the chosen action
matches. A learning-policy configuration in this description controls a changing learner; it is
not necessarily a single fixed action rule. (Microsoft, 2026a)
   That conceptual account is insufficient to reconstruct a general estimator or its uncertainty
theorem. For an exact illustration, suppose two contexts are equally common, a target
always chooses action one, and its mean rewards are 10 and 100. Let the logger’s action-one
probabilities be 0.9 and 0.1. The target value is 55, but the mean among matching logged
actions is
                                   0.9(10) + 0.1(100)
                                                       = 19.
                                         0.9 + 0.1
Weighting by the correct context-specific assignment probabilities recovers 55 in this population.
This is a counterexample to matching alone under nonuniform logging, not a claim that
Microsoft’s actual implementation uses that incomplete estimator. The inspected pages do
not supply all the algorithmic and confidence-bound details needed to make such a runtime
claim. A successor comparison must acquire those details and verify the logging distribution,
retained-event denominator, replay updates and policy-selection rule. (Microsoft, 2026a; Causal
banking proposal, 2026az)
   Availability changes the acquisition recommendation. The official pages state that new
resources became unavailable on 20 September 2023 and that the service would retire on
25 August 2026. That retirement date precedes the proposal’s 7 October 2026 cutoff. The
pages recommend the open-source microsoft/learning-loop project. Thus Personalizer is a
historical workflow comparator rather than a proposed new hosted dependency. The named
successor needs its own pinned code, rights and estimator review; the migration link does not
establish feature or statistical parity. The pages were acquired after the cutoff and are labeled
as archived documentation, with their displayed update dates and source metadata retained.
(Microsoft, 2026a)


32.18.4     Recommendation quality, incremental value and capacity

Amazon Personalize’s inspected technical page defines train/test constructions, metrics
such as precision, recall and normalized discounted cumulative gain, and a metric named
average_rewards_at_k. The latter normalizes rewards from interactions with selected rec-
ommendations relative to rewards from interactions with recommendations. Its name does
not make it an estimate of the population intervention contrast. The page also warns against
comparing solution metrics across different training data, and provides CLI and SDK routes
32.18. Commercial policy evaluation: what an offline score permits                            609


to retrieve metrics. Those are meaningful operational capabilities to compare, while their
documented target remains distinct from a causal policy effect. This mutable page has no
independently authenticated cutoff byte identity; the source limitation is retained. (Amazon
Web Services, 2026a)
  A generated capacity example makes the distinction operational. Suppose 80% of customers
have baseline recovery probability 0.9 and a contact effect 0.02, while 20% have baseline
probability 0.1 and effect 0.2. At USD 100 per recovery and USD 5 per contact, incremental
net values are −3 and 15. Treating everyone gives only 0.8(−3) + 0.2(15) = 0.6 dollars
per customer; contacting the high-increment group gives 0.2(15) = 3. If capacity permits
contacting 10% of all customers, randomly selecting half of that group yields 1.5 dollars per
customer. Ranking by treated response probability instead favors the low-increment group,
whose response probability is 0.92 rather than 0.3, and gives 0.1(−3) = −0.3 dollars per
customer at the same capacity. (Causal banking proposal, 2026az)
   The values are stipulated, but the comparison identifies a product requirement: retain the
baseline outcome, incremental effect, cost, assignment probability and capacity separately.
JMP’s inspected uplift platform explicitly chooses partition splits to emphasize treatment
differences, using treatment-by-split interactions for continuous or categorical responses. It is
consequently a relevant targeting comparator. Its older guide’s validation and treatment-level
details are scoped to that guide; the current overview cannot establish that every edition
implements the same procedure. Stata’s prespecified policy-value target provides another
relevant comparison once the net outcome and population are aligned. Neither source licenses
an automatic inference from a fitted ranking to an independently validated policy gain. (JMP,
2025; StataCorp, 2025)


32.18.5     Selecting a policy is an additional experiment

Suppose m candidate policies all have true incremental value zero, and each evaluation has
an independent error equal to −4 or 4 with equal probability. Every individual estimate is
unbiased. Reporting the largest estimate gives
                                              
                                  E max Vbj = 4{1 − 21−m }.
                                         j≤m

The maximum is −4 only when all errors are negative and is 4 otherwise. Its expectation is
zero for one candidate, two for two candidates, and 127/32, approximately 3.969, for eight.
A fresh independent mean-zero evaluation of the selected index has expectation zero. This
exact finite example explains the role of an independent final evaluation; it is not a proposed
universal subtraction rule for a commercial optimizer. (Causal banking proposal, 2026az)
   The candidate list, training and tuning records, validation sample and final policy identity
should therefore be part of the comparison. If a product supports repeated online adaptation,
the evaluation must reproduce that adaptation under an appropriate experiment rather than
call it a frozen-policy test. The best policy among a declared finite list also differs from an
unknown optimum over all feasible strategies. The proposed reporting should state which value
is being estimated and preserve the selection uncertainty or the independence that justifies its
exclusion. (Jiang and Li, 2016; Causal banking proposal, 2026ba)


32.18.6     Influence diagrams support a different reuse decision

SMILE’s inspected manual represents controllable decisions as nodes with available states,
value nodes with utility tables, and multi-attribute utility nodes with weights or expressions. It
610                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


exposes indexing parents, including earlier decisions and chance observations relevant before a
decision. After inference, its matrices contain policy-indexed probabilities or expected utilities,
depending on node type. GeNIe supplies the associated decision framing, preference elicitation
and value-of-information workflow. These capabilities are relevant to a bank that can supply a
credible finite decision model. (BayesFusion, LLC, 2024n)
   The proposed reuse choice is a licensed supplied-model comparator. A bridge must preserve
which observations precede which actions, decision-state order, utility units, the interpretation
of indexing parents, and the distinction between evaluating a supplied policy and optimizing
within the model. Maximizing a supplied utility table cannot validate its transition probabilities
against a selectively logged bank history. Nor does the presence of hidden chance nodes identify
a partially observed causal system from arbitrary data. The inherited SMILE licensing
documentation remains relevant; public manuals do not grant embedding rights or establish
a current price. Porting the vendor engine is not the proposed route. (BayesFusion, LLC,
2024n,k)


32.18.7     What the proposed product still needs

The current common local service exposes six bounded scientific operations; its declared
operation schema and estimator dispatch do not provide a general policy-evaluation service.
Three actual local requests naming fixed-history, learned-policy validation and static-assignment
value methods returned unsupported with no result. This observation is restricted to that
service. The repository also contains separate history-evaluation and controlled-model research
modules; their existence and selected demonstrations are not equivalent to a qualified common
library/CLI/MCP policy interface. (Causal banking proposal, 2026bb)
   The concrete proposal gap is therefore larger than adding another estimator identifier. A
policy request must bind its initial population, physical and availability clocks, full history
variables, action probabilities, observation and censoring process, discounting, net-reward
map, selection/training identity and final evaluation units. Its response should distinguish a
static rule, a fixed sequence policy, an adapting learner and a supplied-model optimum. It
must retain support failures and uncertainty limits. The documented commercial workflow
features—policy comparison, model export, diagnostics and decision-model inspection—are
useful requirements for this design, while the scientific meaning is checked independently.
(Causal banking proposal, 2026ba)
   The bounded portfolio covers eleven named families. Stata and JMP support docu-
mented static alternatives; Azure supplies a retired workflow reference; Amazon supplies
a recommendation-evaluation comparator; and BayesFusion supplies model-based decision
analysis. MATLAB’s selected official routes were inaccessible. SAS reinforcement-learning
routes and HUGIN’s selected routes did not yield technical originals. The inherited SAS
survival, IBM regression, Mplus dynamic-model and Bayesia causal-model sources cannot settle
their policy-specific capabilities. These entries remain unresolved with concrete manual/version
acquisition routes. No absence of a policy capability is inferred from an unavailable page.
Exact editions, entitlements, prices and runtime behavior remain open across the prospective
commercial trials. (Causal banking proposal, 2026ba)
   An economical prototype can begin with the exact mechanisms above and the existing
open-source reference comparisons. Public data can supply realistic covariates, event clocks
and missingness patterns, while generated assignments and outcomes provide declared causal
truth. Compare one static policy, one history policy and one supplied-model decision on
matched eligible questions; retain a predictive recommendation baseline as an explicitly
different alternative. Freeze final trajectories, candidate policies, metrics, cost accounting
32.19. CausalPy at a lending threshold: what a reusable experiment must preserve             611


and stopping rules before evaluation. Native commercial execution follows only for a selected
edition with available rights. Bank experiments become relevant when the prototype identifies
a consequential logging, support, hidden-state or transport uncertainty that public/generated
evidence cannot settle. This route makes the proposal executable while leaving the unresolved
general research questions visible. (Causal banking proposal, 2026ba)


32.19      CausalPy at a lending threshold: what a reusable exper-
           iment must preserve
A credit policy often turns a continuous score into a discrete action. A borrower just above a
threshold might receive a different offer, servicing contact or review requirement. The useful
software question is therefore not simply whether a package can fit two curves. It is whether
the resulting contrast answers the bank’s intervention question, whether its uncertainty refers
to that contrast, and whether the interface preserves the design when observations, units or
models change. CausalPy offers an instructive candidate because its experiment interface can
expose a Bayesian regression or a point-estimation backend. The source revision considered
here declares version 1.0.0rc1 and is dated 6 October 2026; the earlier distribution-metadata
observation of 0.9.0 is a different artifact. The following analysis concerns the selected
sharp regression-discontinuity path, not automatic approval of its other designs.(pymc-labs
contributors, 2026)


32.19.1     The local question precedes the fitted contrast

Let X be the score available at the decision time, c the cutoff and T = 1{X ≥ c} the
stipulated sharp assignment rule. Define Y (t) as the fixed-horizon outcome under action t. If
observed outcomes obey consistency, the conditional potential-outcome means are continuous
at c, and score support approaches the cutoff from both sides, the limiting observed jump
identifies the local mean effect. To see the dependence on these assumptions explicitly, write
µt (x) = E[Y (t) | X = x]. Sharp assignment and consistency imply E[Y | X = x] = µ0 (x)
below the cutoff and µ1 (x) above it. Continuity then gives

                  τc = µ1 (c) − µ0 (c) = lim E[Y | X = x] − lim E[Y | X = x].
                                        x↓c                 x↑c

This derivation is conditional on the stipulated design. It does not establish that a real
score cannot be manipulated, that a simultaneous pricing change is absent, or that the effect
transports to all borrowers. A servicing outcome also requires a stable measurement horizon
and a declared treatment of censoring. Those are parts of the question, not properties acquired
by importing a regression class.(Causal banking proposal, 2026d,c)
   The inspected CausalPy experiment builds design matrices and later obtains predictions at
two rows: (c − ϵ, T = 0) and (c + ϵ, T = 1). Its result subtracts the first prediction from the
second. The default separation is ϵ = 0.001 in the running variable’s units. Consequently the
returned quantity is a finite-separation model contrast,

                                ∆ϵ = m(c + ϵ, 1) − m(c − ϵ, 0),

which approaches a model’s threshold jump only under the relevant limiting behavior. The
implementation’s name does not make a finite separation identical to that limit. The inspected
treatment rule assumes treatment above the cutoff; the selected validation method requires a
dummy-coded treated column but does not itself demonstrate that every observed treatment
matches this rule. An eligibility cutoff with imperfect take-up is a different design. Relabeling
612                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


actual receipt as deterministic eligibility would hide the first-stage question. (pymc-labs
contributors, 2026)
  Consider the exact, stipulated conditional mean with the score centered at zero,

                               m(x, t) = 100 + 20x + 5t + 10xt.

Its threshold jump is 5. At ϵ = 1/1000, however, ∆ϵ = 5 + (2 · 20 + 10)/1000 = 5.05. More
generally, for m(x, t) = α + βx + τ t + γxt centered at the cutoff, the difference is (2β + γ)ϵ.
This is an exact contrast identity, not an observed software bias estimate or an assertion about
a fitted sample. Shrinking the separation reduces this particular deterministic difference but
does not repair a misspecified regression, weak support or an invalid design. (Causal banking
proposal, 2026d)
   Units make the distinction operational. Expressing the same score as Z = 100X changes the
coefficients to 0.2 and 0.1 for the score and its interaction. Keeping the numeric separation at
0.001 now produces 5.0005; preserving the physical separation requires ϵZ = 0.1, which restores
5.05. The cutoff, bandwidth and donut exclusion must also transform. A unit conversion
that leaves all numeric tuning inputs untouched therefore changes the question asked of an
otherwise equivalent model. A proposed adapter should return the two physical prediction
locations and their units alongside the contrast. (Causal banking proposal, 2026d,c)


32.19.2    What fit quality cannot resolve

The need for a design restriction can be demonstrated without simulated noise. In world A let
Y (t) = 100 + 20X + 5t; in world B let Y (t) = 100 + 20X + 51{X ≥ 0} for both treatment
values. Retain T = 1{X ≥ 0} in each world. Both worlds have exactly the same observed
outcome function, including the jump of 5, but their treatment effects are respectively 5 and
0. World B violates the continuity restriction. No estimator that sees only this observed
law can use fit quality to decide which counterfactual extension is true. For an illustrative
outcome measured in dollars and an action cost of USD 3 per borrower near the cutoff, the
stipulated net effect is USD 2 in world A and minus USD 3 in world B. These are alternative
local mechanisms, not a bank-wide return estimate.(Causal banking proposal, 2026d)
  This ambiguity suggests a useful public-data prototype. Generate known mechanisms with
and without baseline discontinuities, retain the same observed law where possible, and require
the workflow to state which assumption separates them. Public lending or policy datasets can
exercise data preparation and diagnostics, but their public availability alone does not reveal
the missing counterfactual truth. Density or covariate checks can contribute design evidence;
neither should be represented as a proof of every identifying restriction. The evaluation
should score appropriate qualification and refusal as well as numerical recovery. The proposed
prototype can therefore demonstrate whether the interface preserves the question before an
expensive institution-specific study is justified. (Causal banking proposal, 2026c)


32.19.3    Uncertainty is a semantic type, not an array dimension

The inspected Bayesian linear model places Normal priors with scale 50 on coefficients and uses
a Normal likelihood whose noise scale has a HalfNormal prior with scale 1. Its deterministic
mean is the design matrix times the coefficient vector. The experiment adapter extracts
these expected-outcome means; the response-predictive variable has a different interpretation.
The selected RD plotting path uses equal-tail posterior quantiles. Such quantiles condition
on the model and prior: they are not automatically highest-density intervals, robust bias-
corrected frequentist intervals, or uncertainty about the truth of the causal design. The
32.19. CausalPy at a lending threshold: what a reusable experiment must preserve             613


sampling path merges stored settings and call-time overrides before invoking the sampler. A
reproducible request consequently needs the actual runtime and sampler configuration, not
just the experiment class name. (pymc-labs contributors, 2026)
   A point-estimation backend introduces a subtler conversion hazard. Its adapter places point
predictions into arrays with singleton chain and draw dimensions. Those dimensions provide
a common representation; they do not manufacture posterior variation. An interval routine
applied mechanically to a singleton would return equal endpoints, but that degeneracy is not
evidence of statistical certainty. The proposed result contract must distinguish a point estimate
from posterior expected outcomes, response-predictive draws and prior draws. Requests for
unsupported uncertainty should return an explicit unavailable result, never a zero-width
confidence claim.(pymc-labs contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal, 2026c)
   Prior scales must follow units as well. In the coordinate change Z = 100X, a coefficient
distributed as Normal with scale 50 in the old score units has scale 0.5 in the new units if
the prior is to describe the same model. Resetting both to the same default numeric scale
changes prior beliefs. Outcome transformations likewise affect coefficient and noise priors.
These observations do not condemn the default model: they explain why a reusable banking
operation must record and review its units, likelihood and prior rather than silently rebuilding
them. (pymc-labs contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal, 2026d)


32.19.4     Support, lifecycle and the choice of an alternative

The selected implementation filters a symmetric bandwidth and optionally removes a donut
around the threshold. At ten or fewer retained observations it warns; the warning is not a
scientifically sufficient qualification rule. A positive donut leaves no observations arbitrarily
close to the cutoff in that selected sample, so threshold predictions rely on the model’s
extrapolation across the excluded region. The default infinite bandwidth also does not
constitute a data-driven local bandwidth choice. A bank wrapper needs left and right support,
row-selection records and an explicit extrapolation flag alongside fitted output. It should
separately check invalid tuning inputs and reversed treatment coding. These are proposed
boundary obligations; the selected source has not been run against those cases here.(pymc-labs
contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal, 2026c)
   Lifecycle is equally consequential for an agent or a long-running service. The source warns
that its frozen design fingerprint does not detect later edits to the experiment’s data and
recommends constructing a new experiment for changed data. Assigning a fresh model resets
result state. Therefore a request should bind an immutable data identity and a formula/design
identity, create a fresh experiment when either changes, and keep configured, built and
fitted states distinguishable. The selected test sources cover RD smoke paths, treatment
normalization and donut masks. Reading those tests is evidence of intended cases, not evidence
that this proposal executed them or obtained calibrated RD intervals. (pymc-labs contributors,
2026)
   For a different uncertainty objective, the inspected R documentation for rdrobust describes
local-polynomial estimators and robust bias-corrected confidence intervals, with separate fitting
and bias bandwidths, polynomial orders, kernels and sharp/fuzzy/kink options. This supplies
a concrete comparison to a Bayesian model contrast. The choice depends on the design, target
and uncertainty statement; the packages should not be interchanged by a generic causal-effect
endpoint. The R source snapshot used for this comparison precedes the stated literature
cutoff. Documentation of an algorithm is not a qualification result for the bank’s sampling
law.(rdrobust contributors, 2026)
614                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


32.19.5     A scoped reuse decision and the work it creates

The proposal retains CausalPy as a pinned reference and a candidate for a narrow future
integration. Direct production adoption is deferred until the conversion and failure contract
has been implemented and exercised. Porting the model or sampler is not presently justified:
it transfers numerical and maintenance ownership without an established benefit. Rejecting
the entire package is also unsupported by this review. Its root source license is Apache 2.0, its
packaging requires Python 3.12 or later, and its declared direct dependencies include broad
PyMC and PyTensor major-version ranges. These declarations establish neither a resolved
environment nor complete dependency rights. The pinned pre-release version and dated activity
are observable facts; they are not promises of future support.(pymc-labs contributors, 2026;
Causal banking proposal, 2026c)
   The next prototype should exercise cutoff equality, direction reversals, physical unit transfor-
mations, bandwidth and donut masks, changed-data reconstruction, point/posterior/predictive
distinctions and failure retention. A scientific owner must specify the local estimand, continuity
restrictions and the uncertainty claim. An integration owner must preserve data, formula
and prediction identities. A runtime owner must resolve dependencies, retain notices, fix
sampler settings and define diagnostic failures. An evaluation owner must predeclare generated
mechanisms, public-data uses and appropriate recovery and refusal criteria. DiD, synthetic
control, IV and longitudinal uses remain separate design decisions. (Causal banking proposal,
2026c)
   Costs should include environment resolution, model and prior review, sampling time,
failed fits, diagnostic inspection, conversion maintenance and comparison against a simpler
alternative. These costs can be measured on public or generated cases before committing to
bank experiments. The immediate deliverable is a reviewable product choice with an explicit
path to a prototype. Integration remains disabled until executed upstream behavior supports
the proposed contract; the exact examples in this section establish mathematical distinctions,
not a working external adapter.(Causal banking proposal, 2026c)
Chapter 33

Functional discovery, symbolic
identification and estimating
equations

33.1      An operation is defined by its mathematical output
A bank may ask a single software team to discover a graph, identify an effect and estimate
the value of an offer. Those requests have different outputs. Discovery can return a selected
directed graph, an equivalence class or a set of candidates. Identification can return an
expression in the observed law or a nonidentification result. Estimation can return a number
with a sampling uncertainty claim. A shared product becomes misleading when it places all
three behind a field named “causal effect” without preserving these types.
  Consider a renewal offer A, retained balance Y and customer characteristics X available
before the offer. A point-treatment question might be

                                       θ = E{Y (1) − Y (0)}.

Here the expectation is over a declared eligible population, not automatically over the customers
who accepted an offer. A discovery algorithm can help propose relationships among X, A, Y ,
but a graph proposal does not by itself establish that Y (a) is identified. Even after identification,
numerical uncertainty depends on how customers were sampled and whether branch, household
or calendar dependence matters. Software comparison must preserve each stage.
   The selected source paths considered here make these differences concrete. DirectLiNGAM
exposes a functional discovery construction; y0 exposes symbolic identification; delicatessen
exposes estimating equations; and statsmodels exposes fitted treatment-effect operations with a
joint GMM representation. These are useful components of a workflow, with different scientific
contracts. The source inspections establish the specific interfaces and branches described below.
They do not establish execution speed, numerical agreement or empirical coverage for this
bank.LiNGAM project (2026b); y0 project (2026b); delicatessen project (2026b); statsmodels
project (2026b)
