37.6     Implications for reusable causal operations
These examples support a common semantic contract with explicit graph orientation, query/-
failure type, independent observational unit, decision clock, target population, dose units
and uncertainty construction. A business-facing assistant can elicit these fields and explain
unresolved choices, while a deterministic validator checks the declared operation against its
supported combinations. An LLM’s plausible description is not evidence that a package uses
the intended covariance or intervention target.
   The relevant next qualification compares complete causal requests. It retains the same
estimand and information across packages, separates sampling from Monte Carlo error, includes
failed fits and preserves unbounded sets. Numerical agreement in a benign case is useful
evidence about implementation, but cannot establish assignment truth, identification or useful
precision in adverse banking regimes. Those remain scientific and institutional requirements.
Chapter 38

Catalog context for causal
observations

A bank considering a new servicing policy first needs to locate the histories that describe
eligibility, actions, cash flows and observation. An enterprise catalog can identify datasets,
owners, schema fields and transformations that would otherwise have to be rediscovered. The
causal proposal should reuse that work. It must also preserve the distinction between a record
about a dataset and evidence about the decision made for a particular customer.
    DataHub is a concrete candidate for this boundary. Its open repository contains typed
dataset and field identities, ownership and lineage aspects, a Python client and metadata
ingestion tooling. The inspected revision, dated 7 October 2026, pins sixteen selected original
files. The Python distribution is named acryl-datahub; its version is dynamically supplied, so
the source revision does not establish the identity of an installed distribution. The README
separately describes OSS and Cloud. The referenced MCP server and Cloud SDK require their
own package, rights and behavior review. No service, SDK, connector or MCP server was
executed for the comparison below. (datahub-project contributors, 2026a,b)


38.1     The metadata graph has a useful, specific meaning
The dataset constructor takes a platform, dataset name, platform instance and environment,
then delegates the construction of its URN. Field identity adds a field path to a dataset
identity. An exporter should preserve those opaque identities and their versions. The display
name balance is insufficient: three stipulated fields in production/east, development/east
and production/west are distinct even when their dataset and leaf field names agree. An
exact identity example has three complete tuples but only one leaf name. Merging them
changes which population and source produced an observation; a downstream estimator cannot
reconstruct the lost distinction. (datahub-project contributors, 2026a; Causal banking proposal,
2026bf)
   The UpstreamLineage aspect represents upstream datasets and optional fine-grained field re-
lationships. FineGrainedLineage can retain transformation text and a query reference. These
fields help explain how a derived value was computed. The type also has a confidenceScore
whose default is one. The inspected definition calls it confidence in lineage; it supplies no
calibrated probability that a corresponding causal arrow is true. Its optional matching status
describes the resolution of a URN against the catalog at ingestion time, and the comments
explicitly say that this status is not re-evaluated later. A later exporter must preserve the
distinction between exact, normalized, unresolved and unassessed references. (datahub-project

                                              639
640                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


contributors, 2026a)
   This distinction matters when an agent helps construct a diagram. A pipeline may transform
a contact table and a recovery table into an analysis table. That lineage supports a provenance
statement. It does not establish that contact caused recovery, that contact assignment was
unconfounded, or that every predictor was available before contact. A description or glossary
term can suggest a variable interpretation, but the proposal should retain its source, owner and
unresolved alternatives until the causal interpretation has separate support. The agent may
propose a mapping; it must not promote a lineage-confidence default into scientific certainty.
(datahub-project contributors, 2026a; Causal banking proposal, 2026be)


38.2     Identical catalog context can support different interven-
         tions
An exact generated example makes the missing information visible. Let A be a binary offer
and Y a binary recovery. In a first world, A is a fair random draw and

                              Y = A ⊕ E,        P (E = 1) = 1/4,

where ⊕ denotes exclusive-or and E is independent of assignment. In a second world, an
unobserved fair borrower state U determines assignment, A = U , and Y = U ⊕ E; changing
the offer leaves the recovery mechanism unchanged. Both worlds give the strictly positive
observed table
                                         Y =0 Y =1
                                  A=0     3/8     1/8
                                  A=1     1/8     3/8
and can use the same two source tables, field descriptions and transformation lineage. Direct
enumeration gives

              E[Y | do(A = 1)] − E[Y | do(A = 0)] = 1/2 in the first world,
                                                    =0      in the second world.

The observed conditional difference is 1/2 in both. At a stipulated USD 100 per recovery and
USD 30 per offer, the incremental net values are USD 20 and USD −30. The opposing decisions
arise with identical observed tables and catalog structure. This is an authored information
example, not a bank effect estimate or a failure observed in DataHub. More catalog entries
cannot alone choose the assignment mechanism. (Causal banking proposal, 2026bf)
   Useful catalog integration therefore retains the evidence for an assignment claim alongside
the variable mapping. For a randomized campaign, that may eventually include the actual
allocation record and deviations. For an observational proposal, it may be a declared adjustment
argument with competing graphs and sensitivity analyses. An empty assignment-evidence
field remains unknown. It cannot be filled by a well-connected asset graph. (Causal banking
proposal, 2026be)


38.3     Separate the clocks before constructing a historical feature
The inspected audit-stamp type records when a resource or association entered a lifecycle
stage and who acted. An upstream lineage stamp records who reported that lineage and when.
Ownership has an audit stamp whose zero time explicitly denotes missing data. Schema-field
creation and modification stamps likewise describe metadata objects. None of these definitions,
38.4. A bounded export must preserve incompleteness                                           641


by itself, states when a particular customer-level value first became available to a servicing
decision. (datahub-project contributors, 2026a)
   Let t be the action time, ej a feature’s event time, aj the time its value became available,
and mj the time the catalog observed its metadata. A proposed historical input contract
requires aj ≤ t for a feature used by the policy, together with evidence for the relevant version.
The inequality ej ≤ t is insufficient when an event is recorded or revised later. Similarly,
mj > t need not invalidate a retrospectively acquired description of an older value; it means
that the exporter needs an additional historical availability argument. The clocks have different
meanings. (Causal banking proposal, 2026be)
   For a generated example, take an independent fair baseline B and recovery Y at day 30.
The baseline is available on day −1. A derived field Z = Y is labeled with an origination
event on day zero but becomes available only on day 31. Both fields have schema creation
time −60 and their catalog snapshot is acquired on day 40. Enumerating the four equally
likely (B, Y ) pairs gives classification agreement P (B = Y ) = 1/2 and P (Z = Y ) = 1. The
latter is perfect retrospective leakage. At a day-zero action, the availability rule admits only
B; filtering solely by event time also admits Z. A third field with unknown availability stays
unresolved even if its event time is old. These exact agreements describe stipulated variables,
not a fitted prediction benchmark. (Causal banking proposal, 2026bf)
   DataHub’s inspected get_aspect method supports an explicit version, with version zero
documented as latest. A latest schema can be useful for discovery, but it is not automatically
the schema used by a historical policy. The proposed export should bind the requested
aspect version, returned bytes, source-data version and clock evidence. A sequence of reads
is not declared an atomic catalog snapshot merely because every request succeeds. Version
consistency and concurrent changes belong in the prototype acceptance cases. (datahub-project
contributors, 2026a; Causal banking proposal, 2026be)


38.4     A bounded export must preserve incompleteness
The selected aspect reader distinguishes a missing aspect, which yields None for HTTP 404,
from other HTTP failures and from a malformed response lacking the expected aspect. It
also rejects a time-series aspect on this particular path. An adapter should retain these
distinctions. Missing metadata is not evidence that an asset has no owner, that a covariate
has no confounders, or that the underlying data were complete. An authorization or transport
failure must not become an empty successful causal context. (datahub-project contributors,
2026a)
   Lineage traversal has two further source-level details. The inspected client maps requested
hop counts above two to the categories one, two and “3+”. That is not a strict three-edge
radius: a generated chain with distances one through four retains distance four under the
“3+” category, whereas a literal three-hop contract would exclude it. The method’s count
argument is passed to a scrolling query, and the implementation accumulates results while
a continuation cursor is returned. Two generated pages of 500 and one records therefore
produce 501 accumulated records. The per-query count is not a proved whole-export bound.
These are static interpretations of the saved code, not observations from a running server.
(datahub-project contributors, 2026a; Causal banking proposal, 2026bf)
   A proposed export wrapper should make its own request, result, byte and elapsed time
limits explicit. It should track cursors, preserve each returned page, and mark exhaustion,
repetition or inconsistency as partial or failed retrieval. In the authored cursor example, seeing
the same nonempty cursor twice produces a repeated-cursor disposition after two requests,
642                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


with completeness false. No live failure is alleged. The example specifies what a bounded
wrapper must do if that response sequence occurs. A partial graph cannot support the claim
that all relevant upstream sources have been found. (Causal banking proposal, 2026bf,be)
   Lifecycle and projection also affect completeness. The inspected status model separates
the legacy removal flag from a lifecycle stage whose search visibility may differ; its comments
warn that these are not automatically synchronized. The lineage-result conversion retains
schema-field path entries while omitting other path-node types, such as queries. A causal
provenance export should therefore retain raw aspect/query evidence and lifecycle context, in
addition to a convenient summarized path. It should not silently infer a missing transformation
from the projected result. (datahub-project contributors, 2026a)


38.5      A reuse choice with a concrete prototype
The present choice is to retain DataHub as a pinned technical reference and a candidate for
conditional integration with an existing catalog. Adopting the entire platform as a required
causal engine would add a deployment and maintenance dependency before the narrow use
has been justified. Porting its catalog or client into the causal core would create another
implementation to keep compatible. A small export boundary, with a manually prepared
public metadata fixture as the initial comparator, is a more testable proposal. Other catalog
families remain separate candidates; their names do not supply equivalent APIs, rights or
clock semantics. (Causal banking proposal, 2026be)
   The root source license is Apache 2.0 and the repository has a substantial NOTICE file.
The inspected redistribution conditions address license copies, modification notices, attribution
and applicable NOTICE content. The Python project declares Python 3.10 or newer and
numerous dependencies, including version ranges; its dependency file says it is generated from
another source of truth. This review does not establish a complete resolved distribution,
dependency-license inventory or equivalence to that generating file. The source revision and a
recent commit show observed maintenance activity, not a support commitment or compatibility
with a future bank’s server. (datahub-project contributors, 2026b)
    The prototype should first consume a frozen, project-authored export containing opaque
entity and field identities, aspect versions, raw hashes, acquisition time, lineage evidence,
lifecycle state, unknown fields and separate feature availability declarations. It should reproduce
the four exact example families, retain the five explicit missing-context cases, and refuse to
emit causal arrows solely from catalog lineage. A later source-matched SDK fixture must check
actual serialization, pagination, schema changes, deletion visibility and failure behavior before
the proposed adapter receives integration permission. No such permission is granted by the
present reference decision. (Causal banking proposal, 2026be)
   An agent using the library, CLI or MCP interface should receive the same bounded context
object and evidence links. Read operations and proposed metadata changes should have
separate interfaces: the inspected SDK contains both query and mutation methods, including
automatic column matching. A discovery request should not invoke a lineage mutation as a side
effect of trying to understand the data. Descriptions remain source material, not instructions
to change the analysis or credentials. This is a proposed consumer contract; it does not claim
that an existing MCP integration implements it. (datahub-project contributors, 2026a; Causal
banking proposal, 2026be)
   The catalog owner would eventually supply the permitted scope, access route and relevant
historical evidence. The prototype maintainer owns source/version matching, conversion
and bounded failure handling; a scientific reviewer owns the assignment and measurement
38.6. Analytical preparation must preserve the population and its information clock          643


claims. The economic comparison includes manual mapping time, maintenance, infrastructure,
entitlement, semantic review and incident investigation. A public fixture can establish whether
the proposed boundary prevents identifiable errors before any bank connection is sought.
It cannot establish actual owner truth, causal identification or bank return on investment.
(Causal banking proposal, 2026be)


38.6      Analytical preparation must preserve the population and
          its information clock
A servicing analyst may ask whether an additional contact improves recovery, then construct
the analysis table by joining account records, contact events and repayment observations. The
resulting query can execute successfully while changing the population, discarding unobserved
outcomes or incorporating information that did not exist when contact was chosen. The
database is therefore part of the causal workflow’s measurement boundary. Its useful product
role is to make a declared preparation repeatable and inspectable; query success cannot
establish the causal premises of the subsequent analysis.
   DuckDB is a concrete candidate for local analytical preparation. The selected historical
source is version 1.4.0, released on 16 September 2025, at commit b8a06e4a2267. This choice
fixes a reproducible object for discussion; it is not a claim about the newest release, present
support or any installed binary. The inspected C++ interface distinguishes a materialized
Query call from streaming and pending paths. Result objects expose column information,
errors and potentially chained results, while fetching a materialized result consumes its
contents. These interfaces suggest a narrow first integration: a typed request produces one
bounded, completed table and an explicit completion status. They do not justify treating
every query handle, first batch or returned row as a completed analysis. The Python client is
a separate wrapper boundary whose conversions and installed dependencies require their own
inspection.(DuckDB contributors, 2025)


38.6.1    A missing outcome is not an observed failure

Consider an authored six-account example with three contacted and three uncontacted accounts.
The contacted outcomes are (1, missing, missing) and the uncontacted outcomes are (1, 0, 0),
where one means recovery. These are stipulated binary observations, without a randomization,
exchangeability or missingness assumption. The contrast among observed outcomes is
                                                         1  2
                                      dbobserved = 1 −     = .                             (38.1)
                                                         3  3
If the two missing contacted outcomes are denoted u, v ∈ {0, 1}, the full six-account descriptive
contrast instead satisfies
                                     1+u+v 1  u+v     1 2
                                                                      
                         d(u, v) =        − =     ∈ 0, ,  .                                (38.2)
                                       3   3   3      3 3
Both endpoints are attainable, so [0, 2/3] is the sharp endpoint range for this stipulated finite
completion problem. The feasible set has three values; it is not every real number in that
interval. Neither the complete-case contrast nor the completion set is a causal effect without
additional assignment and observation assumptions. Exact rational enumeration reproduces
all four binary completions.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026ab)
  The economic consequence of the transformation is visible before any bank experiment.
Suppose solely for illustration that a unit change in this descriptive contrast is valued at USD
644                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


300 and an additional contact policy costs USD 40 per case. The resulting arithmetic is

                  V (u, v) = 300d(u, v) − 40 ∈ {−40, 60, 160}     USD per case.              (38.3)

Using only observed outcomes produces the optimistic plug-in value USD 160; the declared
completion problem also permits minus USD 40. This is an illustration of how an unacknowl-
edged denominator choice can reverse an economic recommendation, not evidence of treatment
value or bank ROI. A missingness model, additional observations or a deliberately restricted
target population would change the problem and must be stated before interpretation. (Causal
banking proposal project, 2026ab)
   The selected upstream aggregate tests reinforce why the interface must retain these distinc-
tions. On an empty input, the tests expect zero counts but NULL for sums, averages and
several other aggregates; grouped all-null values also produce NULL aggregates. Those are
inspected upstream expectations, not native test results obtained here. A zero-row relation,
two rows with no observed outcome, and two observed zeros therefore require different records.
The proposed record carries total rows, observed outcomes and nullable summaries; it never
silently replaces a missing mean with zero. NaN, overflow and invalid type conversions need
additional explicit cases rather than being folded into the SQL NULL convention.(DuckDB
contributors, 2025; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ab)


38.6.2    Joins and clocks define the observation being analyzed

For a second exact example, let two contacted accounts have observed amounts USD 100
and USD 0, and two uncontacted accounts both have USD 0. The account-level descriptive
difference is USD 50. Suppose a one-to-many contact join duplicates the positive contacted
account three times while leaving each other account once. The joined table has six rows and a
contacted mean of USD 75. No account outcome changed: the join changed the weights. The
input and output keys, expected join cardinality and analytical unit must therefore be part of
the preparation request. A deliberate contact-event target is possible, but it is a different target
and does not turn six joined rows into six independent accounts.(Causal banking proposal
project, 2026ab)
   Time ordering creates a separate problem. In the authored reference, an account has a
feature with value zero on day one, an action on day two and a feature with value one on
day three. Selecting the latest unrestricted record returns the postaction value; selecting
the latest strictly preaction record returns zero. A production definition must additionally
distinguish event time from availability time: a backdated event received after the decision
was not necessarily available to the decision maker. The proposed table carries both clocks,
the action cutoff, time-zone interpretation and an explicit tie-break for events with equal
timestamps. This clock discipline is an authored requirement; the small reference does not
validate a bank’s record history.
   Row position is an unsuitable replacement for those keys. The selected tests make null
ordering configurable, and an insertion-order test explicitly disclaims which tuples an unordered
limit selects when insertion-order preservation is disabled. A reproducible export consequently
specifies a total order with unique tie-breaks and a declared NULL convention. All 24
permutations of the four-account reference return the same rows after sorting by its unique
account key. That exact property belongs to the reference construction; native parallel
execution, collations and timestamp conversions remain future conformance cases.(DuckDB
contributors, 2025; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ab)
38.6. Analytical preparation must preserve the population and its information clock         645


38.6.3    Local execution needs explicit permissions and completion

The selected source initially enables external access. When external access is disabled on
a running instance, its setting handler adds already attached database and write-ahead-log
paths to allowed paths and permits a configured temporary directory. Selected storage and
attachment tests continue to permit writes or checkpoints to attached databases after this
setting is disabled. It is therefore neither a read-only guarantee nor an operating-system
sandbox. The proposed worker needs independently defined filesystem permissions, reviewed
attachments and scratch storage, even when that database option is false. Its input copies
must be immutable under the declared execution policy. (DuckDB contributors, 2025)
   Extension behavior is also a build and runtime question. The selected CMake options
default automatic installation and loading to false, but compile-time definitions can change the
configuration defaults. The base extension configuration includes core functions and Parquet,
and conditionally includes jemalloc under its platform rules. Inspecting those declarations
does not prove the configuration of a wheel, executable or embedded library. For the initial
proposal profile, automatic extension installation and loading should be disabled and any
required artifact explicitly selected and bound. An agent may propose a typed preparation
request; it should not acquire unrestricted SQL and installation authority as a side effect. The
inspected autoload helper catches exceptions and can return false. Such a dependency failure
is not evidence that an intervention is unidentified or that an estimated effect is zero.(DuckDB
contributors, 2025)
   Transactions do not remove the need for those boundaries. The C++ begin, commit and
rollback wrappers inspect errors and throw them; a selected upstream test expects a conflict
for overlapping updates. These observations support explicit transaction-error handling but do
not prove a complete isolation regime or an immutable snapshot of files outside the database.
The preparation manifest binds input bytes separately from the transaction identifier and
records whether an output is complete. A timeout, cancellation, incomplete stream or later
error invalidates a claim of completed output. Materialization simplifies the initial completion
boundary while increasing memory exposure; row and byte limits, disk use and cancellation
costs must be measured on the selected prototype rather than assumed from the interface
name. (DuckDB contributors, 2025)


38.6.4    Reuse the original engine under a bounded proposal contract

The preferred proposal route retains the original engine behind that typed preparation boundary.
A port would reproduce SQL, optimization, storage and conversion obligations without a
demonstrated platform need. The selected historical build declares C++11, twelve direct non-
amalgamation third-party subdirectories, additional conditional test directories and extension
inputs. The root MIT notice is not the complete distribution inventory. The inspected RE2
and Zstd notices are BSD-style, utf8proc carries MIT and Unicode data notices, and MbedTLS
declares Apache-2.0 or GPL-2.0-or-later alternatives. These four inspected third-party notices
illustrate scope differences; they do not clear every dependency, wrapper, extension or actual
distribution arrangement. (DuckDB contributors, 2025)
   A transparent explicit-file implementation remains the small-case reference. SQLite is a
separate SQL/storage candidate; dataframe and columnar libraries are separate preparation
candidates. Each alternative requires its own type, join, missingness, ordering and resource
review. The choice among them should follow the declared workload and measured end-to-end
costs, including frozen inputs, conversions, failed requests, maintenance and retained evidence.
No unmeasured speed, feature parity or maintenance advantage is assumed here.
646                                                                 Causal analysis for a universal bank


   The proposal choice is consequently concrete while executable admission is deferred. Before
admitting the selected engine/client path, a prototype must bind its complete distribution
and notices, exercise native empty/all-missing/ zero cases, duplicate joins, information cutoffs,
total ordering and precision, and compare errors, cancellations, external-file changes and
extension behavior with the typed contract. The analyst owns the scientific population and
causal assumptions; the adapter maintainer owns conversion, execution and resource behavior;
the distribution owner reviews the actual retained software and notices. None of these public
or synthetic prototype steps requires bank data. Institution-specific assignment, audit truth
and economic value remain distinct later questions. The database prepares the evidence; it
does not certify the causal meaning of that evidence.


38.6.5    Feast: reconstructing the information available to a banking decision

Consider a credit team replaying yesterday’s offer decisions. A transaction can have an early
business date, a later correction date and a still later arrival in the system used by the offer
engine. Joining on the business date alone does not reproduce the information on which the
original offer could depend. Feast is a concrete candidate for organizing feature definitions
and retrieving historical and online features, but its usefulness for this proposal depends on
a precise observation contract. The selected original revision is commit 9d42729d471a of
7 October 2026. Its historical API already provides an optional creation-time cutoff; the
appropriate comparison must acknowledge that capability and investigate its meaning for each
provider.(Feast contributors, 2026)
    For a feature version j associated with customer i, let eij be its event time, cij its source
creation time and aij the first time that the version, with the required transformations, was
usable by the decision system. Let ti denote the decision time and ℓ > 0 a declared feature
lifetime. The proposed admissible set is

                          Ji (ti , ℓ) = {j : ti − ℓ ≤ eij ≤ ti ,   aij ≤ ti }.                   (38.4)

All times use a declared timezone and ordering convention. If feature arrival and action
share a coarse timestamp, an additional sequence number or conservative ordering is needed
to establish which occurred first. The inclusive inequalities in (38.4) are meaningful only
after that convention is fixed. The latest admissible event and revision may then be selected,
provided that the revision order is well defined. A source row with an unknown availability
time does not establish membership in this set. Conflicting values with the same event and
revision coordinates require an explicit conflict result or a separately justified source ordering.
   The distinction is statistical as well as operational. If Fti is the information available
to the decision maker, a deployable rule must be measurable with respect to Fti , with any
independent policy randomization stated separately. A retrospectively corrected covariate can
belong to a larger information set. Its association with a later outcome may be useful for
another scientific question, but it cannot silently replace a predecision predictor, confounder
or effect modifier. Nor does successful retrieval establish exchangeability, positivity, a causal
graph or calibrated uncertainty. Those obligations remain with the analysis that consumes the
retrieved table.


What the selected API and providers actually specify. The historical API returns
a retrieval job and defaults filter_by_created_timestamp to false. With the flag enabled,
the requested additional condition is cij ≤ ti for views that declare a creation-timestamp
column; views without that column are unaffected. The selected passthrough provider checks
the offline store’s declared support, and the base store raises an unsupported-operation error
38.6. Analytical preparation must preserve the population and its information clock             647


when support is absent. It would therefore be inaccurate to say that Feast necessarily ignores
creation time. It would also be inaccurate to equate that field with aij without evidence about
ingestion delays, transformations and the actual serving path.(Feast contributors, 2026)
   The selected Dask implementation applies the event-time and lifetime filters, then the
optional creation cutoff, then duplicate handling. For late or unknown creation times it blanks
feature-side fields while retaining the entity-side fields. The accompanying source tests specify
the difference between a later-created value of 0.6 and an earlier value of 0.4, exclusion of
null creation times, retention of an entity whose candidates are all late, and separation of
different entities. These are informative upstream test specifications; they are not native test
results obtained by this proposal. The implementation treats a zero or unspecified lifetime
as absence of a finite lower event-time bound. The proposal must therefore distinguish an
explicitly unbounded history from a positive duration, rather than converting zero into an
instantaneous window.(Feast contributors, 2026)
   The selected BigQuery template applies event-time conditions and, when requested and
configured, the creation cutoff before choosing the latest event and creation timestamps. Its
final join back to feature records uses those timestamps and the entity-row identifier. If
different records share the chosen coordinates, the proposal cannot infer unique output merely
from the earlier ranking expression. A source uniqueness condition or a qualified revision
key is necessary. The Dask path also needs native checks for equal timestamps and duplicate
decision rows, since sorting and duplicate removal do not by themselves establish the required
population contract. This is a specific conformance question, not a claim that a defect has
been reproduced in an installed provider.(Feast contributors, 2026)

An exact decision example with two kinds of late information. Consider the following
authored finite law, chosen to make the information constraint explicit. An applicant has
an unobserved type T ∈ {g, b} with equal probabilities. Conditional on action, the potential
success indicator Y (1) has probabilities
                                          4                                1
                   P {Y (1) = 1 | T = g} = ,        P {Y (1) = 1 | T = b} = .                (38.5)
                                          5                                5
The joint probabilities for (g, 1), (g, 0), (b, 1), (b, 0) are respectively 2/5, 1/10, 1/10, 2/5. At
decision hour 10, both alternative worlds have the same observed customer key and the same
available score 1/2; the type label used to describe the generating law is not an input to the
decision. A successful action has stipulated payoff USD 100, every action costs USD 50, and
no action has value zero. The action value in each type is consequently
                               4                           1
                       vg = 100 − 50 = 30,         vb = 100 − 50 = −30.                      (38.6)
                               5                           5
These amounts are assumptions of the illustration, not observed bank prices or estimates from
Feast.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026af)
   The original score has event hour 6, creation hour 7 and availability hour 7. A correction
reveals the type-specific score, retains event hour 6, and has creation and availability hour 11.
With a four-hour lifetime, the original lies exactly on the admissible lower event-time boundary.
An event-only retrieval can select the correction despite its later creation; creation filtering
selects the original. In a second history, add a record with event hour 9 and creation hour
9 that reveals the same type-specific score but is not delivered to the decision system until
hour 12. Now both event-only and creation-filtered retrieval select that unavailable record. An
actual-availability predicate still selects the original. No timestamp flag can compensate for
a field whose meaning is different from the required clock.(Causal banking proposal project,
2026af)
648                                                               Causal analysis for a universal bank


  Let the proposed action rule take action precisely when its retrieved score exceeds 1/2. The
exact comparison is

      History                               Event only Creation cutoff Availability cutoff
      Correction created after decision        USD 15                USD 0                USD 0
      Additional delivery delay                USD 15               USD 15                USD 0

The USD 15 entries equal P (T = g)vg = (1/2)30: they evaluate a rule that knows the type
and acts only for g. That rule is unavailable at decision hour 10. Every feasible rule in this
example has the same action probability r in both worlds, because its available inputs and
independent randomization reveal no type. Hence
                                                                1     1
                                                                        
                      E{net value of a feasible rule} = r         vg + vb = 0.                 (38.7)
                                                                2     2
The apparent improvement is thus an information advantage that cannot be implemented at
the declared clock. This derivation does not estimate an upstream software error or prove
a general monetary loss from delayed data. It supplies a reproducible reason to include
availability checks in a public-data prototype before funding bank experiments.(Causal banking
proposal project, 2026af)
   The reference evaluates the entire four-state law with rational arithmetic and checks
invariance to source-row permutations. Its boundary cases separate the lifetime endpoint,
an earlier expired record, a future event, all-late candidates, unknown clocks, observed nulls,
observed zero and conflicting equal-timestamp values. In an actual cohort, the adapter must
also preserve one result per request identifier. Dropping an applicant because all features arrive
late changes the evaluated population; treating the missing value as zero changes its meaning.
Feature unavailability can itself depend on customer behavior or servicing workload, so the
analysis must address the resulting selection mechanism explicitly.(Causal banking proposal
project, 2026af)

Historical retrieval, online access and agent tools. The selected online API retrieves
the latest online feature values, and the online-store documentation describes materialization
into a latest-value store. A successful online read is therefore not evidence that an old
decision’s information has been reconstructed. There is also a separate provenance obligation
for transformations: a feature carrying a predecision timestamp can still use future observations,
a retrospectively fitted normalizer or a later model version. The proposed library result must
bind the input snapshot, feature and transformation versions, provider, retrieval mode and
relevant clocks. A CLI or MCP wrapper should preserve that same meaning.(Feast contributors,
2026)
   Feast’s selected source distinguishes two MCP surfaces. The standalone feast mcp process
proxies feature and registry servers. Its feature tools include online retrieval and vector search,
but also push and materialization operations. The selected client turns HTTP error statuses
into tool errors, rather than presenting a denial body as feature data. The in-process MCP
endpoint uses a different extra and deployment path. These facts justify an integration design,
not an assertion that the proposal’s historical contract already exists in either surface.(Feast
contributors, 2026)
  For the proposed causal workflow, an agent should request a separately named historical
operation carrying decision identifiers, declared clocks, feature versions and failure states.
Registry browsing can help locate candidate features; it cannot certify their causal role or
availability. Online reads serve current decisions, while push and materialization change system
38.6. Analytical preparation must preserve the population and its information clock           649


state. Those capabilities need separate operational contracts. An unsupported historical
filter, HTTP failure, cancelled job or missing feature must remain a typed failure or missing
observation throughout the library, CLI and MCP path. Retrying with weaker time semantics
would silently answer a different question.


Reuse choice, alternatives and a bounded public qualification. The proposed route
is to retain the original Feast implementation behind a typed historical boundary, initially
with one selected provider. The root source declares Apache-2.0, including redistribution
and notice obligations. The selected project requires Python 3.10 or later and declares thirty
direct dependencies with version ranges; provider extras and the two MCP extras add different
dependencies. The source version is dynamically determined, so a commit identity alone should
not be presented as a verified package-release number. A complete distribution, resolved
environment and applicable dependency notices remain necessary before executable admission.
No native provider or MCP conformance is established here.(Feast contributors, 2026)
   An explicit bitemporal file or database query is the reference alternative for a small public
prototype: it makes both clocks and the revision rule visible with fewer components, although
its scale and operating costs remain to be measured. Existing bank feature infrastructure
may eventually be the better integration choice if it already retains the required history
and availability evidence; that cannot be inferred from a feature-store label. Porting Feast
would duplicate provider, timestamp, conversion and failure semantics without a demonstrated
platform requirement. The conditional preference is therefore integration of an original provider
after qualification, with porting deferred.
   Public or generated histories can exercise late corrections, ingestion delays, null clocks,
lifetime boundaries, tied revisions, duplicate requests and provider errors. The test must
compare complete rows and missing states against a frozen reference, then check that library,
CLI and MCP responses preserve the same retrieval mode. The data owner is responsible
for the meaning of availability and revision fields; the scientific owner for the information set,
population and causal assumptions; and the adapter owner for conversions, row conservation,
failure handling and version changes. Costs to measure include history retention, joins,
validation, data transfer, materialization and upgrade regressions. These public checks can
establish whether an expensive bank trial is worth proposing. They do not supply bank truth,
measured commercial prices or institutional acceptance.

Matched qualification and build, buy
or integrate decisions

39.1     An admissible route before a preferred supplier
A bank selecting causal software is choosing a procedure for a specified decision, together with
the means of maintaining and operating that procedure. Discovery for a supplied independent
sample, identification in a latent graph, and evaluation of a repeated servicing policy are
different services. The software survey establishes candidate routes and their restrictions. This
chapter asks how those routes should be compared once a bounded use has been chosen, and
what evidence could justify direct adoption, a process bridge, a port, an internal implementation,
a commercial purchase, or reference-only use.
  Let q denote the complete requested scientific operation and s a declared workload scenario.
For candidate route j, write

              aj (q, s) = amethod
                           j      (q, s) arepresentation
                                          j              (q, s) aoperating
                                                                 j         (q, s) arights
                                                                                   j      (q, s),

where each factor is one only when the corresponding necessary condition has been established
in the declared scope. The factors describe compatibility with the causal method, preservation
of its objects, the required runtime behavior, and the intended reuse arrangement. An unknown
condition remains unresolved; it is not a passing value. This is an admission rule for a proposed
comparison, not a probability model or a weighted capability score. A low price cannot
compensate for a method that answers a different intervention query, and a favorable license
cannot supply missing uncertainty. (Causal banking research project, 2026as)
    Admission should distinguish hard scientific restrictions from tunable engineering require-
ments. If the selected routine only handles independent units, declaring a panel identifier does
not make it a dependent-data method. If the issue is process startup, an alternative process
lifecycle may resolve it without changing the target. If the issue is an unsupported counterfac-
tual, an adapter cannot resolve it by relabelling an associational prediction. This classification
tells the proposal whether to restrict the supported domain, implement a conversion, select
another scientific method, or commission research. It prevents an implementation task from
carrying an implicit promise to solve nonidentification.
   The inspected candidates illustrate why a route is more specific than a package name. The
pinned pgmpy review finds an advertised adjustment option whose selected implementation
raises NotImplementedError; that option cannot enter the executable comparison merely
because it appears in a guide. The selected Tetrad review supports a restricted Java PC
prototype subject to runtime, conversion and reuse conditions, not an unrestricted Java

                                                     650
39.2. Matching the experiment and its denominator                                            651


discovery service. The CausalNex review treats the inspected discontinued source as an
archival comparison; maintenance and unreported solver behavior remain part of the decision.
These are findings for inspected revisions. They do not establish that another release, method
or supplier has the same restriction. (pgmpy contributors, 2026a; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026r; mckinsey/causalnex, 2026b)


39.2     Matching the experiment and its denominator
A comparison requires a common request population before it requires a common timer. Let
Q be the prespecified distribution of requested cases, including difficult and unsupported
cases relevant to the proposed service. For each route, retain a disposition Rj (q) such as
computed, unsupported, unavailable, or invalid input, together with the target and uncertainty
object actually returned. The intended denominator is the requested workload. A conditional
accuracy figure among successful outputs remains useful, but it answers a different question
from the probability of receiving a correct, usable result for an arbitrary requested case.
   For estimator comparisons, a matched case must bind the population measure, intervention,
horizon, information clock and uncertainty meaning. The two procedures may legitimately
use different computational strategies. They may also use different statistical methods if the
purpose is a method comparison, provided the target and admissible information are held
fixed and each method’s assumptions are exposed. A port-equivalence study has a narrower
objective: it tests whether the intended procedure survives translation, including defaults,
failure behavior, randomness and diagnostic outputs. Mixing these objectives would make a
better result ambiguous between a scientific change and a faithful implementation.
   The first prototype should contain three complementary groups. Exact finite or analytic
constructions test meanings and numerical identities. Generated sampling experiments test
operating characteristics under explicit truth. Documented public datasets test preparation,
interfaces, and useful questions within their evidence limits. Agreement on public observational
data is not itself a causal-truth label. A benchmark with known intervention assignments
supports a stronger comparison only for its documented population and design. The proposal
can therefore establish the merit and practicality of a later bank experiment without pretending
that public data reproduces private bank assignment, identity or operational truth. (Causal
banking research project, 2026as)
   Workload matching also includes resource and information budgets. Both routes should
receive the same permitted data and expert restrictions; preprocessing, search, tuning and
human repair must be charged consistently. If one candidate uses a larger graph-search
budget, report both a fixed-budget comparison and the declared cost–quality tradeoff. For a
bridge, include serialization, data movement, environment startup, numerical work, uncertainty
construction and publication. Warm and cold executions are distinct operating scenarios.
Reuse of a fitted model or cached result is valid only when the identity and invalidation rule
agree with the intended service.


39.3     A paired comparison can reverse a preferred route
Consider an authored workload law with 1,000 equally weighted request slots. Each route
produces a correct usable answer, a wrong answer, or an unavailable answer. The following
table specifies the entire paired law; it is not an observed package trial. A row refers to route
652                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


A, and a column to route B.

                               B : correct B : wrong B : unavailable total
                 A : correct          600         20              10  630
                 A : wrong              10         5               5   20
               A : unavailable        190         75              85  350
                    total             800        100             100 1000

Among available answers, A is correct in 630/650 = 126/130 cases and B in 800/900 = 8/9.
On the requested denominator, their correct-answer rates are 0.63 and 0.80. Thus A has higher
conditional correctness while B supplies more correct answers overall. Neither statement alone
selects the preferred banking workflow. (Causal banking research project, 2026at)
  Suppose a correct answer has stipulated gross value USD 10, a wrong answer causes loss ℓ,
unavailable answers have zero gross value, and the complete per-request costs are USD 1 for A
and USD 2 for B, charged on all requests. Their total values are

                VA = 630(10) − 20ℓ − 1000,       VB = 800(10) − 100ℓ − 2000.

The difference is VB − VA = 700 − 80ℓ. Route B is preferred only when ℓ < 8.75. At ℓ = 40,
the totals are USD 4,500 and USD 2,000, respectively. This threshold is a sensitivity result
under a specified loss and fallback convention. It is not a market price or a claim about a
bank’s actual error cost. If unavailable answers require manual review, that fallback has its
own value, delay and cost and must be incorporated in both workflows. (Causal banking
research project, 2026at)
  Pairing provides information that two separate success percentages lose. Let Xj be the
indicator of a correct usable answer from route j, and let D = XB − XA . In the stipulated
law, D = 1 on 200 slots, D = −1 on 30, and D = 0 on 770. Hence

                     E(D) = 0.17,       Var(D) = 0.23 − 0.172 = 0.2011.

Equivalently, the covariance of the two correctness indicators is 0.600 − (0.63)(0.80) = 0.096,
and
                        Var(D) = 0.63(0.37) + 0.80(0.20) − 2(0.096).
If independent paired requests were drawn from this law, the sample mean difference would have
variance 0.2011/n. Treating the two outcomes as independent instead gives 0.3931/n. These
expressions describe the stipulated sampling experiment; they are not confidence statements
for a fixed benchmark table. Repeated variants from one customer, graph or source document
require their actual group dependence to be retained. (Causal banking research project, 2026at)
   The paired table also makes disagreement review efficient. The 200 cases on which only B
is correct and the 30 on which only A is correct are natural targets for diagnosing method
domain, conversion or failure handling. They should remain in the final outcome accounting
after investigation. Correcting a test oracle or an adapter creates a successor comparison with
explicit changes; removing disagreeing cases until the routes agree would change the workload
and obscure the reason for the improvement.


39.4     What a failure-free prototype establishes
A set of successful fixtures proves the stated examples, not universal compatibility. A small
stochastic qualification experiment supplies a different, conditional statement. Suppose a fixed
workload distribution has independent Bernoulli failures with probability p, and the evaluation
39.5. A port must preserve the full procedure                                                  653


contains n prespecified requests. If zero failures occur, the probability of that observation is
(1 − p)n . Inverting the one-sided test at error probability α gives the upper bound

                                         pU = 1 − α1/n .

With n = 100 and α = 0.05, this is approximately 0.0295. Zero failures among a hundred
independent requests therefore does not establish a one-percent failure ceiling at this level.
The exact inequality
                                     (0.99)n ≤ 0.05
first holds at n = 299. This is a prospective sample-size implication if that design and ceiling
are appropriate, not a claim that the prototype has passed it. (Causal banking research project,
2026at)
   For eight separately declared profiles, a simultaneous statement needs its own error allocation.
Assigning α/8 to each and applying the union bound yields joint error at most α without
requiring independence between profiles. Each within-profile zero-failure calculation still
requires its stated independent Bernoulli experiment. At a common one-percent ceiling,
(0.99)n ≤ 0.05/8 first holds at n = 505 requests per profile. A single pooled bound would
answer a different question and could hide a bad rare profile. Conversely, infinitely many graph
families or deployment regimes cannot be qualified by calling eight chosen profiles exhaustive.
(Causal banking research project, 2026at)
   These calculations motivate a bounded qualification protocol rather than a large unstructured
test collection. Define the admitted profile, failure event, request distribution, denominator,
sample size, simultaneous statement and stopping rule before evaluation. A crash, timeout,
missing interval or wrong target is not automatically the same event; retain their separate
frequencies and any combined service failure used for acceptance. If a generated experiment
tests confidence-set coverage, its event is whether the known fixed target is contained, together
with declared availability and precision requirements. Statistical coverage, computation
completion and useful decision resolution need separate criteria. Adaptive test selection or
optional stopping requires a design that justifies it; repeatedly adding cases until the displayed
bound passes does not preserve this fixed-sample argument.
   An exact finite-domain test can offer stronger evidence within a smaller domain. Exhausting
all supported endpoint pairs or all three-node graphs may settle the declared finite conversion
behavior. It does not become a sampling confidence claim, nor does it establish arbitrary-
dimensional algorithm correctness. The topology examples show how exact counterexamples
and actual codecs complement rather than replace a generated performance study. The
proposal should state which of these evidence forms closes each acceptance condition. (Causal
banking research project, 2026aw,au)


39.5      A port must preserve the full procedure
Porting has several possible meanings. A mathematical reimplementation may reproduce
a functional using a different algorithm. A compatibility port may seek the same defaults,
accepted inputs, warnings and output semantics as a specified release. A new method may
deliberately improve an estimator or uncertainty construction. Each can be useful, but each
requires a different comparison. The product should not retain an upstream method name
while changing its weighting measure, policy target or interval construction without declaring
that change. Source-level agreement is particularly weak when a caller changes the meaning of
an otherwise correctly translated routine.
654                                                                    Causal analysis for a universal bank


   For the inspected CausalPy route, the proposed sharp-discontinuity contract distinguishes a
finite-epsilon prediction contrast from a threshold estimand, and a point backend from posterior
draws and predictive responses. A port that reproduces a plotted difference while discarding
epsilon, treatment direction or left/right support has not reproduced the causal operation. For
the d3rlpy route, the proposed contract separates episode termination, administrative cutoff,
missing continuation, initial-state population, policy identity and the physical discount clock.
Reproducing an optimizer while averaging the wrong initial states can produce a different
policy value. These source-grounded contracts specify tests to execute before enabling the
proposed integrations; they are not records of native acceptance trials. (Causal banking
proposal, 2026c,at)
   Numerical acceptance should be stated in the coordinates of the decision. Let θe approximate
an independently defined reference θ, with justified deterministic bounds |θei − θi | ≤ εi . For
fixed weights wi and cost c, the triangle inequality gives
                                                               !
                          X                      X                     X
                                wi θei − c −          wi θ i − c   ≤       |wi |εi .
                            i                     i                    i

This transports certified numerical error; it does not certify the reference’s causal validity or
its sampling uncertainty. Relative-error tolerances alone are unsuitable near a zero-valued
target, and coordinate tolerances that look small can still reverse a near-threshold decision.
   For a stipulated example, let w = (3/4, 1/4), θe = (24, −8) USD, c = 15 USD and ε = (2, 4)
USD. The approximate net value is USD 1, but its numerical error allowance is USD 2.5,
giving the enclosure [−1.5, 3.5]. The permitted reference θ = (23, −10) yields USD −0.25.
Declaring a profitable action from the approximate point would exceed the available numerical
evidence. Reducing the numerical budget, retaining an unresolved decision, or changing the
information/design are distinct responses. If sampling uncertainty is also present, the numerical
enclosure must be combined with that construction under its actual guarantee, not relabelled
as another confidence level. (Causal banking research project, 2026at)
   Port acceptance should consequently include independent algebraic references, metamorphic
transformations with known consequences, adverse inputs, and method-specific numerical
error checks. Graph and set outputs need structural and containment criteria, not only a
mean squared difference. Seeds, thread counts, solver versions, hardware-dependent arithmetic
and stopping conditions belong in the tested procedure. An upstream test suite is valuable
inherited evidence, but common implementation mistakes can survive a direct translation
of both code and tests. Independent references should target the scientific properties the
proposed product promises.


39.6     Lifecycle cost conditional on qualified behavior
Only admitted routes should enter a procurement comparison. For route j, a transparent
planning quantity over T periods is
                                        T
                                        X
                          Cj = F j +           dt {Ljt + Mjt + Nt cjt + Ijt },
                                        t=1

where Fj is initial engineering and qualification cost, Ljt license or subscription expense, Mjt
maintenance and compatibility work, Nt cjt workload-dependent cost, and Ijt the expected
incident or recovery cost under an explicitly stated model. The dt are the chosen discount
factors. These terms need not be known at proposal time. Ranges and break-even conditions
are more informative than an invented precise total, and omitted costs must remain visible.
39.7. A proposal decision that can be executed                                              655


  Suppose, purely for planning, a bridge costs USD 100,000 initially, USD 20,000 per year to
maintain and USD 3 per request. A port costs USD 300,000 initially, USD 80,000 per year
and USD 1 per request. Ignore discounting over three years and assume both routes meet
exactly the same service requirements. Ignoring maintenance suggests a break-even volume of
                                  300000 − 100000
                                                  = 100000
                                       3−1
requests. Including the three years of maintenance gives
                        300000 − 100000 + 3(80000 − 20000)
                                                           = 190000.
                                      3−1
At 150,000 total requests the bridge costs USD 610,000 and the port USD 690,000. The
cheaper numerical kernel does not establish the cheaper full route. These are exact hypothetical
calculations, not measured costs, vendor quotes or return on investment. Their practical use
is to identify which workload and maintenance estimates could change the decision. (Causal
banking research project, 2026at)
   The same decomposition organizes substantive alternatives. Direct adoption can minimize
translation work when the upstream environment and result contract fit, but it retains
dependency and upgrade obligations. A process bridge can isolate an environment and preserve
the upstream implementation, at the cost of conversion, lifecycle and operational work. A
port may serve an unavailable deployment environment or a demonstrated bottleneck, but
incurs full-procedure equivalence and maintenance responsibilities. An internal implementation
is justified when the required scientific construction or result type is absent from suitable
existing routes; its comparison should include the continuing cost of independent verification.
Reference-only use is appropriate when an implementation clarifies a method but its runtime,
rights, maintenance or scientific domain is unsuitable for the proposed service.
   A commercial purchase is evaluated through the same admitted operation and whole-
workflow cost. The exact edition, automation route, technical method, diagnostics, export
semantics and intended deployment terms matter. Community extensions should not be
attributed to the vendor’s supported core without evidence. Missing technical documentation
leaves a capability unresolved; it does not establish absence. Unquoted prices remain unknown.
The commercial comparison therefore supports a request for a matched evaluation or a bounded
purchase decision when its evidence permits one, rather than an unsupported claim of product
superiority. (Causal banking research project, 2026as)


39.7     A proposal decision that can be executed
The immediate deliverable should be a conditional route decision, with a specific supported
profile and a finite acceptance experiment. A useful decision identifies the candidate revision
and environment, the exact causal operation, the alternative route, the information and
compute budget, the correctness and failure events, the required numerical or uncertainty
guarantee, and the cost quantities that remain to be measured. It also states what outcome
would change the choice. A preferred prototype candidate is therefore compatible with deferred
integration; it expresses where the next evidence is most valuable without asserting that the
evidence exists. (Causal banking research project, 2026as)
  For a discovery prototype, a restricted supplied regime and independently checked graph
conversions precede an effect claim. For a threshold design, the treatment direction, support
and requested limit precede a comparison of predictions. For servicing, the complete policy
and episode population precede offline value comparison. For funding, weak information and
656                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


the topology of the effect set precede a monetary recommendation. These conditions let
independent prototype routes advance while another method remains unsupported. They also
make rejection useful: a documented mismatch removes a route from the admitted domain
and identifies whether new information, another method or engineering work could restore it.
   No proposed acceptance test can make observationally indistinguishable causal models
distinguishable by computation alone. Nor can it invent bank precision targets, authentic
identity and assignment records, supplier commitments or independent approval. Those limits
should govern the claim made by the proposal, while public/generated prototype comparisons
establish what can be learned now. A later bank trial is justified by a credible scoped method,
demonstrated semantic and numerical behavior, and a decision-relevant uncertainty and cost
question. The resulting build, buy or integrate decision is conditional on that evidence, with
an explicit fallback when qualification fails.


39.8     Commercial orchestration and the recovery of a causal
         batch
A recovered causal batch is useful only if its result answers the declared question for the
declared population and information set. Consider a nightly offer analysis that fails after
writing some cohort effects. Restarting the job can save computation, but it can also duplicate
customers, reuse an outdated estimate or execute a changed procedure. The relevant product
requirement joins execution recovery to preservation of the scientific request. This motivates
comparing available orchestration before building another scheduler.
   The six selected official manuals cover Databricks Lakeflow Jobs on AWS, Snowflake task
graphs, Azure Machine Learning API-v2 pipeline reuse, Dataiku DSS scenarios and AWS Step
Functions. They provide current technical observations retrieved on 22 October 2026. They
do not establish an unchanged capability at the literature cutoff, 7 October 2026. Databricks’
repair and monitoring pages display 9 and 15 October updates. Azure displays a 30 March date
while its HTML repository metadata records a 19 October update. The remaining mutable
manuals lack an authenticated historical revision. These observations supplement the cutoff
survey; historical coverage remains open. (Databricks, 2026d,c; Microsoft, 2026b; Snowflake,
2026c; Dataiku, 2026a; Amazon Web Services, 2026c)

39.8.1    Partial repair must preserve both writes and meaning

The inspected Databricks repair manual describes rerunning unsuccessful tasks and their
dependents using current job and task settings. Each unsuccessful task starts again from
the beginning. The text explicitly warns that Jobs does not make task writes idempotent:
a partially completed append can duplicate data when repaired. A shared job cluster is
recreated using current settings, and repair parameters can override earlier values. These
mechanisms can support efficient recovery; they make the application’s output-commit and
version contracts material to a causal result. They do not establish that the platform cannot
implement those contracts.(Databricks, 2026d)
    Let the finite target population be U, and let τi be its stipulated potential-outcome contrast
Yi (1) − Yi (0). The equal-unit target is
                                                 1 X
                                          τU =         τi .                                 (39.1)
                                               |U| i∈U
For an exact constructed example, three units have contrast 6 and one has contrast −2, in
hypothetical dollars per unit. Their effect is 4. If the first two positive-contrast units are
39.8. Commercial orchestration and the recovery of a causal batch                            657


written before interruption, and all four units are appended on repair, the stored-row average
becomes
                               5(6) + 1(−2)      14                     2
                     τappend =                = ,       τappend − τU = .                 (39.2)
                                      6          3                      3
The batch is computationally complete but its implicit positive-group weight has changed from
3/4 to 5/6. At stipulated per-unit cost 1, the intended net value 3 becomes the misleading
value 11/3. No statistical noise is needed for this error. These are exact authored values,
rather than bank observations or measured vendor behavior.(Causal banking proposal project,
2026bn)
   A final output keyed by unit identifier can recover four unique units, provided the values
belong to the same semantic request and the final commit is atomic or otherwise conflict
checked. The history still contains six write attempts. Deduplicating the result must not erase
the partial attempt, its cost or its failure. Conversely, overwriting a key with a result from a
different target or data vintage is not valid idempotency. Identifier equality alone does not
establish scientific equality. The proposed adapter must distinguish a repeated delivery of the
same result from a conflicting new result.


39.8.2    Job status and request status answer different questions

The current Databricks monitoring manual distinguishes “Succeeded with failures” from
ordinary success and explains job outcomes in terms of leaf tasks. A final task that tolerates
an upstream failure can complete without establishing that every requested customer cohort
or sensitivity scenario was evaluated. A causal batch therefore needs a request-level ledger
alongside the scheduler’s result: completed, refused, failed, skipped and reused requests remain
distinguishable.(Databricks, 2026c)
   The same manual describes a 48-hour finished-run graph and a 60-day run-history window. It
also explains that one-time API submissions have no saved job name, so searching by that name
does not find them. A durable scientific record should bind the actual run identifier and export
the relevant lineage before its operating display expires. Retention and search convenience
are useful platform features; neither determines the validity of the causal assumptions or the
completeness of the requested workload. (Databricks, 2026c)
   For a declared request set Q, report the requested count together with each disposition
count. Accuracy among returned results and the fraction of requests receiving an admissible
result are different quantities. Retry success must not silently remove difficult requests from
the denominator. An unsupported intervention is a scientific refusal; a transient storage failure
is an operating failure. Treating them identically would hide the appropriate remedy and
distort the comparison with another route.


39.8.3    Version the scientific dependencies behind an execution DAG

Snowflake’s inspected task-graph manual describes dependent SQL execution, retries, finalizers
and overlap controls. Its graph is a scheduling DAG. An edge that says one job must finish
before another does not imply a causal arrow or identify an intervention. This distinction
matters when an agent translates the same word “graph” across workflow and causal APIs.
(Snowflake, 2026c)
   The manual says that graph versions include task properties, but not the definitions of
stored procedures called by those tasks. If a called procedure changes during execution, its
new definition can run within the current graph run. Scientific replay must therefore pin
658                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


procedure definitions and their relevant dependencies separately. A stable task-graph version
is insufficient to infer unchanged estimator code. (Snowflake, 2026c)
   The same text says that a suspended child can be treated as though it succeeded, while a
finalizer does not start when the root task is skipped. Overlap can be allowed where read/write
operations tolerate it. These are documented execution choices whose compatibility with
the proposed experiment must be assessed. A manifest and commit protocol should make
incompatible concurrent writes detectable and should retain skipped scientific requests. This
is a design requirement, not a demonstrated Snowflake adapter or an absence claim about
other product features. (Snowflake, 2026c)


39.8.4    A reusable output must still answer the same target

Azure Machine Learning’s inspected API-v2 description requires a deterministic component,
ForceReRun=false and matching code, environment, inputs, parameters, output settings and
run settings for reuse. The reused component displays the earlier status, output, logs and
metrics. Force-rerun children cannot be reused by other jobs. These controls offer a useful
starting point for lineage and reproducibility, with the historical-edition limitation stated
above. (Microsoft, 2026b)
   The scientific application must express its dependencies through the declared artifacts. An
unchanged URI need not establish an unchanged table behind it; an undeclared population
revision can change the question even if the code is identical. The determinism flag is a
declaration about the component, not an independent validation of determinism or causal
assumptions. The manual’s code-snapshot and environment comparisons help diagnose execu-
tion reuse; the library must add the estimand and information clock to the meaning of reuse.
(Microsoft, 2026b)
   In the finite example, keeping group effects (6, −2) but changing population weights from
(3/4, 1/4) to (1/4, 3/4) changes the effect from 4 to 0 and net value from 3 to −1. Retaining
the original weights but revising the last unit’s contrast from −2 to −10 changes the effect to
2 and net value to 1. The first change is a target change; the second is a data-vintage change.
A cached number may be exactly equal to an earlier output and still answer the wrong current
question.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026bn)


39.8.5    Retries need a budget that survives redrive

The current AWS Step Functions manual describes ordered retriers and catchers, backoff,
jitter and bounded retry counts. Catchers apply to Task, Parallel and Map states, rather than
top-level execution failures. Eligible states can have their retry counts reset on redrive. A
library request that requires a total budget must retain attempts across these boundaries, as
well as configure each state’s retry policy. A new execution identifier must not erase earlier
time, resource use or failed scientific requests. (Amazon Web Services, 2026c)
   Error classes require the exact documented meaning. In the inspected current text, the
States.ALL wildcard excludes DataLimitExceeded and Runtime. The manual explicitly permits
a named DataLimitExceeded retry or catch, whereas Runtime remains non-retryable. It would
be inaccurate to infer from the wildcard exclusion that every explicit payload-limit handler is
unavailable. The historical revision must be recovered before attributing these semantics to
the cutoff edition.(Amazon Web Services, 2026c)
 The manual states that retries are billed as state transitions. Actual comparison requires
more than the number of successful final tasks. For a common workload, define a proposed
39.8. Commercial orchestration and the recovery of a causal batch                            659


accounting identity

       Cworkflow = Ctransitions + Ccompute + Cstorage + Ctransfer + Chuman + Clicense .   (39.3)

Each term includes failed and recovery attempts within the declared horizon; overlapping
charges must not be counted twice. Rates, region, service edition, retention and staff time need
authentic evidence before evaluating this identity numerically. No observed prices, runtime
advantage or bank return are supplied by the exact arithmetic example.


39.8.6    What remains unresolved in the commercial comparison

Dataiku’s retrieved page identifies DSS 15 and indexes automation scenarios, build/check/-
metrics/code steps, trigger categories and failure/conditional execution. It is primarily an
index. Those headings establish the scope of linked topics, not detailed transaction, retry or
concurrency semantics. The technical pages and historical DSS edition must be inspected
before a stronger comparison.(Dataiku, 2026a)
   SAS Viya orchestration, Domino and Posit Workbench/Connect remain candidates for this
bounded frame. Their presence here grants no capability or absence finding. Complementary
market discovery, product aliases, deployment editions, licensing and actual prices remain
necessary. For the five inspected families, current manuals support specific mechanisms
and application obligations; none completes historical coverage or native qualification. This
comparison therefore motivates an architecture that reuses suitable orchestration while adding
scientific semantics. Whether each adapter preserves those semantics remains a proposition to
test.


39.8.7    A common manifest across the library, CLI and MCP

Let m(q) serialize the full declared meaning of scientific request q:

                  m(q) = (D, T, I, G, A, E, S, N, O),       k(q) = hash(m(q)).            (39.4)

Here D identifies input snapshots and availability, T the population and estimand, I the
information clock, G graph/identification assumptions, A the estimator and covariance settings,
E code and environment, S seeds or randomness coupling, N numerical tolerances, and O
the output schema. The serialization must be canonical and must include the dependencies
needed for that method; the tuple is a proposed contract, not a proof of completeness. Equal
hashes bind specified bytes and declarations. They do not establish truthful provenance, valid
assumptions or an identified causal effect.
   The reference program constructs a finite manifest and verifies that changes to the data,
target weights or environment change its key. It also verifies the append bias and keyed recovery
using exact rational arithmetic. This is a local authored reference, not a vendor adapter or
a fault-injected deployment. The CLI and MCP should transport the same manifest and
return lineage, the target, uncertainty meaning and request disposition. A refused unidentified
effect must not be converted into an ordinary numerical answer by either entry point.(Causal
banking proposal project, 2026bn)


39.8.8    Demonstrate merit on public fixtures before a costly trial

A first frozen experiment should combine a public dataset with a separately generated potential-
outcome fixture. The public source exercises realistic schema, scale and custody; generated
660                                                                Causal analysis for a universal bank


outcomes supply known causal truth under declared assumptions. Public observational
agreement alone supplies no such truth label. Compare uninterrupted and interrupted execution
with the same targets, data, methods, randomization and resource envelope.
  Prespecify partial writes, lost responses after commit, changed tables or procedures, stale
cache, skipped children, payload limits and exhausted redrive budgets. Every requested case
remains in the denominator. Deterministic exact cases require identical results and statuses.
Floating or randomized cases need predeclared tolerances and appropriate coupled randomness.
Incompatible manifests must be refused; commits must be unique and the attempt/cost ledger
complete. A statistical estimator retains a separate calibration protocol. Computational
equivalence does not itself establish coverage or identification.
   This experiment can justify whether a native trial is worth its cost. Later commercial
