for arbitrary longer horizons or complementary experiments.
   Finally, suppose a proposed model pool contains only H = 1. Its normalized posterior
assigns probability one to good outcomes and predicts USD 100 from deployment. If the
omitted bad world is true, deployment instead yields USD −120. No entropy calculation
confined to the single-model pool detects the omission. The bank therefore needs sensitivity
to model support as well as uncertainty within the pool. Challenging a favorable mechanism
with a null, adverse or selection-based alternative can be more consequential than refining its
parameters. A formal robust recommendation would specify the larger set of admissible laws
and the associated loss criterion; it cannot be inferred merely from an agent having considered
46.4. Public software: what can be reused and what remains a design                          823


several verbal stories.


46.4      Public software: what can be reused and what remains a
          design

46.4.1    GlucoseBench: a useful acquisition and evaluation boundary

The inspected GlucoseBench source is a small adaptation of simglucose for patient-specific
intervention forecasting. Its documented target is the same simulated patient under new
interventions, not generalization to unseen patients or clinical treatment. The maintained
interface supplies two passive training episodes, a menu of available interventions, an observe
operation with a six-episode total budget, and freeze before held-out evaluation. The
inspected evaluator reports failed query cells explicitly; the summary returns no mean score if
any cell in its group failed murphyk (2026a).
   These are useful design patterns for the proposed bank library. A separate evaluator should
retain the generator truth, give the learner only the permitted history and action menu, and
prevent held-out outcomes from steering acquisition. Freezing the acquisition history before
scoring makes an otherwise subtle form of information leakage visible. The in-process object
boundary is explicitly not protection against deliberate introspection; an agent capable of
arbitrary code execution needs a separate process with limited inputs for an adversarial leakage
test.
   The root MIT notice and the vendored simglucose notice are present, and the project
provides attribution and upstream/vendored file hashes. Those records make a future audit
feasible; the inspected manifest is not an independent verification of every upstream byte or a
complete dependency and data-rights review. The physiological mechanism has no claimed
validity for depositors. The immediate recommendation is to adopt the acquisition/evaluation
contract in the bank proposal, and evaluate any actual package reuse separately with its
pinned source, numerical environment and observation semantics.


46.4.2    NeuronBench: explicit experiments with hidden operational fallbacks

NeuronBench exposes deterministic and stochastic neuronal worlds, a protocol menu and
held-out intervention forecasts. Its documented distinction between observed traces and
hidden mechanism truth illustrates how an environment can support active discovery without
showing its answers to the learner. The inspected source also includes a reference LLM
baseline with an injected client. That baseline is explicitly not Bayesian inference or numerical
value-of-information optimization murphyk (2026b).
   A source-level detail affects any comparison that reuses the baseline. If an experiment
response cannot be parsed, the implementation chooses the first remaining protocol. If a
forecast cannot be parsed, it returns the mean observed count, or zero without observations.
These behaviors keep the procedure running but change the meaning of its output. A reported
“LLM-selected” design may actually be a deterministic fallback. The proposed adapter must
therefore expose the attempted query, parse outcome, substituted action, retry cost and
downstream result. A useful ablation compares this fallback-only policy with the model-
assisted policy under equal environment budgets. Errors should count in the assigned workload,
while any successful-only estimate receives its own explicit denominator.
   The pinned project declares version 0.1.0, a Python requirement and an MIT license. Its
reference interface is a candidate for an optional public simulator study; no package was
824                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


installed or executed for this source comparison. Porting its neurophysiological equations into
the bank library would add an unrelated model. Reusing an isolated environment interface, or
implementing the same interface for a transparent generated bank law, is the more relevant
proposal choice. Neither route establishes that the full Model Discovery Agent has been
integrated.


46.4.3    DFM-Plans and unresolved implementation identities

The inspected DFM-Plans repository describes itself as an overview, research map and
navigation point. Its README calls Zetema a research design and states that individual
implementations are released in separate repositories. The pinned, nontruncated tree contains
documentation and assets. Consequently, this repository is unsuitable as a directly executable
Zetema causal agent. Its Apache-2.0 notice applies to the inspected repository; it does not
confer the rights or capabilities of separately linked projects Gen-Verse (2026).
   ScienceBuddy, ScienceIDE and JEPA-Anything are implementation leads from that overview,
not inspected capability evidence in this comparison. Likewise, the benchmark repositories do
not establish a complete public implementation of the model-discovery method, and dataset
links from the noisy-prior paper do not establish its full agent package. A separately identified
DISCERN task and grading harness would also require source and dataset-rights review. These
distinctions prevent a literature survey from promising integration with software that has not
yet been identified at the required level.
   The source map remains bounded by the stated literature cutoff and explicit omissions.
Relevant originals on psychological hypothesis generation and the scientific method were not
obtained as PDFs from the inspected official routes. Additional chemistry, hidden-structure
and interactive-causality candidates remain uninspected. No technical claim here relies on
their discovery metadata, and no absence or complete-frontier claim follows from those gaps.
The acquired originals and pinned sources support the developed comparisons above while
leaving those further comparisons open Causal banking proposal project (2026b).


46.5     A justified next experiment before an expensive bank
         trial
The immediate empirical question is whether agent assistance improves the translation from a
decision brief to a valid acquisition plan. That can be tested with generated worlds and public
documentation. Begin with a brief that specifies the decision, clock, admissible actions and
loss, but withholds the generator’s mechanism. Compare a fixed design, a uniformly random
design, a numerical information criterion, a numerical decision-value criterion and an optional
agent-assisted proposal policy. The numerical policies need the same candidate mechanisms
and observations as the policy being compared; an oracle with the true mechanism belongs in
a separately labeled reference.
   Vary the challenge along interpretable axes: irrelevant but highly informative measurements,
delayed outcomes, unavailable acquisitions, correlated expert errors, observationally indistin-
guishable models, misspecified model pools and malformed tool responses. Include clean cases
that reward accepting valid information. Evaluate the final decision loss, calibration of stated
probabilities where a probability target exists, the frequency of unsupported causal claims, and
whether constraints actually change the chosen action. Graph accuracy alone cannot establish
investment value.
  Before final sampled runs, freeze the generated laws, held-out families, permitted information,
46.5. A justified next experiment before an expensive bank trial                           825


cost accounting, query and compute budgets, comparators, failure handling and stopping rule.
Report every assigned case and attempted acquisition. If exploratory runs are used to select
prompts or mechanisms, keep them separate from the final comparison. A live model arm
requires its actual version, calls, prices and errors; an offline formulation exercise supports
claims about the design and reference logic only. The exact construction above is already
reproducible without live calls, random draws or an expensive bank intervention.
   A subsequent bank experiment becomes worth considering when the bounded prototype
identifies a consequential uncertainty that public and generated evidence cannot settle. Its
proposal should state which deployment decision could change, the feasible observation law, the
expected reduction in loss, and the complete cost of obtaining that information. If candidate
models remain observationally equivalent under every permitted acquisition, the appropriate
result may be a restricted recommendation or abstention. An agent adds value by recognizing
that limit and specifying the missing measurement or intervention, rather than by presenting
another confident causal narrative.
Chapter 47

Agents across the causal decision
workflow

47.1     A decision contract before an agent architecture
A banking assistant becomes useful when it helps an analyst preserve the meaning of a decision
across several transformations. A treasury question becomes a population and an intervention;
account records become measurements of that population; a diagram becomes an identification
problem; an identified functional becomes a numerical request; and the result becomes a
monetary comparison. Each transformation can change the question without producing a
software error. Fluent explanations are particularly dangerous when they make these changes
hard to notice. The appropriate object of automation is therefore a sequence of accountable
transformations, with explicit unresolved states.
   Consider a request to “reduce the funding cost of the customers likely to leave.” An analyst
must establish whether the intervention is a deposit-rate offer, a service action, or a portfolio
allocation; whether the unit is an account, customer, household, or business group; whether
likely departure is a baseline score or a future outcome; and whether cost includes the offer paid
to customers who would have stayed anyway. An assistant can list these alternatives and attach
relevant contract passages. It cannot establish which alternative the bank intends merely by
selecting the most plausible sentence. A structured interview, conducted without an LLM, is
the comparison baseline. The relevant quality measure is the accuracy and completeness of
the resulting target under expert review, together with analyst time and unresolved-question
rates.
  We represent the decision contract schematically as

                               Q = (P, U, A, g0 , g1 , Y, τ, ν, H, A),

where P is the population, U the unit, A the feasible action, g0 , g1 the comparison regimes, Y
the outcome, τ the horizon, ν the target measure, H the available histories and A the declared
assumptions. An ordinary population mean and a propensity-overlap mean have different ν.
A policy responding at day 11 and one acting at day 10 may have different H, even when they
reference the same event. This tuple is a project specification, not a theorem that every target
is identified. Its purpose is to make semantic changes observable.
   The literature supplies several useful components but no generally qualified substitute for
this contract. Causal discovery assistants can separate user decisions from formal algorithm
outputs; retrieval systems can attach passages; benchmark environments can require structured
identification and estimation answers. These roles have different failure modes and should not

                                                826
47.2. Evidence retrieval and the construction of observations                              827


receive a single undifferentiated “agent accuracy” score Zheng (2026); Zhang et al. (2024b);
causalds contributors (2026).


47.2      Evidence retrieval and the construction of observations
Retrieval has two distinct products: a discovered source and a supported claim. A search
result supplies the first. The second requires reading primary text, checking its version and
population, and showing why its assumptions apply to the present query. A banking process
manual may establish when a contact occurs without establishing why customers receive it. A
statistical paper may justify an estimator conditional on exchangeability without establishing
that exchangeability holds in the bank. A source-to-claim relation must therefore record both
the supported statement and the applicability judgment.
   The retrieval baseline is a curated collection reviewed by an analyst. A useful assistant
can broaden candidate discovery, locate conflicting passages and produce an evidence table
for review. Evaluation should include relevant, irrelevant and misleading documents, missing
sources, obsolete versions and sources that contradict each other. Retrieval failure must
remain distinguishable from evidence that a proposed relation is false. The LACR results
discussed in the preceding chapter are a concrete reason not to assume that more retrieved
text monotonically improves discovery Zhang et al. (2024b).
   Observation construction is equally substantive. A field called owner_id may identify an
operational account holder rather than the economic owner relevant to exposure aggregation. A
link score is a measurement about a proposed relation, not the relation itself. The observation
journey must retain candidate mappings, inclusion rules, missed records, joint dependence
and the origin of adjudicated labels. Ontology tools can help align terminology, but class
membership and linguistic relations do not identify causal arrows. The inspected OntoLearner
download path also illustrates a reproducibility problem: the code revision alone does not pin
ontology bytes when its hub download does not specify a revision OntoLearner contributors
(2026). The design uses explicit local ontology identities and keeps conceptual variables
separate from their proxies. A real ownership audit remains additional information.
   For time-dependent decisions, every relevant measurement has an event time te and an
availability time ta . An event observed on day 10 but delivered on day 11 cannot be used by a
day-10 operational policy. Retrospective analysis may nevertheless use it under a correctly
stated design; that is a different claim from saying a deployed policy could have acted on it.
Corrections and revisions need their own availability records. A validator checks the declared
ordering. Only a process audit can establish whether those declarations reflect the actual
information system.


47.3      Diagrams, discovery and identification as separate hand-
          offs
Diagram elicitation should preserve competing scientific accounts. A proposal must distinguish
a direct edge from an ancestral path, a latent common cause from a measured covariate, and
a circle endpoint from an arrowhead. Revision history should show which source, reviewer
or new experiment changed a claim. Automatic cycle removal is at most a representation
repair: deleting a scientifically important edge to obtain a DAG does not justify the repaired
mechanism. The ordinary baseline is expert elicitation with a deterministic graph editor and
explicit uncertainty.
828                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


   Discovery then asks a statistical question under a specified sampling law. An assistant may
suggest a method, summarize its assumptions, or propose a soft constraint. The numerical
procedure remains responsible for its own output semantics. A response histogram from a
language model is not a conditional independence test under a bank sampling law. A temporal
initialization does not establish that observed anomalies were randomized interventions. A
retained equivalence class should reach the effect-query stage intact. The previous chapter
explains why language-assisted graph methods require separate tests of proposal quality, graph
retention and downstream effect uncertainty.
   Identification maps a target and assumptions to a functional or set. It can also establish
nonidentification in a declared model class. A missing backend, unsupported graph type or
failed calculation instead means that the implementation did not answer the question. These
outcomes are not interchangeable. The inspected CausalDS helper preserves an unknown
state and does not count an IV estimand as nonparametric population-ATE identification; its
evaluator still requires care with missing metadata and invalid intervals causalds contributors
(2026). A prototype should preserve that distinction even when a downstream report would
be easier to write as a single yes/no answer.
   PyWhy-LLM is a candidate elicitation component, but the inspected front-door routine is
unfinished and back-door suggestions delegate to a language model pywhy-llm contributors
(2026). Such output can propose variables for review; it does not supply a verified adjustment
proof. Similarly, the inspected CLadder IV template requires generator-level scrutiny before
its population-ATE labels can become benchmark truth cladder contributors (2024). The
project example with half compliers and half never-takers has Wald ratio one and population
ATE two under randomization, exclusion and monotonicity. Correct algebra for the ratio does
not fix an incorrectly named target.


47.4     Estimation, diagnostics and the temptation to change the
         target
Once identification has supplied a functional, the assistant can prepare a fixed estimator
request, summarize diagnostics and explain the output. It should not choose a more convenient
target after inspecting poor overlap. If trimming changes the population, that change belongs
in a new target or an explicitly reported sensitivity analysis. An estimated propensity score,
nuisance learner, sample split and covariance rule must be versioned together with the result.
Prediction accuracy does not by itself qualify the resulting effect interval, especially with
dependent observations or adaptively selected specifications.
   The inspected OCI example makes the target issue concrete. It averages an AIPW quantity
uniformly over a trimmed sample while using an ATO label oci-agent contributors (2026).
Under the corresponding assumptions this construction targets the retained population’s
average effect, not the usual overlap-weighted population. In the project’s two equally frequent
strata, propensities are 0.2 and 0.5 and effects are 0 and 10. Retaining both strata gives mean
effect 5. Weighting by e(X){1 − e(X)} gives
                             0.16 · 0 + 0.25 · 10   250
                                                  =     ≃ 6.09756.
                                0.16 + 0.25         41
These are exact arithmetic consequences of different target measures, not a performance
comparison of fitted estimators. They give a small independent oracle for a semantic validator.
  Diagnostics need similarly explicit interpretations. A negative control can falsify an impli-
cation of a causal account; passing it does not prove all unmeasured confounding absent. A
47.5. Longitudinal policies require a causal history                                              829


critic can identify a missing source or an inconsistent formula; agreement between two models
exposed to the same text is not independent scientific confirmation. Uncertainty reporting
should preserve identification uncertainty, sampling uncertainty, sensitivity to assumptions
and numerical approximation separately. A disconnected effect set cannot be replaced by its
midpoint, and a whole-line set cannot be described as a precise zero effect. Reporting all
requested cases, including failures and refusals, prevents success-conditioned accuracy from
masquerading as general availability.


47.5      Longitudinal policies require a causal history
Servicing decisions expose the limits of a generic planner particularly clearly. Let L0 be
baseline information, A0 an initial contact, L1 the subsequent account state, A1 a second
action and Y a later net value. The state L1 can be affected by A0 while confounding the
relation between A1 and Y . Ordinary regression adjustment for L1 can block part of the
earlier treatment effect or induce selection bias. Omitting it can confound the later action.
Hernán and Robins develop the corresponding g-methods and the assumptions under which
they identify longitudinal intervention means Hernán and Robins (2020).
  For a discrete two-decision example, write g0 (l0 ) for the first action and g1 (l0 , a0 , l1 ) for
the second. Under consistency, appropriate sequential exchangeability and positivity for the
policy’s supported histories, a specialization of the g-formula is
                                     X
                           V (g) =            m{l0 , g0 (l0 ), l1 , g1 (l0 , g0 (l0 ), l1 )}
                                     l0 ,l1

                                                  × p{l1 | l0 , A0 = g0 (l0 )}p(l0 ),          (47.1)

where m(l0 , a0 , l1 , a1 ) = E[Y | L0 = l0 , A0 = a0 , L1 = l1 , A1 = a1 ]. The sum is over supported
covariate values; an integral is required for continuous components. The first treatment changes
the distribution over which the later outcome regression is averaged. That dependence is why
simply conditioning on a fixed observed distribution of L1 can answer a different question. A
recursive regression representation integrates the final outcome backward, while IP weighting
reweights observed histories toward the regime. Their identification relationship does not
imply equal finite-sample behavior.
   An assistant can help check whether the proposed regime uses available information and
whether the analyst has stated assumptions at each decision. It can propose an evidence
request for treatment assignment, censoring or action feasibility. It cannot infer sequential
exchangeability from the fact that all database columns have timestamps. Causally relevant
history is not simply every past variable; some past variables can induce selection bias, as
the source’s discussion of history emphasizes Hernán and Robins (2020). A policy might also
lack support in distressed segments where staff always take the same action. More generated
explanations do not create that support.
   The availability rule is operationally separate from the identification rule. If the second
decision occurs on day 11, a state available on day 11 may enter g1 under a specified within-day
ordering. If the action occurs on day 10, it may not. A missing within-day ordering must
remain unresolved. Censoring and interference require additional modeling; neither appears
automatically in equation (47.1). The assistant’s proposed handoff therefore includes the
policy, available history, assignment/retention assumptions, support diagnostics and explicit
limits. This is a design for review, not a claim that the current orchestration frameworks
implement qualified longitudinal causal inference.

47.6     What the available packages can contribute
The pinned package comparison separates reusable ideas from ready adoption. PyWhy-LLM
offers candidate elicitation interfaces. CausalAgent illustrates a causal MCP wrapper, but its
inspected OLC function is called without being imported or defined in that module; malformed
JSON may become an empty dictionary in its helper CausalAgent contributors (2026). That
path requires repair and independent qualification before direct use. The response-based test
in causal_GPT is not accepted as a bank CI engine, for the reasons derived in the preceding
chapter causal_GPT contributors (2024).
   OCI’s separation of specifications and reporting is worth evaluating, but its unbounded
notebook-execution route is inappropriate for the proposed fixed-tool surface. CausalDS is a
stronger candidate for a bounded benchmark environment after scorer and metadata handling
are repaired. CLadder remains a useful formal-question lead with problematic IV cells excluded
until reviewed. OntoLearner may assist semantic mapping with explicit local bytes. The
adjacent numerical LCM is neither a language assistant nor a presently qualified temporal
backend: weight identities, component terms and its sufficient lagged model class need separate
treatment LCM contributors (2026).
   The Java/Python research bundle LLM-CD and the LLM-SCD notebooks also illustrate
why publication and code adoption need different decisions. Inspected component licenses do
not establish a license for a repository as a whole; missing root terms and code–paper version
alignment remain unresolved LLM-CD contributors (2025b); LLM-and-SCD contributors
(2024). Their scholarly arguments can be discussed from genuine papers while code adoption is
deferred. No package in this comparison is credited with a successful local bank or live-model
trial.


47.7     Orchestration is an implementation choice
Three generic frameworks were inspected at revisions no later than the client cutoff. LangGraph
supplies state-graph compilation, checkpoint and interrupt interfaces. Its interrupt documen-
tation explicitly says that resumption starts the node again, re-executing its preceding logic
langgraph contributors (2026). A node that publishes a result before interrupting therefore
needs idempotent publication. A checkpoint is useful state, not proof that an arbitrary external
side effect occurs exactly once. This distinction determines the design of durable request
identifiers and immutable artifact checks.
   Pydantic AI supplies typed tool and output boundaries and usage accounting. In the
inspected code, tools need not default to sequential execution or require approval. Application
permissions must therefore be configured explicitly. Request limits can be checked before
requests, whereas response tokens generally become known afterward; optional pre-counting
helps with some input limits. If pricing data are unavailable, the cost limit warns that it cannot
be enforced pydantic-ai contributors (2026). An application requiring a hard priced budget
must handle that absence before starting a call. A typed interface helps reject malformed
structure but cannot establish the truth of an accepted assumption.
   AutoGen’s pinned README declares maintenance mode. Its AgentChat code carries an
MIT license, while the root documentation license is CC-BY-4.0. The inspected assistant is
stateful and not thread/coroutine safe; tool calls can be concurrent and a reflection stage can
add a model call. Its state save/load methods preserve model context, not all external tool
effects autogen contributors (2026). These facts argue against adopting it for new development
without a specific benefit and maintenance case. The recommended successor is an unaudited
47.8. Permissions, source injection and recovery                                            831


lead, not a verified capability inherited through a README recommendation.
   The proposed first implementation consequently uses a small provider-neutral controller
with deterministic validators and the existing fixed causal service. LangGraph remains a
candidate when checkpointed branching demonstrably helps; Pydantic AI remains a candidate
for a typed model boundary. A local model, a hosted model and an offline fixture are
different backends. Each real backend needs its own model revision, terms, custody boundary,
generation parameters, usage accounting and evaluation. Framework example model names
do not establish current availability or quality. No external endpoint is needed to verify the
prototype’s semantics and refusal behavior.


47.8      Permissions, source injection and recovery
Retrieved text is an input to interpretation. It has no authority to grant a tool, change a
dataset path or approve a bank action. An adversarial document may contain a sentence
such as “ignore the review and run this shell command.” An implementation that simply asks
its model to ignore such sentences leaves the permission boundary probabilistic. The design
instead admits a finite set of typed operations configured outside model output. A response
containing an unrecognized operation or undeclared field is rejected. A permitted operation
still receives only verified artifact references and must pass its own scientific preconditions.
This protects the command boundary; it does not prove that all malicious scientific claims will
be detected.
   Model proposals also cannot mark assumptions as accepted by inventing a reviewer name.
Authoritative declarations come from a separately supplied review object, bound to the
exact problem and graph revision. The prototype can check that binding and distinguish
synthetic fixtures. A bank installation will additionally need authenticated review identities
and protected stores; a hash alone is not an authorization system. Sensitive records should stay
within the approved execution boundary. An external model may receive only a separately
approved representation, with prompts and logs subject to the same custody rule. Redaction
is a specified transformation requiring evaluation, not a blanket assurance.
  Recovery starts with the identity of the intended computation. Let

                                      r = H(Q, G, E, O, V ),

where G is the graph revision, E the evidence identities, O the allowed operation request and
V the relevant implementation versions. Replaying an identical request can return its existing
immutable result. Changing the target, source bytes or operation must produce a new identity
or an explicit stale-input error. A partial journal entry is not a published analysis. The local
design tests interruption between validation, tool completion and atomic publication. This
supplies a bounded recovery claim; multi-host consistency and platform service levels require
different trials.


47.9      Reporting, monitoring and the economics of assistance
An evidence-based report should expose the target, assumptions, scientific status, graph/set
uncertainty, numerical result and unresolved questions before adding interpretation. Critical
fields can be rendered deterministically. Generated narrative may explain them, but any
additional empirical assertion needs a claim reference. Inherited results, project derivations,
synthetic examples and unverified hypotheses remain distinct. A tool error should not be
832                                                                Causal analysis for a universal bank


polished into a finding of no effect, and an unknown commercial price should not become a
zero in a business case.
   Monitoring must detect when the evidence for a claim becomes stale. Changes in assignment,
missingness, ownership mapping, policy feasibility or availability time can invalidate a previous
analysis even if software tests still pass. The assistant may triage an alert and propose an
investigation. Suspension and resumption rules belong to the analysis owner. Retuning prompts
or refitting a learner after inspecting drift creates a new procedure whose old calibration does
not transfer automatically.
   The economic comparison includes model calls, retrieval, numerical computation, review,
failures, rework and ongoing maintenance. If Cm , Cr , Cn , Ch , Cf denote these components, a
proposed net benefit is a change in held-out decision value minus Cm + Cr + Cn + Ch + Cf ,
relative to a specified ordinary workflow. This expression is an accounting design, not an ROI
estimate. The available evidence does not supply authentic bank losses, prices, review times
or accepted decision outcomes. A faster explanation can be valuable, but it must not conceal
a lower rate of scientifically usable answers. The appropriate next trial therefore measures
decision quality, all-request availability and total cost separately, while the implementation
preserves the reasons an answer was ambiguous, refused or unavailable.


47.10      Servicing decisions: intervention histories and net value
The policy functional in equation (47.1) becomes operationally useful only when its histories
have a banking interpretation. Consider an initial servicing contact A0 , a subsequent distress
indicator L1 , and a second contact A1 . An initial contact can prevent distress; distress can
prompt a second contact; and both contacts incur costs. A request to compare “contacted
and uncontacted customers” conceals all three relations. It also conceals whether the analyst
wants the value of a fixed history, a rule that responds to distress, or a policy learned from
the same observations. These are different inferential requests. An assistant can make the
alternatives explicit and translate the selected request into a rule. Its interpretation remains
reviewable against the business decision.
    The following mechanism is stipulated for an independent exact reference; its numbers are
illustrative USD per account, not observations from a bank Causal banking proposal (2026ar).
There is no baseline covariate in this small law. The first action has probability 1/2, and the
state transitions satisfy

   Compare three fixed, feasible policies. The no-contact policy sets both actions to zero. The
treat-all policy sets both to one. The risk-responsive policy sets A0 = 1 and A1 = L1 . Its

state distribution. This decomposition explains why a recovery lift alone is insufficient for the
business decision. A contact can improve gross recovery while its marginal net contribution is
negative in a low-risk state.
   Two plausible shortcuts answer different questions. Restricting the observed data to histories
that happen to follow the risk policy gives mean 93, because the two retained states have equal
conditional frequency. Restricting to histories with both actions zero gives 220/3, because
distress changes the chance of avoiding the second contact. The unweighted difference is
therefore 59/3, rather than 134/5. Alternatively, averaging the risk-policy outcome under the
pooled distress frequency 3/5 yields 91.2. That calculation holds the mediator distribution
at its observational mixture, rather than allowing the first intervention to change it. Neither
error is repaired by producing an explanation of a correctly computed mean. The assistant’s
most valuable intervention is to detect the target substitution before numerical execution.

                            mg (H1 ) = m{H1 , g1 (H1 )},

Then V (g) = E[Q0 (L0 )] under the stated longitudinal identification conditions. Backward out-
come regression implements these successive conditional expectations. Forward g-computation
models the state transition and outcome, then propagates the regime through both. Inverse-
probability weighting instead uses

                          1{A0 = g0 (L0 )}                    1{A1 = g1 (H1 )}
                w0 =                           ,    w1 =                           ,
                       P {A0 = g0 (L0 ) | L0 }             P {A1 = g1 (H1 ) | H1 }

for which E[w0 w1 Y ] = V (g). All three representations use the intervention’s history. They
differ in which nuisance quantities must be estimated and in their behavior when data are
sparse, weights are variable, or a regression extrapolates. The choice should follow the declared
target and its supported histories, rather than the name of a preferred package.


47.11      Retention, recursive augmentation and uncertainty
The outcome may become unavailable when an account moves to another servicing system or
its case is unresolved. Let R indicate that Y is observed at the final horizon. To identify the
834                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


same full-population value, suppose R ⊥ Y | H1 , A1 , with r(H1 , A1 ) = P (R = 1 | H1 , A1 ) > 0
on the regime’s support. This is a final-outcome missingness law. If earlier histories also
disappear, their observation mechanisms require additional nodes and weights; the single R
does not silently represent them. Nor does administrative censoring justify this conditional
independence merely because its date is recorded Hernán and Robins (2020).
   In the stipulated servicing law, let retention be one for L1 = 0 and one half for L1 =
1, independently of the outcome given history. Among retained accounts under the risk
intervention, the mean becomes
                               (3/5)102 + (2/5)(1/2)84
                                                       = 97.5.
                                   3/5 + (2/5)(1/2)

Inverse retention weights restore the intervention value 94.8. Multiplying w0 w1 by R/r also
restores it in the observational enumeration. The complete-case mean is higher because
distressed accounts are less often retained, not because servicing became more effective. A
fluent report that describes 97.5 as a population policy value would obscure an observation-law
error. Conversely, if loss depends on an unobserved recovery component even after conditioning,
these weights have no such causal justification. The appropriate output is a sensitivity analysis
or unresolved population value, not a fabricated retention probability.
  An augmented representation shows where the pieces enter. With the true nuisance
quantities, a centered score for this two-action, final-retention problem is
                                      R
                     ϕg (O) = w0 w1            {Y − m(H1 , A1 )}
                                   r(H1 , A1 )
                              + w0 {mg (H1 ) − Q0 (L0 )} + Q0 (L0 ) − V (g).               (47.2)

The first residual has conditional mean zero under the observation law. The second has
mean zero conditional on L0 after first-action reweighting. The last term centers the baseline
regression. Where R = 0, the first term is defined as zero; it does not require an unavailable
value of Y . This mean-zero argument is a population identity. A fitted estimator needs control
of nuisance errors and remainder terms, a valid sampling law, and the appropriate handling of
sample splitting. The display does not establish coverage simply by being called an influence
function.
   The exact law isolates one aspect of precision. Its outcome is deterministic given history
and it has no varying L0 . The first and last components in equation (47.2) vanish, leaving
variation from the intermediate state. Under independent accounts, the risk-policy score has
variance 3888/25 = 155.52; the no-contact score has variance 512. Their covariance is zero
here because their nonzero first-action indicators are disjoint and both scores are centered.
The variance of their difference is consequently 16688/25 = 667.52. A normalized policy-IPW
estimator with true weights has asymptotic centered score w0 w1 {Y − V (g)} when there is no
retention loss. Its variance is 248.832 for the risk policy and 1228.8 for no contact. These are
exact moments under the declared law Causal banking proposal (2026ar). They explain how
recursive adjustment can remove second-action sampling variation in this example. They do
not rank fitted procedures under arbitrary bank dependence or qualify any confidence interval.
   Robustness requires equally precise terminology. Luedtke and colleagues distinguish con-
ventional longitudinal double robustness, requiring all outcome components or all treatment
components to be correct in the relevant sense, from sequential double robustness, allowing
the appropriate component to be correct at each stage Luedtke et al. (2018). Their definitions
distinguish outcome-regression specification from treatment-mechanism consistency. A point-
treatment AIPW function placed inside a loop does not inherit their recursive construction
or its theorem. An assistant recommending a “doubly robust longitudinal estimator” should
47.12. Branch adoption is a panel question with a different target                           835


therefore identify the actual algorithm and its conditions, rather than treating robustness
as a universal package property. The safe comparison includes a transparent fixed-regime
g-formula, an IP-weighted representation, and an estimator whose longitudinal construction is
genuinely supported by primary text.
   Support is a property of the policy’s histories, not only a histogram of the first propensity.
An initially supported contact can lead to a distressed state where the requested later action
is never taken. Product probabilities can also become very small although each decision
separately looks tolerable. Weight truncation may improve numerical behavior while changing
bias and the effective comparison. Diagnostics should show where weights concentrate, which
histories disappear, and how the result changes under a declared sensitivity choice. A regime
that requires a forbidden or unavailable contact should be returned for redesign. A new policy
learned after inspecting the same outcomes introduces selection and policy-learning questions
beyond the fixed-policy arithmetic above. Its apparent best value cannot be reported with a
fixed-regime interval without a separate argument.


47.12       Branch adoption is a panel question with a different
            target
Suppose branches adopt a servicing platform at different dates and the bank asks whether the
platform improves recovery. This differs from evaluating the account-level dynamic contact
rule. Let Gi be branch i’s first adoption time, Yit (g) its outcome at time t if adoption begins
at g, and Yit (∞) the outcome without adoption. A useful target is

                      ATT(g, t) = E[Yit (g) − Yit (∞) | Gi = g],         t ≥ g.

The unit, adoption event, composition of branch accounts, and monetary outcome must be
fixed before estimation. A decline in average loss among remaining accounts could arise from
account transfers rather than an improvement for the original cohort. A repeated cross-section
and a stable account panel therefore need different observation arguments. Arkhangelsky and
Imbens organize panel methods by data configuration, relative numbers of units and periods,
and treatment assignment patterns; this organization helps avoid selecting a method solely
because the table has a date column Arkhangelsky and Imbens (2024).
  With no anticipation and an appropriate never-treated comparison group C, unconditional
parallel untreated trends over the relevant periods identify

                             ATT(g, t) = E[Yit − Yi,g−1 | Gi = g]
                                           − E[Yit − Yi,g−1 | Ci = 1].

Conditional parallel trends instead require comparing changes at the relevant baseline covariates
X and averaging over the adopting cohort’s covariate distribution, with overlap for that
comparison. Callaway and Sant’Anna also develop not-yet-treated comparisons and explicit
anticipation windows Callaway and Sant’Anna (2021). For an anticipation horizon δ, the
baseline must precede g − δ, and a comparison group must still be unaffected at the relevant
later time including its anticipation window. A branch preparing for rollout can change staffing
before formal adoption; the recorded software installation date alone does not establish no
anticipation.
   The comparison choice carries substantive assumptions. Never-treated branches may operate
in different markets. Not-yet-treated branches may be more similar but supply no untreated
comparison after the last adoption, and their rollout plans may already affect behavior. Both
designs require an argument about untreated changes, rather than the stronger sequential
836                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


exchangeability of an account-level dynamic policy. The analyst must state which argument is
being used. An assistant can locate adoption notices, reconstruct candidate dates, and propose
competing controls. It cannot establish the unobserved untreated trend from a satisfactory
regression fit.
  A small stipulated panel makes these distinctions visible Causal banking proposal (2026ar).
There are three equal-sized cohorts, early adopters E, late adopters L, and never adopters N .
Their observed means are

                                Cohort Time 0 Time 1 Time 2
                                Early        100       107      119
                                Late         100       102      108
                                Never        100       102      104

The stipulated untreated means are 100, 102, and 104 for every cohort. Early adoption has
effects five at time 1 and fifteen at time 2; late adoption has effect four at time 2. Comparing
early and never cohorts from time 0 to time 1 gives five; from time 0 to time 2 gives fifteen.
Comparing late and never cohorts from time 1 to time 2 gives four. In contrast, comparing
the late cohort’s change to the already-treated early cohort’s change gives

                                (108 − 102) − (119 − 107) = −6.

The early cohort’s treatment effect increases by ten during that comparison. The negative
difference therefore subtracts another group’s changing effect from the late cohort’s benefit. It
is not evidence that the platform harms late adopters.
   Aggregation also changes the question. Equal weighting of the three treated cohort-time
cells gives (5 + 15 + 4)/3 = 8. Equal weighting of the two cohorts at their first exposure
gives (5 + 4)/2 = 4.5. The first includes a later-exposure effect for early adopters; the second
compares a common event horizon. Other bank questions may weight cohort sizes, account
exposure, or the distribution of dates in a proposed rollout. These weights must be stated.
In this particular balanced fixture, residualizing the adoption indicator against cohort and
calendar effects produces a two-way fixed-effects coefficient of 4.5: the early time-2 cell has
zero residual weight and the other treated cells have equal positive weights. It happens to
equal the first-exposure target here. The contaminated two-group comparison does not imply
that every fixed-effects coefficient is negative or scientifically useless. The exact residualization
and the survey’s qualified discussion both argue for inspecting the target and weights, rather
than adopting a universal rejection of fixed effects Arkhangelsky and Imbens (2024); Causal
banking proposal (2026ar).
   Observational ambiguity remains even after this algebra is correct. Suppose the early
cohort’s untreated outcome at time 2 is 107 because it receives a cohort-specific favorable
shock of three, and its actual treatment effect is twelve. The observed value remains 119, and
every other displayed value is unchanged. The first law’s effect fifteen and the alternative
law’s effect twelve are compatible with the same observed panel. The alternative violates the
relevant post-adoption parallel untreated trend. Additional common pre-adoption periods can
be appended to both laws without distinguishing them. Good pre-adoption agreement is a
useful diagnostic; it does not exclude every later counterfactual shock. A bank may need a
rollout assignment design, a defensible control, or explicit sensitivity to such shocks before
attaching a causal interpretation to the contrast.
   Synthetic control and factor-based alternatives are substantive when the bank has few
treated units, rich histories, and a credible structure for untreated outcomes. They do not
automatically solve an unsupported counterfactual: donor contamination, a new factor after
47.13. Observation construction can determine the answer                                      837


rollout, or a change in measurement can defeat their argument. The panel survey motivates
these alternatives without asserting a particular bank guarantee Arkhangelsky and Imbens
(2024). The assistant’s proposal should connect each candidate to the data dimensions and
assignment pattern, identify which restriction supplies its counterfactual, and retain uncertainty
about that restriction. A dynamic servicing value should not be silently substituted for a
branch adoption ATT merely because both methods return a monetary number.


47.13      Observation construction can determine the answer
The preceding values assume that accounts and outcomes have been correctly assembled.
A causal workflow should instead begin with the population frame, inclusion mechanism,
ownership relation, and label meaning. An assistant extracting “recovery” from notes may
confuse gross recovery with net value, or a revised figure with the figure available at the
decision. Linking two accounts to a customer may change the unit, create duplicated outcomes,
and alter dependence at once. These changes belong to the scientific observation model. A
schema that accepts the resulting rows does not establish their truth.
  Consider a frame containing two equally frequent strata with values zero and 100. Suppose
every zero-value unit is included but each 100-value unit is included independently with
probability 1/4. Writing S for inclusion, the mean among observed records is

                              E[SY ]      (1/2)(1/4)100
                                     =                     = 20.
                               E[S]    (1/2)1 + (1/2)(1/4)

The population mean is 50. If the frame size N and truthful inclusion probabilities πi are
known, the Horvitz–Thompson form
                                                  N
                                               1 X  Si Yi
                                       µ
                                       bHT =
                                               N i=1 πi

has expectation 50 under the stipulated sampling law. This uses the known frame denominator;
a ratio estimator with an estimated denominator is a different construction. For independently
generated framed units, the per-unit weighted contribution is zero or 400. Its variance is
20000 − 502 = 17500, so the mean’s variance is 17500/N Causal banking proposal (2026ar).
Correcting selection can therefore increase uncertainty even while restoring the target. A
narrow unweighted interval around 20 does not constitute a more precise estimate of 50.
   The correction requires knowledge that an LLM cannot manufacture. If inclusion probabili-
ties are estimated from an incomplete frame, depend on an unknown outcome component, or
are zero for a relevant group, the displayed equality need not apply. Retrieving a description
of the sampling system can identify a candidate probability model; an actual audit must
establish that it was followed. When the target is an intervention mean, treatment, retention,
sampling, and linkage cannot simply be handled as unrelated cleaning steps. Their joint
chronology determines which histories and outcomes are observed and which probabilities can
be conditioned on. The longitudinal observation intervention discussed by Hernán and Robins
supplies a model-based way to formulate that joint problem Hernán and Robins (2020).
   Noisy labels pose a separate problem. Let T be a true binary ownership or distress label, Z
its observed classifier label, p = P (T = 1), sensitivity s = P (Z = 1 | T = 1) and specificity
c = P (Z = 0 | T = 0). If these error rates are known for the target population, then

                                                             P (Z = 1) + c − 1
                 P (Z = 1) = sp + (1 − c)(1 − p),       p=                     .
                                                                 s+c−1
838                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


With p = 0.4, s = 0.8 and c = 0.9, the positive-label frequency is 0.38 and the inversion
returns 0.4. If s + c = 1, the observed label frequency contains no information about prevalence
through this model. Close to that boundary, sampling noise is amplified by the denominator.
With known rates and n independent labels in this example, the inverted proportion has
variance (589/1225)/n before any probability-bound handling Causal banking proposal (2026ar).
Estimating the error rates from a gold-label sample adds uncertainty. Reusing one error-rate
estimate across many account records also introduces shared estimation error; multiplying the
number of rows does not make that component disappear.
  This inversion concerns a marginal prevalence, not a causal effect or an individual ownership
map. Errors can differ by treatment, history, market or time, and two competing customer
mappings can have the same correctness count. A prevalence correction does not reconstruct
which record belongs to which economic owner. For causal use, the workflow must retain the
candidate mapping and how its uncertainty affects exposure, outcome and unit formation. An
LLM can propose label rules and flag contradictory notes; the proposal should compare that
assistance with deterministic rules and human adjudication on genuinely reviewed examples.
Agreement between two assistants exposed to the same notes is not an independent gold label.
Missing truth is an evidence limitation, rather than a reason to replace adjudication with
confidence in generated prose.
   Dependence can survive correct inclusion and label handling. Let B independent branches
each have a centered shock εb of variance one, shared by two account records. Their overall
account mean is B −1 b εb , with variance 1/B. Treating the 2B rows as independent instead
                       P

gives 1/(2B). Now add a centered calendar shock C of variance four shared by every branch,
independently of their shocks. The mean’s variance is 4 + 1/B. More accounts or branches
reduce only the second component. This is an exact covariance construction Causal banking
proposal (2026ar), not a universal banking variance model. It shows why account counts alone
cannot justify precision and why a common calendar component needs replicated dates or
additional restrictions. Splitting nuisance training and evaluation by independent branch can
protect one dependence boundary; it cannot remove the shared calendar shock. The sampling
and covariance argument must follow the intended deployment and observation law.


47.14      What assistance and software reuse can responsibly
           achieve
These three pathways suggest distinct roles for an assistant. In sequential servicing, it can
translate a verbal rule into a decision-time history, locate post-action variables, and ask why
assignment and retention are conditionally ignorable. In a branch rollout, it can distinguish
cohort time from event time, construct candidate comparison groups, and expose anticipation or
account composition changes. In observation construction, it can extract candidate definitions
and mappings while retaining conflicting evidence and unavailable truth. A generic request
to “run causal inference” is insufficient for all three. The proposed product should make the
pathway and its resulting target visible to the analyst before selecting an estimator.
   The point-in-time OCI workflow demonstrates a narrower literature precedent: an ac-
countable human principal, actor/critic assistance, reproducible notebooks, cross-fitted AIPW
and overlap diagnostics under supplied unconfoundedness OCI paper (2026). It supports
discussion of human oversight and point-treatment workflow. It does not establish sequential
exchangeability, identify a rollout counterfactual, or qualify ownership reconstruction. These
are candidate extensions requiring the corresponding scientific and numerical arguments. A
reviewer should be able to see whether the assistant asks for the missing premise, changes the
47.15. How estimated components can change a sequential value                                  839


target explicitly, or refuses the requested interpretation. An apparently complete notebook
can still be wrong if its target differs from the business question.
   The inspected R package ltmle offers a more directly relevant longitudinal com-
ponent: treatment/censoring-specific means, dynamic treatment rules and outcome-
regression/weighting outputs joshuaschwab contributors (2026). Its interface uses column
order to encode model chronology and binary treatment nodes. An adapter would need to
validate the actual event and availability clocks before constructing that order. A continuous
contact dose cannot be passed as though it were binary without an explicit intervention
redesign. Absorbing event coding is appropriate for a one-time event only when its semantics
are actually absorbing. Automatically truncating net outcomes at a declared range can
alter the quantity being averaged, whereas a known affine scaling can be reversed for an
intervention mean. These interface choices have scientific consequences, rather than merely
formatting consequences. The saved source inspection motivates restricted reuse; it is not an
execution or qualification of the package in a bank setting.
  A matched baseline is an analyst using explicit decision interviews, a graph editor, and
deterministic estimation software with the same sources and information budget. Assistance
should be assessed on preserved targets, unsupported assumptions, actual tool completion,
accurate uncertainty, and review effort. Comparisons should include unavailable histories,
unsupported actions, contaminated controls, missing frames, and labels without gold truth.
An appropriate unresolved answer may be more valuable than a confidently generated estimate.
Genuine improvement would mean reducing analyst effort while preserving those decisions
and making more errors detectable, rather than increasing the number of successful-looking
reports.
   The immediate prototype can use the finite mechanisms above and suitable public panels to
test those transformations economically. Known synthetic truth tests target preservation and
numerical arithmetic; a public observed panel tests the discipline of stating a counterfactual
without supplying its truth by construction. A later bank experiment must resolve the actual
assignment, observation, operating-cost and acceptance questions. The proposal can justify
that experiment through its scoped comparisons and explicit failure modes. It cannot replace
the experiment’s missing evidence with the existence of an agent architecture.


47.15      How estimated components can change a sequential value
The exact score moments above assume the true conditional quantities. A prototype must also
make visible what happens when its fitted components are wrong. This is particularly relevant
when an assistant chooses a regression, uses an estimated assignment model, and presents the
resulting augmented calculation as automatically protected against bias. Double robustness is
a property of a specified construction under specified conditions. It is not a guarantee that
any two imperfect components cancel each other.
   Consider the same fixed risk policy, without retention loss or baseline variation. Let p0 be
the observational probability of its first action and p1 (l) the probability of its required second
action at state l. These are probabilities of following the rule: when the rule requests zero,
p1 (l) is the probability of action zero. Let pe0 and pe1 (l) be fixed positive approximations, and
define
                                          p0                 p1 (l)
                                    ρ0 = ,         ρ1 (l) =          .
                                          pe0                pe1 (l)
Write m e g (l) = mg (l) + d(l) and qe = V (g) + η. The last quantity is an approximation to
the first-stage regression; it need not equal the average of m
                                                             e g under the true transition law.

Replace the quantities in equation (47.2) by these fixed approximations and add V (g) to obtain
an uncentered augmented value Z.  e Conditioning successively on the action history gives

                           E[Z]

Here Eg averages over the state law after the regime’s first action. Subtracting V (g) yields

This is a project derivation for this restricted two-stage law, independently checked by enu-
