the general sequential robustness theorem discussed by Luedtke and colleagues Luedtke et al.
(2018).
   The identity separates two errors with different histories. Correct action probabilities at
both stages make the right side zero. Correct outcome quantities at both stages also make
it zero. Other combinations can make it zero, but only by satisfying the displayed stage
conditions. If d = 0 while both ρ0 ̸= 1 and η ̸= 0, correctness of the final outcome model alone
does not remove the first-stage product. Conversely, a correct first-action probability does not
remove a second-stage treatment/outcome product. Fitting two separate models and calling
one of them a critic has no bearing on these conditions.
   For a concrete failure, use the servicing law’s p0 = 1/2, approximate it by pe0 = 2/5, and set
qe = V (g) + 3. In the low-distress state the rule requires action zero with true and approximated
probability 1/2. In the distressed state it requires action one with true probability 3/4 and
approximated probability 1/2. Let d(0) = 0 and d(1) = 5. Then ρ0 = 5/4, and the second
product averaged under the regime is (2/5)(1 − 3/2)5 = −1. The total bias is

                                 (1 − 5/4)3 + (5/4)(−1) = −2.

The augmented mean becomes 92.8 instead of 94.8. Enumeration of the weighted residual,
intermediate regression and final scalar separately gives the same answer. Restoring both
assignment probabilities restores 94.8 despite these outcome errors; restoring both outcome
components also restores it despite the assignment errors. These are population identities
with fixed approximations, not fitted-estimator performance results Causal banking proposal
(2026as).
   There is also a quantitative diagnostic. With square-integrable components under the
regime’s state law, Cauchy–Schwarz gives

                      |E[Z]
                         e − V (g)| ≤ |1 − ρ0 | |η| + ρ0 ∥1 − ρ1 ∥2,g ∥d∥2,g .

Lower bounds on approximated treatment probabilities are relevant because they control the
ratios; weak support can amplify small absolute propensity errors. The bound does not supply
observable values of the unknown errors. It explains which approximations must be justified,
and why predictive fit alone need not settle the causal quantity.
   For nuisance quantities trained on an independent sample, the fixed-component calculation
can be read conditionally on that training sample. A familiar route to root-n inference requires
the bias products to be op (n−1/2 ), appropriate convergence of the centered score, and a valid
limit law for its sampling unit. Each requirement needs its own argument; sample splitting
alone proves none of them. Under the   p independent-account, known-law construction above,
the contrast’s standard-error scale is 667.52/n. A normal planning multiplier of 1.96 would
47.16. Conditional panel comparisons must preserve cohort composition                            841


require at least 4007 accounts to make its planning half-width no greater than USD 0.8. This is
arithmetic using the known-law variance, not a claimed achieved confidence interval, a selected
trial size, or a bank precision commitment Causal banking proposal (2026as). Dependence,
estimated components and rare histories can invalidate that planning scale. Increasing the
account count does not remove the fixed bias of two in the preceding example.
   The assistant should therefore keep the causal target, fitted components, training boundary,
covariance unit and approximation status together. It can flag a mistaken probability of action
one when the policy requests zero, propose checks of each stage, and compare a transparent
fixed-regime calculation. An unavailable rate argument remains an uncertainty limitation even
when the numerical value is finite. A report should explain that limitation before turning the
point estimate into a recommendation.


47.16       Conditional panel comparisons must preserve cohort
            composition
The preceding panel example used identical untreated trends across cohorts. Conditional
parallel trends allow a different situation: branches with the same baseline covariates have
comparable untreated changes, while adopting and control branches have different covariate
compositions. Pooling their changes without standardization can then answer the wrong
question even though the conditional design is valid. Callaway and Sant’Anna’s identifica-
tion representations average the conditional comparison over the adopting group’s covariate
distribution Callaway and Sant’Anna (2021).
  Here is an independent stipulated two-period example in USD per account Causal banking
proposal (2026as). Let X distinguish two branch markets, and suppose three quarters of
adopting branches have X = 1, compared with one quarter of never-adopting controls. At
X = 0, the untreated change is two and the adoption effect is four. At X = 1, those quantities
are ten and eight. Within each market the untreated change is identical for adopting and
control branches; no anticipation and stable composition are stipulated. The target is the
adopting cohort’s average treatment effect,
                                     ATT = 14 (4) + 43 (8) = 7.
The adopting cohort’s observed average change is 14 (2 + 4) + 34 (10 + 8) = 15. The pooled
control change is 34 (2) + 14 (10) = 4. Their unadjusted difference is eleven, overstating the target
by four. The difference is caused by unequal market composition, not by a violation of the
stipulated conditional trends.
   Outcome standardization instead computes the control change under the adopting composi-
tion: 14 (2) + 34 (10) = 8. Subtracting it from fifteen restores seven. Weighting supplies a second
representation. Suppose the two cohorts have equal population mass, so the propensity to
belong to the adopting cohort is e(0) = 1/4 and e(1) = 3/4. Control weights proportional to
e(X)/{1 − e(X)} are 1/3 and three. Their control-group average is one, and their weighted
change is                                  
                                        3 1         1
                                        4 3 2 + 4 (3)10 = 8.
The weights reconstruct the adopting covariate distribution. They are cohort-comparison
weights, rather than the probabilities of following a two-action account policy. The corre-
sponding target and observation clocks must remain distinct when an assistant selects an
API.
  If market X = 1 has no untreated controls, this representation cannot be evaluated from
the stipulated comparison without extrapolation or another restriction. Dropping that market
842                                                                    Causal analysis for a universal bank


changes the target from seven to four; silently describing the retained-market result as the
original ATT would replace the business question. Matching, regression and weighting should
therefore be compared on their supported target, not merely on whether each returns a
coefficient. Adding a covariate measured after platform adoption can also change the scientific
argument; the baseline market variable here does not justify adjustment for any convenient
post-adoption metric.
   For an illustrative deployment cost of six per adopting account, the identified gross effect of
seven leaves a net margin of one. The pooled difference of eleven would suggest five. These are
planning values under stipulated truth and cost, with no fitted uncertainty or bank ROI claim
Causal banking proposal (2026as). They show why composition and support checks matter to
the investment proposal: a target error can dominate a modest economic margin even when
every arithmetic step and generated explanation appears convincing.


47.17      From language-assisted collaboration to adaptive servic-
           ing
A bank considering language-assisted servicing faces two related decisions. An analyst may
ask an assistant to formulate and evaluate a contact policy; the contact itself may also contain
model-generated language. In the first case, the assistant changes the analysis workflow. In
the second, it changes the intervention delivered to a customer. A successful analysis assistant
does not establish the effectiveness of the resulting message, and an effective writing strategy
does not establish a sound policy evaluator. The distinction determines what the proposed
product should estimate, which public evidence is relevant, and what an inexpensive prototype
must resolve.
   The sequential servicing construction in Section 47.10 already gives a formal baseline for a
fixed policy with treatment–confounder feedback. Here the question is whether the available
language-model literature and software preserve that target. Consider eligible accounts at their
first servicing decision. The proposed comparison is the expected thirty-day net cash recovery
under two specified contact rules, including contact costs. Follow-up ends at a common
horizon; sale, transfer, default and missing recovery need distinct definitions. A default state is
absorbing only if the economic outcome and action rules make it so. Evaluation of a fixed rule,
learning a rule, and constructing an interval for the value of a selected rule require different
statistical arguments.
   Let Hk contain the baseline, previous delivered actions and information available before
decision k. An event timestamp is insufficient: an event on day seven that arrives on day nine is
unavailable for a day-eight rule. The assistant can propose this history and explain exclusions,
but the decision clock must be enforced by deterministic validation. Let Ak = gk (Hk ) be a
fixed deterministic action rule, and let K be the last decision index. With complete observation,
a discrete representation is

                             X                             K−1
                                                           Y
                   V (g) =        m{hK , gK (hK )}p(l0 )         p{lk+1 | hk , gk (hk )}.           (47.4)
                             l̄                            k=0

Here m(hK , aK ) is the conditional expected net outcome. Each history in the sum contains the
actions already generated by g, and each later action must be recomputed from that generated
history. Integrals replace sums for continuous states. Consistency, sequential exchangeability,
support for the rule and a justified observation law give this expression its causal meaning. A
fitted transition model supplies a numerical approximation; it cannot supply those premises.
47.17. From language-assisted collaboration to adaptive servicing                              843


The earlier retention and augmented-score development remains the appropriate baseline when
outcomes disappear (Hernán and Robins, 2020).


47.17.1     What the direct collaboration literature establishes

Zhang and colleagues’ CausalCollab is a direct precedent for causal analysis of sequential human–
language-model interaction (Zhang et al., 2024a). Human refinements are treatments, model
replies are evolving states, and an evaluated final text is the outcome. The paper recognizes
that a particular text string is often an inappropriate intervention across different contexts. It
instead defines an Incremental Stylistic Effect, or ISE, through a lower-dimensional function of
the refinement and its history. Its equation (2) averages over text versions conditional on the
specified style and history. Its equation (1) then takes a limiting difference for an infinitesimal
style shift. Theorem 1 identifies that target under the paper’s sequential exchangeability and
positivity conditions.
   This construction is useful for the proposal because it makes the intervention’s versions
explicit. It does not establish that any embedding has sufficient causal information, that
every desired style is supported in every banking history, or that an arbitrary new generator
implements the same conditional version mixture. Knowing that a text can be rewritten more
formally does not demonstrate that the required intervention has historical support among
accounts subject to the same eligibility, communication and distress conditions. Likewise, a
recorded conversation can omit a human’s private judgement, an earlier unlogged contact
or information from another channel. An LLM’s description of the history cannot establish
sequential exchangeability in their presence.
   Algorithm 1 proposes learning style representations with a conditional variational autoen-
coder, fitting an outcome model and evaluating the functional with Monte Carlo calculations.
The empirical evaluation uses rebuilt interaction datasets, generated counterfactual refinements
and outcome labels, and a constructed confounding split. Table 2 reports a meaningful but
qualified tradeoff. For CoAuthor at α = 0.2, no adjustment gives mean squared errors 0.188 on
observational examples and 0.353 on counterfactual examples; G-E plus CVAE gives 0.216 and
0.219. The counterfactual error falls while the observational error rises. These are averages
over three seeds with reported standard deviations, not causal interval coverage measurements
or a uniform superiority result. PCA and CVAE yield similar counterfactual errors in the
table, so the method name does not by itself justify extra complexity. The text labels and
counterfactual generation procedures define the experiment’s truth construction; they do not
constitute observed customer cash outcomes (Zhang et al., 2024a).
   The authors explicitly leave optimal collaboration strategies to future work. Their ethical
discussion also says that the rebuilt datasets are for research and cannot be redistributed.
Consequently, the public code and dataset links do not establish a permitted product training
corpus. This paper supports a conditional text-intervention target and a promising research
example. It supplies neither a generally qualified longitudinal policy learner nor evidence of
bank deployment.


47.17.2     A style intervention needs a version distribution

For a one-step illustration, let S = s denote a style and T the actual message. A proposed
intervention kernel q(t | s, h) specifies which version is delivered in history h. Writing the
version-specific conditional outcome as m(t, h), its value takes the form
                                         X          X
                              Vq (s) =       p(h)       m(t, h)q(t | s, h).
                                         h          t
844                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


This is an authored simplification used to explain the deployment contract; it does not
replace the paper’s longitudinal definition. If two messages have the same style but different
consequences, changing q changes the intervention even when s is unchanged. Suppose their
stipulated gross values are 120 and 60 dollars and either message costs eight dollars. A
historical mixture assigning probability 3/4 to the first version has value

                                  (3/4)120 + (1/4)60 − 8 = 97.

A generator assigning probability 1/4 to that version has value 67. The thirty-dollar difference
comes entirely from the version mixture. The example is reproducible arithmetic, not a
measured language effect (Causal banking proposal, 2026bh).
   There are several substantive remedies. The bank can freeze a finite template set and
its randomized assignment law, retain the complete message as part of the intervention, or
define and validate a history-dependent generation kernel. An assumption that outcomes
depend on style alone would also remove version dependence in this example, but it is a strong
scientific restriction, not a benefit obtained merely by compressing text. Changing a model,
prompt, retrieval source or decoding rule can change the kernel. A product proposal should
therefore bind those identities to the policy comparison and explain how a later version would
be reevaluated.
   Locality creates another boundary. Suppose a stipulated gross response curve is v(s) =
100 + 20s − 40s2 . At s = 0, its derivative is positive: v ′ (0) = 20 dollars per style unit. Moving
to s = 1 nevertheless changes gross value by −20; after an eight-dollar deployment cost, the
finite net change is −28. An infinitesimal effect cannot be reported as the gain from that finite
change without an additional response and cost argument (Causal banking proposal, 2026bh).
For banking use, the assistant should distinguish a local diagnostic from a decision over feasible
message versions and doses. It should expose that difference before recommending an action.


47.17.3     The published code’s actual statistical path

The public CausalCollab repository at the inspected June 2024 revision provides a research
script with a useful, bounded implementation path (XMUBQ/dtr-text, 2024). Its caller
dispatches to a logistic outcome model, optional treatment representations, a learned last-state
mean and generated-state predictions. The default action count is two. In cal_g_estimate,
the code samples baseline embeddings from a training bank, retains the supplied action or style
embeddings, and replaces the last state with generated draws before predicting the outcome.
Earlier nonbaseline states are retained from the input. There is no call in this path that
recomputes the next action as a function of each newly generated history. This is a precise
limitation on reuse as an adaptive servicing evaluator; it is not evidence that the authors
claimed to implement such a banking evaluator.
   The last-state sampler uses a fitted conditional mean and Normal noise with default standard
deviation one. That choice is a model for the embedding distribution, not a universal transition
or residual law. The CVAE path sets its KL weight to zero; the inherited loss backpropagates
reconstruction error plus that weight times the KL term. The inspected encoder and decoder are
linear, with stochastic latent sampling. Thus an adapter cannot infer a particular regularized
latent model merely from the label CVAE. It must bind the actual objective, representation and
sampling configuration. The output path writes observed and constructed-counterfactual class
probabilities, the columns gE0 and gE1, and MSE comparisons. The inspected caller-to-output
path does not expose an explicit δ → 0 derivative calculation or a confidence interval. This
is a path-specific source finding; no claim is made about unseen external experiments or a
package-wide impossibility (XMUBQ/dtr-text, 2024).
47.17. From language-assisted collaboration to adaptive servicing                            845


   Several engineering conditions follow directly. The README’s example spells the representa-
tion option CVAE, while dispatch uses cVAE; a proposed wrapper should validate the enumeration
before execution. Importing the utility module requests unrevisioned bert-base-uncased
weights and unconditionally moves the feature model to CUDA after an earlier CPU branch.
An integration would need explicit device selection, pinned model artifacts and an intentional
acquisition boundary. Shuffled row folds do not group by the participant or topic IDs retained
by the loader. If participants, households or calendar shocks span rows, that split does not
support an independence claim. The appropriate grouping and time holdout must follow the
deployment population; their impact was not measured by this source inspection.
   The nontruncated repository tree contains no root license, dependency lock, package setup
or test suite. These observations leave reuse rights, installation closure and maintenance
responsibility unresolved. Twenty-two original blobs, including the README and selected
caller, loader, loss and output paths, were verified against the pinned tree. Other dataset
loaders and installed dependency behavior remain outside this inspection. No source import
or upstream experiment was executed. The proposed decision is reference use pending rights
and prototype qualification. An independent implementation of the mathematical baseline
is a viable alternative, with its own attribution, review and maintenance obligations; public
visibility alone establishes neither copying nor redistribution permission.


47.17.4     Recomputing actions changes the banking answer

The servicing law makes the missing recursion concrete. Hold the initial action at A0 = 1, so
P (L1 = 1) = 2/5, and use the already specified net outcome

                                Y = 102 − 40L1 + (30L1 − 8)A1 .

The adaptive rule A1 = L1 yields 102 in the low-distress state and 84 in the high-distress state,
giving V = 94.8. Suppose a hypothetical converter instead draws an action with the correct
marginal probability 2/5, independently of the newly generated distress state. Its value is

                          102 − 40(2/5) + (2/5){30(2/5) − 8} = 87.6.

The loss of feedback changes value by 7.2 dollars per account. Relative to making no second
contact, whose value is 86 with this same first action, the adaptive gain is 8.8 while the
independent-action gain is only 1.6. Matching action frequencies does not preserve a dynamic
intervention. Exact enumeration and separate backward and factorized calculations agree on
these quantities (Causal banking proposal, 2026bh).
   This is a project-authored counterexample to the hypothetical conversion, not an observed
output of CausalCollab. Its purpose is to define an acceptance case. A proposed adapter must
regenerate H1 , call g1 on that history, retain the resulting action, and propagate the complete
trajectory to the outcome. For more stages, it must repeat those steps. It should agree with
exact enumeration on small finite laws and with a separately implemented backward recursion.
A stochastic policy also needs its conditional action probabilities and controlled random draws.
Padding a fixed vector of actions or reusing factual future actions is insufficient.
   Support may fail before any numerical discrepancy appears. If each of four required
actions has conditional logging probability 0.1 along the policy history, the complete matching
path has probability 0.0001. For 10,000 independent trajectories, the expected matching
count is one and the probability of none is approximately 0.367861. Adding independent
retention probability 0.8 at each step gives an expected complete matching count of 0.4096
and a zero-count probability of approximately 0.663910 (Causal banking proposal, 2026bh).
These are planning calculations under stipulated probabilities, not an estimate of a particular
846                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


method’s variance. Outcome-model structure may permit borrowing across histories; that adds
assumptions and does not create missing randomized evidence. Restricting the rule, changing
the target population, collecting more informative data or proposing a limited experiment are
substantive responses. Silently clipping large weights can change the statistical object without
resolving the original support question.

47.17.5    Related frontiers and the limits of transfer

The medical causal co-pilot roadmap by Alaa and colleagues helps organize eligibility, treatment,
follow-up, assumptions and accountable human review. It explicitly discusses time-varying
exposure and the danger of convincing but wrong estimands; illustrative responses are not a
qualified sequential estimator (Alaa et al., 2024). The OCI workflow supplies a more concrete
precedent for reproducible analysis and human supervision, including point-treatment designs
and multiple simultaneous treatments through partially linear models. Its simultaneous-
treatment extension does not supply the evolving history recursion required here (Chou et al.,
2026). These sources motivate an assistant that records alternatives, identifies missing premises
and hands a reviewed target to deterministic software.
   Lampinen and colleagues show that active causal strategies can be learned from passive
training examples in their task environments. Their Appendix B.2 finds active intervention
during evaluation critical in the examined ablations. The positive learning result therefore
does not imply that observational banking logs alone settle the consequences of a new policy
(Lampinen, 2023). The Model Discovery Agent distinguishes open-loop input sequences
from closed-loop policies and states that its experiments use open-loop policies. Candidate
mechanistic models and experiment proposals are relevant assistance, but forecasting or
approximate model evidence does not independently identify an adaptive policy value (Murphy,
2026). Shi and colleagues’ two-wave discovery result adds another useful contrast: its linear
non-Gaussian and higher-cumulant conditions address path discovery, with nonzero-cumulant
restrictions and power limitations. They neither establish a longitudinal language-model
estimator nor turn edge detection into a consistently estimated monetary effect (Shi et al.,
2026).
   The appropriate formal alternatives remain longitudinal g-computation, weighting and
recursively augmented or targeted estimation under their specific assumptions. The inspected
R ltmle interface is a closer candidate for a restricted binary-treatment/censoring mean than
a text-collaboration demonstration, but it also requires correct node order, dynamic-rule
semantics, outcome transformations and observation laws (joshuaschwab contributors, 2026).
None of these choices removes hidden confounding by adding an LLM. A representation that
predicts well may still omit information needed for assignment or future response. Repeated
model answers, Monte Carlo variation and variation across fitted causal models are different
uncertainty sources; they cannot be exchanged for sampling uncertainty or identification
bounds.

47.17.6    A bounded integration and public-evidence program

The proposed CLI and MCP entrypoints should accept the same reviewed scientific request.
It binds population, unit, horizon, policy and comparator; event, availability and decision
clocks; outcome units and costs; treatment and retention laws; and the graph or structural
assumptions used for identification. A text-generating intervention also binds its templates or
generation kernel, model artifacts and representation. The policy is versioned independently
of the estimation code. A request that changes the policy during evaluation requires a new
analysis scope.
47.17. From language-assisted collaboration to adaptive servicing                             847


   The response should distinguish an invalid chronology, an unsupported backend, unavailable
identifying information, failed support or diagnostics, and a successful calculation under stated
assumptions. It should carry the admitted target, supported histories, numerical error estimate
where justified, statistical uncertainty method, source identities and observed tool outcome. A
JSON success field cannot certify exchangeability. An assistant may draft the request, explain
refusals and compare remedies. The proposed product should require an accountable review
of its scientific premises before estimation; it should not infer approval from fluent prose or
automatically send customer contacts.
   The next affordable prototype has two complementary evidence tracks. Finite generated
mechanisms can expose known target and numerical errors: feedback-aware versus fixed-action
rollout, missing retention, unsupported histories, changed text-version mixtures, late-arriving
states and local effects presented as finite gains. Exact enumeration and independently
coded backward recursion supply references. A deterministic analyst workflow and a scripted
assistant using the same facts supply useful initial comparators. Where a genuine public
longitudinal dataset has suitable documentation and permissible use, it can test ingestion,
clock construction, diagnostics and reproduction of a declared analysis. Its observed outcomes
do not reveal both policy counterfactuals. The rebuilt collaboration datasets should not be
redistributed on the strength of their public links.
   The public-data survey supplies concrete choices. UCI’s credit-card default dataset contains
monthly payment and bill histories with documented CC BY 4.0 terms. It can supply covariate
and timing exercises, but a customer payment is not an assigned bank contact and the file
does not disclose the full servicing action law (UCI Machine Learning Repository, 2026b).
Explicitly generated actions and responses on such covariates would constitute a semi-synthetic
study. Freddie Mac and Fannie Mae performance histories add realistic loan and termination
clocks, subject to registration and use restrictions; their modification records do not supply all
feasible actions, private hardship information or known assignment probabilities (Freddie Mac,
2026; Fannie Mae, 2026). They are conditional realism candidates. The fully generated route
remains usable while access and rights are resolved.
   Prototype acceptance should bind each expected target, unit, refusal and numerical tolerance
before running the comparison. Every attempted case remains in the denominator, including
missing evidence and tool failures. A later live-model comparison needs frozen models, prompts,
tool budgets, held-out task mechanisms, a stopping rule and prespecified uncertainty for its
error and review-effort measures. Separate policy learning from value evaluation; preserve
account or household groups and an appropriate future calendar holdout. The exact arithmetic
here executes reference calculations only. It does not execute that prototype, a live-model trial
or an upstream package benchmark (Causal banking proposal, 2026bg).
   Costs include analyst formulation and review, rights and environment resolution, embedding
inference, nuisance fitting, trajectory simulation, diagnostics, failed attempts and maintenance
after a model or policy revision. The inspected nested sampling path uses 50 baseline draws
and 50 inner repetitions, amounting to 2,500 outcome-prediction rows per evaluated case.
Shared fitted models and baseline draws mean this is not 2,500 independent observations, nor
is the loop count a runtime measurement (XMUBQ/dtr-text, 2024; Causal banking proposal,
2026bh). A fair comparison measures the full workflow for the same policy, information and
accepted uncertainty. Real prices, realized recovery and institutional adoption remain later
inputs.
  The engineering repairs have known routes: explicit clocks and policy recursion, model
pinning, validated options, grouped evaluation, typed failures and exact behavioral references.
Missing reuse terms and uninspected originals require evidence acquisition or a permitted alter-
native. General representation sufficiency, latent longitudinal identification, valid uncertainty
848                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


after policy selection, and useful precision in poor-support regimes remain research obligations.
The proposal can justify pursuing those questions with public and generated evidence while
leaving their answers open (Causal banking proposal, 2026bg).


47.17.7    Agent architectures must preserve scientific uncertainty

Several systems now make causal analysis a sequence of tool-supported decisions. Their
strongest contribution is often a concrete representation of the intermediate work: a dataset, a
graph, an estimand, a proof statement or a failed tool call. Comparing these systems requires
examining what each intermediate object means and which transformations are allowed. A
graph stored in agent memory can prevent a variable-name error while still carrying an
unsupported orientation into every later calculation.


Causal Agent: useful tool boundaries and unequal baselines

Han and colleagues store causal graph objects in a dictionary that agents address by name.
This connects independence tests, graph questions and effect calculations without requiring
each operation to reconstruct the graph from prose. Their CausalTQA examples combine small
generated nonlinear additive Gaussian mechanisms with medical and marketing vocabulary.
The vocabulary tests a language interface; it does not turn the generated mechanism into a
medical or marketing observation. Kairong Han, Kun Kuang, Ziyu Zhao, Junjian Ye and Fei
Wu (2026)
   The paper documents informative failures: requesting conditional rather than marginal
independence, passing the wrong variable name, using the wrong graph operation, and building
unnecessarily long tool chains. Typed variable references and explicit tool signatures are
plausible remedies. The main code-generation baseline, however, executes once, whereas
the agent uses specialized tools and iterative reasoning. Its measured advantage therefore
combines tool design, supplied knowledge and opportunities for repair. An evaluation intended
to isolate orchestration should give a deterministic workflow and a simpler agent the same
tool implementations and permitted repair budget.
   The reported average cost of 3.37 seconds, 2.51 iterations and 5,308 tokens comes from 100
sampled variable, edge and graph questions with a maximum iteration count of 15. It does
not establish the cost of the full effect workflow, rare failures or deployment under a different
model and platform. An average well below a limit is also insufficient evidence to remove that
limit. The prototype should retain explicit budgets and report tails, timeouts, failed requests
and review effort. The source’s effect-answer tolerance and benchmark oracle require code
inspection before its reported 157 correct answers out of 160 become a reproduction target.
Kairong Han, Kun Kuang, Ziyu Zhao, Junjian Ye and Fei Wu (2026)


ORCA: shared state without silently choosing a causal world

ORCA organizes analysis of relational databases around dataset exploration, discovery and
inference. It records table choices, joins, variable roles, candidate graphs and estimation
configurations, with opportunities for human review. Its REEF benchmark uses a specified
structural causal model inside a relational e-commerce database. This is directly relevant to
a banking proposal: a mistaken join or aggregation can change the unit of analysis before a
causal estimator is called. Joanie Hayoun Chung, Sumin Lee and Sungbin Lim (2026)
  The important limitation lies between graph discovery and inference. The paper describes a
consensus PAG that retains uncertain endpoints, followed by a separate “actionable’ ’ DAG.
47.17. From language-assisted collaboration to adaptive servicing                               849


Uncertain directions are resolved using the highest-ranked candidate, cycle-safe orientation,
reversal or edge removal. Acyclicity does not establish that the selected orientation is true.
An effect computed from this one DAG is conditional on choices added during that conversion,
and cannot automatically represent all models encoded by the uncertainty-preserving graph.
   For a servicing decision, suppose distress and contact intensity remain ambiguously related.
Directing the edge one way can make distress an adjustment variable; directing it the other
can make it a treatment descendant. The proposed interface should retain the original graph
object and give every added orientation an explicit assumption record. It should compare
identification across compatible models, return an effect set where appropriate, or state that a
scalar target is not identified. Ranking an orientation for display is not authorization to treat
it as scientific fact. This is a proposed restriction on reuse, not behavior shown to exist in
ORCA’s implementation.
   The reported user study also requires careful interpretation. Twelve participants used ORCA
and a baseline with tools, step gates and minimal state in counterbalanced order. Table 1 gives
rounded completion rates of 0.83 and 0.75. The abstract’s 42-percentage-point completion
gain is not consistent with that table; it should not be repeated as a verified result. Appendix
E defines completion as producing an ATE regardless of accuracy, and discovery success as
including both treatment and outcome nodes. Neither definition establishes correct discovery.
Joanie Hayoun Chung, Sumin Lee and Sungbin Lim (2026)
   The paper’s “CI coverage’ ’ description counts an estimated ATE falling within an interval
around a ground-truth effect. That wording differs from the usual repeated-sampling event in
which an estimated interval contains a fixed true effect. Its exact oracle and implementation
require clarification. Likewise, the full-data test for the ATE-error condition effect has p = .321,
whereas the analysis excluding large configuration-error outliers reports p = .020 under OLS.
Configuration failures are central outcomes for a workflow product. They should remain in
the primary comparison, with conditional numerical accuracy reported separately.


CausalPulse: operational success has a different denominator

CausalPulse supplies another concrete design: agents coordinate semantic descriptions, domain
rules and causal tools through a utility layer that includes MCP. Such interfaces can make
tools accessible and operations traceable. The inspected manufacturing study nevertheless
distinguishes successful operation from successful root-cause attribution. Its PSE example
reports Hits@1 of .44, precision .46, recall .40 and F1 .39 despite much higher operational
success. Tool availability and completion are necessary engineering outcomes, but substituting
them for causal correctness would misstate the evidence. Shyalika et al. (2026)
  This distinction determines the proposed monitoring interface. It should record whether
the request was parsed, whether the analysis was admissible, whether the tools completed,
whether the scientific target was answered, and whether the decision was useful under the
declared loss. These events need separate denominators. A scientific refusal can be a correct
answer, while a complete report can be wrong. Banking acceptance would additionally need
appropriate target-bank evidence; the public prototype can already test these distinctions with
generated known-truth cases.


CausalSmith: a checked proof still needs a checked statement

CausalSmith combines a Lean library with proposal, formalization, proof and presentation
stages. Its paper reports 8,179 declarations and a catalog of 144 runs: 14 accepted, 59
downgraded and 71 failed. Those counts include reruns as separate entries and exclude a
850                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


legacy track. They describe one campaign with changing model versions, not independent
draws from a fixed research-task population. The authors explicitly acknowledge that research
quality ratings lack independent human validation and that the error rate of their LLM
statement-match audit is unknown. Jiyuan Tan and Vasilis Syrgkanis (2026)
   The source’s most useful distinction is between checking a proof against a formal statement
and checking whether that statement expresses the intended claim. A compiled artifact can
assume a hard step as an axiom, weaken a conclusion, strengthen an assumption or make a
predicate vacuous. The paper describes mechanical scans and dependency checks alongside
language-model statement review. These are complementary checks with different assurances.
The latter does not acquire a formal guarantee merely by sitting next to a proof checker.
   For a proposed bank-effect theorem, the statement record should expose the unit, intervention,
estimand, time ordering, conditioning information, positivity and dependence assumptions.
The proof environment should bind the toolchain, imported definitions and axioms. A separate
review should compare the English claim with that exact formal statement and test whether
its assumptions are satisfiable in the intended model. A theorem conditional on observed
confounders cannot be presented as solving unmeasured confounding in operational data.
Formal correctness, semantic fidelity and scientific relevance each need their own evidence.
   The near-term reuse choice is therefore selective. Retain typed graph memory, explicit
intermediate state, preserved failures, and formal statement/dependency records as design
candidates. Defer executable adoption of these newly inspected systems until exact code,
dependencies, licenses and relevant numerical or proof paths have been reviewed. This permits
a concrete prototype architecture now without claiming that paper descriptions have already
been integrated or independently reproduced.


47.18      Choosing an agent architecture for a servicing decision
A bank considering assisted causal analysis faces an architectural choice before it faces a model
leaderboard. It can give a language model a broad notebook environment, surround a fixed
statistical pipeline with conversational assistance, or ask several specialist agents to negotiate
an analysis. Each choice changes which mistakes are easy to detect, what must be reviewed
by a person, and how much an apparently completed answer costs. The useful comparison
is therefore between complete analytical paths with declared scientific obligations. Counting
agent roles or successful tool calls gives little guidance about whether a servicing decision has
been answered.
   Consider a manager asking: “Should we offer an early restructuring review to customers
entering arrears?” Let the unit be an eligible account at its first qualifying arrears date, X the
information available immediately before the offer, A ∈ {0, 1} the offer, and Y the discounted
net cash recovery over a fixed following horizon. The offer is distinct from acceptance and
from the eventual restructuring terms. For a specified eligible population P , an initial target is

                                    τP = EP {Y (1) − Y (0)}.                                 (47.5)

If Y excludes the incremental cost c of making the offer, an expected-value decision compares
τP with c. If costs are already inside Y , subtracting them again is wrong. An agent should
make this definition explicit before requesting an estimator. Neither an offer-acceptance
prediction nor the effect among customers who accepted is automatically an answer to this
question.
  The information clock is equally consequential. A field can carry an event date before
the offer but be entered into the database after it. The admissible record is the version
47.18. Choosing an agent architecture for a servicing decision                              851


available at the decision time, with the extraction and revision rule specified. A distress
assessment obtained during the offer call cannot silently become a pretreatment covariate.
Multiple accounts held by one customer, branch policies and shared collection teams require
an explicit sampling and interference analysis; calling each row an independent customer does
not settle these issues. The simple point-treatment example below assumes one eligible unit,
no interference and a declared independent-unit law. The longitudinal construction earlier
in this chapter is needed when subsequent contacts and evolving distress become part of the
intervention.


47.18.1     What the competing architectures actually contribute

The primary literature supports several distinct proposals. Zhu and colleagues’ CausalAgent
routes processing, structure learning and reporting through agents and MCP tools. Its four-
page demonstration uses the Sachs dataset; quantitative effect estimation and counterfactual
modules remain among its stated future directions. Its conversational interface is evidence of
an interaction design, not a demonstrated solution to the servicing target in (47.5). Han and
colleagues’ separately authored Causal Agent instead illustrates named graph objects in tool
memory and a generated question benchmark. Keeping these two systems distinct prevents a
result from one from being attributed to the other’s implementation Zhu et al. (2026); Kairong
Han, Kun Kuang, Ziyu Zhao, Junjian Ye and Fei Wu (2026).
   The actor/critic design of oci-agent addresses a closer statistical problem: point-in-time
observational effects under supplied unconfoundedness. It exposes specifications, notebooks
and diagnostics to a human principal. This can reduce the effort of reproducing an analysis
or finding a failed overlap diagnostic. The critical question is whether a proposed revision
preserves the target. Removing unsupported parts of the population may make an estimate
more stable while answering a different banking question. That is a substantive decision which
an attractive report must not hide. The paper’s benchmark results remain reported source
findings, and are not reproduced live-model results of this proposal Chou et al. (2026).
   The causal-learn+ position takes a stricter approach. Agents assist data inspection, method
explanation and interpretation around a protected discovery core. Their proposed edges,
orientations or constraints do not automatically become scientific evidence. This reduces
one path by which language-model beliefs enter a graph, but leaves assumption elicitation,
variable construction and statistical method choice as important tasks. Its call for future
benchmarks is consistent with treating the architecture as a candidate for evaluation rather
than an established performance advantage Zheng (2026).
   ORCA emphasizes shared relational state: joins, variable roles, graphs and estimation
configurations. This is especially relevant when banking data are spread over account, customer,
contact and transaction tables. However, the paper’s conversion of a consensus PAG into an
actionable DAG introduces orientation, reversal or deletion decisions. An analysis conducted
on that DAG inherits these extra choices. The architecture should expose them as additions
to the assumptions, and preserve the original uncertain graph. The numerical comparison
is also narrower than its headline suggests: the inspected table reports completion rates of
.83 and .75, whereas the abstract claims a 42-percentage-point gain. Completion is defined
as producing an ATE regardless of its accuracy. These are reasons to preserve the source
discrepancy and to design a better denominator, not to invent a corrected experiment Joanie
Hayoun Chung, Sumin Lee and Sungbin Lim (2026).
   Two further architectures broaden the comparison. CausalSmith makes a formal statement,
proof dependencies and compiler results explicit; its own limitations separate proof checking
from unvalidated model judgments about statement faithfulness and research quality. Model
852                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


Discovery Agent proposes executable mechanisms, then uses numerical fitting and experiment
design to compare them. The latter’s model-disagreement criterion approximates information
gain within a changing candidate set. Its reported predictive tests do not establish causal
identification, and its illustrated experiments use open-loop policies. Neither formal proof
search nor mechanism proposal alone replaces the observational assumptions needed for the
servicing target Jiyuan Tan and Vasilis Syrgkanis (2026); Murphy (2026).

   These alternatives suggest a restrained first prototype: one application-owned controller, a

should be measured against the same tools, information and total repair budget available to
a simpler workflow. This choice concerns the proposed product; it does not claim that the
reviewed external frameworks have been installed or integrated.

47.18.3     What repeated critics can and cannot repair

A critic is useful when it brings a distinct check: reconstructing weights, reading a source
passage, evaluating a graph criterion or reproducing a numerical baseline. Merely repeating the
same prompt with the same evidence does not create independent scientific information. To
quantify this distinction, suppose each of three critics misses an error with marginal probability
q = .1. If their errors are independent, majority failure has probability

                                     q 3 + 3q 2 (1 − q) = .028.                                (47.10)

Perfectly shared errors instead leave the failure probability at .1. Consider an intermediate
stipulated law: with probability γ = .05, all three fail from a common cause; otherwise they
fail independently with probability r = 1/19. Each still has marginal error γ + (1 − γ)r = .1,
but majority failure becomes

                             γ + (1 − γ){r3 + 3r2 (1 − r)} ≃ .05762.                           (47.11)

Thus the same individual error rate can accompany quite different benefits from voting. Exact
enumeration over all eight independent-error patterns checks the calculation. None of these
probabilities is an empirical estimate of a language model or a deployed critic Causal banking
proposal project (2026c).
  There is also an information limit. Consider two linear Gaussian worlds with mutually
independent standard normal noises in each world:
                                                            q
                             W1 : X = U,       Y = 12 X +     3/4 V,
                                                             q
                             W2 : Y = V ′ ,     X = 21 Y +        3/4 U ′ .                    (47.12)

Both observed pairs have zero mean, unit marginal variances and covariance 1/2, hence the
same joint distribution. The effect of increasing X by one is 1/2 in W1 and zero in W2 .
Suppose an adaptive agent system receives only samples from that common law, identical
documents in both worlds and randomness independent of the world. The first transcript step
then has the same law in both worlds. If this holds through step t, the next tool or agent
applies the same conditional transition to an identically distributed history, so it holds at t + 1.
Induction gives the same distribution for the final answer. An additional critic operating on
that transcript cannot distinguish these worlds.
   This argument concerns the stated information set. Genuine temporal knowledge, an
intervention or a justified scientific restriction can break its premise. Retrieval is valuable
when it supplies such information with an inspectable provenance; fluent agreement alone
cannot do so. The appropriate output before the added information is available can be an
identified set, a conditional answer or a request to clarify the decision model. It need not be
an arbitrary scalar produced to make the workflow look complete.
   Repeated repair also changes evaluation. In a deliberately simple experiment, suppose a
scientifically invalid candidate independently has probability .05 of passing a fallible screen
on each try. Allowing twenty tries and retaining the first apparent pass gives probability
1 − .9520 ≃ .6415 of at least one false pass. Without independence, the union bound is only
min(1, 20 × .05) = 1. This example describes independent screening attempts, not deterministic
replay of the same input, and does not assign a statistical significance level to real agent review.
It explains why the proposed evaluation must retain all attempts, give comparators the same
repair budget and separate development feedback from held-out evaluation Causal banking
proposal project (2026c).
47.18. Choosing an agent architecture for a servicing decision                                855


47.18.4     Typed handoffs and the scope of recovery

For the servicing prototype, a useful analysis state contains the decision contract, data identity
and clock, graph or graph class, assumptions with their source and status, target measure,
method applicability, numerical artifacts, uncertainty statement and request history. These
objects should refer to one another by immutable identity. A revised target or graph invalidates
dependent results even when the data bytes are unchanged. A successful statistical call must
not make an unresolved assumption disappear.
   The controller can enforce local invariants. An estimation request must name a target and
population; every variable must exist in the supplied schema; a numerical interval must have
finite, ordered endpoints unless the result type explicitly supports an unbounded set; and
a result must bind the method and input versions that produced it. A graph-identification
operation can check a formal condition relative to a supplied graph. These checks support
meaningful handoffs, but none proves that the graph or observation law describes the bank.
Scientific assumption status should therefore remain visible alongside mechanical validity.
   This distinction leads to several result types with different continuation actions. Malformed
input calls for correction of the request. A missing backend calls for an implementation or
environment remedy. A mathematical nonidentification result calls for different information or
a different target. An unsupported method calls for a scoped alternative. A valid set-valued
answer can proceed to a decision calculation that respects the set. Collapsing all of these into
either an empty successful object or a single generic failure would discard the reason that
determines the next useful action.
   The inspected CausalAgent server illustrates a concrete boundary to repair before reuse.
Its OLC handler refers to a function not imported or defined in that module and catches
the resulting exception into a JSON error string. Separately, its output helper extracts text
between braces and returns an empty dictionary on a decoding failure. These are static source
findings, not a claim that this proposal executed the upstream server. A wrapper must validate
the scientific result and propagate an explicit failure before downstream analysis; successful
transport of an error string is not a learned graph CausalAgent contributors (2026).
   Recovery has a related distinction. A graph checkpoint preserves enough state to resume an
operation; it does not automatically make external effects occur exactly once. The inspected
LangGraph interrupt restarts its node from the beginning. An application should therefore
give an expensive computation a stable request identity, record its durable outcome and check
that identity on replay. For a remote provider call interrupted before a receipt is saved, the
outcome can remain unknown unless the provider supports lookup or idempotency. Blind
resubmission cannot be advertised as exact-once execution langgraph contributors (2026).
   Pydantic AI supplies typed tool boundaries and usage controls, but the inspected price
check cannot enforce a monetary limit when price is unavailable. Some usage becomes known
only after a response. A prototype requiring a hard budget needs a known pricing contract,
conservative reservation and explicit behavior for unknown cost. AutoGen’s inspected save/load
methods preserve model context; they do not constitute a journal of arbitrary external side
effects. Its maintenance declaration and separate code/documentation licenses also enter
the adoption decision. These observations favor a plain controller baseline before adding a
framework whose incremental benefit has not yet been measured pydantic-ai contributors
(2026); autogen contributors (2026).
   The existing local prototype provides narrower positive evidence. Six authored offline cases
preserve blocked, unsupported, ambiguous and completed outcomes, including directed-revision
recovery and a weak moment set. The saved replay reproduces those outcomes using real local
tools with no live model calls. This supports selected semantics and recovery behavior. It does
856                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


not test whether a language model elicits the right servicing graph, reduces human effort or
behaves correctly on an external platform. The library, CLI and MCP contracts should carry
this same distinction when transporting the result Causal banking proposal project (2026d).


47.18.5     Selecting the next experiment by useful output and total cost

The minimal comparison has a deterministic analyst template, a single assisted controller
and, if justified, a controller with a critic. All receive the same documents, permitted tool
implementations and task budget. Generated cases should include correctly identified effects,
ambiguity requiring a set or refusal, misleading variable clocks, a target change after trimming
and a tool failure. A held-out task split separates adaptation of prompts and templates from
evaluation. Numerical truth comes from the declared generator, while semantic scoring needs
an independently specified reference and ambiguity rubric. A correct refusal is a successful
answer to a nonidentified task; unnecessary refusal on an identified task is a separate error.
  Let N count all eligible assigned requests and Ui indicate that request i produced an
admissible, correct and decision-appropriate answer under the rubric. A useful workflow
summary is                        PN
                                      (C tools + wTireview + Ciother )
                        Cusable = i=1 i
                        b                      PN                      .         (47.13)
                                                 i=1 Ui
It is undefined when there is no usable output. Costs for failed requests stay in the numerator.
The statistic should accompany the usable fraction, error categories, refusal behavior, latency
distribution and conditional numerical accuracy. Reporting only accuracy among completed
estimates can reward a system that abandons difficult requests or hides configuration errors.
   For planning, suppose manual review costs 15 minutes per request at 120 dollars per hour
and yields a usable fraction .9. Its ratio is 30/.9 = 33.33 dollars. An assisted workflow costing
3 dollars in tools plus 6 review minutes, with usable fraction .8, gives 15/.8 = 18.75 dollars. At
20 review minutes the same tool and quality assumptions give 43/.8 = 53.75 dollars. Equating
the assisted ratio to the manual ratio yields a review-time threshold of 71/6 ≃ 11.83 minutes.
These stipulated scenarios omit fixed build costs; they show which quantities to measure, not
that assistance saves money Causal banking proposal project (2026c).
   The next justified experiment is consequently a bounded public/generated task study
measuring semantic failures and total review effort, with matched tools and frozen denominators.
A live-model performance claim requires a recorded backend revision, actual calls and measured
usage. A literature and architecture proposal can proceed without that claim. Authentic
bank experiments become worth considering when the prototype isolates an uncertainty whose
resolution could change the build or investment decision. The unresolved questions are specific:
how often assumptions are elicited correctly, whether criticism adds independent information,
how much adjudication is needed and whether the resulting gain survives a change in task
population. None is answered by adding agent roles to a diagram.


47.19      Data and code agents: a fail-closed banking boundary
An agent that prepares data or code can save analyst time while silently changing a causal
question. The proposed boundary starts with a typed decision contract and uses the agent for
retrieval, clarification, code drafting and criticism around fixed operations. It does not execute
arbitrary notebook or shell text, download mutable ontologies, or convert malformed output
into an empty successful analysis. This is a proposal architecture supported by inspected
papers, package source and local adverse fixtures; it is not a live-model performance result.
47.19. Data and code agents: a fail-closed banking boundary                                  857


   Suppose a bank asks whether an early arrears review should be offered to eligible accounts.
The unit is the account at its first qualifying arrears date. The action A is an offer made
using data available immediately before that date, and Y is discounted net recovery over 180
days. The target is τP = EP [Y (1) − Y (0)] for the declared eligible population P , with the
offer cost either inside Y or subtracted once in the decision rule. A field’s event date and its
database availability date are separate: a hardship flag entered on day 11 cannot be a day-10
covariate. The agent may list candidate fields and ask an analyst to resolve ownership, timing,
interference and missingness; it cannot infer those facts from column names.
   The non-agent baseline is a structured analyst interview, a versioned data dictionary and
manually reviewed code. The agent-assisted path adds a typed specification, source-to-claim
links, a graph candidate set, fixed operation requests and deterministic report rendering. Both
paths receive the same information and the same numerical fixtures. The comparison should
score target preservation, clock errors, unsupported certainty, unresolved questions, artifact
completeness and analyst time. A shorter answer is not better if it changes P , A, Y or the
horizon.


47.19.1     What the inspected frontier contributes

CausalAgent describes processing, structure-learning and reporting agents routed through
MCP tools and demonstrates a Sachs protein-signalling workflow. Its paper lists quantitative
effect estimation and counterfactual modules as future work. It therefore supplies an interaction
and routing idea, not evidence that a bank servicing effect was estimated. The inspected
pinned server declares PC and OLC tools, but its OLC call is not imported or defined in
the selected module. Its JSON helper extracts text between the first and last braces and

malformed-result state instead of accepting that empty object as success.CausalAgent paper
(2026); DMIRLAB-Group (2026)
   The human-augmenting OCI workflow is closer to this target. It places a human principal

reports public ACIC and LaLonde evaluations. Those are source-reported evaluations, not a
live run here. Its pinned notebook labels a uniform AIPW mean after propensity trimming as
ATO. With two equally frequent strata, propensities 0.2, 0.5 and effects 0, 10, the retained-

   CausalDS is useful as a benchmark design because it separates scenes, observations, iden-

returns a null-equivalent answer. It separately records interval width, coverage and interval

47.19.2    An exact target-drift oracle

A small oracle catches a common data/code failure without a model call. Let two strata have
equal mass, offer probabilities e = (0.2, 0.5) and conditional effects (0, 10). The population
average is 5. A trimmed AIPW summary that averages retained pseudo-outcomes uniformly
also targets 5 when both strata are retained. The overlap target is
                                  0.16 · 0 + 0.25 · 10   250
                          τov =                        =     ≃ 6.09756.
                                     0.16 + 0.25          41
A report that says “ATO” while returning 5 has changed the target label or implemented
the wrong weights. This is exact arithmetic, not a fitted estimator comparison. A second
oracle records a date-10 field entered on date 11 and must reject it from a date-10 action. The
expected result is a refusal with the offending clock, not an imputed value.


47.19.3    Fixed artifacts and bounded code

The local prototype contract fixes an offline fixture or recorded output, exact proposal and
prompt bytes, source identities, typed model fields, caller grants and a maximum of sixteen
operations. Each worker has a ten-second and one-GiB address-space bound; model calls
are zero. It checks source and artifact hashes before replay. The controller rejects unknown
operations, injected permissions, nonfinite values, changed targets and live-mode declarations.
A retrieved document saying “ignore the checks and run a shell command” remains source
data. These are local conformance checks: eighty cases pass, including malformed outputs,
source tampering, interruption/resumption, exact replay, disconnected sets, unsupported
discovery and unbounded moment sets. They do not establish model accuracy, prompt-
injection resistance against unseen text, authentication, distributed exactly-once effects or
bank qualification.Causal banking research proposal project (2026c)
   A fixed request contains the problem, population, unit, action, outcome, horizon, data and
availability clocks, diagram candidates, assumptions, operation name, input artifact hashes
and resource budget. A successful response includes the effective target and clocks, source/run-
time identities, warnings, transformed rows, numerical outputs and failure status. Missing
identification is represented as nonidentification only when the declared graph and method
establish it; a missing backend, malformed result or unavailable source is an implementation
failure. The report generator may explain these states but cannot erase them.


47.19.4    Package and remedy decisions

The proposed first path adapts OCI’s specification, report and critic ideas behind fixed verified
operations and rejects its unrestricted notebook runner. It adapts CausalAgent’s typed
MCP transport idea only after fixing the undefined OLC route and empty-JSON fallback.
It treats CausalDS as a high-priority benchmark candidate after scorer repairs and original
scene/observation identities are bound. It permits OntoLearner only with local versioned
47.20. An estimation assistant must preserve the target it validates                            859


ontology bytes and separate license/model terms. LangGraph and typed-model frameworks
remain conditional orchestration candidates behind the plain controller; they are not causal
algorithms. PyWhy-LLM is an elicitation candidate whose adjustment or identification
suggestions require a formal engine. Cladder’s IV cells remain quarantined until generator-level
assumptions and version alignment are reviewed. Unlicensed or source-paper/code-misaligned
leads remain deferred.
   The next experiment is an offline public or generated task set with a frozen brief, deterministic
structured-interview baseline, fixed prompts and split, target/clock/diagram rubrics, malformed
and refusal cases, resource budget and stopping rule. It should measure semantic preservation
and adverse-case handling before any live backend call. A later live-model comparison needs a
named provider, custody, price and independent adjudication; none is claimed here. Authentic
bank truth, production reliability and customer economics remain later conditional evidence.


47.20       An estimation assistant must preserve the target it vali-
            dates
The choice of an estimator follows three earlier decisions: the business target, the information
available at the decision time, and identification under the stated model. The assistant should
keep these decisions separate from statistical calibration and diagnostic adequacy. A balanced
weighted sample can still omit a common cause; an excellent predictive model can use a field
recorded after the intervention. A critic that approves the prose does not validate either
assumption. The causal co-pilot roadmap is valuable precisely because it makes eligibility,
baseline time, incident versus prevalent treatment, follow-up and outcome definitions explicit
before estimation (Alaa et al., 2024).
   For an early arrears-review offer, let X be the information available before an eligible
account’s first qualifying arrears date, A ∈ {0, 1} the offer, and Y discounted net recovery
over 180 days. The offer, acceptance and eventual restructuring terms are distinct actions.
The population P consists of the specified eligible accounts at time zero, with one declared
interference and sampling unit. Define τP = EP {Y (1) − Y (0)}. Offer cost is either included in
Y or subtracted once when comparing actions. Changing the outcome horizon or the eligible
population creates a different target.
   Under consistency, conditional exchangeability, positivity, a suitable sampling law and
the declared measurement conditions, write µa (x) = E(Y | A = a, X = x) and p(x) =
Pr(A = 1 | X = x). For candidate nuisance functions ma and e, a population augmented
inverse-probability score is
                                         A{Y − m1 (X)} (1 − A){Y − m0 (X)}
               ϕ = m1 (X) − m0 (X) +                  −                    .
                                             e(X)            1 − e(X)
Conditioning on X and subtracting the identified conditional contrast gives
                                                        m1 − µ1 m0 − µ0
                                                                            
                    E(ϕ | X) − (µ1 − µ0 ) = (e − p)              +             .           (47.14)
                                                           e          1−e
This algebra explains the population double-robustness property when the denominators are
well defined: the conditional bias vanishes if the propensity is right or both outcome regressions
are right. It does not establish the causal assumptions, a finite-sample confidence guarantee,
or arbitrary learner validity. Cross-fitting can separate nuisance training from score evaluation,
but rates, moments, dependence and uncertainty calculations still require their own conditions.
The inspected OCI notebook uses a cross-fitted AIPW approach within a human-principal
and actor/critic workflow; its source results remain distinct from this project derivation (Chou
et al., 2026; Netflix-Skunkworks/oci-agent; andleb/causalds, 2026).

47.20.2     Validation losses, unknown states and retrieval failure

CausalDS separates narrative scenes, an observation layer and hidden causal truth. Its
identification targets refer to conceptual variables; an adapter must not infer that a noisy
observed proxy provides the same identifying law. The paper’s 100-scene exam, sampled from
953 scenes, reports different patterns for symbolic success, numeric quality, abstention and
resource cost. Those are dated author findings for a benchmark. Its source scorer also exposes
implementation choices that matter when adapting the benchmark: missing identification
metadata can default toward an identifiable interpretation, and finite numeric endpoints must
be checked separately from successful conversion to a floating-point value (Leban and Sun,
2026; Netflix-Skunkworks/oci-agent; andleb/causalds, 2026).
47.20. An estimation assistant must preserve the target it validates                              861


  The interval score for a central interval [l, u], target θ and nominal error α is
                                            2                  2
                 Sα (l, u; θ) = (u − l) +     (l − θ)1{θ < l} + (θ − u)1{θ > u}.
                                            α                  α
It penalizes width and noncoverage. The inspected CausalDS source reports both uncapped
and capped normalized scores, together with coverage and width. It is incorrect to describe it
as offering only capped loss. A dashboard that keeps only the capped value can nevertheless
reverse a comparison. Score pairs (1, 100) and (9, 9) have uncapped means 50.5 and 9; with a
cap of ten, the means are 5.5 and 9. Such pairs can be constructed with covered zero-centered
intervals of the corresponding widths and truth zero, so the arithmetic is compatible with the
interval-score definition. This is an exact illustration of a dashboard choice, not a result from
executing CausalDS (Netflix-Skunkworks/oci-agent; andleb/causalds, 2026; Causal banking
proposal, 2026o).
   The proposed assessment keeps identified, nonidentified and unknown as separate scientific
states. Unsupported operations, malformed files, execution failures and deliberate abstentions
have separate operational states. It reports how many requests returned finite valid intervals
and how many were refused, while retaining uncapped losses for the valid interval population.
Assigning an infinite or arbitrary loss to every refusal may be inappropriate for a task where
refusal is correct; silently dropping failures is also inappropriate. Task-specific scientific scoring
and the all-request operating denominator must therefore be published together.
   ARGUS provides a complementary example at the assumption-audit boundary. It audits
reported support for identification assumptions, not causal truth. Its synthetic flaw results
show that retrieval gating changes the tradeoff between flagging flaws and missing omissions.
In its five-paper human pilot, weak retrieval produces excessive severity, and the reported
adjustment is in-sample. The useful remedy is to retain retrieval quality and evidence status
as separate fields, with unresolved evidence labeled unknown. A failure to retrieve a bank
policy is not evidence that the policy does not exist (Zhang et al., 2026a).
   The initial prototype should adapt OCI’s specification and critic artifacts behind fixed
bounded operations, and adapt CausalDS’s hidden-truth and scoring separation only after
its generator and scoring paths are independently checked. OCI’s unbounded notebook-
runner timeout is not an admissible default for the bounded CLI/MCP service. Direct
package integration, a live provider comparison and bank validation are separate later claims.
The concrete near-term output is a reproducible design that preserves the target, refuses
unsupported certainty, and measures review burden against a deterministic analyst baseline.
Chapter 48

Packages, model backends and
auditable agent architecture

48.1      Choose the contract before the framework
The proposed causal assistant has three separable responsibilities. It helps a person express a
banking decision, invokes mathematical operations whose applicability is explicit, and preserves
the evidence needed to interpret the answer. A model backend proposes text or structured
objects. An orchestration framework arranges calls and state transitions. A causal engine
supplies a particular graphical or numerical calculation. Their outputs have different evidential
meanings even when one software package exposes all three through the same chat interface.
The architecture should make those meanings visible before selecting a vendor or adopting a
framework.
   Consider a lender comparing an offer with no offer for accounts entering arrears. The
declared population, twelve-month outcome, information available at first eligibility, treatment
contrast and cost convention determine the question. A model may propose a graph, explain
why a field is measured too late or draft an analysis plan. A numerical service may compute a
conditional effect under the supplied graph and sampling law. The controller must prevent the
first activity from silently certifying the assumptions of the second. The servicing comparison in
Section 47.18 develops the substantive causal alternatives; here the question is which software
boundary preserves them.
  Let an analysis state be
                                     s = (q, d, g, a, m, r, e),                             (48.1)
where q is the decision contract, d the data and observation definitions, g the graph or graph
class, a the assumptions and their statuses, m the method request, r the result and e its
provenance. Each component has a version identity. An external grant u specifies permitted
operations and inputs. It is not a field that the model can authorize for itself. A proposed
transition f should be admitted only if its preconditions hold for the current state and
grant. The output must retain the identities it actually used. These are proposed application
invariants, not properties supplied by the word agent in a package description. (Causal banking
proposal, 2026z)
   This formulation also prevents an unhelpful choice between unrestricted automation and
manual work. Some transitions are mechanical: parsing a versioned request, verifying source
bytes or detecting a graph cycle. Others need scientific judgment: whether an omitted variable
is plausibly a common cause, whether a policy’s information set reflects actual availability,
or whether a transport assumption is defensible. An admissible workflow can automate the

                                               862
48.2. Backend alternatives and what can actually be compared                                  863


first group and record uncertainty in the second. A fixed controller can continue independent
analyses after one method refuses a request, provided it does not substitute a new target
without an explicit revision.


48.2      Backend alternatives and what can actually be compared
An offline fixture is the first useful backend. It returns a predetermined proposal whose
intended errors and ambiguities are known. It can establish whether the controller preserves a
PAG, refuses an unsupported policy and binds a result to the right horizon. It cannot establish
how often a language model generates a correct proposal. The existing local prototype accepts
authored or recorded proposals and makes no live model calls. Recorded provider/model labels
are caller-supplied provenance, not independently authenticated proof of generation. (Causal
banking proposal project, 2026d; Causal banking proposal, 2026ab)
   A prospective local model moves the inference computation to a selected host. Qualification
would bind weight files, tokenizer, inference software, quantization and decoding settings,
model terms and any remotely retrieved material. A prospective hosted model binds a provider
endpoint, model revision or declared alias policy, request/response schema, data transfer
boundary, usage accounting and service contract. These are comparison requirements. Neither
local execution nor a commercial contract by itself establishes causal competence, confidentiality
of every component, or permission to use a particular source. Current model rankings, prices
and retention guarantees are not inferred from generic framework examples. (Causal banking
proposal, 2026z)

   Model substitution is therefore a reviewed change to the analysis system. If a provider
