Linearity gives the equality because ER Ri = πi . Inclusion may depend on a recorded risk score;
its probabilities must describe the actual random design. A deterministic zero-probability
exclusion makes this argument unavailable for that part of the collection. A missed adjudication
after selection is another observation process, requiring its own treatment.
  For independent Bernoulli inclusion across outputs, the design variance is
                                                     1 X 1 − πi 2
                                   VarR (qb | d) =             di .
                                                     N2 i  πi

The independence in this formula is an assumption of the audit design, not an assertion that
banking mechanisms or model errors are independent. Sampling a fixed number without
replacement or reviewing whole mechanism clusters changes the variance through joint inclusion
probabilities. Repeats and paraphrases should normally be grouped by mechanism before
deciding the scientific unit of inference. Generalization to new mechanisms is a further sampling
problem, beyond a correct audit of this finite list.
   An exact four-output example makes the cost of uneven inclusion visible. Take error labels
(1, 1, 1, 0) and independent inclusion probabilities (1/2, 1/4, 3/4, 1). Enumerating the eight
positive-probability selections gives ER qb = 3/4 and VarR qb = 13/48, agreeing with the displayed
formula. If the first three errors are all selected, the estimate is 11/6. A design-unbiased
weighted estimator can lie outside the range of the parameter in a particular sample. Clipping
it to one changes its expectation, so a report should not silently clip and preserve the original
unbiasedness claim. A more balanced or stratified design can improve precision; its sample
allocation and variance calculation should be planned before the final review. (Causal banking
proposal, 2026ac)
   Truthful adjudication remains a separate premise. Two reviewers can agree because they use
the same erroneous target, reference graph or model answer. Perfect agreement is compatible
with shared error. If the review records a proxy label zi , weighting by inclusion estimates
its population mean, not the unknown mean of di . Method-blinded presentation, an explicit
rubric, independently derived tiny oracles and retained disagreements make the evidence
more informative. They do not prove the reviewers correct. Unresolved labels should remain
unresolved, with sensitivity bounds or additional reference work, rather than being converted
to majority-vote truth.
906                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


   In a restructuring-offer study, targeted review might inspect every proposed use of a post-
offer balance because it is a likely leakage defect. That review answers whether the defect
exists and how to repair it. An additional random audit across all formulated tasks answers
a different question: how often does the workflow produce a critical error under this task
collection and rubric? Keeping both records permits efficient development without converting
a defect-hunting sample into an unsupported reliability claim. Neither record establishes
authentic institutional assignment or monetary truth.


50.13        Consistency checks require a scientific reference
A metamorphic check compares answers to related inputs when computing a full reference
answer for every input is difficult. The relation must preserve or deliberately transform the
scientific problem. A permutation of arbitrary node identifiers should permute the same
graph object. Reversing a binary action contrast should negate its effect when the action
definitions and population are preserved. Changing a unit of outcome rescales that effect.
These relations can expose implementation or formulation errors without requiring an expensive
model comparison.
   Their force depends on the information supplied. Renaming a meaningless identifier is
different from deleting a substantive variable definition that supplied domain knowledge.
Changing offer to acceptance changes the intervention; shifting a feature timestamp past the
offer changes its admissibility. A benchmark should annotate the expected relation before
running the assistant. Otherwise an answer that correctly responds to a changed problem may
be scored as inconsistent.
   Consider a stipulated structural model for an offer A, pre-offer risk indicator X, and
contribution Y in hundreds of US dollars. Let A and X be independent fair Bernoulli variables
and Y = A + X, with consistency and no interference. The average contribution contrast for
offering rather than not offering is

                                   τ = E{Y (1) − Y (0)} = 1.

Arbitrary relabeling leaves this contrast unchanged; coding the action as B = 1 − A gives the
reversed contrast −1. A deliberately incorrect rule that always reports zero satisfies both the
relabeling and reversal relations. It also satisfies any outcome-unit scaling relation because
zero rescales to zero. Thus even perfect performance on these consistency relations does not
imply correctness on this model. A single admitted nonzero oracle case detects the defective
rule.
   The banking consequence is concrete under these stipulated values. At an incremental offer
cost of USD40 per account, the true modeled net increment is USD60. The always-zero rule
predicts minus USD40 and can reject an offer that is beneficial in the constructed model. This
calculation measures neither real bank effects nor actual assistant performance; it shows why
consistency scores alone cannot support a decision-value claim. (Causal banking proposal,
2026ac)
     A nonlinear outcome change needs still more care. Evaluating Y ∗ = Y 2 changes the target
to
                             E{Y (1)2 − Y (0)2 } = E(1 + 2X) = 2.
If instead X = 0 for every account, the original contribution effect is still one but the
squared-outcome effect is one. Therefore a known original mean effect does not determine
the squared-outcome effect. Likewise the effect on 1{Y ≥ 1} is one half under the fair-X
construction. A threshold event and a squared objective are new response functions, not
50.14. Admitting an oracle before funding a larger experiment                                907


cosmetic unit changes. They require their own definitions, units and reference calculation. A
deterministic small model can supply those references without pretending that the changed
objective is the original monetary benefit.
   For a stochastic assistant, exact equality of two realized responses is not the general null
hypothesis: fresh calls can disagree even when their output distributions obey the intended
relation. The design should declare whether it tests a deterministic replay, a coupled stochastic
run or a distributional property over repeated calls. Such repeats remain nested within the
mechanism. A high agreement rate is useful diagnostic evidence, while accuracy, scientific
justification and generalization require their own references and sampling units.


50.14      Admitting an oracle before funding a larger experiment
These arguments suggest a concrete admission procedure for public and generated benchmark
cases. First retain the business target and allowed information alongside the generator’s hidden
world. Next verify which features of that world are identified from the information actually
supplied to the method. A generator can know an effect that the analyst cannot identify. Then
check the numeric or set-valued reference with a separate small implementation or analytic
enumeration. Finally ensure that the scorer preserves unavailable reference states and target
types. The inspected CausalDS grader’s default when identification metadata is absent makes
this last check substantive; source-level correctness cannot be inferred merely from a successful
score being returned. (causalNLP/cladder; andleb/causalds, 2026; Causal banking proposal,
2026ad)
   For a task without an established reference, keep the task visible and report its unresolved-
reference status. Do not label every answer wrong, label the generator’s preferred answer
correct, or silently exclude the task from an all-assigned success rate. Validated tasks can
have their own conditional scores, accompanied by the fraction and kinds of tasks for which
no valid reference was available. This separates an oracle defect from an assistant defect and
indicates where the next research effort is needed.
   The first prototype can implement these admissions, the exact adversarial cases, and
explicit exposure and audit records using public documents and generated mechanisms. An
ordinary numerical reference and a structured form workflow provide inexpensive comparators
before adding language assistance. A later bounded live pilot should estimate the unresolved
translation and review burdens under declared information and budgets. Changing the prompt
or scorer after inspecting pilot failures is legitimate development, followed by a fresh final
collection. Evidence of useful performance and manageable review cost can then justify a bank
experiment. The proposal does not require that costly experiment to explain or test these
preliminary failure mechanisms.


50.15      Two further benchmarks sharpen the evaluation contract
Two primary studies extend the comparison in different directions. Wang’s CausalBench groups
four perspectives on each scenario across text, mathematics and code. Babakov, Reiter and
Bugarín’s CausalGraphBench standardizes descriptions for reconstructing published graphs.
The names refer to distinct artifacts; Wang’s language benchmark is also distinct from the
biological perturbation benchmark discussed elsewhere. Their value to the proposal comes
from their task definitions and exposed limitations, not from treating every reported score as
a common causal capability. (Wang, 2024; Babakov et al., 2025)
908                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


50.15.1     Four questions make a stricter outcome, not a proof of understand-
            ing

CausalBench asks cause-to-effect and effect-to-cause questions, each with and without inter-
vention. Its construction starts from manually expanded scenarios, uses GPT-4 Turbo for
scale, and describes a causal inference engine followed by human review when answers disagree.
The four-question group score requires all four answers to be correct. Table 2 reports 61.4%
group correctness and 88.7% overall correctness for GPT-4 Turbo on the mathematical tasks.
These are historical author-reported outcomes. They do not measure the effect of language
assistance on a banking decision. (Wang, 2024)
  The metric has a useful, exact interpretation. If Sj is correctness on perspective j, pj =
Pr(Sj = 1), and q = Pr(S1 = S2 = S3 = S4 = 1), then
                                       P4
                              max{0,    j=1 pj − 3} ≤ q ≤ minj pj .

The lower bound follows by applying the union bound to the four error events; the upper
bound follows because joint success implies each individual success. Neither argument assumes
independent answers. Using the reported GPT-4 Turbo mathematical margins, 78.6%, 88.3%,
91.7% and 96.0%, gives 54.6%–78.6%. The reported 61.4% lies inside that range. The group
score measures their joint behavior, which the mean alone conceals. It does not establish
how the correct answers were produced. Even four independent fair binary guesses are jointly
correct with probability 1/16; dependence or answer imbalance changes that probability.
(Causal banking proposal, 2026ae)
   The quality-control description also illustrates the adjudication problem. Agreement between
a generated answer and an engine is accepted; disagreement triggers manual analysis. Shared
graph-extraction, target or identification errors can survive agreement. In particular, the paper’s
generic suggestion of an instrumental-variable or front-door route for hidden confounding
requires the corresponding assumptions and information; hidden confounding alone does not
supply either route. The project should retain the four-view rubric while independently
checking formal targets and a probability sample of agreed as well as disputed labels.
   Direct dataset adoption remains conditional. The inspected proceedings text describes
approximately 10,000 text, 2,000 mathematics and 2,000 code scenarios with four questions
each, while its introduction says more than 60,000 problems. Exact counts and split/version
identity require the original dataset bytes. Its CLADDER bibliography attribution also differs
from the Jin et al. original inspected here. These discrepancies should be reconciled before
claiming inherited provenance. The described engine is not an implementation verified in this
workspace. The proposed disposition is to adapt and test the rubric, while deferring imported
labels and code pending primary artifact, license and oracle inspection. (Wang, 2024)


50.15.2     Graph reconstruction and a recall probe have limited targets

CausalGraphBench selects 35 Bayesian-network graphs: 14 from repositories and 21 from
papers. The repository graphs have median 42 nodes, compared with 14 for the paper graphs.
Runnable files and the feasibility of extracting diagrams affect selection. GPT-4o helps extract
graph ideas, domains and clarified variable descriptions from source material; the evaluation
gives methods standardized descriptions. The resulting task is reconstruction from semantic
information. It is not discovery from an observed joint law, and the authors explicitly leave
data-driven and hybrid comparisons to future work. Each imported Bayesian network would
still need review of its causal interpretation for the proposed banking use. (Babakov et al.,
2025)
50.16. Conflicting modalities require correctness evidence and a separate causal test        909


   Method comparisons must retain their size scopes. Pair and triplet querying are limited to
graphs with at most ten nodes, and the iterative efficient method to fifty. On the small-graph
GPT-4o comparison, Table 2 reports edge-normalized structural Hamming distances of 0.65
for the single-query baseline, 1.67 for pairs and 2.02 for triplets. These adverse results make
the simple baseline essential. They do not support a compute-matched universal ranking. The
study also reports manual repair of malformed outputs and generation-token limitations; a
banking workflow must charge that intervention to its actual operational outcome.
  The metric convention is material: reversed directions count as two errors, and normalization
uses the reference edge count. A graph with a different normalization or reversal convention
cannot be compared numerically without recalculation. Nor does this directed-reference score
automatically fit an equivalence-class output. Graph validity, unresolved orientation and
downstream effect support retain their own evaluation contracts. (Babakov et al., 2025)
   The contamination probe asks a model to recall nodes from a named source, then recover
edges for high-recall cases. Its stated rule uses less than 15% deviation in node count and
recall above 0.85. This is a useful diagnostic for recognizable public graphs, but no calibrated
sensitivity or specificity for training exposure is supplied. Failure to recall a source does not
prove absence from training. There is also an internal inconsistency to resolve before copying
the flags: the Llama-3.3 asiam row has nine generated nodes against seven true nodes and
is treated as known, although the count deviation is 2/7, or about 28.6%, above the stated
limit. The printed record supports reporting this discrepancy; it does not justify inventing
a different threshold or correcting unpublished raw results. (Babakov et al., 2025; Causal
banking proposal, 2026ae)
   The proposal therefore adopts the idea of standardized descriptions and source-recall
diagnostics as development tools. Importing graph files, prompts or scores awaits artifact
and rights inspection, resolved count rules, checked variable meanings and an explicit causal
reference. Node paraphrasing can be an additional diagnostic only when the meaning is
preserved. Neither the count probe nor paraphrasing supplies the exposure bound in the
preceding mixture analysis. This restricted reuse route retains valuable evidence while keeping
the next prototype testable.


50.16       Conflicting modalities require correctness evidence and
            a separate causal test
A bank analyst may encounter a chart, its caption and a service narrative that support
different answers. Zhu and colleagues study an adjacent problem in Unraveling Cross-Modality
Knowledge Conflicts in Large Vision-Language Models. The inspected original is arXiv version
1, dated 4 October 2024; the archive’s later version 2 is a separate edition. Their text and
image question-answering experiments motivate checks for inconsistent representations, but do
not establish causal identification or bank decision performance. (Zhu et al., 2024b)
   Let T and V be textual and visual answer labels for the same task and let G be its gold label.
Define flip rate F = P (T ̸= V ) and accuracies aT = P (T = G) and aV = P (V = G). The
paper proposes a lower bound on its knowledge-conflict rate of the form CR ≥ F − (aT − aV ),
attributing a net accuracy gap to performance-gap samples. That attribution is an additional
premise about unobserved knowledge, rather than an identified consequence of observing
predictions.(Zhu et al., 2024b)
  Partition the observations by the correctness of each answer. Cases where text alone is
correct and cases where vision alone is correct both flip. Both-correct cases do not flip;
both-wrong cases may flip. Subtracting the accuracy difference gives the exact prediction
910                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


identity
              F − (aT − aV ) = 2P (T ̸= G, V = G) + P (T ̸= G, V ̸= G, T ̸= V ).           (50.1)
This is a project derivation about answer labels. It supplies no observation of stored knowledge
and no causal explanation of the errors. In a four-item authored example with gold answers
AAAA, text AABB and vision BBAA, each accuracy is one half, yet every answer flips
and the right side equals one. With text and vision both BBBB, agreement is perfect and
both accuracies are zero. Agreement, correctness and causal validity therefore need distinct
evaluation records.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026bp)


50.16.1     The decoding proposal and what the printed results establish

The paper reports that confidence, confidence shifts and minimum-variance strategies did not
reliably choose correct answers in the tested conflicts. Its dynamic contrastive decoding (DCD)
uses answer confidence to scale log-probabilities and subtracts the less confident modality from
the more confident modality. It requires access to the relevant probabilities and both modality
paths. It is a proposed inference-time answer rule, not a causal intervention on the bank’s
data-generating process. In particular, the earlier finding about confidence limits qualifies the
heuristic used to select the subtraction direction.(Zhu et al., 2024b)
   Table 4 reports LLaVA-34b accuracy rising from 80.99 to 83.35 on ViQuAE and from 66.02
to 68.14 on InfoSeek: gains of 2.36 and 2.12 percentage points, averaging 2.24 points. These are
author-reported cells, not reproduced model runs. The same table contains an InstructBlip-7b
InfoSeek tie at 50.53, so the printed claim of strict improvement across every case is too broad.
There is also a baseline inconsistency: Table 2 prints 82.46 for LLaVA-34b ViQuAE textual
accuracy, whereas Table 4 prints 80.99. Neither value should silently replace the other.(Zhu
et al., 2024b; Causal banking proposal project, 2026bp)
   Selected Table 5 cells require a stronger arithmetic qualification. Against the displayed
visual baseline accuracy 53.26, the reminder and answer-conflict values 53.99 and 54.58 differ
by +0.73 and +1.32 percentage points; the table instead prints −1.66 and −1.07. Against
the displayed recognized accuracy 58.11, values 57.25 and 58.51 differ by −0.86 and +0.40;
the printed changes are −2.53 and −1.27. These four inconsistencies do not resolve which
underlying experiment or baseline is intended. The selected InfoSeek accuracy changes from
22.11 to 21.25 and 20.23 do match the printed −0.86 and −1.88. Preserve the raw cells and
their edition while seeking data or clarification; do not use the inconsistent signs to rank a
mitigation. (Zhu et al., 2024b; Causal banking proposal project, 2026bp)


50.16.2     A bounded route from this literature to a banking prototype

The paper’s public repository is a candidate for inspection. Its code, data, license, environment
and raw results have not been acquired or qualified here. The proposal can nevertheless
specify useful tests using public or authored materials. Construct matched chart, table and
narrative versions of the same known-law problem, deliberately introduce a unit change, stale
date, swapped axis or unsupported causal caption, and retain a source-backed gold answer
for each representation. Evaluate answer correctness and conflict detection separately; count
abstentions and incorrect agreement. Require a causal question to pass the separate target,
graph and identification checks developed above even when all representations agree.
   Compare a single-modality baseline, source inspection, explicit disagreement reporting and,
where logits and rights permit, a reproduced DCD rule. Charge for both modality passes,
repeated confidence samples and human adjudication. The inspected appendix’s ten prompt
or dropout samples concern its confidence analysis; they are not a general guarantee about
50.17. Shared evidence and scientific validation in a causal assistant                      911


uncertainty or an automatic ten-fold price for DCD. Freeze tasks, corruptions, costs and
denominators before evaluation. A generated monetary target can expose a wrong decision
under a declared law, while authentic bank utility remains a later experiment. This sequence
makes the expensive study conditional on a demonstrated prototype merit.


50.17       Shared evidence and scientific validation in a causal
            assistant
A bank analyst may ask whether a fee waiver prevents delinquency, while several agents retrieve
policy manuals, propose confounders and restate the same customer-service memorandum.
Repetition can make one unsupported assumption appear to have several independent witnesses.
A second failure occurs when a fluent derivation is accepted because a validator assigns it a
low risk score. Neither successful storage nor a reassuring score establishes that the waiver is
identifiable from the available data. The useful product therefore needs distinct contracts for
admitting evidence, proposing a graph, validating a mathematical argument and releasing a
decision. Two recent papers expose both useful mechanisms and the assumptions that such
contracts must retain.

50.17.1     What an admission benchmark actually measures

Li et al. (2026c) distinguish a static admission benchmark from a running shared-memory
environment. The static construction imports public verdicts, adds authored agent and
consumer settings, and scores a fixed gold action. Its 1,200 episodes are divided into 600
training, 200 validation and 400 test episodes. Agreement with the admission specification is
the target; it is not an empirical measure of emergent propagation. The live construction uses
six agents for six rounds and 100 configurations per model family, with additional diagnostic
and truth-by-copy sets reported separately. Every live scenario is authored fiction. This makes
the input lineage and scenario truth available to the evaluator, but does not estimate their
frequency in bank operations.
  Only promotion writes to shared memory. Later candidates depend on what earlier policies
admitted, so a false-admission fraction is conditional on a policy-specific stream. If NπF false
candidates arrive under policy π and AFπ are admitted, the ratio
                                            fπ = AFπ /NπF                                 (50.2)
is not a comparison on common candidate inputs. For example, ten admissions from 100
false candidates give 0.10, whereas five from ten give 0.50. The first policy has the smaller
conditional rate and the larger number of admitted false claims. These are stipulated counts,
not the paper’s results. A prototype should therefore use both frozen-candidate replay, which
measures a gate on matched inputs, and a closed-loop experiment, which measures the whole
policy-induced stream. It must not combine their denominators.
   The paper’s propagation damage counts consumer reads while a false belief is retrievable.
This is simulated exposure, not monetary damage. Assertion adoption is a separate consumer-
output measurement. The reported 0.97–0.99 adoption of an uncontested false belief is
conditional on a memory-only consumer and a selected pool of 553 probes. It is informative
about that constrained interface, not a bank-wide error probability. Source-type gating
performs well in several authored scenarios but admits false restatements when the source
type supplies the authority signal it trusts. The lineage oracle rejects copied support yet can
admit independently restated falsehoods. Provenance and truth are different properties (Li
et al., 2026c).
912                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


   An elementary model makes the distinction precise. Suppose each of three independent
witnesses is correct with probability p = 4/5. A majority is correct with probability 3p2 (1 −
p) + p3 = 112/125. If all three repeat one root witness, the same majority is correct with
probability 4/5. Copy detection prevents an unjustified increase in confidence; it cannot
improve the root witness’s truth probability by itself. These independent rational calculations
are project examples, not a model fitted to the benchmark (Causal banking proposal project,
2026bo).

50.17.2     Truth, lineage and usefulness require separate tests

Input-feed lineage is fixed by the live scenario. For generated claims, retrieval is logged but the
derivation link remains agent-declared and can be incomplete. A citation may mention a false
proposition without endorsing it, while an uncited sentence may assert the same falsehood.
The benchmark therefore separates assertion grading from provenance tracing. Its assertion
grader receives gold propositions; a deployable admission policy does not. The distinction
must survive any reuse of its evaluation design.
   The paper also separates blind human labels from labels revised after seeing the grader.
On the assertion sample, the two blind annotators agree more closely with one another than
either does with the model grader. The consumer matcher misses rephrased values, and its
validation sample is balanced by matcher category rather than drawn to estimate deployment
prevalence. Reported false assertions and adoption therefore depend on the measurement
procedure. The release should retain raw sentences, blind adjudication, normalization rules
and alternative labels instead of treating one grader as truth. No evaluated admission policy
retracts beliefs although the store offers retraction actions; correction remains untested, not
technologically impossible. The Mem0 and A-MemGuard comparisons concern particular
components and configurations. They do not license an unrestricted conclusion about every
version or deployment of either system (Li et al., 2026c).
   For the bank prototype, each proposed graph edge should retain the business assertion,
original source, observation date, copying lineage, conflicting evidence and status of human
review. An edge such as “delinquency causes a servicing call” must not become “a ser-
vicing call causes delinquency” merely because several agents reproduce the same text. A
claim-dependency graph records support between sentences; an intervention graph records
assumptions about mechanisms. The former can organize evidence for the latter, but cannot
identify an intervention by its own topology.
  Usefulness must include abstention. Let pC and pW denote probabilities of a correct and a
wrong released answer per evaluated request, let an abstention have zero stipulated gross value,
and let c be mean cost per request. Under assumed benefit B and loss L, the expected net is
                                     V = BpC − LpW − c.                                     (50.3)
Take B = 10, L = 100 and c = 1 dollars. A policy with (pC , pW ) = (0.60, 0.05) has net zero
dollars; one with (0.30, 0.01) has net one dollar despite answering correctly less often. These
inputs illustrate a decision rule and are not observed bank values. Compare admission methods
at declared coverage, error costs and workload, then vary those assumptions. Agreement rates
or token counts alone cannot select the better bank policy(Causal banking proposal project,
2026bo).

50.17.3     What graph-structured conformal validation can promise

Mo et al. (2026) propose progressive scientific validation with branching and an approximate
deducibility graph. Their factuality definition requires both correct claims and justification
50.17. Shared evidence and scientific validation in a causal assistant                        913


from prior context and scientific ground truth. It does not require a relevant answer. Their
approximate graph has semantic ancestor-connectivity and consistency properties. Acyclicity,
reproducible template matching or a plausible linguistic causal connective does not alone
establish these properties.
   There is a sound conditional idea in the process-level argument. Let Z1 , . . . , Zn+1 be
exchangeable complete examples and let g be the same fixed measurable construction for every
example. Then (Zi , g(Zi ))n+1
                           i=1 is exchangeable because applying the same coordinate map
commutes with permutation. This argument permits rich dependence within one example.
It neither assumes that the claims inside a response are independent nor manufactures
exchangeability across examples. Training a validator, choosing a threshold on the test cases,
changing the generation policy after calibration, or selecting convenient branches requires a
separate argument. Randomized construction is possible if its randomness is incorporated
with the appropriate symmetric law; empirical repeatability below one does not verify the
paper’s deterministic special case.
   For a conventional score-coverage construction, a finite calibration sample uses rank k =
⌈(n + 1)(1 − α)⌉. If k = n + 1, an infinity sentinel may be needed; silently choosing the largest
finite calibration score changes the procedure. With n = 5 and α = 0.1, the rank is six. Most
importantly, coverage of a score or prediction set must be linked to the desired event that
the released reasoning is valid. That link requires trustworthy calibration labels, the correct
threshold orientation, a nested filtering family and the stated semantic conditions. The paper’s
coherent-factuality proof invokes those properties in addition to exchangeability. A fallible
validator accepting a false statement with score zero is enough to show why “accepted prefix”
cannot be substituted for “true prefix” in a cascade prevention argument(Mo et al., 2026;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026bo).
   A marginal guarantee is also different from simultaneous reliability. Five independent
answers, each valid with probability 0.9, have probability 1 − 0.95 = 0.40951 of at least one
invalid answer. Adaptive repeated queries need a specified selection and error-control contract.
This calculation does not refute a marginal conformal result; it identifies the additional product
question(Causal banking proposal project, 2026bo).


50.17.4     Ambiguities to repair before certification

Several passages prevent direct adoption of the paper as a certificate. Its main pipeline
accepts low risk scores, while its branching prose selects the highest score above threshold. Its
minimum-domain-quantile rule must be interpreted against an explicit event. For ordinary
coverage Pr(S ≤ q), decreasing q is not conservative: two deterministic domains with scores
and valid own-domain quantiles zero and one each have own-domain coverage one, but using
the minimum quantile zero gives coverage one half under an equal mixture. In contrast,
removing more claims can preserve an all-retained-claims-valid property when the candidate
family is properly nested and validity hereditary. The counterexample concerns the ordinary
score event, not that distinct filtering theorem. The implementation must state which event
it guarantees and prove the relevant nesting rather than transport the word “conservative”
between them (Mo et al., 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026bo).
   The displayed progressive-generation pseudocode increments its attempt counter only when
it is below the maximum. If the last attempt again fails, the loop condition remains true and
no exit or counter increment is shown. An independent bounded trace with maximum two
gives attempt states 1, 2, 2, 2, 2. This is a finding about the printed algorithm, not evidence
that an uninspected implementation hangs. A prototype should use a bounded attempt loop,
distinguish an incomplete retained prefix from a completed answer, and return an explicit
914                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


abstention when its budget is exhausted. The paper’s cycle-to-linear-graph fallback likewise
needs semantic testing; turning a graph into a DAG does not establish the claimed deduction
relation.
   The reported empirical ranking also needs reconciliation. Table 1 gives MATH accuracy 48.9
for the descendant-weighted method and 71.2 for one listed comparator, despite its universal-
superiority caption. Table 2 changes the full-system MATH and ScienceQA accuracies, and a
partial configuration reports PhyX accuracy 53.1 and validity 92.1, compared with 50.1 and
91.7 for the full system. Main-text and appendix model roles, overall validity, and some domain
figures also differ. These observations justify requesting exact run manifests, denominators,
paired outcomes and frozen calibration sets before ranking methods. They do not establish
misconduct, nor do they erase the useful design ideas. The local review reproduces arithmetic
and control-flow witnesses only; it does not reproduce the reported model experiments(Mo
et al., 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026bo).


50.17.5     A bounded public-evidence prototype route

The proposal can proceed without costly bank experiments. Construct public or authored
business scenarios with declared truth and copying lineage; keep scoring-only labels out of
agent inputs. Freeze separate tasks for translating a business request, proposing competing
intervention graphs, identifying a query, checking an argument and deciding whether to answer.
Replay admission gates on common candidates, then test the entire interacting pipeline with
independent scenario units. Include paraphrase, conflicting authoritative text, missing lineage,
incorrect graph orientation, unsupported deduction, cyclic dependency output and exhausted
validation budgets.
   Fit scoring components on training examples; choose the complete generation, branching and
validation procedure before calibration; evaluate on untouched examples under the declared
sampling law. Record refusals, incomplete answers, truthful corrections, coverage, resource use
and conditional errors separately. Inspect authentic software, licenses and run artifacts before
choosing direct adoption or a port. The memory benchmark is presently a design reference
and the scientific-validation paper a hypothesis and cautionary comparison. Neither supplies
a ready certificate for causal discovery, bank identification or universal scientific truth. This
staged use of public evidence can establish whether a prototype merits a later bank study
while preserving the scientific questions that the eventual study must answer.


50.18      Original factuality guarantees and an agent-facing econo-
           metrics comparator
The preceding discussion leaves two different uncertainties: which validity claim the original
conformal arguments support, and whether a unified agent-facing estimator interface already
exists in a form worth reusing. The original factuality papers and the StatsPAI software
paper permit more precise answers. They narrow the design obligations without supplying an
accepted causal product.


50.18.1     A lower guarantee is not a tight calibration interval

Mohri and Hashimoto (2024) formulate factuality as entailment by a chosen reference. Their
guarantee is relative to the available binary entailment oracle, which may be a human or an
automated judge; it is not a theorem that the oracle represents external truth. A back-off
50.18. Original factuality guarantees and an agent-facing econometrics comparator               915


mechanism progressively weakens a response and must admit an empty response. Its safe-
threshold score checks every subsequent threshold, not merely one currently accepted claim.
This distinction permits their lower bound without nested entailment sets. In their Theorem
4.1, nesting is an additional condition for the tight upper bound. The theorem also restricts
the finite-sample error level to α ≥ 1/(n + 1) and specifies distinct scores. The infinity-sentinel
example in the preceding discussion describes a conventional extension outside that finite
order-statistic range; it is not a claim that this published theorem covers n = 5, α = 0.1 as
written.
   Their practical merger assumption states that a merged output is entailed if and only if each
retained claim is entailed. This is a semantic property of decomposition and recombination,
not stochastic independence of claims. The exchangeability requirement concerns complete
input/reference examples. Correlated claims inside one example do not by themselves violate
that sampling assumption. The distinction is particularly important when a bank answer
combines accounting identities, a causal assumption and an estimate: all three may depend
on the same underlying records while requiring different truth checks. Their empirical study
uses the first 50 inputs from each of three datasets, author-provided labels and repeated
random half-splits. A thousand re-splits do not create a thousand independent newly collected
samples. Their limitations explicitly distinguish marginal validity from per-user, per-domain
and fixed-calibration-set guarantees, and warn about changing input distributions(Mohri and
Hashimoto, 2024).
   Rubin-Toles et al. (2025) make a related but distinct separation. Their lower bound
calibrates the maximum tolerable risk using actual coherent-factuality labels for candidate
subsets. That lower-bound argument does not require the proxy graph to satisfy every semantic
property of an approximate deducibility graph. Their tight upper bound additionally uses
the approximate-graph properties and a finite first-bad-subgraph threshold. This qualifies the
preceding statement about graph and nesting requirements: those requirements cannot all
be treated as necessary for every lower-bound construction. They matter for the particular
tight-bound proof and for the shortcut that replaces full subset labels with graph-assisted
individual labels. Genuine subset-level truth information remains the crucial resource.
   The paper labels graph-assisted individual assessments as silver and direct subset assessments
as gold. Silver labeling asks whether a claim would be true if its ancestors were true. Turning
these labels into a subset truth assessment presumes adequate graph structure. The MATH
evaluation contains both label types, whereas FELM contains only silver labels and exhibits
some miscalibration. The authors explicitly say that their model-generated graph validity
cannot be enforced rigorously, report difficulties with long outputs, and find nonsensical or cyclic
biography graphs. Their re-prompted completions are evaluated separately: observed error
reduction is not an automatic extension of the original filtered-output guarantee (Rubin-Toles
et al., 2025).
   For a prototype, choose one of two auditable services. A full subset-label service evaluates
the actual retained reasoning, with its annotation cost and subjective rubric recorded. A
cheaper graph-assisted service must test the graph and labeling shortcut against independent
subset judgments and retain the resulting uncertainty. Neither service may identify truth
with a model’s confidence score. Fit scorers separately, freeze the complete pipeline and
query population, retain tie rules and empty-output behavior, and evaluate answer usefulness
alongside validity. The original theory supports these bounded choices; it does not certify
unrestricted banking questions or an adaptively changing assistant.
916                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


50.18.2     StatsPAI changes the integration comparison

The published StatsPAI paper describes a unified Python interface spanning regression, panels,
IV, modern difference-in-differences, regression discontinuity, synthetic control, matching and
heterogeneous-effect methods. Its registry supplies argument/output schemas, limitations,
citations, stability tiers and structured failures for agent-facing discovery, including possible
MCP use. The authors identify the integration layer, rather than a single superior estimator,
as their contribution. Their package depends on established numerical and econometric
libraries and offers optional PyTorch, JAX and Rust/PyO3 paths. These are source-reported
capabilities, not results of execution in this proposal(Wang and Rozelle, 2026).
   The comparison is substantive because the proposed library also needs a common method-
discovery and result surface. Before building another broad wrapper, inspect whether a
StatsPAI adapter can preserve the proposal’s estimand, population, intervention, observation
clock, uncertainty type, assumption failures and refusal states. A shared coefficient field
is useful only if it does not disguise different causal targets. The paper limits its uniform
reporting/export promises to mature estimators; auxiliary helpers have narrower capabilities.
Dedicated packages may expose more design-specific options, and optional compiled kernels
add platform and build costs. A registry count therefore measures interface breadth, not the
number of independently qualified causal methods(Wang and Rozelle, 2026).
   The paper reports a cross-language parity harness covering more than sixty estimator
modules, with matched input bytes and disclosed tolerances. It also distinguishes redistributable
real teaching data from deterministic simulated replicas calibrated near published estimates.
Those replicas are not exact replications of the original studies. Its Texas synthetic-control
example reports different local optima and roughly three-percent effect agreement; a smaller
pre-treatment fit error does not by itself establish a more accurate counterfactual. Its reported
1,000-replication coverage checks concern selected OLS, difference-in-differences and strong-
instrument IV designs. They do not establish weak-instrument validity or arbitrary bank
dependence. Each claim requires the exact source, data identity, harness, tolerances and output
artifacts before this proposal can report independent reproduction (Wang and Rozelle, 2026).
   A reasonable disposition is conditional adapter/reference use while source and dependency
review proceeds. Inspect the published release, registration mechanism, schema coverage, error
handling and stability distinctions; map one bounded design end to end; run a registered
comparison against an independent reference; then decide whether direct dependency, isolated
worker or selective port preserves the contract. Reject a route if it loses the scientific target or
silently converts unsupported states into numeric answers. The paper declares the package MIT
licensed and distinguishes it from a commercial downstream product; package, dependency,
dataset and commercial-use rights still require their own exact records. This route can
avoid unnecessary duplication while keeping native qualification and bank adoption as later,
separately evidenced decisions.


50.19       From an agent-facing toolkit to a qualified causal adapter
The preceding software comparison motivates a more precise design decision. A banking analyst
may ask an agent to estimate the effect of a servicing intervention, compare alternative estima-
tors, and preserve a result that another analyst can reproduce. A unified catalogue can reduce
the effort of finding and calling methods. It does not itself determine which customers, inter-
vention, time horizon or assignment law make the returned number relevant. StatsPAI provides
a concrete integration candidate against which to develop this separation. The inspected cut-
off source declares version 1.39.0 at commit 35d5a4fbd05f1b90201c24d806df9b12f966e50d,
50.19. From an agent-facing toolkit to a qualified causal adapter                              917


dated 7 October 2026. This is distinct from the paper’s archived version 1.23.0; an observation
about one version cannot silently be transferred to the other. The selected eleven files include
the package declaration, result-schema exporter, parity taxonomy, MCP server, workflow guide
and two test specifications. (Biaoyue Wang and StatsPAI contributors, 2026a; Wang and
Rozelle, 2026)
   The package declares Python 3.10 or later, a substantial scientific and reporting dependency
set, optional JAX and PyTorch stacks, and separate command-line and MCP entrypoints.
Its inspected MIT notice includes an attribution condition and warranty disclaimer. The
package declaration also names third-party notices; those notices, dependency-specific terms
and dataset rights require their own inventory before a chosen distribution. A package-level
license observation is not a conclusion about every optional component or about the separately
identified commercial downstream product. An adapter should pin the source, selected extras
and executable environment together, rather than relying on lower bounds in a package
declaration as a reproducible lock. (Biaoyue Wang and StatsPAI contributors, 2026a)


50.19.1     Transport shape and scientific admissibility

There are at least three distinct contracts. A transport contract determines whether the
response can be read. A result contract determines whether the required fields and diagnostics
for a particular method are present. A scientific contract determines whether the estimand and
uncertainty answer the banking question under stated assumptions. The exported agent-result
JSON schema requires only a string-valued method. It permits method-specific extensions,
and its interval array has no length or order constraint. Its standard error, probability and
observation-count properties do not impose nonnegativity, the unit interval or integer-valued
sample size respectively. The MCP server’s compact advertised output schema is more
permissive still: it accepts any object and refers the client to a fuller result resource. This
supports a heterogeneous catalogue, but acceptance under either schema must not be promoted
into scientific admissibility. (Biaoyue Wang and StatsPAI contributors, 2026a)
   Independent data-only checks make the boundary concrete. A payload containing only a
method name satisfies the exported schema. A second payload with a reversed interval [2, 1],
standard error −1, p-value 2, error level −1 and observation count 0.5 also satisfies it, as
does an empty interval array. A numeric method name fails. These are deliberately authored
payloads validated against the downloaded schema; they are not observations that an estimator
emitted such values. The check executes the project’s validator and parses upstream syntax as
data; it does not import or execute StatsPAI. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026cc)
   For a proposed average-treatment-effect adapter, the consumer contract should require the
target population, treatment contrast, units, horizon, information cutoff and identification
assumptions, together with a declared uncertainty kind. If a finite standard error is applicable,
require it to be nonnegative. If an ordinary confidence interval is applicable, require two ordered
endpoints and an explicit coverage level. A legitimate unbounded identified set must retain
its meaning through a separate representation; turning an infinity into an apparently missing
scalar would erase information. Regression coefficient tables, causal effects, diagnostic tests
and helper responses need distinct variants. Refusal and partial identification are substantive
outcomes, not malformed estimates to be replaced by a default value. These requirements are
our proposed consumer design, beyond the generic transport schema.
918                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


50.19.2     Failures, time budgets and reproducible custody

The inspected server distinguishes JSON-RPC request failures from failures inside a tool call.
It constructs an execution-error response with an error flag, structured error fields and a
serialized text representation. The underidentified-IV tests specify retention of diagnostic and
alternative-method information. Those tests are useful contract specifications; their presence
is not evidence that they passed in a local executable environment. Likewise, a suggested
alternative method is a proposal for analyst review, not proof that it is identified under the
original question’s assumptions. (Biaoyue Wang and StatsPAI contributors, 2026a)
   Timeout semantics particularly matter after an interrupted session. The caller can dispatch
an eligible call to a process worker, but a result that cannot be transferred can fall back to
the thread runner. The process-timeout branch reports a killed worker. The thread branches
explicitly report that a data read or computation may remain active. Eligibility, kill behavior,
handle transfer, queue admission and orphan tracking are delegated to other modules that were
not part of this eleven-file inspection. The supported conclusion is therefore about the caller’s
distinct contracts, not a verified guarantee that every call stops computing when its client
stops waiting. An adapter should retain actual execution mode and worker state, reconcile the
original attempt after reconnection, and allow a retry only after its duplication and resource
consequences are understood. This is the same distinction between an observation deadline and
terminal completion required of commercial workflow services. (Biaoyue Wang and StatsPAI
contributors, 2026a)
   Output size has a similarly precise boundary. The server applies its budget to the structured
result and then serializes that result again in a text content block; an image can be appended
separately. The stated budget is not a cap on the entire transmitted message. A structured
JSON payload of 262,144 bytes already contributes at least 524,288 bytes when present twice,
before enclosing fields, string escaping or an image. This is an arithmetic lower bound on the
duplicated representations, not a network benchmark. A causal adapter should measure and
limit the complete response and preserve whether risk details were shortened. The inspected
caller records nonfinite locations, truncation metadata and a capped list of runtime warnings;
it calls separate helpers for the detailed budgeting policy. A small successful message is not
sufficient if omitted diagnostics could change the decision. (Biaoyue Wang and StatsPAI
contributors, 2026a; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cc)
   The workflow guide recommends saving externally retrieved data and preserving provider,
indicator, query, retrieval date and transformations. It distinguishes local-file provenance from
remote data whose bytes are not hashed unless saved locally. The caller also distinguishes a
standalone replay from a replay that depends on process-held handles or merely records a
call. Thus a replay string is not a complete reconstruction package. For a banking proposal,
the reusable artifact should contain the selected immutable input, transformation graph,
model configuration, sampling and fold choices, package environment, complete result and
diagnostics. Its permissions and confidential-data custody must be specified separately. No
sibling repository has to be modified to define this handoff: a consumer can read a versioned
artifact and test the declared result contract in its own environment. (Biaoyue Wang and
StatsPAI contributors, 2026a)


50.19.3     Parity is conditional on the target and the statistic

The taxonomy explicitly records past problems with inherited alias claims and circular evidence.
It separates estimator entries from loaders, renderers and other infrastructure, and requires
named equivalence evidence before an alias receives another entry’s grade. Its mapping labels
externally aligned results as certified, internally supported results as validated, and other states
50.19. From an agent-facing toolkit to a qualified causal adapter                            919


as API-stable. These are upstream labels with specific meanings. None is an independent
certification of a bank’s causal claim. The source’s Python-reference mapping contains eight
entries although the adjacent comment still says two; the literal mapping, verified without
executing the module, prevents the stale comment from narrowing the apparent cross-package
exceptions. Cross-package comparison should not be described as cross-language evidence
when both implementations are Python. (Biaoyue Wang and StatsPAI contributors, 2026a;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026cc)
   The inspected parity-boundary tests read committed results. For one RD fixture they
prescribe much tighter point-estimate tolerances than the allowed relative standard-error
difference of seven percent. A DML comparison specifies shared explicit folds; a synthetic-
control comparison distinguishes nonunique weight solutions and a unique-solution counterpart.
These are useful prospective checks. They do not show that the current installation reproduced
R or Stata, or that a tight agreement on one fixture establishes coverage for another sampling
law. An adapter’s evidence unit must therefore name the exact entrypoint, input bytes,
target, statistic, convention, reference version and tolerance. The guide itself separates stored
comparisons from invoking a separately configured R or Stata runtime. (Biaoyue Wang and
StatsPAI contributors, 2026a)
   A documented non-alias illustrates why matching a method family is insufficient. The
taxonomy distinguishes cohort-size weighting from treated-observation weighting even when
both arise from related difference-in-differences estimators. Consider our stipulated servicing
example with two cohorts of ten customers each. The first cohort contributes three post-
treatment periods and has a constant effect of USD 4 per customer-period; the second
contributes one period and has effect USD −4. The equal-customer average effect at a common
evaluation period is
                                            10(4) + 10(−4)
                                τcustomer =                 = 0,
                                                   20
whereas the available treated-observation average is

                                             10 · 3 · 4 + 10 · 1 · (−4)
                            τobservation =                              = 2.
                                                         40
With a stipulated USD 1 per-customer decision cost, the first target gives net USD −1.
Subtracting that cost from the second average gives USD 1 but mixes a different weighting
target into the customer decision. Neither arithmetic calculation repairs the mismatch. No
estimator is run here, and these dollar inputs are authored examples, not measured benefits. The
adapter must bind the aggregation and horizon before deciding whether two software outputs
disagree or simply answer different questions. (Biaoyue Wang and StatsPAI contributors,
2026a; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cc)


50.19.4     Adoption decision and a bounded qualification route

The preferred proposal route is a conditional isolated adapter, with StatsPAI serving as a
source-grounded reference until qualification. Its catalogue, metadata, structured errors and
replay concepts are valuable design assets. Direct blanket adoption is deferred because the
generic schema does not enforce our scientific contract and runtime guarantees depend on
uninspected helpers. A selective port may be justified by a specific numerical or deployment
need, but a broad port would add solver, environment and maintenance obligations. The
rejected claim is blanket certification based on registry labels or JSON validity; rejecting that
claim does not discard the underlying package. (Biaoyue Wang and StatsPAI contributors,
2026a)
920                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


   The executable qualification route has five bounded parts. First, inventory third-party
notices, selected dependencies and data rights, and lock one estimator family and environment.
Second, inspect the process worker, runner, loader, caches, replay and budget helpers at the
same revision. Third, when a separately permitted prototype environment exists, reproduce
one named estimator against a qualified reference with identical inputs and folds, preserving
full covariance, diagnostics and refusal behavior. Fourth, exercise stale handles, missing files,
nonfinite values, incomplete risk output, timeout, cancellation and reconstruction after restart;
scientific success must not survive an incomplete result. Fifth, compare the adapter with
a direct mature-package wrapper on matched public or generated tasks, recording actual
operational cost separately from stipulated banking economics. Failure at one gate gives a
scoped disposition and does not block independent literature or software review. This develops
a testable product proposal while leaving native implementation, independent acceptance and
bank adoption as later evidence.


50.20      Qualifying the worker, custody and replay boundary
The conditional adapter decision can now be narrowed by inspecting eight additional files at
the same StatsPAI cutoff revision. These cover third-party notices, process and thread workers,
output budgeting, local data loading, result and data caches, and replay construction. The
additional inspection resolves specific source questions left open in the preceding discussion.
It does not execute the toolkit or convert source-defined behavior into a measured reliability
claim. The third-party notice reproduces an MIT notice for the HonestDiD 0.2.8 algorithm
port in a named module; the selected dependency stack, redistribution and datasets still
require a complete inventory. (Biaoyue Wang and StatsPAI contributors, 2026b)


50.20.1     An observation deadline is not a complete resource contract

Process isolation is opt-in; the default is the thread runner. The eligibility predicate excludes
calls with data handles, selected session tools and pipeline prefixes. Result handles may
be transferred using signed serialized objects, but a missing or unpicklable result can cause
fallback to the thread path. The HMAC check establishes that a transfer was signed with the
shared per-call key; it is not a scientific validity test or a sandbox for arbitrary trusted Python
objects. The proposed adapter must declare whether a tool is eligible and record which mode
actually executed, rather than infer isolation from a server-wide option. (Biaoyue Wang and
StatsPAI contributors, 2026b)
   The process supervisor creates a child, writes its request, then establishes its deadline. On
timeout or cancellation it calls the direct child’s kill method and waits up to ten seconds. After
receiving a result it can wait up to thirty seconds for the child; when stdout closes without
an answer, a branch calls an unbounded wait. These are static control-flow observations, not
observed hangs. The inspected routine does not establish a process-tree termination guarantee,
nor does its clock cover every startup, request-write or post-response operation. A native
qualification should therefore measure end-to-end elapsed time separately from estimator
time and test startup failure, closed streams, descendants and delayed exit in a permitted
environment. The adapter’s own supervisor needs explicit terminal states and resource
ownership, including a response that says termination could not be confirmed. (Biaoyue Wang
and StatsPAI contributors, 2026b)
   The thread worker signals cancellation and registers unfinished threads as orphans. Cancel-
lation takes effect at a cooperative checkpoint or when the operation returns; the response
deadline does not kill the thread. In the inspected configuration reader, the default is 600
50.20. Qualifying the worker, custody and replay boundary                                     921


seconds and a nonpositive value disables the timeout. A proposed servicing workflow must
budget active attempts as well as client waiting time. In an entirely stipulated illustration,
a single useful outcome worth USD 10 and an attempt cost of USD 7 gives net USD 3; two
charged attempts delivering that same one outcome give USD −4. This arithmetic does
not measure infrastructure prices. It shows why retry policy belongs in the full workflow
comparison and why reconnecting should first reconcile the original request. (Biaoyue Wang
and StatsPAI contributors, 2026b; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cd)

50.20.2     Resource bounds and immutable inputs

The output-budget helper protects headline fields and selected evidence subtrees, shortens
other containers first, and reports incomplete risk details when risk lists must be shortened. It
can report unavoidable overflow when protected content itself cannot fit. Its scope remains
structured content, so the consumer must budget the whole wire representation separately.
This is a valuable explicit failure state: an oversized protected diagnostic should lead to an
artifact handoff or bounded refusal, not silent deletion of the scientific reason for rejecting an
estimate. (Biaoyue Wang and StatsPAI contributors, 2026b)
   The data cache estimates DataFrame memory usage, whereas the general result cache is
count-bounded by default and has optional expiry. Its insertion loop evicts for byte pressure
only while more than one entry remains. Consequently, the source permits the newest single
item to exceed the byte budget. A small independent model of that guard retains an item
of size 12 against a budget of 10. This is not a runtime memory measurement. A strict
deployment limit needs an explicit oversize-item decision before insertion, a clear distinction
between object estimates and process memory, and resource measurements that include workers
and serialization copies. Cache handles also do not supply durable storage: lineage stops
at an evicted parent, and its traversal has a finite depth. The adapter should retain an
external immutable reconstruction artifact when the scientific record must survive process loss.
(Biaoyue Wang and StatsPAI contributors, 2026b; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cd)
   The local loader resolves paths for an allowlist check, but no roots configured means
unrestricted local paths within the process’s own permissions. It then opens the caller path
through format-specific readers. Data-frame caching uses path, modification time and requested
columns; hash caching additionally uses file size and nanosecond modification time. These
are efficient cache keys, not immutable identities. Two distinct equal-length byte strings have
different hashes while their path and metadata could be held equal. Moreover, path checks,
data reading and provenance hashing occur as separate operations. No concurrent change was
performed or observed in this review, but the control flow does not itself establish that the
hashed bytes are exactly the parsed bytes under concurrent replacement. A proposal requiring
that guarantee should stage a regular immutable input under a content identity, establish
provenance from the same captured bytes, and test its platform’s path and replacement
behavior. Remote acquisition should retain provider metadata and local bytes before analysis.
These requirements strengthen the custody contract without claiming that a real bank incident
occurred. (Biaoyue Wang and StatsPAI contributors, 2026b; Causal banking proposal project,
2026cd)

50.20.3     Re-execution and full numerical agreement are different claims

The replay helper improves on a bare call string: a standalone bundle records a local file hash
and transformations and can generate a script that checks the input digest. Nevertheless,
the generated script checks only a point estimate when both an expected value and a result
attribute exist, plus any expected coefficient point estimates. The helper collects selected
922                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


standard error and observation-count fields into its expected-value record, but the script does
not compare them. It also lacks an assertion that at least one number was checked, so its
success text permits a zero-check case. Static inspection of the template and independent
AST assertions reproduce these observations without generating or executing an upstream
script. This is a limited comparison contract, not proof of a numerical failure in an estimator.
(Biaoyue Wang and StatsPAI contributors, 2026b; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cd)
  For the causal service, a replay outcome should say separately whether the input bytes
matched, whether transformations and environment matched, whether the calculation finished,
and which scientific quantities were compared. The expected comparison set must include
every claimed quantity: effect or identified set, uncertainty representation, sample membership
and weighting, full covariance where aggregation uses it, diagnostic and refusal status, and any
random split or optimization setting relevant to the result. Missing expected fields must fail
that comparison rather than reduce its count. Tolerances should be predeclared by statistic,
with a difference attributed to numerical error, stochastic variation or a changed target. Version
text in a script comment is not an environment lock, and agreement of a coefficient alone
cannot certify the stated uncertainty.
   These findings refine the existing conditional-adapter route rather than justify building
another full estimator library. The next source review should inspect the transformations and
native fixtures actually selected for one banking task. The later permitted prototype should then
test process lifecycle, input replacement, cache oversize handling and full replay comparisons
before scaling to more estimators. Unresolved native behavior remains a bounded qualification
obligation; commercial-service source coverage, unread frontier papers and manuscript-depth
review can proceed independently.


50.21      A method-specific reuse decision for Python DoubleML
A uniform agent interface is most useful when its underlying scientific operation has a precise
target. Python DoubleML is a natural reference for orthogonal-score estimation, but the
package name does not identify one estimand or one sampling law. The inspected source is
pinned to commit 6884b5f9816f180324d854a4d81b22e9d334f5e0, dated 23 September 2026.
Five authenticated files cover the license, dependency declaration, data and panel containers,
and interactive-regression model. The checkout uses a dynamic version scheme. It is not
silently equated with the previously observed installed version 0.11.4, whose selected local
findings retain their original scope. The R implementation, generic double-machine-learning
methodology and wrappers in other packages are separate comparison objects. (DoubleML
contributors, 2026; DoubleML contributors, 2026; doubleml contributors, 2026)
  The inspected BSD three-clause notice requires retained notices and excludes unauthorized
endorsement; it is not a clearance of all transitive dependencies or datasets. The source
declares Python 3.10 or later and lower bounds on scientific libraries, with a separate optional
RD dependency. A named maintainer, public issue tracker and a dated source revision provide
concrete maintenance identity, not a support-duration commitment. The proposed reuse route
should select an executable environment and a narrow method before comparing its full cost
with a new implementation. (DoubleML contributors, 2026)

50.21.2     Reference now, a bounded adapter after qualification

The proposal disposition is to retain Python DoubleML as a method-specific reference and
condition a future isolated IRM worker on explicit qualification. Direct whole-package adoption
is deferred because target, propensity processing, score solving and uncertainty aggregation
vary across families. A new language port is not justified without a measured platform or cost
advantage that outweighs reproducing and maintaining those details. R DoubleML remains a
separate candidate for matched comparisons, and StatsPAI a separate integration candidate.
Neither receives automatic credit from the Python package’s source transparency or earlier
installed-version results. (DoubleML contributors, 2026)
   The conversion contract requires stable observation IDs and units, explicit outcome and
treatment definitions, nuisance-array ordering, saved folds and training provenance, raw and
924                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


processed propensities, normalization and weights. Outputs should retain score components,
the declared target, complete applicable uncertainty and all failures. Before native qualification,
inspect the selected propensity processor, score solver, repeated-split aggregation and covariance
delegates at the same revision, freeze the environment and review its data and dependency
notices. Then compare a selected operation with an independent reference on identical inputs,
including refusals and uncertainty, under the registered public or generated-data protocol.
The scientific owner supplies identification and sampling assumptions; the maintainer owns
conversion, versioning and regression checks; the operator owns custody and resource limits.
Changed source, target, sampling law or platform triggers re-review. This source follow-up
retains the earlier reference disposition. The recorded reuse decision remains inconclusive
because a complete release artifact, dependency lock and original license inventory are still
missing. No native integration capability or general inference guarantee is awarded.


50.22      Two complementary sensitivity references for a banking
           decision
A lending or servicing analysis can return a precise estimate while remaining vulnerable to
omitted borrower information. A useful product proposal must explain which perturbation
a sensitivity tool studies, which sampling uncertainty it preserves, and what changes in the
decision if the perturbation is credible. Two concrete R candidates illustrate why one generic
robustness field would be inadequate. The inspected CRAN mirror revisions are sensemakr
0.1.6, dated 23 July 2024, and EValue 4.1.4, dated 29 August 2025. Their immutable trees
authenticate thirteen selected source and documentation blobs. They are different engines: the
former develops regression sensitivity in partial-R2 coordinates; the latter includes risk-ratio
sensitivity thresholds and several effect-scale conversions. (Carlos Cinelli and sensemakr
contributors, 2026; Maya Mathur and EValue contributors, 2026)
   The package declarations are GPL-3 and GPL-2 respectively. The audit retains those
declarations and separately identifies local operating-system copies of the license texts; it does
not represent the latter as newly acquired package release files or a review of every dependency.
sensemakr declares R 3.1.0 or later and suggests additional packages including fixest. EValue
imports several plotting, meta-analysis and data-processing dependencies. A named maintainer
and dated CRAN snapshot establish concrete provenance, but do not promise future support
or a complete reproducible environment. The reference route below is therefore distinct from
permission to distribute an adapter. (Carlos Cinelli and sensemakr contributors, 2026; Maya
Mathur and EValue contributors, 2026)

   In the inspected fixest path, model extraction explicitly requests iid covariance. A warning
in the corresponding adjustment path identifies this restriction. Consequently, accepting a
clustered model object does not justify claiming that the original clustered uncertainty survives
the sensitivity calculation. The numeric helper’s degrees-of-freedom guard admits zero and
one, while its adjusted-variance expression contains ν − 1 in the denominator. The partial-R2
validator admits the endpoint a = 1, while the bias expression contains 1 − a. These are
static domain observations. The proposed regular profile requires finite inputs, s > 0, ν > 1,
0 ≤ a < 1 and 0 ≤ b < 1; degenerate boundaries receive an explicit separate disposition
instead of being presented as a finite scientific result. No native failure is inferred from source
inspection alone. (Carlos Cinelli and sensemakr contributors, 2026)
   Two further details belong in the qualification protocol. The direct adjusted_ci.numeric
helper uses ν − 1 in its critical-value calculation; the inspected numeric wrapper constructs
intervals with ν. Their uncertainty outputs cannot be promised identical without resolving
the intended convention. The wrapper also passes an estimate to an adjusted-SE helper that
accepts an ellipsis. That extra argument is accepted by the signature; it is not evidence of an
unused-argument error. Observed-covariate benchmarking introduces additional assumptions
through separate treatment and outcome multipliers. Its implementation rejects impossible
treatment bounds and warns before capping an implied outcome bound above one. The adapter
must retain those warnings, raw restrictions and benchmark choices, rather than turning a
benchmark label into evidence that the omitted variable exists or is no stronger than the
chosen observed variable. (Carlos Cinelli and sensemakr contributors, 2026)


50.22.2     Risk-ratio sensitivity requires an explicit effect scale

For the null target and a strictly positive observed risk ratio r, orient its magnitude as
q = max(r, 1/r). The selected threshold calculation reduces to
                                                q
                                       E=q+       q(q − 1).

The package describes this as confounding strength required to shift the observed association
to the specified target. It is not an estimated confounder strength, a corrected treatment effect
or a probability that the causal claim is true. The interface also permits a non-null target,
which must remain an explicit field rather than silently inheriting the null formula. It reports
the relevant near-target confidence limit separately; a supplied interval crossing the target
receives threshold one. That result does not establish that the effect is zero, and the original
interval’s sampling justification remains the caller’s responsibility. (Maya Mathur and EValue
contributors, 2026)
   The reciprocal ratios 9/5 and 5/9 both give threshold 3, while the null ratio 1 gives threshold
1. These exact arithmetic symmetries are useful conversion oracles. They do not test finite-
sample interval coverage. The source rejects negative point ratios and inconsistent interval
ordering, but its zero-inclusive checks and reciprocal operations leave singular boundary
926                                                              Causal analysis for a universal bank


behavior for native qualification. The proposed worker instead declares a strictly positive
finite ratio and target, compatible bounds, event coding, population and horizon; an infinite or
missing result is not renamed strong causal evidence. (Maya Mathur and EValue contributors,
2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cb)
  The broader package offers different conversions for odds ratios, hazard ratios, standardized
mean differences and linear-regression coefficients. For example, its nonrare-outcome odds-ratio
conversion uses a square root. This is an approximation, not a universal algebraic identity.
For odds ratio OR = 81/25, that conversion is 9/5. Under a stipulated baseline risk p0 = 1/5,
the exact risk-ratio identity for those two risks is instead

which differs from 9/5. A banking interface that discards event prevalence or the rare-outcome
