50.22.3     Reference decisions and the bounded prototype route

Retain both packages as method-specific proposal references. A future isolated R worker is a
conditional route for a declared regression-sensitivity or risk-ratio profile, after complete artifact
and dependency custody, applicable rights review and native conformance. Direct adoption of
every package family would overextend this inspection. A new Python, Java or C++ port
is not justified without a measured platform or maintenance advantage sufficient to cover
dispatch, numerical, uncertainty and upgrade obligations. Independent arithmetic remains a
matched oracle, not a substitute calibrated inference service. Neither package replaces graph
identification, trend sensitivity, selection-bias analysis or a different confounding model merely
because all are called sensitivity analysis. (Carlos Cinelli and sensemakr contributors, 2026;
Maya Mathur and EValue contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cb)
   The scientific owner must specify the causal question, adjustment clock, sampling law and
plausibility of sensitivity restrictions. The maintainer must preserve model and row identity,
covariance type, full conversion history, warnings and failures; compare direct helpers with
numeric and model dispatch; and register singular-input and incompatible-interval cases. The
operator must bind an actual delivery, dependencies and resource budget. Qualification then
compares the selected outputs with independent references on public or generated data before
expensive bank experiments. Changes in source, target, covariance law or delivery trigger
re-review. The two reference decisions settle the proposal’s present reuse choice while granting
no native integration capability or general sensitivity guarantee.


50.23       Goal clarification before causal analysis and tool dispatch
A request to improve a distressed-loan portfolio does not yet specify whether the decision
is to change contact frequency, offer a payment holiday, alter collections or merely explain
observed arrears. Dispatching a scientifically valid estimator for the wrong intervention still
answers the wrong business question. GIST-CMTF addresses a related upstream problem:
inferring a symbolic goal before filtering the tools exposed to a language-model agent. Its
June 2026 original develops candidate goals, ambiguity detection and clarification within a
50.23. Goal clarification before causal analysis and tool dispatch                                927


common precondition–effect vocabulary. The authentic ten-page original and a cutoff-selected
repository revision are useful design evidence, but their workflow use of causal does not by
itself identify a treatment effect or supply a structural causal model for borrowers. (Rahul
Suresh Babu and Rohit Shukla, 2026a,b)


50.23.1     What the state-transition model supplies

Represent a tool by ti = (di , Ri , Ei , ci , ρi ): a description, required state predicates, produced
predicates, optional cost and optional risk label. A state s and goal g are sets of predicates.
A symbolic tool is executable when Ri ⊆ s, and its declared transition adds Ei to the state.
The goal-inference layer maps the user’s request and state to candidate goals and confidence
scores; the paper describes confidence and margin rules that can request clarification instead
of committing to one goal. Clarification is itself represented as a transition, for example from
an ambiguous request to a specified goal. This supplies a concrete place to represent missing
business variables in a CLI or MCP request. (Rahul Suresh Babu and Rohit Shukla, 2026a)
   The proposed banking extension should require an intervention, comparator, population,
outcome, horizon, information clock and decision owner before constructing an effect query.
A lender’s goal predicate such as servicing option selected does not establish exchangeability,
support or a defensible adjustment set. Those are separate scientific obligations. Likewise, a
workflow edge saying a tool produces a graph does not establish that the graph is causally
correct. The useful inheritance is an explicit contract for ambiguity and clarification, with
scientific identification review following goal selection. (Rahul Suresh Babu and Rohit Shukla,
2026a,b)
   The inspected runner implements breadth-first search over monotone symbolic states and
returns the first tool on a shortest path, with ties determined by tool order. Optional cost
and risk labels in the conceptual representation are not thereby optimized. The semantic-goal
comparator uses lexical overlap with candidate descriptions. The model inference prompt
requests one selected goal and its confidence, while the actual clarification rule combines that
output with a fixed confidence threshold, vague-word detection and the benchmark’s annotated
request type. Thus the released implementation is a specific hybrid rule, not an evaluation of
an arbitrary calibrated goal posterior or the complete candidate-margin formulation. (Rahul
Suresh Babu and Rohit Shukla, 2026b)


50.23.2     Reported results and reproducible aggregation

The paper evaluates 120 constructed tasks: 40 explicit goals, 40 ambiguous goals, 30 missing-
variable requests and 10 clarification-required requests. Six methods and seven backends
produce 5,040 saved rows, with deterministic mocked tool effects. Independent data-only
checks confirm 5,040 unique model–method–task keys, 32 tools, positive saved token totals
and the published aggregate tables. GIST-CMTF succeeds in 815 of 840 rows, compared with
673 for top-goal CMTF and 696 for the semantic-goal comparator. Its 21 wrong-goal outcomes
contrast with 163 under top-goal CMTF. These are reaggregations of the released final dataset,
not independently repeated model calls or evidence of general superiority on banking requests.
(Rahul Suresh Babu and Rohit Shukla, 2026a,b; Causal banking proposal project, 2026bt)
   The disaggregated results matter. On explicit-goal tasks the paper reports 94.6% success for
GIST-CMTF versus 98.9% for the semantic-goal comparator, with unnecessary clarification on
16.8% of explicit requests. Its reported advantage is concentrated in ambiguous requests. The
final saved dataset retains 170 labeled errors: 128 precondition failures, 24 tool-parse errors,
14 empty responses, three goal-parse errors and one invalid selection. The authors state that
928                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


infrastructure-corrupted rows were cleaned before the final analysis. The final positive-token
file cannot establish the complete attempt, retry or provider-failure denominator without those
original logs and cleaning records. The paper explicitly leaves latency, monetary cost, user
satisfaction and real multi-turn clarification unmeasured. (Rahul Suresh Babu and Rohit
Shukla, 2026a,b; Causal banking proposal project, 2026bt)

50.23.3     A source-to-result reproducibility gap

The repository revision dated 30 June 2026 is later than the 15 June paper but before the
literature cutoff. Its identity is therefore distinct from proof that it generated the published
results. Eleven authenticated artifacts include the runner, task generator, registry, task file,
final metrics, summary tables, citation metadata, dependency declaration and MIT notice.
The requirements are unpinned, and no raw provider trace appears in the inspected complete
tree. The paper’s documented replacement of a Nova preview backend with Nova Pro is visible
in the saved rows, while the runner’s default list still names the preview profile. An explicit
override could explain the model list; it must be retained in a reproducible execution record.
(Rahul Suresh Babu and Rohit Shukla, 2026b)
   Three further discrepancies prevent direct replay claims. First, the runner forces clarification
for each nonexplicit request type and then assigns the annotated intended goal. Yet 53 of
560 nonexplicit GIST rows in the saved data report zero clarification. Second, the runner
reads a gold_path field to count wrong tools. None of the 120 task objects has that field; all
instead provide gold_chains. With those unmodified inputs, that branch has no expected
next tool against which to increment its count, whereas the saved file contains 3,520 wrong-tool
counts. Third, the runner’s written CSV columns differ from the released metrics columns.
An unreleased producer, transformation or earlier revision could reconcile these artifacts; the
available bytes do not establish which. This is an explicit provenance gap, not an allegation
that the reported observations were fabricated. (Rahul Suresh Babu and Rohit Shukla, 2026b;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026bt)
   Benchmark-assisted clarification also limits transport to real users. The runner consults
annotated request type and resolves a clarification by substituting the intended goal, without
observing a possibly ambiguous user answer. The all-tools and state-aware comparators receive
the intended goal as prompt context. A production assessment must separately test learned
ambiguity detection, actual user responses and the absence of such labels at inference time.
Open-world goals, imperfect state predicates and failed or nondeterministic tools remain explicit
limitations in the original paper. These limitations preserve the value of the design hypothesis
while preventing a claim that workflow goal validation solves general causal reasoning. (Rahul
Suresh Babu and Rohit Shukla, 2026a,b)

50.23.4     A public-evidence qualification route

Retain GIST-CMTF as a goal-contract and evaluation reference. Before proposing direct
integration, reconcile the exact generating revision, task schema, metric definitions, model
overrides and cleaning log. A project-owned prototype can then compare a label-free goal
classifier, a clarification policy, a simple lexical baseline and an explicitly named oracle
on held-out public or generated business requests. Freeze the scenario definitions before
outcome inspection; retain wrong goals, unsupported causal questions, nonresponses, retries
and abstentions in the full denominator. Actual clarification responses and their costs must
be represented, rather than silently replacing them with the correct goal. This protocol is
prospective; no model is invoked or downloaded code executed for this source review. (Rahul
Suresh Babu and Rohit Shukla, 2026a,b)
50.24. Natural-effect models need an expansion and uncertainty contract                       929


   An illustrative cost equation makes the missing economics concrete. Let ∆p be a descriptive
difference in success frequency, ∆T the additional tokens and ∆C the additional clarifications
per task. For stipulated success value v, token price cT and clarification cost cC , define
∆N = v∆p − cT ∆T − cC ∆C. The saved GIST versus top-goal averages give ∆p = 71/420,
∆T = 45979/420 and ∆C = 23/70. With v = 10 dollars and cT = 1/1000 dollar, clarification
cost USD 2 gives ∆N = 388021/420000 dollars, whereas cost USD 6 gives −163979/420000
dollars. These exact stipulated amounts illustrate a decision threshold; they do not estimate
bank ROI or causal performance gains. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026bt)
   The scientific owner remains responsible for translating a clarified business objective into
a causal estimand and diagram. The maintainer owns schema compatibility, raw traces and
versioned provenance; the operator owns the actual endpoint, authentication and measured
resource costs. A verified workflow predicate should record what evidence established it. It
must not transform a language model’s declaration that a goal or graph is correct into an
accepted scientific premise. The route is sufficiently concrete to justify a bounded prototype
proposal, while native capability, independent acceptance and broader frontier coverage remain
open.


50.24      Natural-effect models need an expansion and uncertainty
           contract
In a servicing proposal, a repayment holiday may change both immediate cash availability and
later contact engagement. An analyst may want to separate those pathways. The medflex
package offers natural-effect models using either predictions from an outcome working model
or ratio-of-mediator probability weights. Its inspected 0.6-11 sources provide a concrete
R implementation reference. The proposed boundary must retain the exposure, mediator,
baseline covariates, original subject identity and nested-outcome scale. Expanding a dataset
creates computational rows; it supplies neither new independent customers nor the scientific
assumptions needed to interpret a mediation contrast. (Johan Steen and medflex contributors,
2026)


50.24.1     A decomposition whose components depend on their definition

Write M (x) for a mediator under exposure x and Y (x, m) for an outcome under jointly
specified exposure and mediator. Define µ(x, a) = E{Y (x, M (a))}. A pure direct contrast is
µ(1, 0)−µ(0, 0), and its complementary total indirect contrast is µ(1, 1)−µ(1, 0). Another valid
algebraic decomposition uses µ(0, 1)−µ(0, 0) and µ(1, 1)−µ(0, 1). Both sum to µ(1, 1)−µ(0, 0),
but their individual terms need not coincide. These definitions are project notation; interpreting
them through observed data requires separate justification for the nested counterfactual law.
    For an explicit constructed example, let M (x) be binary with probabilities p0 = 1/5 and
p1 = 3/5, and stipulate Y (x, m) = 10 + 2x + 5m + 4xm. Direct enumeration gives µ(0, 0) = 11,
µ(1, 0) = 69/5, µ(0, 1) = 13 and µ(1, 1) = 87/5. The first decomposition is 14/5 + 18/5; the
second is 2 + 22/5. Their common total is 32/5. With stipulated value USD 10 per outcome
unit and total-policy cost USD 50, the total net is USD 14. Substituting the pure direct
component gives USD −22 and answers a different question. A natural-effect component is
not automatically a feasible intervention with the same implementation cost. The example
illustrates target discipline, not measured bank economics or an identification theorem. (Causal
banking proposal project, 2026bu)
930                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


50.24.2     What the inspected expansion actually preserves

The imputation interface expects exposure and mediator variables in a prespecified formula
order; its second predictor is the first mediator. The weighting interface similarly interprets the
first predictor as the exposure. A wrapper must inspect the resulting variable-type pointers,
factor levels and contrasts instead of relying on a reordered display formula. The expansion
implementation creates an identifier from original row names and joins hypothetical exposure
values to that identifier. Categorical exposures expand over their factor levels. Continuous
exposures use a specified replication count and either sampled values or conditional normal
quantiles, by default between the fifth and ninety-fifth percentiles. Those finite nodes do not
cover an unbounded distribution’s entire support. (Johan Steen and medflex contributors,
2026)
   The two paths are semantically distinct. Imputation predicts nested outcomes and assigns the
impData class. Weighting forms mediator probability or density ratios and assigns weightData.
The inspected expData help text reverses those class descriptions and describes row count
using length(data). The constructor paths and explicit subject-count checks should govern a
prospective adapter; the textual discrepancies do not establish an observed numerical failure.
The weighting path restricts the joint mediator request to one mediator with a warning, while
imputation has a distinct multiple-mediator path. One generic method label must not erase
that difference. (Johan Steen and medflex contributors, 2026)
   An exact probability example makes the denominator contract visible. If the binary mediator
probabilities are 1/5 and 3/5, the event ratio is 3 and the nonevent ratio is 1/2. Reversing the
ratio changes the weighting target. At zero denominator probability the ratio is undefined; a
production profile must specify overlap diagnostics and refusal rather than silently changing
the estimand through clipping. Optional exposure weights introduce another denominator
and another model. The inspected helper verifies exposure and covariate pointers, and
suppresses warnings around its final GLM call. Consequently, proposed validation must inspect
convergence, finite outputs, weights and model objects; the absence of a displayed warning is
insufficient. (Johan Steen and medflex contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project,
2026bu)


50.24.3     Full refitting and original-subject covariance

The default natural-effect fit requests 1,000 bootstrap replicates. Its bootstrap callback
resamples original data indices, refits the working model, maps each original index to its
expanded rows, refreshes the expansion’s predictions or weights, refits an optional exposure
model and refits the natural-effect model. This source path supports a full-refitting design; it
does not authorize freezing all first-stage fitted values in a wrapper. Its index arithmetic also
makes original ordering and constant replication count a contract to verify, especially after
missing-value handling, slicing or serialization. The helper recovers data by evaluating the
stored model call in the global environment, so a portable job needs explicit data custody and
reconstructed call bindings. (Johan Steen and medflex contributors, 2026)
   The robust branch accepts only GLM working models and restricts selected weighting/ex-
posure families to Gaussian, binomial or Poisson. It aggregates the expanded natural-effect
scores by original identifier, combines them with nuisance scores and includes off-diagonal
derivative blocks in the sandwich calculation. This is not the covariance from treating every
expanded row as an independent borrower. It also does not, by itself, justify arbitrary branch,
household or calendar dependence beyond the original-subject unit. The original mediator is
excluded from the final natural-effect formula; an imputation model that does not reflect the
final model structure generates an explicit warning. (Johan Steen and medflex contributors,
50.25. Controlled model writes preserve a conditional proof boundary                           931


2026)
  Two independent score examples show why these distinctions matter. Original subject scores
(−1, 1) give the empirical mean-score variance i s2i /n2 = 1/2. Duplicating each subject
                                              P
                                                                                     twice  
                                                                     1 −2
                                                                                      1 1/2
and treating four rows as independent gives 1/4. Separately let A = 0 1 and B = 1/2 1 .
The first diagonal element of A−1 BA−T is 7, versus 1 if the nuisance contribution is frozen.
These are exact stipulated score laws, not package outputs or measured finite-sample coverage.
The package’s bootstrap interval helper defaults to a normal interval; requesting a different
interval type is an explicit inference choice. (Johan Steen and medflex contributors, 2026;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026bu)


50.24.4     Reference decision and a bounded integration route

Retain the inspected package as a reference for natural-effect semantics, subject expansion and
full uncertainty propagation. An isolated R worker is a plausible future prototype route once
the complete artifact, environment, dependency notices and actual delivery rights are bound.
The GPL-2 declaration and a separately identified local license text do not clear transitive
rights. Direct adoption of every supported learner and mediator family is premature; a port
to Python, Java or C++ would also inherit dispatch, formula, missingness, bootstrap and
covariance maintenance obligations without a measured advantage. (Johan Steen and medflex
contributors, 2026)
   The initial qualification matrix should use binary exposure and one mediator, compare
weighting and imputation on an independently specified law, preserve the nested target and
link scale, and test subject permutation, duplicated rows, missingness and fresh-process data
binding. Compare bootstrap refitting against the robust branch only within their shared model
restrictions, retain seed and backend choices, and reject unsupported or nonfinite results with
complete diagnostics. More general mediation identification, clustered or longitudinal sampling
and empirical utility require separate evidence. This reference decision approves no native
adapter and establishes no implemented banking capability.


50.25      Controlled model writes preserve a conditional proof
           boundary
A credit agent may correctly execute a rule after incorrectly reading its premise. For example,
an admitted statement that an account is in arrears may trigger a valid collection rule even when
the underlying record does not support that statement. CPUNeSy addresses the admission
boundary between language-model proposals and a symbolic executor. Its inspected September
2026 arXiv original separates source checking, restricted predicate writes, derivation verification
and selective serving. The paper’s running header claims a 2027 conference publication; that
self-description is not independently verified acceptance as of the literature cutoff. The evidence
here is the versioned original and its explicit assumptions and reported observations. (Zeyan
Li and Siyuan Qiu and Shuai Zhao and Jianfeng Xu, 2026)


50.25.1     What can be certified, and what remains a premise

Let St be admitted source units, Γt = At ∪ Rt the active facts and rules, and Cn(Γt ) their
closure in a declared decidable Horn fragment. The source mode of the proposed gate checks
type and source support before admitting a unit. Its derived mode requires a complete acyclic
witness rooted at the claimed conclusion, checks every edge and refuses a witness exceeding a
932                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


declared depth budget. Certificates retain dependencies and checker versions; a source erasure
requires eviction or revalidation of affected cached consequences. The paper’s state-soundness
result assumes a sound source checker and a sound fragment verifier. Its induction establishes
the stated invariant under those assumptions. It explicitly says that source soundness has not
been established for the experimental natural-language checkers. (Zeyan Li and Siyuan Qiu
and Shuai Zhao and Jianfeng Xu, 2026)
   A narrower invariant is available without statistical independence. If the allowed source
vocabulary Ω excludes every rule-head predicate, a direct write of an intermediate or target
predicate is rejected. It does not follow that every admitted leaf is true. In an independently
authored toy rule, arrears ⇒ deny, admit only arrears as a writable source predicate.
Directly writing deny is then impossible, but a false admitted arrears premise still derives
it. The proposed banking contract should therefore record both derivation status and source-
support status. Neither status establishes an intervention estimand, an adjustment set or the
truth of a borrower causal diagram. (Zeyan Li and Siyuan Qiu and Shuai Zhao and Jianfeng
Xu, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026bq)
   The voting argument likewise retains its sampling assumptions. It separates a shared-error
query mass β from a regime with independent slips. Conditional independence across traces is
required for its concentration bounds, including within the shared-error regime. Two agreeing
calls do not estimate β or establish those assumptions. A stipulated example with β = 1/5, a
common wrong answer on that mass and independent slip probability 1/10 elsewhere gives
two-vote wrong, correct and abstained probabilities 26/125, 81/125 and 18/125. Answered risk
is 26/107. Three-vote majority error is 139/625; arbitrarily many independent votes within
each regime still leave error floor 1/5. More calls can reduce random slips while preserving a
shared semantic mistake. (Zeyan Li and Siyuan Qiu and Shuai Zhao and Jianfeng Xu, 2026;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026bq)


50.25.2    Execution, checking and fallback are different comparisons

The reported L1-HARD ablation gives 98.8% full-pool accuracy for a one-vote uncertified solver
and 97.1% for the restricted two-vote policy. The paper reports no statistically significant
paired difference and correctly avoids claiming equivalence. Much of the improvement over
neural controls is attributed to deterministic execution, while certification changes the error–
abstention tradeoff. These observations do not isolate checking when the number of grounding
calls changes. A separate fixed-trace comparison on ContractNLI supplies the more relevant
check-versus-agreement evidence. (Zeyan Li and Siyuan Qiu and Shuai Zhao and Jianfeng Xu,
2026)
   For the reported DeepSeek pool of 2,091 items, agreement yields 1,533 correct, 252 wrong
and 306 abstained results. Source rechecking yields 1,482 correct, 189 wrong and 420 abstained.
It removes 63 wrong answers but also withholds 51 correct answers, adding 114 abstentions.
The corresponding answered risks are 12/85 and 63/557, while full-pool accuracy falls by
51/2091. These arithmetic checks reproduce printed counts; they do not rerun raw records
or demonstrate a population guarantee. The Seed pool has a different denominator, so the
two columns are not a paired model contest. (Zeyan Li and Siyuan Qiu and Shuai Zhao and
Jianfeng Xu, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026bq)
   Fallback is a further policy. The paper’s MedCalc native channel has high answered
accuracy but substantial abstention; routing withheld requests to an uncertified same-model
fallback increases full-pool accuracy. The fallback outputs must retain their uncertified status.
A CLI/MCP result should expose which channel served each answer, the full attempted
denominator, source checker identity and uncertainty about semantic support. A single success
50.26. Policy evaluation software must preserve the decision and its uncertainty             933


flag would hide the tradeoff that motivates the design. (Zeyan Li and Siyuan Qiu and Shuai
Zhao and Jianfeng Xu, 2026)
   There is also a material comparator qualification inside the original. The main public-
benchmark table includes Logic-LM, DetermLR, LINC, SymbCoT, LINA, HBLR and MenTaL
rows. The appendix repeats those rows as historical adapter summaries whose per-row split
identifiers, model profiles and exact denominators are unspecified, explicitly excluding them
from primary comparative claims. Thus the main table and its broad ranking prose cannot
support a matched superiority claim over those systems. Very low historical scores also lack a
breakdown of parsing, solver and executable-answer errors. The comparison here retains the
reported rows with this limit and draws no ranking from their apparently common columns.
(Zeyan Li and Siyuan Qiu and Shuai Zhao and Jianfeng Xu, 2026)


50.25.3     A prospective banking protocol and its cost boundary

The internal hypothesis protocol has no independently verified preregistration timestamp.
Complete per-query certificate archival was not instrumented in every adapter; model caches
lack consistent sampling dates and immutable revisions. The paper describes an offline audit
package, but the inspected PDF does not establish custody of that package in this project. Its
coverage bound is not empirically instantiated from step-level channel rates, and independence
remains unverified. Candidate-pool restriction and token savings must also be separated from
physical storage compression: reported bounded redundancy is 37.1% in the mathematical
corpus and 0.60% in the legal corpus, below the internal 50% target. Physical index-byte
savings and the scheduler-specific crossover remain unmeasured. (Zeyan Li and Siyuan Qiu
and Shuai Zhao and Jianfeng Xu, 2026)
   A bounded prototype can nevertheless test a concrete question. Freeze a public or generated
banking rule corpus with explicit leaf facts, source spans, admissible predicates and known
interventions before held-out queries. Compare an unrestricted translator plus solver, restricted
writes, fixed-trace source rechecking and a separately labeled fallback. Inject both prohibited
target writes and false but well-typed leaves. Test dependency deletion, changed-source cache
invalidation, missing evidence, contradictory records, abstention and full failure reporting.
Independent labels must judge source faithfulness separately from formal derivability. This is
a prospective proposal, not an implemented source checker or live-model trial. (Zeyan Li and
Siyuan Qiu and Shuai Zhao and Jianfeng Xu, 2026)
   For a transparent economic decision, let cW price a wrong served answer, cA an abstention
and C the additional total checking cost. Using the printed DeepSeek changes, loss savings
are 63cW − 114cA − C. Stipulating cW = 10 dollars and C = 100 dollars gives USD 302 at
cA = 2 and USD −154 at cA = 6. The change of sign illustrates why accepted-answer precision
alone is not an investment criterion. The costs are invented inputs for the displayed example,
explicitly editable in the independent reference; no bank value or causal performance gain is
estimated. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026bq)


50.26       Policy evaluation software must preserve the decision
            and its uncertainty
A servicing team may use an offline policy evaluation library to compare a sequence of
reminders, forbearance offers and escalations. The useful output is the value of a specified
feasible policy under an information clock, together with defensible uncertainty. A function
returning a ranking is only one part of that task. SCOPE-RL provides a particularly useful
934                                                                        Causal analysis for a universal bank


proposal comparator because its selected discrete estimators, interval helpers and policy-
selection paths make several boundaries explicit. This review concerns version 0.2.1 at the
immutable 1 December 2023 revision returned by the cutoff query. Eleven authenticated source
and declaration files support the following observations; the continuous-action, distributional
and density-learning families have not received equivalent inspection. No upstream program
was executed. Haruka Kiyohara and SCOPE-RL contributors (2023)

simple uncertainty examples below is additional to this identification argument.

50.26.2     Terminal rewards and uncertainty cannot be inferred from names

The high-level evaluator defaults to disabling rewards after a done flag. The actual mask is the
cumulative product of 1 − dt , including the current row. If a dataset defines dt as indicating
that the transition just produced the terminal reward, this removes that terminal reward as
well. A different pre-transition convention could justify the mask; the adapter must state
and test the convention. With undiscounted rewards (2, 8) and flags (0, 1), the literal mask
leaves value 2, whereas retaining the terminal receipt gives 10. At a stipulated servicing cost
of six dollars, the margins are −4 and 4. These are authored examples, not measured bank
returns or observed package outputs. The dataset documentation separately describes episode
end and maximum-step termination, while the fitted-Q dataset call passes the done array
as its terminal argument. A conversion must resolve both meanings. Haruka Kiyohara and
SCOPE-RL contributors (2023); Causal banking proposal project (2026ca)
   The basic estimator’s interval method first calculates one score per trajectory and delegates
the resulting vector to a common interval helper. The bootstrap helper samples those fixed
scores with replacement, takes percentile endpoints, and reports the mean of bootstrap means.
Its signature defaults to 100 replications although its parameter prose says 10,000, and it
requires an explicit random seed. Neither this helper nor the selected call refits the value
model, estimates new logging propensities or repeats policy learning in each bootstrap sample.
Whether conditioning on those fits is scientifically appropriate needs a separate argument; it is
not supplied by the word bootstrap.Haruka Kiyohara and SCOPE-RL contributors (2023)
   This distinction already matters without a learned nuisance. For a self-normalized weighted
mean, let two episode weights be (1, 3) and returns (0, 4). Ignoring the implementation’s tiny
denominator stabilizer solely for this exact algebraic illustration, the estimate is 3 and the
precomputed normalized scores are (0, 6). The four equally likely size-two bootstrap index
pairs produce means (0, 3, 3, 6) if these scores are fixed, but ratios (0, 3, 3, 4) if the denominator
is recalculated. Their bootstrap variances are 9/2 and 9/4. This is not a coverage assessment
of either procedure; it shows that they are different resampling targets. The selected self-
normalized class inherits the score-based interval path and uses a 10−10 denominator stabilizer.
A native test must retain that stabilizer, distinguish ratio recalculation from score resampling,
and state which procedure is justified. Haruka Kiyohara and SCOPE-RL contributors (2023);
Causal banking proposal project (2026ca)
  Three analytic interval helpers need particularly careful admission. The Hoeffding-named
helper computes the radius               q

   The Bernstein-named helper also differs from its printed variance expression: the executable

50.26.3     A selection benchmark is not an offline safety certificate

The inspected lower-bound selector obtains on-policy selection results before ranking candidate
interval endpoints, even when the requested output omits evaluation metrics. The called
routine rejects a missing on-policy return array. This is a concrete benchmark-data requirement:
a logged-only banking request generally cannot furnish those counterfactual returns. Missing
truth must lead to a refusal or a separately designed selection path, never fabricated on-
policy values. The selected call forwards the same alpha to each candidate and estimator; no
multiplicity adjustment appears in this path. Even twenty independent tests with individual
false-admission probability 0.05 have probability 1 − 0.9520 , approximately 0.642, of at least
one false admission. That hypothetical example is not a measured SCOPE-RL error rate. A
candidate policy learned or selected on the evaluation histories requires its own selection-aware
design.Haruka Kiyohara and SCOPE-RL contributors (2023); Causal banking proposal project
(2026ca)
   The ground-truth lower-quartile output also needs a name/value fixture. The source sorts
the policy-value array before deriving a lower-quartile name ordering, then sorts lower-quartile
values separately. In input order A, B, give A returns (−10, −10, 40, 40) and B returns
(4, 4, 4, 4). Their means are 15, 4, but lower quartiles are −10, 4. The selected expressions
pair the unchanged name order A, B with descending values 4, −10, rather than the correct
lower-tail name order B, A. The static witness is sufficient to require an identity-preserving
test; native behavior in a frozen dependency environment has not been measured. A printed
safety or regret column must also preserve the source’s explicit true-safe and estimated-
safe denominators instead of relying on generic type-I/type-II labels.Haruka Kiyohara and
SCOPE-RL contributors (2023); Causal banking proposal project (2026ca)
   The proposal disposition is therefore reference, with no approved native adapter. SCOPE-
RL’s explicit trajectory scores, fitted-value preparation and evaluation organization inform
a narrow design. Whole-package adoption would admit much more functionality than the
inspected contract. A Python worker is a candidate only after complete artifact and dependency
custody, terminal/time fixtures, interval repair review and fresh native conformance. Porting
the package to R, Java or C++ currently has no demonstrated advantage sufficient to justify
reproducing its preprocessing, model delegates and maintenance burden. Independent exact
references are valuable test oracles; they do not replace the package or establish empirical
50.27. Contextual bandit reuse requires a different contract from sequential servicing             937


policy performance.
   The source declares Apache 2.0 and includes the license text, but this does not clear
transitive dependencies, datasets or deployment terms. The requirements span NumPy, SciPy,
pandas, scikit-learn, plotting libraries, torch, d3rlpy, Gym/Gymnasium and Hydra; most are
lower bounds, not a reproducible environment lock. Named authors and the dated revision
establish identity, not a current support commitment. The maintenance owner must resolve
actual dependency versions and rights; the scientific owner must define target, logging truth,
support and sampling law; the operator must measure resource and recovery cost. Haruka
Kiyohara and SCOPE-RL contributors (2023)
   A proposed library/CLI/MCP request should carry immutable episode IDs, decision times,
the information set, reward/termination conventions, action vocabulary, logging and target
probabilities, policy/training identities, horizon, discount, uncertainty method and random
seed. Its response should preserve the target, score definition, source revision, refusal reason,
finite-weight diagnostics and whether uncertainty is conditional on fitted quantities. An agent
must not convert a schema-valid answer into an identified effect or a safety approval. Public
qualification can begin with finite known-policy trajectory laws and adversarial permutations,
missing propensities, terminal rewards, signed returns, shared calendar shocks and policy-
selection leakage. Fresh native tests and measured costs follow only in a reviewed environment;
bank truth and adoption remain later independent gates.


50.27       Contextual bandit reuse requires a different contract
            from sequential servicing
A one-time offer allocation and a sequence of collection decisions are different causal products.
Open Bandit Pipeline (OBP) is a useful comparator for the former: the inspected core orga-
nizes logged contextual-bandit observations, target action distributions, propensity-weighted
estimators, response regressions and evaluation wrappers. It does not convert repeated cus-
tomer histories into a qualified longitudinal policy analysis merely because each history can be
flattened into rows. The selected revision is dated 5 November 2022, declares version 0.5.5 and
is the revision returned by the cutoff query. Eleven authentic source/declaration files support
this profile; slate, continuous-action, multiple-logger and action-embedding estimators need
separate review. Yuta Saito and Open Bandit Pipeline contributors (2022)

   Consider two equally common customer types. For type zero, the logging probability of
offer one is 1/4 and rewards under offers zero and one are (0, 2). For type one, the logging
probability is 3/4 and rewards are (1, 5). The target always gives offer one. Its value is
7/2, and exact weighting recovers that value. Clipping the importance ratio at two gives 3;
substituting a uniform logging probability gives 17/4. At ten dollars per reward unit and
a stipulated offer cost of 32 dollars, the respective margins are 3, −2 and 10.50. An exact
